title: Tray icon & automatic startup(托盘图标与自动启动)
full:
Automatic startup and better integration with the system tray was introduced in v0.104.0. Versions prior to that only have the system tray option which could be found in Options(选项) → Others. 注意：自动启动与更好的系统托盘集成自 v0.104.0 起引入。此前的版本只有系统托盘选项，可在Options(选项) → 其他（Others） 中找到。

Tray icon / 托盘图标

The desktop application has native integration with the system tray on all operating systems. 桌面应用在所有操作系统上都与系统托盘进行了原生集成。

The tray icon is enabled by default, but it can be toggled from Options(选项) → Desktop. 托盘图标默认启用，可在Options(选项) → 桌面（Desktop） 中开关。

The tray icon has the following functionality: 托盘图标具有以下功能：

  • When clicked, the last window is hidden (minimized to the tray icon). Clicking it again will reveal that window.
  • 单击时，最近的窗口会被隐藏（最小化到托盘图标）。再次单击将重新显示该窗口。
  • Right clicking reveals the following options:
  • 右键单击显示以下选项：
    • Each window can be individually shown or hidden, identified by their active note.
    • 每个窗口可按其当前激活的笔记进行识别，并可单独显示或隐藏。
    • New windows can be opened.
    • 可以打开新窗口。
    • A new note can be created directly, which will be created in the Note Inbox(笔记收件箱) (or Day Notes(日记) if an inbox is not available).
    • 可以直接创建新笔记，会创建在Note Inbox(笔记收件箱)中（如果没有收件箱，则创建在Day Notes(日记)）。
    • Today's day note can be opened.
    • 可以打开今天的每日笔记。
    • Bookmarks and recent notes are displayed in a sub-menu and clicking them navigates to that note.
    • 书签与最近笔记显示在子菜单中，点击即可跳转到对应笔记。
    • Quitting the application.
    • 退出应用。

Closing to system tray / 关闭到系统托盘

This is an option which is not enabled by default and it allows a specific behavior: instead of exiting the application when the last window has been closed, the last window is instead hidden with the tray icon remaining available. 这是一个默认未启用的选项，它允许一种特殊行为：当最后一个窗口关闭时不再退出应用，而是将最后一个窗口隐藏，同时托盘图标保持可用。

This option requires the tray icon to be enabled, otherwise it has no effect. 此选项要求托盘图标已启用，否则不生效。

Automatic startup / 自动启动

Two options control the automatic startup functionality in Options(选项) → Startup: Options(选项) → 启动（Startup） 中有两个选项控制自动启动功能：

  • When Launch on startup is enabled, the application will automatically start up when logging into the current user.
    • Note that on Linux support depends on the desktop environment. Feel free to report any issues.
  • 启用 登录时启动（Launch on startup） 后，应用会在当前用户登录时自动启动。
    • 请注意，在 Linux 上该支持取决于桌面环境。如有任何问题，欢迎提交报告。
  • If Start minimized to tray is also enabled, the application will start up in the background and can be revealed from the tray icon.
    • This only applies if Launch on startup is enabled, manual starts are not impacted by this option.
  • 如果同时启用 最小化到托盘启动（Start minimized to tray），应用将在后台启动，并可从托盘图标重新显示。
    • 这仅在启用 登录时启动 时生效，手动启动不受此选项影响。

title: Synchronization(同步)
full:
Trilium is an offline-first note-taking application that stores all data locally on the desktop client. However, it also offers the option to set up synchronization with a server instance, allowing multiple desktop clients to sync with a central server. This creates a star-shaped topology: Trilium 是一款离线优先的笔记应用，所有数据都存储在桌面客户端本地。不过，它也提供与服务器实例设置同步的选项，允许多个桌面客户端与中心服务器同步。这形成了星形拓扑：

In this setup, a central server (referred to as the sync server) and multiple client (or desktop) instances synchronize with the sync server. Once configured, synchronization is automatic and ongoing, requiring no manual intervention. 在这种配置中，一个中心服务器（称为 同步服务器）和多个 客户端（或 桌面）实例与同步服务器同步。配置完成后，同步是自动且持续的，无需手动干预。

Setting Up Synchronization / 设置同步

Security Considerations / 安全注意事项

Setting up the server securely is critical and can be complex. It is crucial to use a valid TLS certificate (HTTPS) rather than an unencrypted HTTP connection to ensure security and avoid potential vulnerabilities. 安全地配置服务器至关重要，也可能比较复杂。务必使用有效的 TLS 证书（HTTPS），而不是未加密的 HTTP 连接，以确保安全并避免潜在漏洞。

Synchronizing a Desktop Instance with a Sync Server / 将桌面实例与同步服务器同步

This method is used when you already have a desktop instance of Trilium and want to set up a sync server on your web host. 当你已经有一个 Trilium 桌面实例，并希望在 Web 主机上设置同步服务器时，使用此方法。

  1. Server Deployment: Ensure your server instance is deployed but uninitialized.
  2. Desktop Configuration: Open your desktop instance, navigate to Options -> Sync tab -> Sync configuration, and set the "Server instance address" to your sync server's address. Click Save.
  3. 服务器部署：确保你的服务器实例已部署但尚未初始化。
  4. 桌面配置：打开桌面实例，进入 选项（Options）→ 同步（Sync）标签 → 同步配置（Sync configuration），将"服务器实例地址"设为你的同步服务器地址。点击保存。

  1. Testing Sync: Click the "Test sync" button to verify the connection to the sync server. If successful, the client will start pushing all data to the server instance. This process may take some time, but you can continue using Trilium. Periodically check the server instance to confirm when the sync is complete. Once finished, you should see the login screen on the server.
  2. 测试同步：点击"测试同步（Test sync）"按钮验证与同步服务器的连接。如果成功，客户端将开始把所有数据推送到服务器实例。这个过程可能需要一些时间，但你仍可继续使用 Trilium。定期检查服务器实例以确认同步何时完成。完成后，你应该会在服务器上看到登录界面。

Synchronizing a Desktop Instance from a Sync Server / 从同步服务器同步桌面实例

This method is used when you already have a sync server and want to configure a new desktop instance to sync with it. 当你已经有一个同步服务器，并希望配置新的桌面实例与之同步时，使用此方法。

  1. Desktop Setup: Follow the desktop installation page.
  2. Initial Configuration: When prompted, choose the option to set up sync with a sync server.
  3. 桌面设置：按照桌面安装页操作。
  4. 初始配置：当提示时，选择与同步服务器设置同步的选项。

  1. Server Details: Configure the Trilium server address and enter the correct username and password for authentication.
  2. Finish Setup: Click the "Finish setup" button. If successful, you will see the following screen:
  3. 服务器信息：配置 Trilium 服务器地址，并输入正确的用户名和密码进行认证。
  4. 完成设置：点击"完成设置（Finish setup）"按钮。如果成功，你将看到以下界面：

Once synchronization is complete, you will be automatically redirected to the Trilium application. 同步完成后，你将自动被重定向到 Trilium 应用。

Desktop-to-desktop sync / 桌面到桌面同步

This method allows two desktop instances to synchronize between each other without requiring a Server Installation. 此方法允许两个桌面实例之间直接同步，而无需Server Installation。

Since v0.104.0, LAN access needs to be enabled to allow this sync to function. See Network Access for information on how to do so. 警告：自 v0.104.0 起，需要启用局域网访问才能让此同步生效。如何操作请参见Network Access。

Proxy Configuration / 代理配置

Two proxy setups are supported: 支持两种代理配置：

  • Explicit Proxy Configuration: Set the proxy server in Options / Sync. Only unauthenticated proxy servers are supported.
  • System Proxy Settings: If no proxy server is explicitly configured, Trilium will use the system proxy settings.
  • 显式代理配置：在 选项（Options）/ 同步（Sync）中设置代理服务器。仅支持无需认证的代理服务器。
  • 系统代理设置：如果没有显式配置代理服务器，Trilium 将使用系统代理设置。

Troubleshooting / 故障排查

Date/Time Synchronization / 日期/时间同步

For successful synchronization, both client and server must have the same date and time, with a tolerance of up to five minutes. 要实现成功同步，客户端和服务器必须具有相同的日期和时间，容差最多五分钟。

Certificate Issues / 证书问题

When using TLS, Trilium will verify the server certificate. If verification fails (e.g., due to self-signed certificates or certain corporate proxies), you can run the Trilium client with the NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED environment variable set to 0: 使用 TLS 时，Trilium 会验证服务器证书。如果验证失败（例如由于自签名证书或某些公司代理），你可以将 NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED 环境变量设为 0 来运行 Trilium 客户端：

export NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0

This will disable TLS certificate verification, significantly reducing security and exposing the setup to MITM attacks. It is strongly recommended to use a valid signed server certificate. Newer Trilium versions include a script called trilium-no-cert-check.sh for this purpose. 这会禁用 TLS 证书验证，显著降低安全性，使配置暴露于中间人（MITM）攻击。强烈建议使用有效的签名服务器证书。较新的 Trilium 版本为此包含一个名为 trilium-no-cert-check.sh 的脚本。

Conflict Resolution / 冲突解决

If you edit the same note on multiple instances before synchronization, Trilium resolves conflicts by retaining the newer change and discarding the older one. The older version remains accessible in note revisions, allowing data recovery if needed. 如果你在同步之前在多个实例上编辑同一笔记，Trilium 通过保留较新的更改并丢弃较旧的更改来解决冲突。旧版本仍可在笔记修订中访问，以便在需要时恢复数据。

Hash Check / 哈希校验

After each synchronization, Trilium computes a hash of all synced data on both the client and the sync server. If there is a discrepancy, Trilium will automatically initiate a recovery mechanism to resolve the issue. 每次同步后，Trilium 会在客户端和同步服务器上计算所有同步数据的哈希。如果存在差异，Trilium 将自动启动恢复机制来解决问题。

title: Mobile Frontend(移动端前端)
full:
Trilium has a mobile web frontend which is optimized for touch based devices - smartphones and tablets. It is activated automatically during login process based on browser detection. Trilium 有一个针对触屏设备（智能手机和平板电脑）优化的移动 Web 前端。它会根据浏览器检测在登录过程中自动激活。

Mobile frontend is limited in features compared to the full desktop version. See below for more details on this. 与完整的桌面版相比，移动前端在功能上有所限制。详见下文。

Layout basics / 布局基础

Unlike the desktop version, the mobile version has a slightly different UI meant to better fit the constrained screens of a mobile phone. 与桌面版不同，移动版有一个略有不同的界面，旨在更好地适应手机受限的屏幕。

Here is a non-exhaustive list of differences between the desktop version and the mobile one: 以下是桌面版与移动版之间的一些差异（非详尽列表）：

  • The Note Tree is displayed as a sidebar. To display the sidebar, press the button in the top-left of the screen.
    • There is also a swipe gesture that can be done from the left of the screen, but the browser's navigation gesture interferes with it most of the time (depending on the platform).
    • Press and hold a note to display the Note tree contextual menu.
  • The Quick search bar is also displayed at the top of the note tree.
  • The full Search function can be triggered either from either the Global menu or from the Launch Bar, if configured.
  • The Launch Bar is displayed at the bottom of the screen.
    • The launch bar uses a different configuration for icons than the desktop version. See the dedicated page for more information on how to configure it.
  • Most of the note-related actions are grouped in the horizontal dots icon on the top-right of the note.
  • The Tabs are grouped under a tab switcher in the Launch Bar, where the tabs are displayed in a full-screen grid with preview for easy switching, as well as additional options such as reopening closed tabs.
  • Since v0.100.0, Split View can also be used in mobile view, but with a maximum of two panes at once. The splits are displayed vertically instead of horizontally.
  • Starting with v0.102.0, the New Layout is enforced on mobile. This brings features such as the note badges, note type switcher or collection properties which would otherwise not be available.
  • Note Tree以侧边栏形式显示。要显示侧边栏，请按下屏幕左上角的按钮。
    • 也可以从屏幕左侧进行滑动手势，但浏览器的导航手势大多数时候会干扰它（取决于平台）。
    • 长按笔记可显示Note tree contextual menu。
  • Quick search栏也显示在笔记树顶部。
  • 完整的Search功能可以从Global menu或（如果配置了）Launch Bar触发。
  • Launch Bar显示在屏幕底部。
    • 启动栏的图标配置与桌面版不同。有关如何配置的更多信息，请参见专门页面。
  • 大多数与笔记相关的操作被分组到笔记右上角的横向圆点图标中。
  • Tabs被分组到Launch Bar中的标签切换器下，标签页以全屏网格加预览的方式显示以便轻松切换，并提供重新打开已关闭标签等额外选项。
  • 自 v0.100.0 起，Split View也可在移动视图中使用，但一次最多两个窗格。分屏改为垂直显示而非水平。
  • 从 v0.102.0 开始，New Layout在移动端强制启用。这带来了笔记徽章、笔记类型切换器或集合属性等功能，否则这些功能将不可用。

Installing as a PWA / 作为 PWA 安装

The mobile view can be set up as a PWA. While this does not offer any offline capabilities, it will display the application in full-screen and makes it easy to access via your mobile phone's home screen. 移动视图可以设置为 PWA。虽然这不提供任何离线能力，但它会以全屏方式显示应用，并让你可以通过手机主屏幕轻松访问。

On iOS with Safari / 在 iOS 上使用 Safari

  1. Open your default web browser and access your Trilium instance.
  2. Login.
  3. Press the […] button in the bottom-right of the screen and select Share.
  4. Scroll down to reveal the full list of items and choose "Add to Home Screen".
  5. Press "Add" and the web app will be available.
  6. 打开默认 Web 浏览器并访问你的 Trilium 实例。
  7. 登录。
  8. 按下屏幕右下角的 […] 按钮并选择共享（Share）。
  9. 向下滚动以显示完整项目列表，选择"添加到主屏幕（Add to Home Screen）"。
  10. 按下"添加（Add）"，Web 应用即可使用。

On Android with Google Chrome / 在 Android 上使用 Google Chrome

Google Chrome requires the server to be served over HTTPS in order to display in full-screen. If using HTTP, the app will appear like a normal web page (similar to a bookmark). 重要：Google Chrome 要求服务器通过 HTTPS 提供服务才能全屏显示。如果使用 HTTP，应用将看起来像一个普通网页（类似书签）。

  1. Open your default web browser and access your Trilium instance.
  2. Login.
  3. Press the three vertical dots icon in the top-right of the screen and select Add to Home screen.
  4. Select the Install option.
  5. Select an appropriate name.
  6. The web app will appear as an application, not on the home screen.
  7. 打开默认 Web 浏览器并访问你的 Trilium 实例。
  8. 登录。
  9. 按下屏幕右上角的三竖点图标，选择 添加到主屏幕（Add to Home screen）。
  10. 选择 安装（Install） 选项。
  11. 选择适当的名称。
  12. Web 应用将作为应用出现（而非放在主屏幕上）。

On Android with Brave / 在 Android 上使用 Brave

Brave requires the server to be served over HTTPS in order to display in full-screen. If using HTTP, the app will appear like a normal web page (similar to a bookmark). 重要：Brave 要求服务器通过 HTTPS 提供服务才能全屏显示。如果使用 HTTP，应用将看起来像一个普通网页（类似书签）。

  1. Open your default web browser and access your Trilium instance.
  2. Login.
  3. Press the three vertical dots icon in the bottom-right of the screen and select Add to Home screen.
  4. Press the Install option.
  5. The web app will appear as an application, not on the home screen.
  6. 打开默认 Web 浏览器并访问你的 Trilium 实例。
  7. 登录。
  8. 按下屏幕右下角的三竖点图标，选择 添加到主屏幕（Add to Home screen）。
  9. 按下 安装（Install） 选项。
  10. Web 应用将作为应用出现（而非放在主屏幕上）。

On Samsung Browser / 在三星浏览器上

  1. Open your default web browser and access your Trilium instance.
  2. Login.
  3. Press the hamburger menu in the bottom-right of the screen.
  4. Select Add to, followed by Home screen.
  5. Press Add and the web app will appear on the home page.
  6. 打开默认 Web 浏览器并访问你的 Trilium 实例。
  7. 登录。
  8. 按下屏幕右下角的汉堡菜单。
  9. 选择 添加到（Add to），然后选择 主屏幕（Home screen）。
  10. 按下 添加（Add），Web 应用将出现在主页面上。

Testing via the desktop application / 通过桌面应用测试

If you are running Trilium without a dedicated server installation, you can still test the mobile application using the desktop application. For more information, see Using the desktop application as a server. To access it go to http://<ip>:37840/login?mobile . 如果你在没有专门服务器安装的情况下运行 Trilium，你仍然可以使用桌面应用测试移动应用。更多信息参见Using the desktop application as a server。要访问它，请访问 http://<ip>:37840/login?mobile。

Forcing mobile/desktop frontend / 强制移动/桌面前端

Trilium decides automatically whether to use mobile or desktop front-end. If this is not appropriate, you can use ?mobile or ?desktopquery param on login page (Note: you might need to log out). Trilium 会自动决定使用移动端还是桌面端前端。如果这不符合需要，你可以在登录页面使用 ?mobile 或 ?desktop 查询参数（注意：你可能需要先登出）。

Alternatively, simply select Switch to Mobile/Desktop Version in the Global menu. 或者，只需在Global menu中选择 切换到移动/桌面版（Switch to Mobile/Desktop Version）。

Scripting / 脚本

You can alter the behavior with Scripting, just like for normal frontend. For script notes to be executed, they need to have labeled #run=mobileStartup. 你可以像普通前端一样，通过Scripting更改行为。脚本笔记要被执行，需要带有 #run=mobileStartup 标签。

Custom Launch Bar widgets are also supported. 也支持自定义Launch Bar小组件。

title: Web Clipper(网页剪藏)
full:
Trilium Web Clipper is a web browser extension which allows user to clip text, screenshots, whole pages and short notes and save them directly to Trilium Notes. Trilium Web Clipper 是一个 Web 浏览器扩展，允许用户剪藏文本、截图、整页和短笔记，并直接保存到 Trilium Notes。

Supported browsers / 支持的浏览器

Trilium Web Clipper officially supports the following web browsers: Trilium Web Clipper 官方支持以下 Web 浏览器：

  • Mozilla Firefox, using Manifest v2.
  • Google Chrome, using Manifest v3. Theoretically the extension should work on other Chromium-based browsers as well, but they are not officially supported.
  • Mozilla Firefox，使用 Manifest v2。
  • Google Chrome，使用 Manifest v3。理论上该扩展也应该能在其他基于 Chromium 的浏览器上运行，但官方并不支持它们。

Obtaining the extension / 获取扩展

The extension is available from the official browser web stores: 该扩展可从官方浏览器应用商店获取：

  • Firefox: Trilium Web Clipper on Firefox Add-ons
  • Chrome: Trilium Web Clipper on Chrome Web Store
  • Firefox：Firefox 附加组件上的 Trilium Web Clipper
  • Chrome：Chrome 网上应用店上的 Trilium Web Clipper

Functionality / 功能

  • select text and clip it with the right-click context menu
  • click on an image or link and save it through context menu
  • save whole page from the popup or context menu
  • save screenshot (with crop tool) from either popup or context menu
  • create short text note from popup
  • 选择文本并通过右键上下文菜单剪藏
  • 点击图片或链接并通过上下文菜单保存
  • 从弹窗或上下文菜单保存整页
  • 从弹窗或上下文菜单保存截图（带裁剪工具）
  • 从弹窗创建短文本笔记

Location of clippings / 剪藏的位置

Trilium will save these clippings as a new child note under a "clipper inbox" note. Trilium 会将这些剪藏作为"剪藏收件箱（clipper inbox）"笔记下的新子笔记保存。

By default, that's the Day Notes but you can override that by setting the label clipperInbox, on any other note. 默认情况下，那是Day Notes，但你可以在任何其他笔记上设置 clipperInbox 标签来覆盖它。

If there's multiple clippings from the same page (and on the same day), then they will be added to the same note. 如果来自同一页面（且在同一天）有多个剪藏，它们将被添加到同一笔记中。

Keyboard shortcuts / 键盘快捷键

Keyboard shortcuts are available for most functions: 大多数功能都有键盘快捷键：

  • Save selected text: Ctrl+Shift+S (Mac: ⌘+⇧+S)
  • Save whole page: Alt+Shift+S (Mac: ⌥+⇧+S)
  • Save screenshot: Ctrl+Shift+E (Mac: ⌘+⇧+E)
  • 保存选中文本：Ctrl+Shift+S（Mac：⌘+⇧+S）
  • 保存整页：Alt+Shift+S（Mac：⌥+⇧+S）
  • 保存截图：Ctrl+Shift+E（Mac：⌘+⇧+E）

To set custom shortcuts, follow the directions for your browser. 要设置自定义快捷键，请遵循你所用浏览器的说明。

  • Firefox: about:addons → Gear icon ⚙️ → Manage extension shortcuts
  • Chrome: chrome://extensions/shortcuts
  • Firefox：about:addons → 齿轮图标 ⚙️ → 管理扩展快捷键（Manage extension shortcuts）
  • Chrome：chrome://extensions/shortcuts

On Firefox, the default shortcuts interfere with some browser features. As such, the keyboard combinations will not trigger the Web Clipper action. To fix this, simply change the keyboard shortcut to something that works. The defaults will be adjusted in future versions. 注意：在 Firefox 上，默认快捷键会干扰某些浏览器功能。因此，这些组合键不会触发 Web Clipper 操作。要解决此问题，只需把快捷键改成可用的组合即可。默认值将在未来版本中调整。

Configuration / 配置

The extension needs to connect to a running Trilium instance. By default, it scans a port range on the local computer to find a desktop Trilium instance. 该扩展需要连接到一个正在运行的 Trilium 实例。默认情况下，它会扫描本地计算机上的端口范围以查找桌面 Trilium 实例。

It's also possible to configure the server address if you don't run the desktop application, or want it to work without the desktop application running. 如果你不运行桌面应用，或希望它在没有桌面应用运行的情况下也能工作，也可以配置服务器地址。

Testing development versions / 测试开发版本

Development versions are version pre-release versions, generally meant for testing purposes. These are not available in the Google or Firefox web stores, but can be downloaded from either: 开发版本是预发布版本，通常用于测试目的。它们不在 Google 或 Firefox 应用商店中提供，但可以从以下任一来源下载：

  • GitHub Releases by looking for releases starting with Web Clipper.
  • Artifacts in GitHub Actions, by looking for the Deploy web clipper extension workflow. Once a workflow run is selected, the ZIP files are available in the Artifacts section, under the name web-clipper-extension.
  • GitHub Releases，查找以 Web Clipper 开头的版本。
  • GitHub Actions 中的构件（Artifacts），查找 Deploy web clipper extension（部署 Web Clipper 扩展）工作流。选择一次工作流运行后，ZIP 文件可在 Artifacts 部分以 web-clipper-extension 名称获取。

For Chrome / 针对 Chrome

  1. Download trilium-web-clipper-[x.y.z]-chrome.zip.
  2. Extract the archive.
  3. In Chrome, navigate to chrome://extensions/
  4. Toggle Developer Mode in top-right of the page.
  5. Press the Load unpacked button near the header.
  6. Point to the extracted directory from step (2).
  7. 下载 trilium-web-clipper-[x.y.z]-chrome.zip。
  8. 解压归档。
  9. 在 Chrome 中，访问 chrome://extensions/
  10. 切换页面右上角的 开发者模式（Developer Mode）。
  11. 按下标题附近的 加载已解压的扩展程序（Load unpacked） 按钮。
  12. 指向第 (2) 步解压的目录。

For Firefox / 针对 Firefox

Firefox prevents installation of unsigned packages in the "retail" version. To be able to install extensions from disk, consider using Firefox Developer Edition or a non-branded version of Firefox (e.g. GNU IceCat).

One time, go to about:config and change xpinstall.signatures.requiredto false. 警告：Firefox 会阻止在"零售"版本中安装未签名的软件包。要能从磁盘安装扩展，请考虑使用 Firefox 开发者版（Firefox Developer Edition） 或非品牌版 Firefox（例如 GNU IceCat）。

一次性前往 about:config，将 xpinstall.signatures.required 改为 false。

  1. Navigate to about:addons.
  2. Select Extensions in the left-side navigation.
  3. Press the Gear icon on the right of the Manage Your Extensions title.
  4. Select Install Add-on From File…
  5. Point it to trilium-web-clipper-[x.y.z]-firefox.zip.
  6. Press the Add button to confirm.
  7. 访问 about:addons。
  8. 在左侧导航中选择 扩展（Extensions）。
  9. 按下 管理你的扩展（Manage Your Extensions） 标题右侧的 齿轮 图标。
  10. 选择 从文件安装附加组件（Install Add-on From File…）。
  11. 指向 trilium-web-clipper-[x.y.z]-firefox.zip。
  12. 按下 添加（Add） 按钮确认。

Credits / 致谢

Some parts of the code are based on the Joplin Notes browser extension. 部分代码基于 Joplin Notes 浏览器扩展。

title: Data directory(数据目录)
full:
Data directory contains: 数据目录包含：

  • document.db - database
  • config.ini - instance level settings like port on which the Trilium application runs
  • backup - contains automatically backup of documents
  • log - contains application log files
  • document.db - 数据库
  • config.ini - 实例级设置，例如 Trilium 应用运行的端口
  • backup - 包含自动生成的文档备份
  • log - 包含应用日志文件

Location of the data directory / 数据目录的位置

Easy way how to find out which data directory Trilium uses is to look at the "About Trilium Notes" dialog (from "Menu" in upper left corner): 要查明 Trilium 使用哪个数据目录，最简单的方式是查看“关于 Trilium Notes”对话框（通过左上角的“菜单”进入）：

Here's how the location is decided: 数据目录的位置按如下方式决定：

Data directory is normally named trilium-data and it is stored in: 数据目录通常名为 trilium-data，存放在：

  • /home/[user]/.local/share for Linux
  • C:\Users\[user]\AppData\Roaming for Windows Vista and up
  • /Users/[user]/Library/Application Support for Mac OS
  • user's home is a fallback if some of the paths above don't exist
  • user's home is also a default setup for [[docker|Docker server installation]]
  • /home/[user]/.local/share（Linux）
  • C:\Users\[user]\AppData\Roaming（Windows Vista 及以上）
  • /Users/[user]/Library/Application Support（Mac OS）
  • 如果上述路径不存在，用户主目录作为回退
  • 用户主目录也是 [[docker|Docker 服务器安装]] 的默认配置

If you want to back up your Trilium data, just backup this single directory - it contains everything you need. 如果你想备份 Trilium 数据，只需备份这一个目录——它包含你需要的所有内容。

Changing the location of data directory / 更改数据目录的位置

If you want to use some other location for the data directory than the default one, you may change it via TRILIUM_DATA_DIR environment variable to some other location: 如果你想将数据目录放到默认位置以外的其他位置，可以通过 TRILIUM_DATA_DIR 环境变量来更改：

Windows

  1. Press the Windows key on your keyboard.
  2. Search and select “Edit the system variables”.
  3. Press the “Environment Variables…” button in the bottom-right of the newly opened screen.
  4. On the top section ("User variables for [user]"), press the “New…” button.
  5. In the Variable name field insert TRILIUM_DATA_DIR.
  6. Press the Browse Directory… button and select the new directory where to store the database.
  7. Close all the windows by pressing the OK button for each of them.
  8. 按下键盘上的 Windows 键。
  9. 搜索并选择“编辑系统变量”。
  10. 在新打开窗口的右下角点击“环境变量…”按钮。
  11. 在上方区域（“[用户] 的用户变量”）点击“新建…”按钮。
  12. 在_变量名_字段中输入 TRILIUM_DATA_DIR。
  13. 点击_浏览目录…_按钮，选择存放数据库的新目录。
  14. 对每个窗口依次点击_确定_按钮，关闭所有窗口。

Linux

export TRILIUM_DATA_DIR=/home/myuser/data/my-trilium-data

Mac OS X

You need to create a .plist file under ~/Library/LaunchAgents to load it properly each login. 你需要在 ~/Library/LaunchAgents 下创建一个 .plist 文件，以便每次登录时正确加载它。

To load it manually, you need to use launchctl setenv TRILIUM_DATA_DIR <yourpath> 要手动加载，需要使用 launchctl setenv TRILIUM_DATA_DIR <yourpath>

Here is a pre-defined template, where you just need to add your path to: 这里提供一个预定义模板，你只需把你的路径加进去：

        Label
        set.trilium.env
        RunAtLoad
        
        ProgramArguments
        
            launchctl
            setenv
            TRILIUM_DATA_DIR
            /Users/YourUserName/Library/Application Support/trilium-data

Create a script to run with specific data directory / 创建使用指定数据目录运行的脚本

An alternative to globally setting environment variable is to run only the Trilium Notes with this environment variable. This then allows for different setup styles like two database instances or "portable" installation. 除了全局设置环境变量，另一种方式是在运行 Trilium Notes 时仅对该进程设置此环境变量。这样可以实现不同的配置风格，例如两个数据库实例或“便携”安装。

To do this in Unix-based systems simply run trilium like this: 在类 Unix 系统上，只需这样运行 trilium：

TRILIUM_DATA_DIR=/home/myuser/data/my-trilium-data trilium

You can then save the above command as a shell script on your path for convenience. 你可以把上述命令保存为路径下的 shell 脚本，以方便使用。

Electron user data directory (desktop only) / Electron 用户数据目录（仅桌面版）

When running the desktop application, Electron stores internal data (caches, spell-check dictionaries, session storage, etc.) separately from the Trilium data directory. By default this goes to the system's application data folder (e.g. %APPDATA% on Windows), which may be undesirable in corporate environments with roaming profiles or when running in portable mode. 运行桌面应用时，Electron 会将内部数据（缓存、拼写检查字典、会话存储等）与 Trilium 数据目录分开存放。默认情况下，这些数据存放在系统的应用程序数据文件夹中（例如 Windows 上的 %APPDATA%），在有漫游配置文件的企业环境中或便携模式下可能并不理想。

To keep Electron data out of the system's roaming profile, set the TRILIUM_ELECTRON_DATA_DIR environment variable to an explicit path. The trilium-portable script does this automatically, pointing it to trilium-electron-data/ next to the application. 要把 Electron 数据移出系统的漫游配置文件，可将 TRILIUM_ELECTRON_DATA_DIR 环境变量设置为显式路径。trilium-portable 脚本会自动执行此操作，将其指向应用旁的 trilium-electron-data/。

Fine-grained directory/path location / 细粒度目录/路径位置

Apart from the data directory, some of the subdirectories of it can be moved elsewhere by changing an environment variable: 除数据目录外，它的一些子目录也可以通过更改环境变量移动到其他位置：

title: Vertical and horizontal layout(垂直与水平布局)
full:
Layouts / 布局

Trilium supports two different layouts, based on your preference. Trilium 支持两种不同的布局，取决于你的偏好。

Vertical layout / 纵向布局

The vertical layout is Trilium's original layout: 纵向布局是 Trilium 的原始布局：

  • The Launch Bar(启动栏) is positioned on the left side of the screen, with buttons being laid out vertically.
  • The tab bar is at the top, but to the right of the Note Tree(笔记树).
  • The Quick search(快速搜索) is at the top of the Note Tree(笔记树).
  • The Note Tree(笔记树) can be collapsed by pressing the button at the bottom of the Launch Bar(启动栏).
  • The Global menu(全局菜单) can be accessed via the icon at the top of the Launch Bar(启动栏).
  • Launch Bar(启动栏)位于屏幕左侧，按钮纵向排列。
  • 标签栏在顶部，但在Note Tree(笔记树)的右侧。
  • Quick search(快速搜索)位于Note Tree(笔记树)的顶部。
  • 通过按下Launch Bar(启动栏)底部的 按钮，可以折叠Note Tree(笔记树)。
  • 通过Launch Bar(启动栏)顶部的 图标，可以访问Global menu(全局菜单)。

Horizontal layout / 横向布局

The horizontal layout is a more traditional layout, since it bears similarity with other applications. In this mode: 横向布局是更传统的布局，因为它与其他应用有相似之处。在此模式下：

  • The Launch Bar(启动栏) is at the top of the screen, with the buttons laid horizontally.
  • The tab bar is at the top of the screen, but now covers the entirety of the width, allowing for more tabs to be displayed at once.
  • The Quick search(快速搜索) is now part of the Launch Bar(启动栏). It can be moved around according to preference and even removed if needed.
  • The Note Tree(笔记树) can be collapsed by pressing the small button to the left of the first tab.
  • The Global menu(全局菜单) can be accessed via the button at the end of the Launch Bar(启动栏).
  • Launch Bar(启动栏)在屏幕顶部，按钮横向排列。
  • 标签栏在屏幕顶部，但现在覆盖整个宽度，可以同时显示更多标签页。
  • Quick search(快速搜索)现在是Launch Bar(启动栏)的一部分。它可以根据偏好移动，甚至在需要时移除。
  • 通过按下第一个标签页左侧的小 按钮，可以折叠Note Tree(笔记树)。
  • 通过Launch Bar(启动栏)末尾的 按钮，可以访问Global menu(全局菜单)。

Changing the layout / 更改布局

Go to Options(选项) and look for the Appearance option on the left. Then look for the Layout section, where there is the possibility to switch between the two available layouts. 进入Options(选项)，在左侧找到 外观（Appearance） 选项。然后找到 布局（Layout） 部分，可以在两种可用布局之间切换。

Selecting an option will immediately apply the new layout by reloading the window. 选择一个选项将立即通过重新加载窗口应用新布局。

title: Global menu(全局菜单)
full:
The global menu configures the current window (zoom, keeping the window on top) and offers access to some more advanced options. 全局菜单用于配置当前窗口（缩放、保持窗口置顶），并提供访问一些更高级选项的入口。

Accessing the global menu / 访问全局菜单

See Vertical and horizontal layout since the position of the global menu is changed based on which layout has been selected. 参见纵向与横向布局，因为全局菜单位置会根据所选择的布局而改变。

title: Note tree contextual menu(笔记树右键菜单)
full:
The note tree menu can be accessed by right-clicking in the Note Tree. 可以通过在笔记树（Note Tree）中右键点击来访问 笔记树菜单（note tree menu）。

Interaction / 交互

The contextual menu can operate: 上下文菜单可以操作：

  • On a single note, by right clicking it in the note tree.
  • On multiple notes, by selecting them first. See Multiple selection on how to do so.
    • When right clicking, do note that usually the note being right clicked is also included in the affected notes, regardless of whether it was selected or not.
  • 单个笔记：在笔记树中右键点击它。
  • 多个笔记：先选中它们。如何操作参见多选（Multiple selection）。
    • 右键点击时请注意，通常被右键点击的笔记也会包含在受影响的笔记中，无论它是否被选中。

Available options / 可用选项

When multiple notes are selected, only a subset of notes will be active. The ones that do support multiple notes will mention this in the list below. 注意：当选中多个笔记时，只有一部分选项会激活。支持多个笔记的选项会在下面的列表中注明。

  • Open in a new tab / 在新标签页中打开
    • Will open a single note in a new tab.
    • 将在新的标签页中打开单个笔记。
  • Open in a new split / 在新分屏中打开
    • Will open a split to the right with the given note within the current tab.
    • 将在当前标签页内右侧打开包含给定笔记的分屏。
  • Hoist note / 提升笔记
    • Will focus the note tree on this note. See Note Hoisting for more information.
    • 将使笔记树聚焦于该笔记。更多信息参见笔记提升（Note Hoisting）。
  • Insert note after / 在后面插入笔记
    • Allows easy creation of a note with a specified note type.
    • Templates will also be present (if any) at the end of the list.
    • The note will be added on the same level of hierarchy as the note selected.
    • 允许轻松创建指定笔记类型的笔记。
    • 模板（Templates）（如果有）也会出现在列表末尾。
    • 该笔记将添加到与所选笔记相同的层级。
  • Insert child note / 插入子笔记
    • Same as Insert note after, but the note will be created as a child of the selected note.
    • 与 在后面插入笔记 相同，但该笔记将作为所选笔记的子笔记创建。
  • Protect subtree / 保护子树
    • Will mark this note and all of its descendents as protected. See Protected Notes for more information.
    • 将该笔记及其所有后代标记为受保护。更多信息参见受保护笔记（Protected Notes）。
  • Unprotect subtree / 取消保护子树
    • Will unprotect this note and all of its descendents.
    • 取消该笔记及其所有后代的保护。
  • Cut / 剪切
    • Will place the given notes in clipboard.
    • Use one of the two paste functions (or the keyboard shortcuts) to move them to the desired location.
    • 将给定笔记放入剪贴板。
    • 使用两个粘贴功能之一（或键盘快捷键）将它们移动到所需位置。
  • Copy / clone / 复制 / 克隆
    • Will place the given notes in clipboard.
    • Use one of the two paste functions (or the keyboard shortcuts) to copy them to the desired location.
    • Note that the copy function here works according to the Cloning Notes functionality (i.e. the note itself will be present in two locations at once, and editing it in one place will edit it everywhere).
    • To simply create a duplicate note that can be modified independently, look for Duplicate subtree.
    • 将给定笔记放入剪贴板。
    • 使用两个粘贴功能之一（或键盘快捷键）将它们复制到所需位置。
    • 注意，这里的复制功能按克隆笔记（Cloning Notes）功能工作（即笔记本身会同时出现在两个位置，在一个位置编辑它会在所有位置生效）。
    • 要创建可以独立修改的重复笔记，请查找 复制子树（Duplicate subtree）。
  • Paste into / 粘贴到其中
    • If there are any notes in clipboard, they will be pasted as child notes to the right-clicked one.
    • 如果剪贴板中有任何笔记，它们将作为子笔记粘贴到右键点击的笔记下。
  • Paste after / 粘贴在后面
    • If there are any notes in clipboard, they will be pasted underneath the right-clicked one.
    • 如果剪贴板中有任何笔记，它们将粘贴到右键点击的笔记下方。
  • Move to… / 移动到…
    • Will display a modal to specify where to move the desired notes.
    • 将显示一个对话框以指定将所需笔记移动到哪里。
  • Clone to… / 克隆到…
    • Will display a modal to specify where to clone the desired notes.
    • 将显示一个对话框以指定将所需笔记克隆到哪里。
  • Duplicate / 复制
    • Creates a copy of the note and its descendants.
    • This process is different from Cloning Notes since the duplicated note can be edited independently from the original.
    • An alternative to this, if done regularly, would be Templates.
    • 创建笔记及其后代的副本。
    • 此过程不同于克隆笔记，因为复制的笔记可以独立于原笔记进行编辑。
    • 如果经常这样做，一个替代方案是模板（Templates）。
  • Archive/Unarchive / 归档/取消归档
    • Marks a note as archived.
    • If the note is already archived, it will be unarchived instead.
    • Multiple notes can be selected as well. However, all the selected notes must be in the same state (archived or not), otherwise the option will be disabled.
    • 将笔记标记为已归档。
    • 如果笔记已归档，则将取消归档。
    • 也可以选择多个笔记。但所有选中的笔记必须处于相同状态（已归档或未归档），否则该选项将被禁用。
  • Delete / 删除
    • Will delete the given notes, asking for confirmation first.
    • In the dialog, the following options can be configured:
      • Delete also all clones to ensure that the note will be deleted everywhere if it has been placed into multiple locations (see Cloning Notes).
      • Erase notes permanently will ensure that the note cannot be recovered from Recent Changes.
    • 将删除给定笔记，并先请求确认。
    • 在对话框中，可以配置以下选项：
      • 同时删除所有克隆（Delete also all clones），确保如果笔记被放置到多个位置，它将在所有位置被删除（参见克隆笔记）。
      • 永久擦除笔记（Erase notes permanently），确保该笔记无法从最近更改（Recent Changes）中恢复。
  • Import into note / 导入到笔记中
    • Opens the import dialog and places the imported notes as child notes of the selected one.
    • 打开导入对话框，并将导入的笔记作为所选笔记的子笔记放置。
  • Export / 导出
    • Opens the export dialog for the selected notes.
    • 为所选笔记打开导出对话框。
  • Search in subtree / 在子树中搜索
    • Opens a full Search with it preconfigured to only look into this note and its descendants (the Ancestor field).
    • 打开完整的搜索（Search），并预配置为只在该笔记及其后代中查找（祖先（Ancestor） 字段）。

Advanced options / 高级选项

The advanced options menu offers some of the less frequently used actions for notes. 高级选项菜单提供一些较少使用的笔记操作。

To access these options, first look for the Advanced option in the contextual menu to reveal a sub-menu with: 要访问这些选项，首先在上下文菜单中找到 高级（Advanced） 选项，以展开包含以下内容的子菜单：

  • Apply bulk actions / 应用批量操作
    • Opens the Bulk Actions dialog, to apply actions such as adding labels or moving notes to multiple notes at once (see Multiple selection).
    • 打开批量操作（Bulk Actions）对话框，一次将添加标签或移动笔记等操作应用到多个笔记（参见多选）。
  • Edit branch prefix / 编辑分支前缀
    • Opens a dialog to assign a name to be able to distinguish clones, see Branch prefix for more information.
    • 打开对话框以分配名称来区分克隆，更多信息参见分支前缀（Branch prefix）。
  • Convert to attachment / 转换为附件
    • Converts the selected notes to Attachments of their parent notes.
    • This functional is most useful when dealing with image File notes that were imported from an external source or an older version of Trilium.
    • 将选中的笔记转换为其父笔记的附件（Attachments）。
    • 此功能在处理从外部来源或旧版 Trilium 导入的图片文件（File）笔记时最有用。
  • Expand subtree / 展开子树
    • Expands all the child notes in the Note Tree.
    • 展开笔记树中的所有子笔记。
  • Collapse subtree / 折叠子树
    • Collapses all the child notes in the note tree.
    • 折叠笔记树中的所有子笔记。
  • Sort by… / 按…排序
    • Opens a dialog to sort all the child notes of the selected note.
    • The sorting is done only once, there is an automatic sorting mechanism as well that can be set using Attributes.
    • See Sorting Notes for more information.
    • 打开对话框以对所选笔记的所有子笔记进行排序。
    • 排序只执行一次；也有一个可以使用属性（Attributes）设置的自动排序机制。
    • 更多信息参见笔记排序（Sorting Notes）。
  • Copy note path to clipboard / 将笔记路径复制到剪贴板
    • Copies a URL fragment representing the full path to this branch for a note, such as #root/Hb2E70L7HPuf/4sRFgMZhYFts/2IVuShedRJ3U/LJVMvKXOFv7n.
    • The URL to manually create Links within notes, or for note Navigation.
    • 复制表示笔记此分支完整路径的 URL 片段，例如 #root/Hb2E70L7HPuf/4sRFgMZhYFts/2IVuShedRJ3U/LJVMvKXOFv7n。
    • 该 URL 用于在笔记中手动创建链接（Links），或用于笔记导航（Navigation）。
  • Recent changes in subtree / 子树中的最近更改
    • This will open Recent Changes, but filtered to only the changes related to this note or one of its descendants.
    • 这将打开最近更改（Recent Changes），但仅过滤与该笔记或其某个后代相关的更改。

title: Multiple selection(多选)
full:
In the Note Tree, it's possible to select multiple notes at one time. This won't affect the currently displayed note, but it allows to do batch operations. 在笔记树（Note Tree）中，可以一次选择多个笔记。这不会影响当前显示的笔记，但允许进行批量操作。

Types of multiple selection / 多选的类型

Selecting notes one by one / 逐个选择笔记

To individually select each note, press the Alt key and click on the note to be selected. 要逐个选择笔记，按住 Alt 键并点击要选择的笔记。

The selected notes will be indicated via a different background color and an icon. 选中的笔记会通过不同的背景颜色和一个图标来标示。

Selecting notes in a sequence / 连续选择笔记

When notes are in a sequence (e.g. one underneath the other), the entire selection can be made just by selecting the first and the last item instead of individually clicking all the notes. 当笔记处于连续排列时（例如一个在另一个下面），只需选择第一个和最后一个项目即可完成整个选择，而不必逐个点击所有笔记。

To do so, first select the note to start the selection with. Then hold Shift and click on the note to end the selection with. All the notes between the start and the end note will be selected as well. 为此，首先选择作为选择起点的笔记。然后按住 Shift 并点击作为选择终点的笔记。起点和终点之间的所有笔记也将被选中。

Selected notes vs. active note / 选中的笔记与活动笔记

There is a distinction between selected notes and the active note: _选中的笔记_和_活动笔记_之间是有区别的：

  • Selected notes are simply the notes that were selected in the multiple section process (i.e. either via Alt or Shift).
  • The active note is simply the note that whose content is being displayed to the right of the tree.

    • Visually, it's identified in the tree by having a different background color and a subtle shadow.

    • The active note can also be selected case in which the icon and background will also change:

  • _选中的笔记_就是多选过程中被选中的那些笔记（即通过 Alt 或 Shift 选中的）。
  • _活动笔记_就是在树右侧显示其内容的那个笔记。
    • 在视觉上，它通过在树中具有不同的背景颜色和细微阴影来识别。
    • 活动笔记也可以被选中，此时图标和背景也会变化：

title: Hiding the subtree(隐藏子树)
full:
The tree works well when the notes are structured in a hierarchy so that the number of items stays small. When a note has a large number of notes (in the order of thousands or tens of thousands), two problems arise: 当笔记按层级结构组织、项目数量保持在较少时，树工作得很好。当一个笔记有大量笔记（数千或数万级别）时，会出现两个问题：

  • Navigating between notes becomes cumbersome and the tree itself gets cluttered with a large amount of notes.
  • The large amount of notes can slow down the application considerably.
  • 在笔记之间导航变得笨重，树本身也会被大量笔记弄得杂乱。
  • 大量的笔记会显著降低应用的速度。

Since v0.102.0, Trilium allows the tree to hide the child notes of particular notes. This works for both Collections and normal notes. 自 v0.102.0 起，Trilium 允许树隐藏特定笔记的子笔记。这对集合（Collections）和普通笔记都有效。

Interaction / 交互

When the subtree of a note is hidden, there are a few subtle changes: 当笔记的子树被隐藏时，会有一些细微的变化：

  • To indicate that the subtree is hidden, the note will not have an expand button and it will display the number of children to the right.
  • It's not possible to add a new note directly from the tree.
    • For Collections, it's best to use the built-in mechanism to create notes (for example by creating a new point on a geo-map, or by adding a new row in a table).
    • For normal notes, it's still possible to create children via other means such as using the Internal (reference) links system.
  • Notes can be dragged from outside the note, case in which they will be cloned into it.
    • Instead of switching to the child notes that were copied, the parent note is highlighted instead.
    • A notification will indicate this behavior.
  • Similarly, features such as cut/copy and then paste into the note will also work.
  • 为了表示子树已隐藏，该笔记将没有展开按钮，并在右侧显示子笔记的数量。
  • 无法直接从树中添加新笔记。
    • 对于集合，最好使用内置机制创建笔记（例如在地理地图上创建新点，或在表格中添加新行）。
    • 对于普通笔记，仍然可以通过其他方式创建子笔记，例如使用内部（引用）链接系统。
  • 笔记可以从外部拖入，此时它们会被克隆到该笔记中。
    • 不会切换到被复制的子笔记，而是高亮父笔记。
    • 会有通知提示此行为。
  • 类似地，剪切/复制然后粘贴到笔记中等功能也仍然有效。

Spotlighting / 聚焦显示

Even if the subtree of a note is hidden, if a child note manages to become active, it will still appear inside the tree in a special state called spotlighted. 即使笔记的子树被隐藏，如果某个子笔记设法成为活动笔记，它仍然会以一种称为_聚焦（spotlighted）_的特殊状态出现在树中。

During this state, the note remains under its normal hierarchy, so that its easy to tell its location. In addition, this means that: 在此状态下，笔记仍处于其正常层级下，因此很容易判断其位置。此外，这意味着：

  • The note position is clearly visible when using the Search.
  • The note can still be operated on from the tree, such as adding a Branch prefix or moving it outside the collection.
  • 使用搜索（Search）时，笔记位置清晰可见。
  • 该笔记仍然可以从树中进行操作，例如添加分支前缀（Branch prefix）或将其移动到集合之外。

The note appears in italics to indicate its temporary display. When switching to another note, the spotlighted note will disappear. 笔记以斜体显示以表示其临时显示。当切换到另一个笔记时，聚焦的笔记将消失。

Only one note can be highlighted at the time. When working with multiple notes such as dragging them into the collection, no note will be spotlighted. This is intentional to avoid displaying a partial state of the subtree. 注意：一次只能高亮一个笔记。当处理多个笔记（例如将它们拖入集合）时，不会有任何笔记被聚焦。这是有意为之，以避免显示子树的中间状态。

Working with collections / 处理集合

For large collections, it can be helpful to hide their child notes for performance reasons or de-cluttering the tree. 对于大型集合，出于性能原因或为了整理树的整洁，隐藏其子笔记会很有帮助。

To toggle this behavior: 要切换此行为：

  • Open the collection and in Collection Properties, look for Hide child notes in tree.
  • Right click the collection note in the Note Tree and select Advanced → Show subtree.
  • 打开集合，在集合属性（Collection Properties）中查找 在树中隐藏子笔记（Hide child notes in tree）。
  • 在笔记树中右键点击集合笔记，选择 高级（Advanced） → 显示子树（Show subtree）。

Working with normal notes / 处理普通笔记

It's possible to hide the subtree for normal notes as well, not just collections. To do so, right click the note in the Note Tree and select Advanced → Hide subtree. 普通笔记也可以隐藏子树，而不仅仅是集合。为此，在笔记树中右键点击笔记，选择 高级（Advanced） → 隐藏子树（Hide subtree）。

title: Ribbon(功能区)
full:
The ribbon allows changing options, attributes and viewing information about the current note. 功能区（Ribbon）允许更改选项、属性，并查看当前笔记的相关信息。

Settings / 设置

It is possible to change whether some ribbon items will be automatically open when navigating to a new note. To do so, in Settings, go to Appearance and look for the Ribbon widgets section. 可以更改某些功能区项目在导航到新笔记时是否自动打开。为此，在设置中，进入 外观（Appearance），找到 功能区小组件（Ribbon widgets） 部分。

Formatting / 格式化

If you are using the Fixed formatting toolbar, all the formatting buttons for text notes will appear here. See Formatting toolbar for more information. 如果你使用的是 固定（Fixed） 格式化工具栏，文本笔记的所有格式化按钮都会出现在这里。更多信息参见格式化工具栏。

Tabs / 标签页

Basic Properties / 基本属性

  • Note type allows changing the note type of a note.
    • Generally this is desirable only if the note is empty.
    • As a more advanced use, it's possible to change the note type in order to modify the source code of a note.
  • Protect the note toggles whether the current note is encrypted and accessible only by entering the protected session. See Protected Notes for more information.
  • Editable changes whether the current note:
    • Enters read-only mode automatically if the note is too big (default behavior).
    • Is always in read-only mode (however it can still be edited temporarily).
    • Is always editable, regardless of its size.
  • Bookmark toggles the display of the current note into the Launch Bar for easy access. See Bookmarks for more information.
  • Shared toggles whether the current note is publicly accessible if you have a server instance set up. See Sharing for more information.
  • Template toggles whether the current note is considered a template and can be used to easily create notes with the same content. See Template for more information.
  • Language changes the main language of the current note, mostly useful for spell checking or right-to-left support. See Content language & Right-to-left support for more information.
  • 笔记类型（Note type） 允许更改笔记的笔记类型。
    • 通常仅在笔记为空时才需要这样做。
    • 作为更高级的用法，可以更改笔记类型以修改笔记的源代码。
  • 保护笔记（Protect the note） 切换当前笔记是否加密，且只能通过进入受保护会话访问。更多信息参见受保护笔记（Protected Notes）。
  • 可编辑（Editable） 更改当前笔记是否：
    • 在笔记过大时自动进入只读模式（默认行为）。
    • 始终处于只读模式（但仍可临时编辑）。
    • 无论大小始终可编辑。
  • 书签（Bookmark） 切换当前笔记是否显示在启动栏（Launch Bar）中以便快速访问。更多信息参见书签（Bookmarks）。
  • 共享（Shared） 切换如果你设置了服务器实例，当前笔记是否可公开访问。更多信息参见共享（Sharing）。
  • 模板（Template） 切换当前笔记是否被视为模板，可用于轻松创建具有相同内容的笔记。更多信息参见模板（Template）。
  • 语言（Language） 更改当前笔记的主要语言，主要用于拼写检查或从右到左支持。更多信息参见内容语言与从右到左支持。

Owned Attributes / 自有属性

This section allows editing the labels and relations of a note. For more information, see Attributes. 此部分允许编辑笔记的标签和关系。更多信息参见属性（Attributes）。

The plus button to the right offers a simplified way to insert labels and relations, via a graphical input. From this menu, it's also possible to define label and relation definitions (see Promoted Attributes). 右侧的加号按钮提供了一种通过图形化输入插入标签和关系的简化方式。在此菜单中，还可以定义标签和关系定义（参见提升属性（Promoted Attributes））。

Inherited Attributes / 继承属性

This section displays the attributes which are applied to this note via Attribute Inheritance. It is not possible to alter the attributes from this section. 此部分显示通过属性继承（Attribute Inheritance）应用到该笔记的属性。无法在此部分更改这些属性。

Note Paths / 笔记路径

This section displays all the places where the current note has been cloned to. Here the current note can also be cloned to a new location (similar to the Note Tree) See Cloning Notes for more information. 此部分显示当前笔记被克隆到的所有位置。在这里，当前笔记也可以被克隆到新位置（类似于笔记树）。更多信息参见克隆笔记（Cloning Notes）。

Note Map / 笔记地图

The note map displays all the relations of the current note to other notes, as well as the subtree structure. See Note Tree for more information. 笔记地图显示当前笔记与其他笔记的所有关系，以及子树结构。更多信息参见笔记树。

Similar Notes / 相似笔记

This section lists all the notes that are similar to the current one. See Similar Notes for more information. 此部分列出所有与当前笔记相似的笔记。更多信息参见相似笔记（Similar Notes）。

Note Info / 笔记信息

This section displays information about the current note: 此部分显示关于当前笔记的信息：

  • The internal ID of the note.
  • The type of the note, as well as its MIME type (used mostly for exporting notes).
  • The created and modification dates.
  • The estimated size of the note in the Database, as well as its children count and size.
  • 笔记的内部 ID。
  • 笔记类型及其 MIME 类型（主要用于导出笔记）。
  • 创建和修改日期。
  • 笔记在数据库中的估算大小，以及其子笔记的数量和大小。

Edited notes / 已编辑笔记

This section pops automatically when entering a day note and shows the notes that were edited that day. 进入每日笔记时，此部分会自动弹出，显示当天编辑过的笔记。

It is possible to disable this behavior from settings, by going to 外观 settings and looking for the Ribbon widgets section. 可以从设置中禁用此行为：进入外观设置，找到 功能区小组件（Ribbon widgets） 部分。

title: Tabs(标签页)
full:
In Trilium, tabs allow easy switching between notes. 在 Trilium 中，标签页允许在笔记之间轻松切换。

Layout / 布局

Depending on the Vertical and horizontal layout: 取决于纵向与横向布局：

  • For the vertical layout, the tabs will be placed at the top but to the right of the Note Tree.
  • For the horizontal layout, the tabs will be placed at the top in full-width, above the note tree, allowing for more tabs to be comfortably displayed.
  • 对于纵向布局，标签页将位于顶部但在笔记树的右侧。
  • 对于横向布局，标签页将全宽置于顶部、笔记树上方，可以舒适地显示更多标签页。

Interaction / 交互

  • To create a new tab, press the button that is to the right of the last tab.
  • To close a tab, press the corresponding button.
  • For multitasking, tabs can be used alongside Split View. Each tab can have one or more notes, displayed horizontally.
  • Tabs can be reordered by drag-and-dropping it into a new position.
  • An existing tab can be displayed in a new window by dragging the tab upwards or downwards. It is not possible to combine tabs back into another window.
  • 要创建新标签页，按下最后一个标签页右侧的 按钮。
  • 要关闭标签页，按下相应的 按钮。
  • 为了实现多任务处理，标签页可以与分屏视图（Split View）一起使用。每个标签页可以有一个或多个笔记，水平显示。
  • 标签页可以通过拖放到新位置来重新排序。
  • 通过向上或向下拖动标签页，可以将现有标签页显示在新窗口中。无法将标签页重新合并回另一个窗口。

Keyboard interaction / 键盘交互

Since tabs are a commonly used feature, there are multiple keyboard shortcuts that can be used: 由于标签页是常用功能，因此可以使用多个键盘快捷键：

  • Ctrl+T to open a new tab.
  • Ctrl+W to close the current tab.
  • Ctrl+Shift+T to reopen the last closed tab.
  • Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab to go to the next or previous tab.
  • Ctrl+1, Ctrl+2, up to Ctrl+9 to activate the first, second and up to ninth tab.
  • There is also a shortcut to go to the last tab, but it is not assigned a key by default.
  • Ctrl+T 打开新标签页。
  • Ctrl+W 关闭当前标签页。
  • Ctrl+Shift+T 重新打开最后一个关闭的标签页。
  • Ctrl+Tab 和 Ctrl+Shift+Tab 转到下一个或上一个标签页。
  • Ctrl+1、Ctrl+2，一直到 Ctrl+9 激活第一、第二直到第九个标签页。
  • 还有一个转到最后一个标签页的快捷键，但默认没有分配按键。

Mobile / 移动端

Tabs are also supported on the Mobile Frontend. 移动前端（Mobile Frontend）也支持标签页。

Since v0.102.0, the tabs are displayed by pressing the dedicated tab switcher button in the Launch Bar. In this view the tabs are laid out on a grid with a preview of the note content. 自 v0.102.0 起，按下启动栏中专门的标签切换器按钮即可显示标签页。在此视图中，标签页以网格形式排列，并带有笔记内容预览。

The context menu button at the top-right of the popup allows creating a new tab, reopening the last closed tab and closing all the tabs. 弹出窗口右上角的上下文菜单按钮允许创建新标签页、重新打开最后一个关闭的标签页以及关闭所有标签页。

Split Views are also indicated in the tab switcher, with two titles displayed in a tab. 分屏视图也会在标签切换器中显示，一个标签页中显示两个标题。

Versions prior to v0.102.0 also supported tabs, but they were displayed directly above the Launch Bar. The decision to use a more mobile-like tab switcher was taken because the original tab bar could not support many tabs at once and the new design better aligns with how mobile applications handle tabs. 注意：v0.102.0 之前的版本也支持标签页，但它们直接显示在启动栏上方。采用更像移动端的标签切换器的决定，是因为原来的标签栏无法同时支持多个标签页，而新设计更符合移动应用处理标签页的方式。

title: Launch Bar(启动栏)
full:
Position of the Launch bar / 启动栏的位置

On desktop, depending on the layout selected, the launcher bar will either be on the left side of the screen with buttons displayed vertically or at the top of the screen. See Vertical and horizontal layout for more information. 在桌面上，根据所选择的布局，启动栏要么位于屏幕左侧且按钮纵向显示，要么位于屏幕顶部。更多信息参见纵向与横向布局。

On mobile, the launch bar will always be at the bottom. 在移动端，启动栏始终位于底部。

If there are too many items in the launch bar to fit the screen, it will become scrollable. 如果启动栏中的项目太多而无法容纳在屏幕内，它将变为可滚动。

Terminology / 术语

  • Launcher: a button that can be (or is) displayed on the launch bar.
  • Available Launcher: a launcher that is not displayed on the launch bar, but can be added.
  • Visible Launcher: a launcher that is currently displayed on the launch bar.
  • 启动器（Launcher）：可以（或已经）显示在启动栏上的按钮。
  • 可用启动器（Available Launcher）：未显示在启动栏上、但可以添加的启动器。
  • 可见启动器（Visible Launcher）：当前显示在启动栏上的启动器。

Configuring the desktop Launch bar / 配置桌面启动栏

There are two ways to configure the launch bar: 配置启动栏有两种方式：

  • Right click in the empty space between launchers on the launch bar and select Configure Launchbar.
  • Click on the Global menu and select Configure Launchbar.
  • 在启动栏上启动器之间的空白处右键点击，选择 配置启动栏（Configure Launchbar）。
  • 点击全局菜单，选择 配置启动栏（Configure Launchbar）。

This will open a new tab with the Note Tree listing the launchers. 这将打开一个新标签页，其中包含列出启动器的笔记树。

Expanding Available Launchers section will show the list of launchers that are not displayed on the launch bar. The Visible Launchers will show the ones that are currently displayed. 展开 可用启动器（Available Launchers） 部分将显示未显示在启动栏上的启动器列表。可见启动器（Visible Launchers） 将显示当前显示的启动器。

Configuring the mobile launch bar / 配置移动端启动栏

The launch bar on mobile uses a different configuration from the desktop one. The reasoning is that not all desktop icons are available on mobile, and fewer icons fit on a mobile screen. 移动端的启动栏使用与桌面端不同的配置。原因是并非所有桌面图标都在移动端可用，而且移动屏幕能容纳的图标更少。

To configure the launch bar on mobile, go to Global menu and select Configure Launchbar. 要在移动端配置启动栏，进入全局菜单，选择 配置启动栏（Configure Launchbar）。

The configure the mobile launch bar while on the desktop (especially useful to configure more complicated launchers such as scripts or custom widgets), go to Global menu → Advanced → Show Hidden Subtree and look for the Mobile Launch Bar section. While in the hidden subtree, it's also possible to drag launchers between the Mobile Launch Bar and (Desktop) Launch Bar sections. 要在桌面上配置移动端启动栏（对于配置脚本或自定义小组件等更复杂的启动器特别有用），进入全局菜单 → 高级（Advanced） → 显示隐藏子树（Show Hidden Subtree），查找 移动端启动栏（Mobile Launch Bar） 部分。在隐藏子树中，还可以在 移动端启动栏 和（桌面）启动栏 部分之间拖放启动器。

Adding/removing and reordering launchers / 添加/移除和重新排序启动器

To display a new launcher in the launch bar, first look for it in the Available Launchers section. Then right click it and select Move to visible launchers. It is also possible to drag and drop the item manually. 要在启动栏中显示新的启动器，首先在 可用启动器 部分找到它。然后右键点击并选择 移动到可见启动器（Move to visible launchers）。也可以手动拖放该项目。

Similarly, to remove it from the launch bar, simply look for it in Visible Launchers then right click it and select Move to available launchers or use drag-and-drop. 同样，要将其从启动栏移除，只需在 可见启动器 中找到它，然后右键点击并选择 移动到可用启动器（Move to available launchers） 或使用拖放。

Drag-and-drop the items in the tree in order to change their order. See Note Tree for more interaction options, including using keyboard shortcuts. 在树中拖放项目以更改其顺序。更多交互选项（包括使用键盘快捷键）参见笔记树。

Customizing the launcher / 自定义启动器

  • The icon of a launcher can be changed just like a normal note. See Note Icons for more information.
  • The title of the launcher can also be changed.
  • 启动器的图标可以像普通笔记一样更改。更多信息参见笔记图标（Note Icons）。
  • 启动器的标题也可以更改。

Resetting / 重置

Resetting allows restoring the original configuration of Trilium for the launcher bar, or for a portion of it. Simply right click a launcher (or even the entire Launch Bar section) and select Reset to bring it back to the original state. 重置允许恢复 Trilium 对启动栏或其一部分的原始配置。只需右键点击一个启动器（甚至整个 启动栏 部分），选择 重置（Reset） 即可恢复到原始状态。

Creating new launchers / types of launchers / 创建新启动器 / 启动器类型

Right click either the Available launchers or Visible launchers sections and select one of the options: 右键点击 可用启动器 或 可见启动器 部分，选择以下选项之一：

  1. Note Launcher / 笔记启动器
    A note launcher will simply navigate to a specified note. 笔记启动器将简单地导航到指定的笔记。

    1. Set the target promoted attribute to the note to navigate to.
    2. Optionally, set hoistedNote to hoist a particular note. See Note Hoisting for more information.
    3. Optionally, set a keyboardShortcut to trigger the launcher.
    4. 将 target 提升属性设置为要导航到的笔记。
    5. （可选）设置 hoistedNote 以提升特定笔记。更多信息参见笔记提升（Note Hoisting）。
    6. （可选）设置 keyboardShortcut 以触发启动器。

  2. Script Launcher / 脚本启动器
    An advanced launcher which will run a script upon pressing. See Scripting for more information. 一种高级启动器，按下时会运行脚本。更多信息参见脚本（Scripting）。

    1. Set script to point to the desired script to run.
    2. Optionally, set a keyboardShortcut to trigger the launcher.
    3. 将 script 设置为指向要运行的脚本。
    4. （可选）设置 keyboardShortcut 以触发启动器。

  3. Custom Widget / 自定义小组件

    Allows defining a custom widget to be rendered inside the launcher. See Widget Basics for more information. 允许定义要在启动器内渲染的自定义小组件。更多信息参见小组件基础（Widget Basics）。

  4. Spacers / 间隔符
    Launchers that create some distance between other launchers for better visual distinction. 在其他启动器之间创建一定距离以实现更好视觉区分的启动器。

Launchers are configured via predefined Promoted Attributes. 启动器通过预定义的提升属性（Promoted Attributes）进行配置。

title: Note buttons(笔记按钮)
full:
To the right of the Ribbon there are a few more buttons: 在功能区（Ribbon）的右侧还有几个按钮：

  • The Note Revisions button displays the Note Revisions for that particular note.
  • The contextual menu offers commands for the note or its subtree, such as import, export, viewing the Note source code or Attachments.
  • “笔记修订（Note Revisions）”按钮显示该特定笔记的笔记修订。
  • 上下文菜单提供针对该笔记或其子树的命令，例如导入、导出、查看笔记源代码或附件。

On the New Layout, the button area is populated by some more buttons that are specific to the current note. For example, for Image and File notes, the download and copy buttons were relocated there. 在新布局（New Layout）中，按钮区域会填充更多针对当前笔记的按钮。例如，对于图片和文件（File）笔记，下载和复制按钮被移到了那里。

title: Options(选项)
full:
The Options section allows the configuration of the TriliumNext client and server. 选项（Options）部分允许配置 TriliumNext 客户端和服务器。

Entering options / 进入选项

The Options can be accessed via: 选项可以通过以下方式访问：

  • The Global menu, by selecting the Options item.
  • The button in the Launch Bar which can optionally be hidden if not desirable.
  • Optionally, a keyboard shortcut can be defined, but it is not assigned by default.
  • By clicking on this link: Options.
  • 通过全局菜单，选择 选项（Options） 项。
  • 通过启动栏中的 按钮，如果不需要也可以隐藏。
  • （可选）可以定义一个键盘快捷键，但默认没有分配。
  • 通过点击此链接：选项（Options）。

Once in the options section, simply select one of the option categories using the Note Tree. 进入选项部分后，只需使用笔记树（Note Tree）选择其中一个选项类别。

Exiting options / 退出选项

When entering the options, they are opened in a new tab. To close them, simply close the tab. 进入选项时，它们会在新的标签页中打开。要关闭它们，只需关闭该标签页。

Options when using sync / 使用同步时的选项

When using Synchronization, some of the options will be kept in sync across all the devices while others can be changed independently. 使用同步时，部分选项会在所有设备间保持同步，而其他选项可以独立更改。

Generally, the options that relate to appearance are intentionally kept not synced in order to allow per-client customization (layout orientation, theme, vertical/horizontal layout, code block themes). 通常，与外观相关的选项被有意保持不同步，以便允许按客户端定制（布局方向、主题、纵向/横向布局、代码块主题）。

title: Split View(分屏视图)
full:
In Trilium, is possible to work with two or more notes side-by-side. 在 Trilium 中，可以并排处理两个或多个笔记。

Interactions / 交互

  • Press the button to the right of a note's title to open a new split to the right of it.
    • It is possible to have as many splits as desired, simply press again the button.
    • Only horizontal splits are possible, vertical or drag & dropping is not supported.
  • When at least one split is open, press the button next to it to close it.
  • Use the or the button to move around the splits.
  • Creating, closing and moving a split can also be triggered from a keyboard shortcut (Create New Split, Close Active Split, Move Split Left and Move Split Right, all unassigned by default) or through the command palette.
  • The focus can be moved from one split to the one next to it with the Focus Split to the Left and Focus Split to the Right actions, which stop at either end of the tab instead of continuing into the next tab. They are unassigned by default as well.
  • Each tab has its own split view configuration (e.g. one tab can have two notes in a split view, whereas the others are one-note views).
    • The tab's title will indicate all the note titles, in the order of the splits from the left to right and separated by a bullet symbol.
    • The tab's icon will indicate the icon of the last active split, which will be automatically focused when clicking on the tab.
  • 按下笔记标题右侧的 按钮，在其右侧打开一个新分屏。
    • 可以拥有任意数量的分屏，只需再次按下该按钮。
    • 只支持水平分屏，不支持垂直或拖放。
  • 当至少有一个分屏打开时，按下其旁边的 按钮即可关闭。
  • 使用 或 按钮在分屏之间移动。
  • 创建、关闭和移动分屏也可以通过键盘快捷键（创建新分屏（Create New Split）、关闭活动分屏（Close Active Split）、左移分屏（Move Split Left） 和 右移分屏（Move Split Right），默认均未分配）或通过命令面板（command palette）触发。
  • 可以使用 焦点左移分屏（Focus Split to the Left） 和 焦点右移分屏（Focus Split to the Right） 操作将焦点从一个分屏移到相邻分屏，这些操作会在标签页的任一端停止，而不会继续进入下一个标签页。它们默认也未被分配。
  • 每个标签页都有自己的分屏视图配置（例如，一个标签页可以在分屏视图中包含两个笔记，而其他标签页是单笔记视图）。
    • 标签页标题将按从左到右的分屏顺序显示所有笔记标题，并用圆点符号分隔。
    • 标签页图标将指示最后活动分屏的图标，点击标签页时该分屏会自动获得焦点。

Splits and the note tree & hoisting / 分屏与笔记树及提升

Clicking on the content of a split will focus that split. While focused, the Note Tree will also indicate the note that is being edited. 点击分屏的内容将使该分屏获得焦点。获得焦点时，笔记树也会指示正在编辑的笔记。

It is possible for each of the splits to have their own Note Hoisting. 每个分屏都可以有自己的笔记提升（Note Hoisting）。

When a new split is created, it will share the same note hoisting as the previous one. An easy solution to this is to simply hoist the notes after the split is created. 创建新分屏时，它将与上一个分屏共享相同的笔记提升。一个简单的解决方案是在创建分屏后提升笔记。

This is generally quite useful for reorganizing notes from one place to the other, by hoisting the old place in the first split and hoisting the new place to the second one. This will allow easy cut and paste without the tree jumping around from switching between notes. 这对于将笔记从一个地方重新组织到另一个地方通常非常有用：在第一个分屏中提升旧位置，在第二个分屏中提升新位置。这样可以轻松剪切和粘贴，而无需因切换笔记导致树跳来跳去。

Mobile support / 移动端支持

Since v0.100.0, it's possible to have a split view on the mobile view as well, with the following differences from the desktop version of the split: 自 v0.100.0 起，移动视图也可以使用分屏视图，与桌面版分屏有以下不同：

  • On smartphones, the split views are laid out vertically (one on the top and one on the bottom), instead of horizontally as on the desktop.
  • There can be only one split open per tab.
  • It's not possible to resize the two split panes.
  • When the keyboard is opened, the active note will be "maximized", thus allowing for more space even when a split is open. When the keyboard is closed, the splits become equal in size again.
  • 在智能手机上，分屏视图是垂直排列的（一个在顶部，一个在底部），而不是像桌面上那样水平排列。
  • 每个标签页只能打开一个分屏。
  • 无法调整两个分屏窗格的大小。
  • 当键盘打开时，活动笔记会被"最大化"，因此即使分屏打开也能有更多空间。当键盘关闭时，分屏再次变得大小相等。

Interaction: 交互：

  • To create a new split, click the three dots button on the right of the note title and select Create new split.
    • This option will only be available if there is no split already open in the current tab.
  • To close a split, click the three dots button on the right of the note title and select Close this pane.
    • Note that this option will only be available on the second note in the split (the one at the bottom on smartphones, the one on the right on tablets).
  • When long-pressing a link, a contextual menu will show up with an option to Open note in a new split.
    • If there's already a split, the option will replace the existing split instead.
  • 要创建新分屏，点击笔记标题右侧的三点按钮，选择 创建新分屏（Create new split）。
    • 仅当当前标签页中没有已打开的分屏时，此选项才可用。
  • 要关闭分屏，点击笔记标题右侧的三点按钮，选择 关闭此窗格（Close this pane）。
    • 注意，此选项仅在分屏中的第二个笔记上可用（智能手机上位于底部的那一个，平板电脑上位于右侧的那一个）。
  • 长按链接时，会显示一个上下文菜单，其中有 在新分屏中打开笔记（Open note in a new split） 选项。
    • 如果已有分屏，该选项将替换现有分屏。

title: Floating buttons(悬浮按钮)
full:
Depending on the current note, a panel will appear near the top-right of the note, right underneath the Ribbon. These buttons offer additional interaction that is specific to that particular note. 根据当前笔记的不同，一个面板会出现在笔记右上角附近，紧挨功能区（Ribbon）下方。这些按钮提供针对该特定笔记的额外交互。

For example: 例如：

  • For Mermaid Diagrams and Canvas, there are buttons to download the SVG representation of the note, or to copy a reference to the note for pasting it a Text note.
  • For read-only notes, there is a button to temporarily edit the note for quick modifications.
  • 对于Mermaid 图表和画布（Canvas），有按钮可以下载笔记的 SVG 表示，或复制笔记的引用以便粘贴到文本（Text）笔记中。
  • 对于只读笔记，有一个按钮可以临时编辑笔记以进行快速修改。

Interaction / 交互

The floating button area can be collapsed by pressing the two right arrows at the end of the section. 可以按下列区域末尾的两个右箭头来折叠浮动按钮区域。

title: Outline tab(大纲标签页)
full:
The Outline tab appears in the Right Sidebar and displays the headings and highlights for the current note. 大纲标签页出现在右侧边栏（Right Sidebar）中，显示当前笔记的标题和高亮。

Table of contents / 目录

The table of contents displays the titles / headings in the current note and allows easy navigation. 目录显示当前笔记中的标题，并允许轻松导航。

The following note types are supported: 支持以下笔记类型：

  • Text
  • Markdown
  • PDFs
  • AI chat notes
  • The pages of the in-app documentation
  • 文本（Text）
  • Markdown
  • PDF
  • AI 聊天笔记
  • 应用内文档页面

Interaction / 交互

  • Clicking on a heading will scroll the document to the position of the heading.
  • Pressing the close button will dismiss the table of contents but it can be shown again from the Floating buttons section.
  • 点击标题将把文档滚动到该标题的位置。
  • 按下关闭按钮将关闭目录，但可以从浮动按钮（Floating buttons）部分再次显示。

Configuration / 配置

This section is relevant only for the old layout, the New Layout shows the table of contents regardless of the number of headings. 注意：此部分仅与旧布局相关，新布局（New Layout）无论标题数量多少都会显示目录。

  • To change the option globally, go to Text Notes options, look for the Table of Contents section and configure the minimum amount of headings that need to be present in the current note in order for the table of contents to show:
    • To always hide it, set the value to a really large number (e.g. 10000).
    • To always display it if there's at least a single heading, set the value to 1.
  • Use Attributes to configure the table of contents for a particular note:
    • #toc=show will show the table of contents for that note regardless of the global settings.
    • Similarly, #toc=hide will always hide the table of contents for that note.
  • 要全局更改此选项，进入文本笔记（Text Notes）选项，查找 目录（Table of Contents） 部分，配置当前笔记中需要存在的最少标题数量，目录才会显示：
    • 要始终隐藏，将该值设置为一个非常大的数字（例如 10000）。
    • 要始终显示（只要至少有一个标题），将该值设置为 1。
  • 使用属性（Attributes）为特定笔记配置目录：
    • #toc=show 将使该笔记显示目录，无论全局设置如何。
    • 类似地，#toc=hide 将始终为该笔记隐藏目录。

Highlights / 高亮

Similar to the table of contents, but instead of headings this feature will list highlighted text from a text note and allow easy navigation to them. 与目录类似，但此功能不是列出标题，而是列出文本笔记中的高亮文本，并允许轻松导航到它们。

Unlike table of contents which supports multiple note types, the highlights are specific to the Text notes. 与支持多种笔记类型的目录不同，高亮功能是文本（Text）笔记特有的。

Highlighted text is defined as: 高亮文本定义为：

  • Bold text.
  • Italic text.
  • Underlined text.
  • Text with a foreground color set.
  • Text with a background color/highlight set.
  • 粗体文本。
  • 斜体文本。
  • 下划线文本。
  • 设置了前景色的文本。
  • 设置了背景色/高亮的文本。

Interaction / 交互

  • Clicking on a highlighted text will scroll the document to its position.
  • For the old layout only, pressing the close button will dismiss the list of highlights but it can be shown again from the Floating buttons section.
  • 点击高亮文本将把文档滚动到其位置。
  • 仅对旧布局，按下关闭按钮将关闭高亮列表，但可以从浮动按钮部分再次显示。

Configuration / 配置

  • Globally, it's possible to toggle the display of each category of highlighted text (as defined above)
    • For the new layout, pressing the gear button in the top-right part of the section will reveal a menu to toggle between the highlight categories.
    • Alternatively, they can be changed by going to Text Notes settings and looking for the Highlights List section.
  • For the old layout only, to suppress the display of highlighted text for one specific note, use Attributes to add the #hideHighlightWidget label.
  • 在全局层面，可以切换每个类别（如上定义）高亮文本的显示。
    • 对于新布局，按下该部分右上角的齿轮按钮将显示一个菜单，用于在高亮类别之间切换。
    • 或者，可以通过进入文本笔记（Text Notes）设置，查找 高亮列表（Highlights List） 部分来更改。
  • 仅对旧布局，要抑制某个特定笔记的高亮文本显示，请使用属性（Attributes）添加 #hideHighlightWidget 标签。

PDF-specific outline / PDF 专属大纲

When PDFs are opened in Trilium, the Right Sidebar is augmented with PDF-specific navigation, with the following features: 当在 Trilium 中打开PDF时，右侧边栏会增加 PDF 专属导航，具有以下功能：

  • Table of contents/outline / 目录/大纲
    • All the headings and "bookmarks" will be displayed hierarchically.
    • The heading on the current page is also highlighted (note that it can be slightly offset depending on how many headings are on the same page).
    • Clicking on a heading will jump to the corresponding position in the PDF.
    • 所有标题和"书签"将以层级方式显示。
    • 当前页面上的标题也会被高亮（注意，根据同一页面上标题的数量，它可能会有轻微偏移）。
    • 点击标题将跳转到 PDF 中的相应位置。
  • Pages / 页面
    • A preview of all the pages with a small thumbnail.
    • Clicking on a page will automatically navigate to that page.
    • 所有页面的预览，带小缩略图。
    • 点击页面将自动导航到该页。
  • Annotations / 批注
    • Highlight and comment annotations are listed here.
    • For the old layout, this feature is not directly available, however there is a listing of comments directly in the PDF toolbar.
    • 高亮和评论批注列在这里。
    • 对于旧布局，此功能不可直接用，但 PDF 工具栏中会直接有一个评论列表。
  • Attachments / 附件
    • If the PDF has its own attachments (not to be confused with Trilium's Attachments), they will be displayed in a list.
    • Some information such as the name and size of the attachment are displayed.
    • It's possible to download the attachment by clicking on the download button.
    • 如果 PDF 有自己的附件（不要与 Trilium 的附件混淆），它们会显示在列表中。
    • 会显示附件名称和大小等信息。
    • 可以通过点击下载按钮下载附件。
  • Layers / 图层
    • A less common feature, if the PDF has toggle-able layers, these layers will be displayed in a list here.
    • It's possible to toggle the visibility for each individual layer.
    • 一个不太常见的功能：如果 PDF 有可切换的图层，这些图层将显示在列表中。
    • 可以切换每个图层的可见性。

title: Attributes tab(属性标签页)
full:
The attributes tab provides a more graphical way to view and edit attributes. 属性标签页提供了一种更图形化的方式来查看和编辑属性（attributes）。

Sections / 部分

The following information is displayed in sections: 以下信息按部分显示：

  • Owned attributes, contains a list of the attributes that belong to this note.
  • Inherited attributes are attributes that apply to the current note but come through Attribute Inheritance.
  • Definitions describe the type of attributes and are used in Promoted Attributes and Table collections.
  • 自有属性（Owned attributes），包含属于此笔记的属性列表。
  • 继承属性（Inherited attributes），是适用于当前笔记但通过属性继承（Attribute Inheritance）而来的属性。
  • 定义（Definitions），描述属性的类型，用于提升属性（Promoted Attributes）和表格（Table）集合。

Owned attributes / 自有属性

Every item is structured as such: 每个项目结构如下：

  • The icon of each item indicates whether it's a label or a relation (link to another note).
  • The first text is the name of the label.
  • The value of the attribute is displayed after the name, if present.
    • The value is shown in a graphical way: a relation's value is a clickable note link; a color label shows a color chip.
  • 每个项目的图标指示它是标签（label）还是关系（relation）（指向另一个笔记的链接）。
  • 第一个文本是标签的名称。
  • 如果存在，属性值显示在名称之后。
    • 值以图形化方式显示：关系的值是可点击的笔记链接；颜色标签显示色块。

System attributes (that have a special meaning in Trilium) show a small cog near the icon and are grouped separately from the user-defined ones. 系统属性（在 Trilium 中具有特殊含义）在图标附近显示一个小齿轮，并与用户定义的属性分开分组。

Interaction: 交互：

  • Clicking on the item (apart from the value and links) reveals a dedicated popup where the name, value and Attribute Inheritance can be defined.
  • The value of the attributes can be edited in-place:
    • The input box follows the type defined in a corresponding label definition (date, color, dropdown, numbers), as well as for system attributes that have a specific type (e.g. color).
    • For labels, clicking on the value edits its in-place.
      • Press Enter to confirm or click outside the input box, or Esc to dismiss.
      • For multi-line text, Ctrl+Enter confirms whereas Enter creates a newline.
    • For boolean values, clicking on the checkbox will toggle its state.
    • For labels without a value, a value can be added by clicking on the No value text which appears while the mouse is hovered on the item.
    • For relations, there is a dedicated pencil button instead.
  • An attribute can be deleted by pressing the X button to its right, which only appears while hovered. A confirmation screen is displayed first to ensure the attribute is not accidentally deleted.
  • 点击项目（值、链接除外）会显示一个专门的弹出窗口，可以在其中定义名称、值和属性继承。
  • 属性的值可以就地编辑：
    • 输入框遵循相应标签定义中的类型（日期、颜色、下拉、数字），也适用于具有特定类型（例如 color）的系统属性。
    • 对于标签，点击值即可就地编辑。
      • 按 Enter 确认，或点击输入框外部，或按 Esc 取消。
      • 对于多行文本，Ctrl+Enter 确认，而 Enter 创建换行。
    • 对于布尔值，点击复选框将切换其状态。
    • 对于没有值的标签，可以通过点击鼠标悬停在项目上时出现的 无值（No value） 文本来添加值。
    • 对于关系，则有一个专门的铅笔按钮。
  • 可以通过按下其右侧的 X 按钮（仅在悬停时出现）删除属性。会先显示确认界面，以确保属性不会被意外删除。

Attributes can be added in two ways: 可以通过两种方式添加属性：

  • A new label, relation or attribute definition can be added from the + button near the title of the section. This shows the full detail popup.
  • To quickly add a label or a relation directly from the sidebar, click the Add attribute item at the end of the list.
    • The name field will be focused first. By default, a label will be created instead but it can be toggled to a relation by typing ~ or pressing the icon (similarly, typing # will switch back to a label instead of a relation).
    • Once the name is filled, press Enter to continue to the value. Type in a value if desired and then press Enter again to create the attribute.
    • Clicking outside the editor will also create the attribute, but only if a name is specified.
  • 可以从该部分标题附近的 + 按钮添加新的标签、关系或属性定义。这会显示完整的详情弹出窗口。
  • 要直接从侧边栏快速添加标签或关系，点击列表末尾的 添加属性（Add attribute） 项目。
    • 名称字段将首先获得焦点。默认会创建标签，但可以通过输入 ~ 或按下图标将其切换为关系（类似地，输入 # 会切换回标签而不是关系）。
    • 填写名称后，按 Enter 继续输入值。如果需要，输入值，然后再次按 Enter 创建属性。
    • 点击编辑器外部也会创建属性，但前提是已指定名称。

Inherited attributes / 继承属性

Inherited labels or relations are shown in the same fashion as Owned attributes. 继承的标签或关系以与 自有属性 相同的方式显示。

The only differences are: 唯一的区别是：

  • To the right of the inherited attribute there is a link to the note where the attribute comes from, as well as an icon to indicate that it's inheritable.
  • Clicking on an inherited attribute will reveal the same popup as owned attributes, but it is not editable. To edit it, first navigate to the note where the attribute is defined.
  • 继承属性的右侧有一个指向属性来源笔记的链接，以及一个表示其可继承的图标。
  • 点击继承属性会显示与自有属性相同的弹出窗口，但它不可编辑。要编辑它，请先导航到定义该属性的笔记。

Definitions / 定义

For attribute definition (see Promoted Attributes): 对于属性定义（参见提升属性）：

  • The icon indicates the type of the attribute (text, number).
    • If an attribute is promoted, it has a small chevron icon overlaid on top of it.
  • The name indicates the name of the attribute it defines (without the label:or relation:prefix).
  • To the right of the name a short summary is displayed which indicates the display name (alias), whether it has multiple values or an inverse relation.
  • Clicking on a definition reveals a popup, where the name, type, display name and other aspects can be configured.
  • A new label or relation definition can be added from the + button near the title of the section.
  • For inherited definition, there is a link to the note where the definition comes from, as well as an icon to indicate that it's inherited.
  • 图标指示属性的类型（文本、数字）。
    • 如果属性被提升，它上面会叠加一个小 V 形图标。
  • 名称指示它定义的属性名称（不带 label: 或 relation: 前缀）。
  • 在名称右侧显示一个简短摘要，指示显示名称（别名）、是否具有多个值或反向关系。
  • 点击定义会显示一个弹出窗口，可以在其中配置名称、类型、显示名称等。
  • 可以从该部分标题附近的 + 按钮添加新的标签或关系定义。
  • 对于继承的定义，有一个指向定义来源笔记的链接，以及一个表示其继承的图标。

Mobile / 移动端

The attributes can also be edited visually on mobile, but not as part of the sidebar. Go to Note buttons and select Note attributes. 在移动端也可以可视化地编辑属性，但不是作为侧边栏的一部分。进入笔记按钮（Note buttons），选择 笔记属性（Note attributes）。

title: Connections tab(关联标签页)
full:
The connections tab groups together all the information about the current note and how it relates to other notes, in four different sections. 连接标签页将关于当前笔记及其与其他笔记关系的所有信息组合在一起，分为四个不同的部分。

It's generally best to keep only the desired sections expanded as each of the sections have to retrieve additional data that might not otherwise be needed. While collapsed, the sections do not retrieve any additional data. 注意：通常最好只展开需要的部分，因为每个部分都必须检索额外的数据（否则可能不需要）。折叠时，这些部分不会检索任何额外数据。

Note map / 笔记地图

The note map displays a graph which shows the relation between the current notes and other notes on the hierarchy. There are two types of visualizations, which can be selected from the top-right part of the section: 笔记地图显示一个图表，展示当前笔记与层级中其他笔记的关系。有两种可视化类型，可以从该部分的右上角选择：

  • The Link map, which displays the relations between notes.
  • The Tree map, which displays the hierarchical structure.
  • 链接地图（Link map），显示笔记之间的关系。
  • 树地图（Tree map），显示层级结构。

The sidebar will remember which visualization is selected, as a global option. Note that note maps also have a #mapType which describes which visualization to use, but the sidebar deliberately ignores that to keep consistency when switching between notes. 侧边栏会记住选择了哪种可视化，作为全局选项。注意，笔记地图也有一个 #mapType 描述使用哪种可视化，但侧边栏刻意忽略它，以在切换笔记时保持一致。

The map can also be expanded by pressing the button in the top-right of the section. When expanded, the map is displayed in a separate dialog. Alternatively, all other sections can be collapsed, which will make the note map taller and the sidebar can be dragged to make for more lateral space. 也可以按下该部分右上角的按钮展开地图。展开时，地图显示在单独的对话框中。或者，可以折叠所有其他部分，使笔记地图更高，侧边栏也可以拖动以获得更多横向空间。

The note map view inside the sidebar is deliberately more compact in order to fit the space: the link map would also show notes that don't have a link to the current note from the hierarchy (creating a cloud of dots) but this is only shown while the map is expanded. Similarly, the link strength and pin configuration buttons are not displayed here. 侧边栏内的笔记地图视图刻意更紧凑以适配空间：链接地图也会显示层级中与当前笔记没有链接的笔记（形成一团点），但这只在地图展开时显示。类似地，链接强度和图钉配置按钮也不在这里显示。

See also: 另见：

  • The Note Map note type
  • Note Map (Link map, Tree map) for more information on the concept as a whole.
  • 笔记地图（Note Map）笔记类型
  • 关于该概念的更多信息，参见笔记地图（链接地图、树地图）。

Note paths / 笔记路径

The note paths section displays the locations in which the current note is cloned. Each segment of the note path is clickable, in order to navigate to that note or clone. 笔记路径部分显示当前笔记被克隆的位置。笔记路径的每一段都可以点击，以便导航到该笔记或克隆。

A new clone can be created from the top-right button. 可以从右上角按钮创建新克隆。

Backlinks / 反向链接

Backlinks list the notes that refer to the current note, as well as a preview of the content where the reference to the note is made. 反向链接列出引用当前笔记的笔记，以及引用该笔记的内容预览。

For more information, see Backlinks. 更多信息参见反向链接（Backlinks）。

Similar notes / 相似笔记

Displays a list of notes that appear similar based on the content of the notes and their attributes. For more information, see Similar Notes. 显示根据笔记内容及其属性看起来相似的笔记列表。更多信息参见相似笔记（Similar Notes）。

title: Recent Changes(最近更改)
full:
Accessing the recent changes / 访问最近更改

  • For an overview of the changes across all documents, press the button in the Launch Bar.
    • If there is a hoisted note or a workspace, the list of recent changes will be limited to the descendents of the hoisted note, or the workspace.
  • To limit the list of recent changes to a note and its descendants, look for the corresponding option in the Note tree contextual menu → Advanced.
  • 要概览所有文档的更改，请按下启动栏（Launch Bar）中的 按钮。
    • 如果存在提升笔记（hoisted note）或工作区（workspace），最近更改列表将限制为提升笔记或工作区的后代。
  • 要将最近更改列表限制为某个笔记及其后代，请在笔记树上下文菜单 → 高级（Advanced）中查找相应选项。

Interaction / 交互

  • Notes which were changed will appear in reverse chronological order (latest update first).
  • The title of the note is displayed, as well as the note path. Clicking on the note title will dismiss the dialog and navigate to that particular note.
  • Deleted notes will also be listed here, at their time of deletion. Press the Undelete link next to them in order to recover them.
  • 被更改的笔记将按时间倒序出现（最新的更新在前）。
  • 显示笔记的标题以及笔记路径。点击笔记标题将关闭对话框并导航到该特定笔记。
  • 已删除的笔记也会在删除时间处列在这里。按下它们旁边的 取消删除（Undelete） 链接即可恢复。

title: Note Tooltip(笔记悬停提示)
full:
The note tooltip is a convenience feature which displays a popup when hovering over an internal link to another note. 笔记工具提示是一项便利功能，当悬停在指向另一个笔记的内部链接上时会显示一个弹出窗口。

The following information is displayed: 显示以下信息：

  • The note path, at the top of the popup.
  • The title of the note.
    • Clicking on the title will open the note in the current tab.
    • Holding Ctrl pressed while clicking the title will open in a new tab instead of the current one.
  • A snippet of the content will be displayed as well.
  • A button to quickly edit the note in a popup.
  • 笔记路径，位于弹出窗口顶部。
  • 笔记的标题。
    • 点击标题将在当前标签页打开笔记。
    • 点击标题时按住 Ctrl 将在新标签页中打开，而不是当前标签页。
  • 同时会显示内容片段。
  • 一个在弹出窗口中快速编辑笔记的按钮。

The tooltip can be found in multiple places, including: 工具提示可以在多个地方出现，包括：

  • In Text notes, when hovering over Internal (reference) links .
  • Collections:
    • Geo Map View, when hovering over a marker.
    • Calendar View, when hovering over an event.
    • Table View, when hovering over a note title, or over a relation.
  • 在文本（Text）笔记中，当悬停在内部（引用）链接上时。
  • 集合（Collections）：
    • 地理地图视图（Geo Map View），当悬停在标记上时。
    • 日历视图（Calendar View），当悬停在事件上时。
    • 表格视图（Table View），当悬停在笔记标题或关系上时。

title: Breadcrumb(面包屑导航)
full:
The breadcrumb allows quickly viewing the note hierarchy of the current note and navigating through it. 面包屑允许快速查看当前笔记的笔记层级并浏览其中。

It is part of the Status bar(状态栏), displayed in the bottom-left of the screen. 它是Status bar(状态栏)的一部分，显示在屏幕左下角。

Layout and Interaction / 布局与交互

  • If a note or workspace is hoisted, a badge will appear on the left-most side.
    • Clicking on the badge will un-hoist the note/workspace.
  • The left-most icon represents the root note, or the hoisted note or workspace.
    • Clicking the icon will jump to the root note.
    • Right clicking the icon will display a menu that allows opening the note in a new tab, split, etc.
  • Each segment shows the title of a note in the current note hierarchy.
