    • Clicking the icon will jump to that note.
    • Right clicking will open a menu with multiple options such as opening the note in a different tab/split/window, hoisting, moving/cloning the note, duplicating as well as changing the color of the note.
  • Clicking the arrow next to each segment will reveal the child notes of the segment on the left.
    • Clicking on an icon will navigate to that particular note.
    • It's also possible to create a new child note from here.
    • The menu can optionally hide the archived notes.
  • If the current note is deep within a hierarchy, the segments will collapse into a […] button in order not to occupy too much space.
    • Clicking this button will display each collapsed entry as a menu item. Clicking on it will navigate to that particular note.
  • Right clicking on an empty space to the right of the breadcrumb (before the other status bar items) will reveal another menu that allows:
    • Toggling whether archived notes are displayed in the breadcrumb and in the note tree.
    • Copying the current note path to clipboard.
  • 如果笔记或工作区被提升，最左侧会出现一个徽章。
    • 点击徽章将取消提升笔记/工作区。
  • 最左侧的图标表示根笔记，或提升的笔记或工作区。
    • 点击图标将跳转到根笔记。
    • 右键点击图标将显示一个菜单，允许在新标签页、分屏等中打开笔记。
  • 每个段显示当前笔记层级中一个笔记的标题。
    • 点击图标将跳转到该笔记。
    • 右键点击将打开一个菜单，包含多个选项，例如在不同的标签页/分屏/窗口中打开笔记、提升、移动/克隆笔记、复制以及更改笔记颜色。
  • 点击每个段旁边的箭头将显示左侧段的子笔记。
    • 点击图标将导航到该特定笔记。
    • 也可以从这里创建新的子笔记。
    • 菜单可以可选地隐藏已归档笔记。
  • 如果当前笔记位于层级深处，各段将折叠成一个 […] 按钮，以免占用太多空间。
    • 点击此按钮将把每个折叠的条目显示为菜单项。点击它将导航到该特定笔记。
  • 右键点击面包屑右侧（其他状态栏项目之前）的空白处将显示另一个菜单，允许：
    • 切换是否在面包屑和笔记树中显示已归档笔记。
    • 将当前笔记路径复制到剪贴板。

title: Note Icons & Colors(笔记图标与颜色)
full:
Icons / 图标

Icons are useful for distinguishing notes and are displayed near the note title, as well as in various places such as the Note Tree, Internal (reference) links or the Jump to & command palette. 图标对于区分笔记很有用，显示在笔记标题附近，也显示在各种地方，如Note Tree、Internal (reference) links或Jump to & command palette。

While editing a note, click on the icon next to the title to bring up a chooser gallery. 编辑笔记时，点击标题旁边的图标以调出选择器图库。

Icons can be inherited through the use of Templates, or Attribute Inheritance. 图标可以通过使用Templates或Attribute Inheritance来继承。

At the technical level, they are set by the iconClass attribute which adds a CSS class to the note. For example #iconClass="bx bx-calendar" will show a calendar instead of the default page or folder icon. Looking up and remembering the CSS class names is not necessary. 注意：在技术层面，它们由 iconClass 属性设置，该属性会向笔记添加一个 CSS 类。例如 #iconClass="bx bx-calendar" 会显示一个日历图标，而不是默认的页面或文件夹图标。无需查阅和记忆 CSS 类名。

Colors / 颜色

Notes can also carry a custom color. Similar to the note icon, this color will be shown in various places such as the Note Tree and Internal (reference) links. 笔记也可以带有自定义颜色。与笔记图标类似，此颜色会显示在各种地方，如Note Tree和Internal (reference) links。

To set a custom color, right click on the note in the Note Tree and select a predefined color from there or use the color picker (last option). 要设置自定义颜色，在Note Tree中右键点击笔记，从那里选择预定义颜色或使用颜色选择器（最后一个选项）。

Alternatively, a custom color can be set manually through the #color label, whose value must be a valid hex color including the leading #(e.g. #ff0000 for red). This color can be carried over across multiple notes via Attribute Inheritance. 或者，可以通过 #color 标签手动设置自定义颜色，其值必须是包含前导 # 的有效十六进制颜色（例如红色为 #ff0000）。这种颜色可以通过Attribute Inheritance跨多个笔记传递。

title: Protected Notes(受保护笔记)
full:
Trilium is designed to store a wide variety of data, including sensitive information such as personal journals, credentials, or confidential documents. To safeguard this type of content, Trilium offers the option to protect notes, which involves the following measures: Trilium 被设计用于存储各种数据，包括个人日志、凭据或机密文件等敏感信息。为保护此类内容，Trilium 提供保护笔记的选项，涉及以下措施：

  • Encryption: Protected notes are encrypted using a key derived from your password. This ensures that without the correct password, protected notes remain indecipherable. Even if someone gains access to your Trilium database, they won't be able to read your encrypted notes.
  • Time-limited access: To access protected notes, you must first enter your password, which decrypts the note for reading and writing. However, after a specified period of inactivity (10 minutes by default), the note is unloaded from memory, requiring you to re-enter your password to access it again.
    • The session timeout is extended automatically while you're interacting with the protected note, so if you're actively editing, the session remains open. However, if you switch to an unprotected note, the session timer starts, and the session expires after 10 minutes of inactivity unless you return to the protected notes.
  • Protection scope: Protected notes ensure the confidentiality of their content and partially their integrity. While unauthorized users cannot read or edit protected notes, they can still delete or move them outside of the protected session.
  • 加密（Encryption）： 受保护笔记使用从你的密码派生的密钥进行加密。这确保了在没有正确密码的情况下，受保护笔记仍然无法解读。即使有人访问了你的 Trilium 数据库，他们也读不了你的加密笔记。
  • 限时访问（Time-limited access）： 要访问受保护笔记，你必须先输入密码，这会解密笔记以供读写。但是，在指定的不活动时间段（默认 10 分钟）后，笔记会从内存中卸载，需要你重新输入密码才能再次访问。
    • 当你与受保护笔记交互时，会话超时会自动延长，所以如果你在积极编辑，会话会保持打开。但是，如果你切换到未受保护的笔记，会话计时器开始计时，并在不活动 10 分钟后过期，除非你返回受保护笔记。
  • 保护范围（Protection scope）： 受保护笔记确保其内容的机密性以及部分完整性。虽然未授权用户无法读取或编辑受保护笔记，但他们仍然可以在受保护会话之外删除或移动它们。

Using Protected Notes / 使用受保护笔记

By default, notes are unprotected. To protect a note, simply click on the shield icon next to the note's title, as shown here: 默认情况下，笔记不受保护。要保护笔记，只需点击笔记标题旁边的盾牌图标，如下所示：

What is Encrypted? / 哪些被加密？

Trilium encrypts the data within protected notes but not their metadata. Specifically: Trilium 加密受保护笔记中的数据，但不加密其元数据。具体来说：

Encrypted: / 已加密：

  • Note title / 笔记标题
  • Note content / 笔记内容
  • Images / 图片
  • File attachments / 文件附件

Not encrypted: / 未加密：

  • Note structure (i.e., it remains visible that there are protected notes) / 笔记结构（即仍然可以看到存在受保护笔记）
  • Metadata, such as the last modified date / 元数据，例如最后修改日期
  • Attributes / 属性

Encryption Details / 加密详情

The following steps outline how encryption and decryption work in Trilium: 以下步骤概述了加密和解密在 Trilium 中的工作方式：

  1. The user enters a password.
  2. The password is passed through the scrypt algorithm along with a "password verification" salt to confirm that the password is correct.
  3. The password is then processed again through scrypt with an "encryption" salt, which generates a hash.
    • Scrypt is used for key stretching to make the password harder to guess.
  4. The generated hash is used to decrypt the actual data encryption key.
    • The data encryption key is encrypted using AES-128 with a random IV.
    • The data encryption key is randomly generated during the database initialization and remains constant throughout the document's lifetime. When the password is changed, only this key is re-encrypted.
  5. The data encryption key is then used to decrypt the actual content of the note, including its title and body.
    • The encryption algorithm used is AES-128 with CBC mode, where a unique IV is generated for each encryption operation and stored with the cipher text.
  6. 用户输入密码。
  7. 密码与一个"密码验证" 盐值（salt）一起通过 scrypt 算法，以确认密码正确。
  8. 然后密码再次通过 scrypt 和一个"加密"盐值处理，生成一个哈希。
    • Scrypt 用于密钥拉伸（key stretching），使密码更难被猜出。
  9. 生成的哈希用于解密实际的 数据加密密钥（data encryption key）。
    • 数据加密密钥使用 AES-128 和随机 IV 加密。
    • 数据加密密钥在 数据库初始化期间随机生成，并在文档的整个生命周期内保持不变。当密码更改时，只有这个密钥会被重新加密。
  10. 然后数据加密密钥用于解密笔记的实际内容，包括其标题和正文。 * 使用的加密算法是带 CBC 模式的 AES-128，其中每次加密操作生成唯一 IV，并与密文一起存储。

Sharing Protected Notes / 共享受保护笔记

Protected notes cannot be shared in the same way as regular notes. Their encryption ensures that only authorized users with the correct password can access them. 受保护笔记不能像常规笔记那样共享。它们的加密确保只有拥有正确密码的授权用户才能访问。

title: Archived Notes(归档笔记)
full:
Archived notes are notes which have archived attribute - either directly or inherited. 归档笔记（Archived notes）是具有 archived 属性的笔记——无论是直接设置还是继承而来。

Such notes are then by default not shown in the autocomplete and in the full text search. 这样的笔记默认不会显示在自动补全和全文搜索中。

This can be useful for notes which are no longer very useful but still valuable enough to keep around without them getting too much in the way. 这对于那些不再非常有用但仍有价值、值得保留而不会太碍事的笔记很有用。

You can control whether archived notes are displayed in the note tree with a setting: 你可以通过一个设置控制是否在笔记树中显示归档笔记：

title: Note Revisions(笔记修订)
full:
Trilium supports seamless versioning of notes by storing snapshots ("revisions") of notes at regular intervals. Trilium 通过定期存储笔记的快照（"修订（revisions）"）来支持无缝的笔记版本控制。

Displaying the revisions / 显示修订

  • On the New Layout, press the note context menu and select Note revisions…
  • On the old layout, press directly the button in the Note buttons area.
  • 在New Layout上，按下笔记上下文菜单并选择 笔记修订…（Note revisions…）
  • 在旧布局上，直接按下Note buttons区域中的 按钮。

Interaction / 交互

This documentation matches the redesign of the note revisions dialog on v0.103.0, older versions have a similar dialog but with some differences. 注意：本文档与 v0.103.0 上笔记修订对话框的重新设计一致，旧版本有类似的对话框但有一些差异。

  • The full list of revisions are displayed on the left in reverse chronological order.
    • The revisions are grouped by the date the revision was taken.
    • This list does not contain the current state of the note, so it is possible to have notes with no revisions/snapshots saved.
  • The icon of a revision indicates the source of that revision (e.g. a icon for a manually saved revision).
  • Pressing the […] on the top-right of the dialog displays multiple options, including:
    • Saving a new revision now.
    • Checking the interval and limit for this note (see below).
    • Deleting all the revisions of this note.
  • For supported notes (text, code), changes are highlighted. This behavior can be toggled via the Highlight changes at the top of the dialog.
    • The highlighted changes are relative to the current state of the note, not to the revision prior to this one.
  • For any given revision, the buttons on the top-right allow operating on it:
    • Deleting the revision.
    • Downloading the revision locally.
    • Restoring the revision, which replaces the current content of the note with the one from the revision. Another revision is saved containing the current content of the note.
  • 完整的修订列表按时间倒序显示在左侧。
    • 修订按修订创建日期分组。
    • 此列表不包含笔记的_当前状态_，因此笔记可能没有任何已保存的修订/快照。
  • 修订的图标指示该修订的_来源_（例如，图标表示手动保存的修订）。
  • 按下对话框右上角的 […] 会显示多个选项，包括：
    • 立即保存一个新修订。
    • 检查此笔记的间隔和限制（见下文）。
    • 删除此笔记的所有修订。
  • 对于支持的笔记（文本、代码），更改会被高亮。此行为可以通过对话框顶部的 高亮更改（Highlight changes） 切换。
    • 高亮的更改相对于笔记的当前状态，而不是相对于此修订之前的那个修订。
  • 对于任何给定的修订，右上角的按钮允许对其操作：
    • 删除修订。
    • 在本地下载修订。
    • 恢复修订，将笔记的当前内容替换为修订中的内容。同时会保存包含笔记当前内容的另一个修订。

Named revisions / 命名修订

Named revisions are a new feature of Trilium v0.103.0 which allows adding a short description of what the changes in the snapshot contain. 命名修订是 Trilium v0.103.0 的新功能，允许添加关于快照中更改内容的简短描述。

In the list of note revisions: 在笔记修订列表中：

  • The name of the revision is displayed underneath the time of the revision in the sidebar, as well as at the top of the dialog where it is displayed in full.
  • Clicking on the edit button near the name of the revision allows it to be changed.
  • 修订的名称显示在侧边栏中修订时间的下方，也显示在对话框顶部（完整显示）。
  • 点击修订名称附近的编辑按钮可以更改它。

To create a named revision, either: 要创建命名修订，可以：

  • Go to the Note buttons, select Save named revision…, enter the name of revision and confirm.
  • Use the corresponding keyboard shortcut or the Jump to & command palette command with the same name.
  • Save a revision normally, and adjust the name afterwards from the note revision list.
  • 进入Note buttons，选择 保存命名修订…（Save named revision…），输入修订名称并确认。
  • 使用相应的键盘快捷键或同名的Jump to & command palette命令。
  • 正常保存修订，然后从笔记修订列表中调整名称。

When revisions are saved / 何时保存修订

Revisions are saved: 修订在以下情况被保存：

  • Automatically at a fixed interval. This behavior can be configured (see below).
  • Manually, by:
    • Going to the press the note context menu and select Save revision.
    • Using the Force Save Revision keyboard shortcut.
    • In the Revisions dialog, pressing the […] button in the top-right and selecting Save a revision now.
  • 以固定的时间间隔自动保存。此行为可以配置（见下文）。
  • 手动保存，方式如下：
    • 按下笔记上下文菜单并选择 保存修订（Save revision）。
    • 使用 强制保存修订（Force Save Revision） 键盘快捷键。
    • 在 修订（Revisions） 对话框中，按下右上角的 […] 按钮并选择 立即保存修订（Save a revision now）。

Additionally, revisions can also come from somewhere else, and this is indicated via the icon of the revision: 此外，修订也可以来自其他地方，这通过修订的图标来指示：

  • Generated externally, by ETAPI (REST API).
  • A modification created by AI.
  • A revision is restored, causing the existing note content to be saved as a revision to prevent potential data loss.
  • 由ETAPI (REST API)在外部生成。
  • 由AI创建的修改。
  • 恢复了修订，导致现有笔记内容被保存为修订以防止潜在的数据丢失。

Snapshot interval / 快照间隔

Time interval of taking note snapshot is configurable in the Options -> Other dialog. This provides a trade-off between more revisions and more data to store. 拍摄笔记快照的时间间隔可在 选项（Options）-> 其他（Other）对话框中配置。这在更多修订和更多要存储的数据之间提供了一个权衡。

To turn off note versioning for a particular note (or sub-tree), add disableVersioning label to the note. 要为特定笔记（或子树）关闭笔记版本控制，请向笔记添加 disableVersioning 标签。

Maximum revisions / 最大修订数

The limit on the number of note snapshots can be configured in the Options -> Other dialog. The note revision snapshot number limit refers to the maximum number of revisions that can be saved for each note. Where -1 means no limit, 0 means delete all revisions. You can set the maximum revisions for a single note through the versioningLimit=X label. 笔记快照数量的限制可在 选项（Options）-> 其他（Other）对话框中配置。笔记修订快照数量限制指的是每个笔记最多可以保存的修订数量。其中 -1 表示无限制，0 表示删除所有修订。你可以通过 versioningLimit=X 标签为单个笔记设置最大修订数。

The note limit will not take effect immediately; it will only apply when the note is modified. 笔记限制不会立即生效；它只会在笔记被修改时生效。

You can click the Erase excess revision snapshots now button to apply the changes immediately. 你可以点击 立即擦除多余的修订快照（Erase excess revision snapshots now） 按钮立即应用更改。

title: Printing & Exporting as PDF(打印与导出为 PDF)
full:
Trilium allows printing notes to a real printer, or generating a structured PDF for a single note or for multiple notes through Collections. Trilium 允许将笔记打印到真实打印机，或通过集合（Collections）为单个笔记或多个笔记生成结构化的 PDF。

Note that not all note types are printable as of now. We do plan to increase the coverage of supported note types in the future. 请注意，目前并非所有笔记类型都可打印。我们确实计划在将来增加受支持笔记类型的覆盖范围。

Printing and exporting as PDF are not perfect. Due to technical limitations, and sometimes even browser or Electron glitches the text might appear cut off in some circumstances. 打印和导出为 PDF 并不完美。由于技术限制，有时甚至浏览器或 Electron 的故障，文本在某些情况下可能会显示被截断。

Printing a note or exporting as PDF on the desktop / 在桌面上打印笔记或导出为 PDF

Versions prior to v0.103.0 had two different options, one for printing and another one for exporting to PDF. With the introduction of the print preview, these functions have been unified. 注意：v0.103.0 之前的版本有两个不同的选项，一个用于打印，另一个用于导出为 PDF。随着打印预览的引入，这些功能已被统一。

On the desktop application of Trilium it is possible to export a note as PDF. To print a note: 在 Trilium 的桌面应用中可以将笔记导出为 PDF。要打印笔记：

  • Press the menu button in the Note buttons area and select Print note.
  • Alternatively, printing can be triggered from a keyboard shortcut (unassigned by default) or through the command palette.
  • 按下笔记按钮（Note buttons）区域中的菜单按钮并选择 打印笔记（Print note）。
  • 或者，打印可以通过键盘快捷键（默认未分配）或通过命令面板触发。

This will trigger the print preview screen next. 接下来将触发打印预览界面。

Print preview & print options / 打印预览与打印选项

The print preview dialog allows the following printing options to be adjusted: 打印预览对话框允许调整以下打印选项：

  • The printer to use / 要使用的打印机

    • Save as PDF generates a PDF that is structured (maintains a table of contents, keeps the text selectable). Prefer this over other virtual PDF printers that ship with the operating system.
    • 另存为 PDF（Save as PDF） 生成的 PDF 是结构化的（保持目录，保持文本可选中）。优先选择此选项，而不是操作系统自带的虚拟 PDF 打印机。

  • Page orientation: Portrait (default) or Landscape. / 页面方向：纵向（Portrait）（默认）或 横向（Landscape）。

  • Page size / 页面大小

  • Scale the entire content from 10% to 200% to improve the fit within the page. / 将整个内容从 10% 缩放到 200%，以改善页面内的适配。

  • Margins, which can be removed completely or adjusted individually for all the four edges. / 边距，可以完全移除或对四个边单独调整。

  • Print only a subset of pages. Individual page numbers are separated by colons and hyphen-based ranges are supported (e.g. 3-5 for pages 3 to 5). / 只打印一部分页面。单独的页码用冒号分隔，支持基于连字符的范围（例如 3-5 表示第 3 到 5 页）。

Additional interaction: 附加交互：

  • Print using system dialog allows setting more options that are otherwise not available in Trilium.
  • 使用系统对话框打印（Print using system dialog） 允许设置更多在 Trilium 中原本不可用的选项。

Most of the options here (except printer & which pages to print) are managed at note level through Attributes (such as #printLandscape, #printPageSize, #printScale, #printMargins).

This means that the print settings will be restored when printing the same note. There are no default settings that can be configured for all the notes, but this can be achieved via inheritable attributes. 注意：这里的大多数选项（除了打印机和要打印哪些页面）都是在笔记级别通过属性（Attributes）管理的（例如 #printLandscape、#printPageSize、#printScale、#printMargins）。

这意味着打印同一笔记时，打印设置会被恢复。没有可以为所有笔记配置的默认设置，但可以通过可继承属性实现。

Printing on the browser / 在浏览器上打印

This feature allows printing of notes. It works on both the desktop client, but also on the web. 此功能允许打印笔记。它既适用于桌面客户端，也适用于网页。

To print a note, select the button to the right of the note and select Print note. Depending on the size and type of the note, this can take up to a few seconds. Afterwards you will be redirected to the system/browser printing dialog. 要打印笔记，选择笔记右侧的 按钮并选择 打印笔记（Print note）。根据笔记的大小和类型，这可能需要几秒钟。之后你将被重定向到系统/浏览器的打印对话框。

On the server or PWA (mobile), the option is not available due to technical constraints and it will be hidden. 在服务器或 PWA（移动端）上，由于技术限制，该选项不可用并会被隐藏。

Reporting issues with the rendering / 报告渲染问题

Should you encounter any visual issues in the resulting PDF file (e.g. a table does not fit properly, there is cut off text, etc.) feel free to report the issue. In this case, it's best to offer a sample note (click on the button, select Export note → This note and all of its descendants → HTML in ZIP archive). Make sure not to accidentally leak any personal information. 如果你在生成的 PDF 文件中遇到任何视觉问题（例如表格适配不佳、文本被截断等），请随时报告问题。在这种情况下，最好提供示例笔记（点击 按钮，选择 导出笔记（Export note）→ 此笔记及其所有后代（This note and all of its descendants）→ ZIP 归档中的 HTML）。确保不要意外泄露任何个人信息。

Consider adjusting font sizes and using page breaks to work around the layout. 考虑调整字体大小并使用分页符来解决布局问题。

Although direct export as PDF is not available in the browser version of the application, it's still possible to generate a PDF by selecting the Print option instead and selecting "Save to PDF" as the printer (depending on the browser). Generally, Mozilla Firefox has better printing capabilities. 提示：虽然应用的浏览器版本不提供直接导出为 PDF，但仍然可以通过选择 打印（Print） 选项并将打印机选择为"保存为 PDF（Save to PDF）"来生成 PDF（取决于浏览器）。一般来说，Mozilla Firefox 有更好的打印能力。

Automatic opening of the file / 自动打开文件

When the PDF is exported, it is automatically opened with the system default application for easy preview. 当 PDF 被导出时，它会自动用系统默认应用打开，以便轻松预览。

Note that if you are using Linux with the GNOME desktop environment, sometimes the default application might seem incorrect (such as opening in GIMP). This is because it uses Gnome's "Recommended applications" list. 请注意，如果你使用带 GNOME 桌面环境的 Linux，有时默认应用可能看起来不正确（例如在 GIMP 中打开）。这是因为它使用 Gnome 的"推荐应用（Recommended applications）"列表。

To solve this, you can change the recommended application for PDFs via this command line. First, list the available applications via gio mime application/pdf and then set the desired one. For example to use GNOME's Evince: 要解决此问题，你可以通过以下命令行更改 PDF 的推荐应用。首先，通过 gio mime application/pdf 列出可用应用，然后设置所需的应用。例如使用 GNOME 的 Evince：

gio mime application/pdf

Printing multiple notes / 打印多个笔记

Since v0.100.0, it is possible to print more than one note at the time by using Collections: 从 v0.100.0 开始，可以通过使用集合（Collections）一次打印多个笔记：

  1. First create a collection.
  2. Configure it to use List View.
  3. Print the collection note normally.
  4. 首先创建一个集合。
  5. 配置它使用列表视图（List View）。
  6. 正常打印集合笔记。

The resulting collection will contain all the children of the collection, while maintaining the hierarchy. 生成的集合将包含集合的所有子笔记，同时保持层级结构。

Not all note types are supported when printing or exporting to PDF. When an unsupported note is encountered, it is skipped. At the end, if any of the notes were skipped, a message will be displayed with the possibility of viewing the full list of skipped notes. The same limitations as the ones described in Constraints & limitations apply. 注意：打印或导出为 PDF 时并非所有笔记类型都受支持。当遇到不支持的笔记时，它会被跳过。最后，如果有任何笔记被跳过，将显示一条消息，并有可能查看被跳过笔记的完整列表。适用与 约束与限制（Constraints & limitations） 中描述的相同的限制。

Keyboard shortcut / 键盘快捷键

It's possible to trigger both printing and export as PDF from the keyboard by going to Keyboard shortcuts in Options and assigning a key combination for: 可以通过进入选项（Options）中的 键盘快捷键（Keyboard shortcuts） 并分配按键组合来从键盘触发打印和导出为 PDF，用于：

  • Print Active Note / 打印活动笔记（Print Active Note）
  • Export Active Note as PDF / 将活动笔记导出为 PDF（Export Active Note as PDF）

Constraints & limitations / 约束与限制

Not all Note Types are supported when printing, in which case the Print and Export as PDF options will be disabled. 打印时并非所有笔记类型（Note Types）都受支持，在这种情况下 打印（Print） 和 导出为 PDF（Export as PDF） 选项将被禁用。

  • For Code notes:
    • Line numbers are not printed.
    • Syntax highlighting is enabled, however a default theme (Visual Studio) is enforced.
  • For Collections, the following are supported:
    • List View, allowing to print multiple notes at once while preserving hierarchy (similar to a book).
    • Presentation, where each slide/sub-note is displayed.
      • Most note types are supported, especially the ones that have an image representation such as Canvas and Mind Map.
    • Table, where the table is rendered in a print-friendly way.
      • Tables that are too complex (especially if they have multiple columns) might not fit properly, however tables with a large number of rows are supported thanks to pagination.
      • Consider printing in landscape mode, or using #printLandscape if exporting to PDF.
    • The rest of the collections are not supported, but we plan to add support for all the collection types at some point.
  • Using Custom app-wide CSS for printing is no longer supported, instead a custom printCss relation needs to be used (see below).
  • 对于代码（Code）笔记：
    • 不打印行号。
    • 语法高亮已启用，但强制使用默认主题（Visual Studio）。
  • 对于集合（Collections），支持以下类型：
    • 列表视图（List View），允许一次打印多个笔记并保持层级结构（类似于一本书）。
    • 演示文稿（Presentation），其中显示每个幻灯片/子笔记。
      • 大多数笔记类型都受支持，尤其是具有图像表示的笔记类型，如画布（Canvas）和思维导图（Mind Map）。
    • 表格（Table），其中表格以适合打印的方式渲染。
      • 过于复杂的表格（尤其是有多列的）可能无法正常适配，但由于分页，具有大量行的表格受支持。
      • 考虑以横向模式打印，或在导出为 PDF 时使用 #printLandscape。
    • 其余的集合类型不受支持，但我们计划在某个时候为所有集合类型添加支持。
  • 不再支持使用自定义全局应用 CSS（Custom app-wide CSS）进行打印，而是需要使用自定义 printCss 关系（见下文）。

Customizing the print CSS / 自定义打印 CSS

As an advanced use case, it's possible to customize the CSS used for printing such as adjusting the fonts, sizes or margins. Note that Custom app-wide CSS will not work for printing. 作为一个高级用例，可以自定义用于打印的 CSS，例如调整字体、大小或边距。请注意，自定义全局应用 CSS对打印无效。

To do so: 具体做法：

  • Create a CSS code note.
  • On the note being printed, apply the ~printCss relation to point to the newly created CSS code note.
  • To apply the CSS to multiple notes, consider using inheritable attributes or Templates.
  • 创建一个 CSS 代码笔记。
  • 在要打印的笔记上，应用 ~printCss 关系指向新创建的 CSS 代码笔记。
  • 要将 CSS 应用到多个笔记，考虑使用可继承属性或模板（Templates）。

For example, to change the font of the document from the one defined by the theme or the user to a serif one: 例如，要将文档字体从主题或用户定义的字体改为衬线字体：

body—{
	--print-font-family: serif;
    --print-font-size: 11pt;
}

When altering --print-font-family, make sure the change is done at body level and not at :root, since otherwise it won't be picked up due to specificity rules. 重要：当更改 --print-font-family 时，确保更改在 body 级别完成，而不是在 :root 级别，否则由于特异性规则，它不会被采用。

To remark: 要点说明：

  • Multiple CSS notes can be added by using multiple ~printCss relations.
  • If the note pointing to the printCss doesn't have the right note type or mime type, it will be ignored.
  • If migrating from a previous version where Custom app-wide CSS was used, there's no need for @media print {—since the style-sheet is used only for printing.
  • 可以通过使用多个 ~printCss 关系添加多个 CSS 笔记。
  • 如果指向 printCss 的笔记没有正确的笔记类型或 MIME 类型，它将被忽略。
  • 如果从使用自定义全局应用 CSS的旧版本迁移，则不需要 @media print {—因为样式表仅用于打印。

Under the hood / 底层机制

Both printing and exporting as PDF use the same mechanism: a note is rendered individually in a separate webpage that is then sent to the browser or the Electron application either for printing or exporting as PDF. 打印和导出为 PDF 都使用相同的机制：笔记在单独的网页中单独渲染，然后发送到浏览器或 Electron 应用，用于打印或导出为 PDF。

The webpage that renders a single note can actually be accessed in a web browser. For example http://localhost:8080/#root/WWRGzqHUFrln/RRZsE9Al8AIZ?ntxId=0o4fzk becomes http://localhost:8080/?print#root/WWRGzqHUFrln/RRZsE9Al8AIZ. 渲染单个笔记的网页实际上可以在网页浏览器中访问。例如 http://localhost:8080/#root/WWRGzqHUFrln/RRZsE9Al8AIZ?ntxId=0o4fzk 变为 http://localhost:8080/?print#root/WWRGzqHUFrln/RRZsE9Al8AIZ。

Accessing the print note in a web browser allows for easy debugging to understand why a particular note doesn't render well. The mechanism for rendering is similar to the one used in Note List. 在网页浏览器中访问打印笔记便于调试，以了解为什么某个笔记渲染不佳。渲染机制与笔记列表（Note List）中使用的类似。

title: Note List(笔记列表)
full:
When a note has one or more child notes, they will be listed at the end of the note for easy navigation. 当一个笔记有一个或多个子笔记时，它们会列在笔记末尾，方便导航。

Configuration / 配置

  • To hide the note list for a particular note, simply apply the hideChildrenOverview label.
  • For some view types, such as Grid view, only a subset of notes will be displayed and pagination can be used to navigate through all of them for performance reasons. To adjust the number of notes per page, set pageSize to the desired number.
  • 要为特定笔记隐藏笔记列表，只需应用 hideChildrenOverview 标签。
  • 对于某些视图类型（如网格视图），只会显示一部分笔记，出于性能原因可以使用分页浏览所有笔记。要调整每页笔记数量，请将 pageSize 设置为所需数量。

View types / 视图类型

The view types dictate how the child notes are represented. By default, the notes will be displayed in a grid, however there are also some other view types available. 视图类型决定子笔记的呈现方式。默认情况下，笔记以网格显示，但也有其他可用的视图类型。

Generally the view type can only be changed in a Collections note from the Ribbon, but it can also be changed manually on any type of note using the #viewType attribute. 一般来说，视图类型只能在集合（Collections）笔记中从功能区（Ribbon）更改，但也可以在任意类型的笔记上使用 #viewType 属性手动更改。

title: Note Navigation(笔记导航)
full:
One of the Trilium's goals is to provide fast and comfortable navigation between notes. Trilium 的目标之一是提供笔记之间快速舒适的导航。

Backwards and forward / 后退和前进

You can use alt-left and alt-right to move back and forward in history of viewed pages. 你可以使用 alt-left 和 alt-right 在已查看页面的历史记录中后退和前进。

This works identically to browser backwards / forwards, it's actually using built-in browser support for this. 这与浏览器的后退/前进完全相同，实际上它使用了浏览器内置的支持。

Jump to note / 跳转到笔记

This is useful to quickly find and view arbitrary notes - click on Jump tobutton on the top or press Ctrl + J . Then type part of the note name and autocomplete will help you pick the desired note. 这对于快速查找和查看任意笔记很有用——点击顶部的 跳转到（Jump to）按钮或按 Ctrl + J。然后输入部分笔记名称，自动补全将帮助你选择所需的笔记。

See Jump to Note for more information. 更多信息参见跳转到笔记（Jump to Note）。

title: Quick search(快速搜索)
full:
The Quick search function does a full-text search (that is, it searches through the content of notes and not just the title of a note) and displays the result in an easy-to-access manner. 快速搜索（Quick search） 功能执行全文搜索（即，它搜索笔记的内容而不仅仅是笔记的标题），并以易于访问的方式显示结果。

The alternative to the quick search is the Search function, which opens in a dedicated tab and has support for advanced queries. 快速搜索的替代方案是搜索（Search）功能，它在专门的标签页中打开，并支持高级查询。

For even faster navigation, it's possible to use Jump to... which will only search through the note titles instead of the content. 为了更快的导航，可以使用跳转到...（Jump to...），它只搜索笔记标题而不是内容。

Layout / 布局

Based on the Vertical and horizontal layout, the quick search is placed: 基于垂直和水平布局（Vertical and horizontal layout），快速搜索被放置在：

  • On the vertical layout, it is displayed right above the Note Tree.
  • On the horizontal layout, it is displayed in the Launch Bar, where it can be positioned just like any other icon.
  • 在垂直布局中，它显示在笔记树（Note Tree）正上方。
  • 在水平布局中，它显示在启动栏（Launch Bar）中，在那里它可以像任何其他图标一样定位。

Search Features / 搜索功能

Quick search includes the following features: 快速搜索包含以下功能：

Content Previews / 内容预览

Search results now display a 200-character preview of the note content below the note title. This preview shows the context where your search terms appear, making it easier to identify the right note without opening it. 搜索结果现在在笔记标题下方显示笔记内容的 200 字符预览。此预览显示你的搜索词出现的上下文，使你在不打开笔记的情况下更容易识别正确的笔记。

Infinite Scrolling / 无限滚动

Results are loaded progressively as you scroll: 结果在你滚动时逐步加载：

  • Initial display shows 15 results / 初始显示 15 条结果
  • Scrolling near the bottom automatically loads 10 more results / 滚动到底部附近自动加载 10 条更多结果
  • Continue scrolling to load all matching notes / 继续滚动以加载所有匹配的笔记

Visual Features / 视觉功能

  • Highlighting: Search terms appear in bold with accent colors
  • Separation: Results are separated with dividers
  • Theme Support: Highlighting colors adapt to light/dark themes
  • 高亮（Highlighting）：搜索词以粗体并带有强调色显示
  • 分隔（Separation）：结果用分隔线分隔
  • 主题支持（Theme Support）：高亮颜色适应浅色/深色主题

Search Behavior / 搜索行为

Quick search uses progressive search: 快速搜索使用渐进式搜索：

  1. Shows exact matches first / 先显示精确匹配
  2. Includes fuzzy matches when exact results are fewer than 5 / 当精确结果少于 5 条时包含模糊匹配
  3. Exact matches appear before fuzzy matches / 精确匹配出现在模糊匹配之前

Keyboard Navigation / 键盘导航

  • Press Enter to open the first result
  • Use arrow keys to navigate through results
  • Press Escape to close the quick search
  • 按 Enter 打开第一个结果
  • 使用箭头键在结果中导航
  • 按 Escape 关闭快速搜索

Using Quick Search / 使用快速搜索

  1. Typo tolerance: Search finds results despite minor typos
  2. Content previews: 200-character snippets show match context
  3. Infinite scrolling: Additional results load on scroll
  4. Specific terms: Specific search terms return more focused results
  5. Match locations: Bold text indicates where matches occur
  6. 拼写容错（Typo tolerance）：即使有轻微拼写错误，搜索也能找到结果
  7. 内容预览（Content previews）：200 字符片段显示匹配上下文
  8. 无限滚动（Infinite scrolling）：滚动时加载更多结果
  9. 特定词（Specific terms）：特定的搜索词返回更聚焦的结果
  10. 匹配位置（Match locations）：粗体文本指示匹配出现的位置

Quick Search - Exact Match Operator / 快速搜索 - 精确匹配运算符

Quick Search now supports the exact match operator (=) at the beginning of your search query. This allows you to search for notes where the title or content exactly matches your search term, rather than just containing it. 快速搜索现在支持在搜索查询开头使用精确匹配运算符（=）。这允许你搜索标题或内容与搜索词完全匹配的笔记，而不仅仅是包含它。

Usage / 用法

To use exact match in Quick Search: 要在快速搜索中使用精确匹配：

  1. Start your search query with the = operator
  2. Follow it immediately with your search term (no space after =)
  3. 以 = 运算符开始你的搜索查询
  4. 紧跟你的搜索词（= 后无空格）

Examples / 示例

  • =example - Finds notes with title exactly "example" or content exactly "example"
  • =Project Plan - Finds notes with title exactly "Project Plan" or content exactly "Project Plan"
  • ='hello world' - Use quotes for multi-word exact matches
  • =example - 查找标题恰好为 "example" 或内容恰好为 "example" 的笔记
  • =Project Plan - 查找标题恰好为 "Project Plan" 或内容恰好为 "Project Plan" 的笔记
  • ='hello world' - 对多词精确匹配使用引号

Comparison with Regular Search / 与常规搜索的比较

Technical Details / 技术细节

When you use the = operator: 当你使用 = 运算符时：

  • The search performs an exact match on note titles
  • For note content, it looks for exact matches of the entire content
  • Partial word matches are excluded
  • The search is case-insensitive
  • 搜索对笔记标题执行精确匹配
  • 对于笔记内容，它查找整个内容的精确匹配
  • 排除部分单词匹配
  • 搜索不区分大小写

Limitations / 限制

  • The = operator must be at the very beginning of the search query
  • Spaces after = will treat it as a regular search
  • Multiple = operators (like ==example) are treated as regular text search
  • = 运算符必须位于搜索查询的最开头
  • = 后的空格会将其视为常规搜索
  • 多个 = 运算符（如 ==example）被视为常规文本搜索

Use Cases / 使用场景

This feature is particularly useful when: 此功能在以下情况特别有用：

  • You know the exact title of a note
  • You want to find notes with specific, complete content
  • You need to distinguish between notes with similar but not identical titles
  • You want to avoid false positives from partial matches
  • 你知道笔记的准确标题
  • 你想查找具有特定完整内容的笔记
  • 你需要区分标题相似但不完全相同的笔记
  • 你想避免部分匹配带来的误报

Related Features / 相关功能

  • For more complex exact matching queries, use the full Search functionality
  • For fuzzy matching (finding results despite typos), use the ~= operator in the full search
  • For partial matches with wildcards, use operators like *=, =*, or *=* in the full search
  • 对于更复杂的精确匹配查询，使用完整的搜索（Search）功能
  • 对于模糊匹配（尽管有拼写错误也能找到结果），在完整搜索中使用 ~= 运算符
  • 对于带通配符的部分匹配，在完整搜索中使用 *=、=* 或 *=* 等运算符

title: Jump to & command palette(跳转与命令面板)
full:
Jump to Note / 跳转到笔记

The Jump to Note function allows easy navigation between notes by searching for their title. In addition to that, it can also trigger a full search or create notes. 跳转到笔记（Jump to Note） 功能允许通过搜索笔记标题在笔记之间轻松导航。除此之外，它还可以触发完整搜索或创建笔记。

To enter the "Jump to" dialog: 要进入"跳转到（Jump to）"对话框：

  • In the Launch Bar, press button.
  • Using the keyboard, press Ctrl + J.
  • 在启动栏（Launch Bar）中，按下按钮。
  • 使用键盘，按 Ctrl + J。

In addition to searching for notes, it is also possible to search for commands. See the dedicated section below for more information. 除了搜索笔记，也可以搜索命令。更多信息请参见下面的专门部分。

Interaction / 交互

  • By default, when there is no text entered it will display the most recent notes.
  • Using the keyboard, use the up or down arrow keys to navigate between items. Press Enter to open the desired note.
  • If the note doesn't exist, it's possible to create it by typing the desired note title and selecting the Create and link child note option.
  • 默认情况下，当没有输入文本时，它会显示最近的笔记。
  • 使用键盘，用上或下箭头键在项目之间导航。按 Enter 打开所需的笔记。
  • 如果笔记不存在，可以通过输入所需的笔记标题并选择 创建并链接子笔记（Create and link child note） 选项来创建它。

Recent notes / 最近笔记

Jump to note also has the ability to show the list of recently viewed / edited notes and quickly jump to it. 跳转到笔记也有能力显示最近查看/编辑的笔记列表并快速跳转。

To access this functionality, click on Jump to button on the top. By default, (when nothing is entered into autocomplete), this dialog will show the list of recent notes. 要访问此功能，点击顶部的 跳转到（Jump to）按钮。默认情况下（当自动补全中没有输入任何内容时），此对话框会显示最近笔记的列表。

Alternatively you can click on the "time" icon on the right. 或者你可以点击右侧的"时间"图标。

Command Palette / 命令面板

The command palette is a feature which allows easy execution of various commands that can be found throughout the application, such as from menus or keyboard shortcuts. This feature integrates directly into the "Jump to" dialog. 命令面板（command palette）是一个允许轻松执行应用中各种命令（例如来自菜单或键盘快捷键）的功能。此功能直接集成到"跳转到（Jump to）"对话框中。

Interaction / 交互

To trigger the command palette: 要触发命令面板：

  • Press Ctrl+Shift+J to display the command palette directly.
  • If in the "Jump to" dialog, type > in the search to switch to the command palette.
  • 按 Ctrl+Shift+J 直接显示命令面板。
  • 如果在"跳转到"对话框中，在搜索中输入 > 以切换到命令面板。

Interaction: 交互：

  • Type a few words to filter between commands.
  • Use the up and down arrows on the keyboard or the mouse to select a command.
  • Press Enter to execute the command.
  • 输入几个词来过滤命令。
  • 使用键盘或鼠标的上、下箭头选择一个命令。
  • 按 Enter 执行命令。

To exit the command palette: 要退出命令面板：

  • Remove the > in the search to go back to the note search.
  • Press Esc to dismiss the dialog entirely.
  • 移除搜索中的 > 以返回笔记搜索。
  • 按 Esc 完全关闭对话框。

Options available / 可用选项

Currently the following options are displayed: 目前显示以下选项：

  • Most of the Keyboard Shortcuts have an entry, with the exception of those that are too specific to be run from a dialog.
  • Some additional options which are not yet available as keyboard shortcuts, but can be accessed from various menus such as: exporting a note, showing attachments, searching for notes or configuring the Launch Bar.
  • 大多数键盘快捷键（Keyboard Shortcuts）都有一个条目，但那些过于特定而无法从对话框运行的除外。
  • 一些额外的选项还不能作为键盘快捷键使用，但可以从各种菜单访问，例如：导出笔记、显示附件、搜索笔记或配置启动栏（Launch Bar）。

Limitations / 限制

Currently it's not possible to define custom actions that are displayed in the command palette. In the future this might change by integrating the options in the launch bar, which can be customized if needed. 目前无法定义显示在命令面板中的自定义操作。将来这可能会通过集成启动栏中的选项而改变，启动栏可以根据需要自定义。

title: Search(搜索)
full:
Note search enables you to find notes by searching for text in the title, content, or attributes of the notes. You also have the option to save your searches, which will create a special search note which is visible on your navigation tree and contains the search results as sub-items. 笔记搜索使你能够通过在笔记的标题、内容或属性中搜索文本来查找笔记。你还可以选择保存搜索，这将创建一个特殊的搜索笔记，它在你的导航树上可见，并将搜索结果作为子项目包含。

Accessing the search / 访问搜索

  • From the Launch Bar, look for the dedicated search button.
  • To limit the search to a note and its children, select Search from subtree from the Note tree contextual menu or press Ctrl+Shift+S.
  • 从启动栏（Launch Bar）中，查找专门的搜索按钮。
  • 要将搜索限制到一个笔记及其子笔记，从笔记树上下文菜单选择 从子树搜索（Search from subtree），或按 Ctrl+Shift+S。

Interaction / 交互

To search for notes, click on the magnifying glass icon on the toolbar or press the keyboard shortcut. 要搜索笔记，点击工具栏上的放大镜图标或按下键盘快捷键。

  1. Set the text to search for in the Search string field.
    1. Apart from searching for words literally, there is also the possibility to search for attributes or properties of notes.
    2. See the examples below for more information.
  2. To limit the search to a note and its sub-children, set a note in Ancestor.
    1. This value is also pre-filled if the search is triggered from a hoisted note or a workspace.
    2. To search the entire database, keep the value empty.
  3. To limit the search to only a few levels of hierarchy (e.g. look in sub-children but not in sub-sub-children of a note), set the depth field to one of the provided values.
  4. In addition to that, the search can be configured via the Add search options buttons, as described in the follow-up section.
  5. Press Search to trigger the search. The results are displayed below the search configuration pane.
  6. The Search & Execute actions button is only relevant if at least one action has been added (as described in the section below).
  7. The Save to note will create a new note with the search configuration. For more information, see Saved Search.
  8. 在 搜索字符串（Search string） 字段中设置要搜索的文本。
    1. 除了按字面搜索单词，还可以搜索笔记的属性（attributes）或性质（properties）。
    2. 更多信息参见下面的示例。
  9. 要将搜索限制到一个笔记及其子子笔记，在 祖先（Ancestor） 中设置一个笔记。
    1. 如果搜索是从提升的笔记或工作区触发的，此值也会被预填。
    2. 要搜索整个数据库，保持该值为空。
  10. 要将搜索限制到只有几层层级（例如，在子子笔记中查找但不在子子子笔记中查找），将 深度（depth） 字段设置为提供的值之一。
  11. 除此之外，可以通过 添加搜索选项（Add search options） 按钮配置搜索，如下一节所述。
  12. 按 搜索（Search） 触发搜索。结果显示在搜索配置面板下方。
  13. 搜索并执行操作（Search & Execute actions） 按钮只有在至少添加了一个操作时才相关（如下一节所述）。
  14. 保存到笔记（Save to note） 将创建一个包含搜索配置的新笔记。更多信息参见已保存搜索（Saved Search）。

Search options / 搜索选项

Click on which search option to apply from the Add search option section. 从"添加搜索选项（Add search option）"部分点击要应用的搜索选项。

  • For each search option selected, the search configuration will update to reveal the entry. Each search option will have its own configuration.
  • To remove a search option, simply press the X button to the right of it.
  • 对于每个选中的搜索选项，搜索配置会更新以显示该条目。每个搜索选项都有自己的配置。
  • 要移除一个搜索选项，只需按下其右侧的 X 按钮。

The options available are: 可用的选项是：

  1. Search script
    1. This feature allows writing a Code note that will handle the search on its own.
  2. Fast search
    1. The search will not look into the content of the notes, but it will still look into note titles and attributes, relations (based on the search query).
    2. This method can speed up the search considerably for large databases.
  3. Include archived
    1. Archived Notes will also be included in the results, whereas otherwise they would be ignored.
  4. Order by
    1. Allows changing the criteria for ordering the results, for example to order by creation date or alphabetically instead of by relevance (default).
    2. It's also possible to change the order (ascending or descending) of the results.
  5. Limit
    1. Limits the results to a given maximum.
    2. This can help if the number of results would otherwise be high, at the cost of not being able to view all the results.
  6. Debug
    1. This will print additional information in the server log (see Error logs), regarding how the search expression was parsed.
    2. This function is especially useful after understanding the search functionality in detail, in order to determine why a complex search query is not working as expected.
  7. Action
    1. Apart from just searching, it is also possible to apply actions such as to add a label or a relation to the notes that have been matched by the search.
    2. Unlike other search configurations, here it's possible to apply the same action multiple times (i.e. in order to be able to apply multiple labels to notes).
    3. The actions given are the same as the ones in Bulk Actions, which is an alternative for operating directly with notes within the Note Tree.
    4. After defining the actions, first press Search to check the matched notes and then press Search & Execute actions to trigger the actions.
  8. 搜索脚本（Search script）
    1. 此功能允许编写一个代码（Code）笔记来自行处理搜索。
  9. 快速搜索（Fast search）
    1. 搜索不会查看笔记的内容，但仍然会查看笔记标题和属性、关系（基于搜索查询）。
    2. 对于大型数据库，此方法可以显著加快搜索。
  10. 包含已归档（Include archived） 1. 归档笔记（Archived Notes）也将包含在结果中，否则它们会被忽略。
  11. 排序方式（Order by） 1. 允许更改结果排序的标准，例如按创建日期或字母顺序排序，而不是按相关性（默认）排序。 2. 也可以更改结果的顺序（升序或降序）。
  12. 限制（Limit） 1. 将结果限制为给定的最大值。 2. 如果结果数量本来就很高，这会有所帮助，代价是无法查看所有结果。
  13. 调试（Debug） 1. 这将在服务器日志（参见错误日志（Error logs））中打印关于搜索表达式如何被解析的附加信息。 2. 在详细了解搜索功能之后，此功能对于确定复杂的搜索查询为何不像预期那样工作尤其有用。
  14. 操作（Action） 1. 除了只搜索之外，还可以应用操作，例如向被搜索匹配的笔记添加标签或关系。 2. 与其他搜索配置不同，这里可以多次应用相同的操作（即，以便能够向笔记应用多个标签）。 3. 给定的操作与批量操作（Bulk Actions）中的相同，后者是在笔记树中直接操作笔记的替代方案。 4. 定义操作后，先按 搜索（Search） 检查匹配的笔记，然后按 搜索并执行操作（Search & Execute actions） 触发操作。

Simple Note Search Examples / 简单笔记搜索示例

  • rings tolkien: Full-text search to find notes containing both "rings" and "tolkien".
  • "The Lord of the Rings" Tolkien: Full-text search where "The Lord of the Rings" must match exactly.
  • note.content *=* rings OR note.content *=* tolkien: Find notes containing "rings" or "tolkien" in their content.
  • towers #book: Combine full-text and attribute search to find notes containing "towers" and having the "book" label.
  • towers #book or #author: Search for notes containing "towers" and having either the "book" or "author" label.
  • towers #!book: Search for notes containing "towers" and not having the "book" label.
  • #book #publicationYear = 1954: Find notes with the "book" label and "publicationYear" set to 1954.
  • #genre *=* fan: Find notes with the "genre" label containing the substring "fan". Additional operators include =*for "contains", =* for "starts with", *= for "ends with", and != for "is not equal to".
  • #book #publicationYear >= 1950 #publicationYear < 1960: Use numeric operators to find all books published in the 1950s.
  • #dateNote >= TODAY-30: Find notes with the "dateNote" label within the last 30 days. Supported date values include NOW +- seconds, TODAY +- days, MONTH +- months, YEAR +- years.
  • ~author.title *=* Tolkien: Find notes related to an author whose title contains "Tolkien".
  • #publicationYear %= '19[0-9]{2}': Use the '%=' operator to match a regular expression (regex). This feature has been available since Trilium 0.52.
  • note.content %= '\d{2}:\d{2} (PM|AM)': Find notes that mention a time. Backslashes in a regex must be escaped.
  • rings tolkien：全文搜索，查找同时包含 "rings" 和 "tolkien" 的笔记。
  • "The Lord of the Rings" Tolkien：全文搜索，其中 "The Lord of the Rings" 必须精确匹配。
  • note.content *=* rings OR note.content *=* tolkien：查找内容中包含 "rings" 或 "tolkien" 的笔记。
  • towers #book：结合全文和属性搜索，查找包含 "towers" 且具有 "book" 标签的笔记。
  • towers #book or #author：搜索包含 "towers" 且具有 "book" 或 "author" 标签的笔记。
  • towers #!book：搜索包含 "towers" 且不具有 "book" 标签的笔记。
  • #book #publicationYear = 1954：查找具有 "book" 标签且 "publicationYear" 为 1954 的笔记。
  • #genre *=* fan：查找 "genre" 标签包含子串 "fan" 的笔记。其他运算符包括 =*（"包含"）、=*（"以...开头"）、*=（"以...结尾"）和 !=（"不等于"）。
  • #book #publicationYear >= 1950 #publicationYear < 1960：使用数值运算符查找 20 世纪 50 年代出版的所有书籍。
  • #dateNote >= TODAY-30：查找 "dateNote" 标签在过去 30 天内的笔记。支持的日期值包括 NOW +- 秒、TODAY +- 天、MONTH +- 月、YEAR +- 年。
  • ~author.title *=* Tolkien：查找与标题包含 "Tolkien" 的作者相关的笔记。
  • #publicationYear %= '19[0-9]{2}'：使用 '%=' 运算符匹配正则表达式（regex）。此功能自 Trilium 0.52 起可用。
  • note.content %= '\d{2}:\d{2} (PM|AM)'：查找提及时间的笔记。正则表达式中的反斜杠必须转义。

Fuzzy Search / 模糊搜索

Trilium supports fuzzy search operators that find results with typos or spelling variations: Trilium 支持模糊搜索运算符，可以找到有拼写错误或拼写变化的搜索结果：

  • #title ~= trilim: Fuzzy exact match - finds notes with titles like "Trilium" even if you typed "trilim" (with a typo)
  • #content ~* progra: Fuzzy contains match - finds notes containing words like "program", "programmer", "programming" even with slight misspellings
  • note.content ~* develpmnt: Will find notes containing "development" despite the typo
  • #title ~= trilim：模糊精确匹配 - 即使你输入了 "trilim"（有拼写错误），也能找到标题像 "Trilium" 的笔记
  • #content ~* progra：模糊包含匹配 - 找到包含 "program"、"programmer"、"programming" 等单词的笔记，即使有轻微拼写错误
  • note.content ~* develpmnt：尽管有拼写错误，也能找到包含 "development" 的笔记

Important notes about fuzzy search: / 关于模糊搜索的重要说明：

  • Fuzzy search requires at least 3 characters in the search term
  • Maximum edit distance is 2 characters (number of character changes needed)
  • Diacritics are normalized (e.g., "café" matches "cafe")
  • Fuzzy matches work best for finding content with minor typos or spelling variations
  • 模糊搜索要求搜索词中至少 3 个字符
  • 最大编辑距离为 2 个字符（所需的字符更改数）
  • 变音符被规范化（例如，"café" 匹配 "cafe"）
  • 模糊匹配最适合查找有轻微拼写错误或拼写变化的内容

Advanced Use Cases / 高级用例

  • ~author.relations.son.title = 'Christopher Tolkien': Search for notes with an "author" relation to a note that has a "son" relation to "Christopher Tolkien". This can be modeled with the following note structure:
    • Books
      • Lord of the Rings
        • label: "book"
        • relation: "author" points to "J. R. R. Tolkien" note
    • People
      • J. R. R. Tolkien
        • relation: "son" points to "Christopher Tolkien" note
        • Christopher Tolkien
  • ~author.title *= Tolkien OR (#publicationDate >= 1954 AND #publicationDate <= 1960): Use boolean expressions and parentheses to group expressions. Note that expressions starting with a parenthesis need an "expression separator sign" (# or ~) prepended.
  • note.parents.title = 'Books': Find notes with a parent named "Books".
  • note.parents.parents.title = 'Books': Find notes with a grandparent named "Books".
  • note.ancestors.title = 'Books': Find notes with an ancestor named "Books".
  • note.children.title = 'sub-note': Find notes with a child named "sub-note".
  • ~author.relations.son.title = 'Christopher Tolkien'：搜索具有 "author" 关系指向某笔记的笔记，该笔记具有 "son" 关系指向 "Christopher Tolkien"。这可以用以下笔记结构建模：
    • 书籍（Books）
      • 指环王（Lord of the Rings）
        • 标签："book"
        • 关系："author" 指向 "J. R. R. Tolkien" 笔记
    • 人物（People）
      • J. R. R. Tolkien
        • 关系："son" 指向 "Christopher Tolkien" 笔记
        • Christopher Tolkien
  • ~author.title *= Tolkien OR (#publicationDate >= 1954 AND #publicationDate <= 1960)：使用布尔表达式和括号对表达式分组。注意，以括号开头的表达式需要前缀"表达式分隔符"（# 或 ~）。
  • note.parents.title = 'Books'：查找具有名为 "Books" 的父笔记的笔记。
  • note.parents.parents.title = 'Books'：查找具有名为 "Books" 的祖父笔记的笔记。
  • note.ancestors.title = 'Books'：查找具有名为 "Books" 的祖先的笔记。
  • note.children.title = 'sub-note'：查找具有名为 "sub-note" 的子笔记的笔记。

Search with Note Properties / 使用笔记属性搜索

Notes have properties that can be used in searches, such as noteId, dateModified, dateCreated, isProtected, type, title, text, content, rawContent, ownedLabelCount, labelCount, ownedRelationCount, relationCount, ownedRelationCountIncludingLinks, relationCountIncludingLinks, ownedAttributeCount, attributeCount, targetRelationCount, targetRelationCountIncludingLinks, parentCount, childrenCount, isArchived, contentSize, noteSize, and revisionCount. 笔记具有可用于搜索的属性，例如 noteId、dateModified、dateCreated、isProtected、type、title、text、content、rawContent、ownedLabelCount、labelCount、ownedRelationCount、relationCount、ownedRelationCountIncludingLinks、relationCountIncludingLinks、ownedAttributeCount、attributeCount、targetRelationCount、targetRelationCountIncludingLinks、parentCount、childrenCount、isArchived、contentSize、noteSize 和 revisionCount。

These properties can be accessed via the note. prefix, e.g., note.type = code AND note.mime = 'application/json'. 这些属性可以通过 note. 前缀访问，例如 note.type = code AND note.mime = 'application/json'。

Order by and Limit / 排序与限制

#author=Tolkien orderBy #publicationDate desc, note.title limit 10

This example will: 此示例将：

  1. Find notes with the author label "Tolkien".
  2. Order the results by publicationDate in descending order.
  3. Use note.title as a secondary ordering if publication dates are equal.
  4. Limit the results to the first 10 notes.
  5. 查找具有作者标签 "Tolkien" 的笔记。
  6. 按 publicationDate 降序排列结果。
  7. 如果出版日期相等，使用 note.title 作为次要排序。
  8. 将结果限制为前 10 条笔记。

Negation / 否定

Some queries can only be expressed with negation: 某些查询只能用否定来表达：

#book AND not(note.ancestor.title = 'Tolkien')

This query finds all book notes not in the "Tolkien" subtree. 此查询查找不在 "Tolkien" 子树中的所有书籍笔记。

Progressive Search Strategy / 渐进式搜索策略

Trilium uses a progressive search strategy that performs exact matching first, then adds fuzzy matching when needed. Trilium 使用渐进式搜索策略，先执行精确匹配，然后在需要时添加模糊匹配。

How Progressive Search Works / 渐进式搜索如何工作

  1. Phase 1 - Exact Matching: When you search, Trilium first looks for exact matches of your search terms. This handles the vast majority of searches (90%+) and returns results almost instantly.
  2. Phase 2 - Fuzzy Fallback: If Phase 1 doesn't find enough high-quality results (fewer than 5 results with good relevance scores), Trilium automatically adds fuzzy matching to find results with typos or spelling variations.
  3. Result Ordering: Exact matches always appear before fuzzy matches, regardless of individual scores. This ensures that when you search for "project", notes containing the exact word "project" will appear before notes containing similar words like "projects" or "projection".
  4. 阶段 1 - 精确匹配： 当你搜索时，Trilium 首先查找你的搜索词的精确匹配。这处理了绝大多数搜索（90%+）并几乎立即返回结果。
  5. 阶段 2 - 模糊回退： 如果阶段 1 没有找到足够多的高质量结果（少于 5 条具有良好相关性得分的结果），Trilium 会自动添加模糊匹配，以找到有拼写错误或拼写变化的结果。
  6. 结果排序： 无论个别得分如何，精确匹配总是出现在模糊匹配之前。这确保了当你搜索 "project" 时，包含精确单词 "project" 的笔记会出现在包含相似词（如 "projects" 或 "projection"）的笔记之前。

Progressive Search Behavior / 渐进式搜索行为

  • Speed: Most searches complete using only exact matching
  • Ordering: Exact matches appear before fuzzy matches
  • Fallback: Fuzzy matching activates when exact matches return fewer than 5 results
  • Identification: Results indicate whether they are exact or fuzzy matches
  • 速度（Speed）：大多数搜索只使用精确匹配即可完成
  • 排序（Ordering）：精确匹配出现在模糊匹配之前
  • 回退（Fallback）：当精确匹配返回少于 5 条结果时，模糊匹配被激活
  • 识别（Identification）：结果会指示它们是精确还是模糊匹配

Search Performance / 搜索性能

Search system specifications: 搜索系统规格：

  • Content size limit: 10MB per note (previously 50KB)
  • Edit distance calculations for fuzzy matching
  • Infinite scrolling in Quick Search
  • 内容大小限制：每个笔记 10MB（之前为 50KB）
  • 模糊匹配的编辑距离计算
  • 快速搜索中的无限滚动

Under the Hood / 底层机制

Label and Relation Shortcuts / 标签和关系快捷方式

The "full" syntax for searching by labels is: 按标签搜索的"完整"语法是：

note.labels.publicationYear = 1954

For relations: 对于关系：

note.relations.author.title *=* Tolkien

However, common label and relation searches have shortcut syntax: 然而，常见的标签和关系搜索有快捷语法：

#publicationYear = 1954
~author.title *=* Tolkien

Separating Full-Text and Attribute Parts / 分隔全文和属性部分

Search syntax allows combining full-text search with attribute-based search. For example, tolkien #book contains: 搜索语法允许将全文搜索与基于属性的搜索结合。例如，tolkien #book 包含：

  1. Full-text tokens - tolkien
  2. Attribute expressions - #book
  3. 全文标记 - tolkien
  4. 属性表达式 - #book

Trilium detects the separation between full text search and attribute/property search by looking for certain special characters or words that denote attributes and properties (e.g., #, ~, note.). If you need to include these in full-text search, escape them with a backslash so they are processed as regular text: Trilium 通过查找表示属性和性质的某些特殊字符或单词（例如 #、~、note.）来检测全文搜索与属性/性质搜索之间的分隔。如果需要在全文搜索中包含这些，用反斜杠转义它们，以便它们被当作常规文本处理：

"note.txt" \#hash #myLabel = 'Say "Hello World"'

Escaping Special Characters / 转义特殊字符

Special characters can be enclosed in quotes or escaped with a backslash to be used in full-text search: 特殊字符可以用引号括起来或用反斜杠转义，以便在全文搜索中使用：

"note.txt" \#hash #myLabel = 'Say "Hello World"'

Three types of quotes are supported: single, double, and backtick. 支持三种类型的引号：单引号、双引号和反引号。

Type Coercion / 类型强制转换

Label values are technically strings but can be coerced for numeric comparisons: 标签值在技术上是字符串，但可以被强制转换用于数值比较：

note.dateCreated =* '2019-05'

This finds notes created in May 2019. Numeric operators like #publicationYear >= 1960 convert string values to numbers for comparison. 这找到 2019 年 5 月创建的笔记。像 #publicationYear >= 1960 这样的数值运算符会将字符串值转换为数字以进行比较。

Auto-Trigger Search from URL / 从 URL 自动触发搜索

You can open Trilium and automatically trigger a search by including the search url encoded string in the URL: 你可以通过包含搜索的 URL 编码字符串来打开 Trilium 并自动触发搜索：

http://localhost:8080/#?searchString=abc

Search Configuration / 搜索配置

Parameters / 参数

Limits / 限制

  • Searched note content is limited to 10MB per note to prevent performance issues
  • Notes exceeding this limit will still be included in title and attribute searches
  • Fuzzy matching requires tokens of at least 3 characters
  • 被搜索的笔记内容限制为每个笔记 10MB，以防止性能问题
  • 超过此限制的笔记仍会包含在标题和属性搜索中
  • 模糊匹配要求至少 3 个字符的标记

title: Note Hoisting(笔记提升)
full:
Hoisting is a standard outliner feature which allows you to focus on (or "zoom into") a specific note and its subtree by hiding all parent and sibling notes. Demo: 提升（hoisting）是一个标准的提纲（outliner）功能，允许你通过隐藏所有父笔记和同级笔记来专注于（或"放大到"）特定笔记及其子树。演示：

In addition to showing only this subtree, this also narrows both full text search and "jump to note" to just notes present in hoisted subtree. 除了只显示此子树外，这还将全文搜索和"跳转到笔记"都收窄到仅限提升子树中存在的笔记。

See also Workspace which extends this feature. 另见扩展此功能的工作区（Workspace）。

title: Quick edit(快速编辑)
full:
Quick edit provides an alternative to the standard tab-based navigation and editing. 快速编辑（Quick edit） 提供了标准标签页式导航和编辑的替代方案。

Instead of clicking on a note which switches the Note Tree to the newly selected note, or navigating between two different Tabs, the Quick edit feature opens as a popup window that can be easily dismissed. 不同于点击笔记切换笔记树（Note Tree）到新选中的笔记，或在两个不同的标签页（Tabs）之间导航，快速编辑 功能作为弹出窗口打开，可以轻松关闭。

This feature is also well integrated with Collections such as the calendar view, which makes it easy to edit entries without having to go back and forth between the child note and the calendar. 此功能还与集合（Collections）（如日历视图）很好地集成，这使得无需在子笔记和日历之间来回切换即可轻松编辑条目。

Feature highlights / 功能亮点

  • All note types are supported, including Collections.
  • Note that the Note List will not be displayed, except for notes of type Collections.
  • For Text notes, depending on user preference, both the floating and classic editors are supported. See Formatting toolbar.
  • The title and the note and the icon are editable, just like a normal tab.
  • The Promoted Attributes are also displayed.
    • This integrates well with Collections where there are predefined attributes such as the Start date and End date, allowing for easy editing.
  • 支持所有笔记类型，包括集合（Collections）。
  • 注意，笔记列表（Note List）将不会显示，除非是集合类型的笔记。
  • 对于文本（Text）笔记，根据用户偏好，浮动和经典编辑器都受支持。参见格式工具栏（Formatting toolbar）。
  • 标题、笔记和图标都可以编辑，就像普通的标签页一样。
  • 提升属性（Promoted Attributes）也会显示。
    • 这与集合集成良好，在集合中有预定义的属性，如 开始日期（Start date） 和 结束日期（End date），方便编辑。

Accessing the quick edit / 访问快速编辑

  • From the Note Tree:
    • Right click on a note and select Quick edit.
    • or, press Ctrl+Right click on a note.
  • On Internal (reference) links—
    • Right click and select Quick edit.
    • or, press Ctrl+Right click on the link.
  • On a Note Tooltip, press the quick edit icon.
  • In Collections:
    • For Calendar:
      • Clicking on an event will open that event for quick editing.
      • If the calendar is for the Day Notes root, clicking on the day number will open the popup for that day note.
    • For Geo Map:
      • Clicking on a marker will open that marker, but only if the map is in read-only mode.
  • 从笔记树（Note Tree）：
    • 右键点击笔记并选择 快速编辑（Quick edit）。
    • 或，在笔记上按 Ctrl+右键点击。
  • 在内部（引用）链接上—
    • 右键点击并选择 快速编辑（Quick edit）。
    • 或，在链接上按 Ctrl+右键点击。
  • 在笔记提示（Note Tooltip）上，按下快速编辑图标。
  • 在集合（Collections）中：
    • 对于日历（Calendar）：
      • 点击事件将打开该事件进行快速编辑。
      • 如果日历用于每日笔记（Day Notes）根，点击日期数字将打开该日笔记的弹出窗口。
    • 对于地理地图（Geo Map）：
      • 点击标记将打开该标记，但仅当地图处于只读模式时。

Handling of read-only notes / 处理只读笔记

The Quick edit feature has a unique behavior for Read-Only Notes: 快速编辑功能对只读笔记（Read-Only Notes）有独特的行为：

  • If the note is read-only due to performance reasons (auto read-only), then the note is made editable for quick editing.
  • If the note has been manually set to read-only, then the note is read-only to prevent accidental changes.
    • In this case, the note can still be edited by on-screen instructions.
  • 如果笔记因性能原因（自动只读）而只读，则该笔记会变为可编辑以进行快速编辑。
  • 如果笔记已被手动设置为只读，则该笔记保持只读以防止意外更改。
    • 在这种情况下，仍可通过屏幕上的指示来编辑笔记。

title: Workspaces(工作区)
full:
Workspace is a concept built up on top of note hoisting. It is based on the idea that a user has several distinct spheres of interest. An example might be "Personal" and "Work", these two spheres are quite distinct and don't interact together. When I focus on Work, I don't really care about personal notes. 工作区（Workspace）是建立在笔记提升（note hoisting）之上的概念。它基于用户有几个不同的兴趣领域这一想法。一个例子可能是"个人（Personal）"和"工作（Work）"，这两个领域相当不同且互不交互。当我专注于工作时，我并不真正关心个人笔记。

So far workspace consists of these features: 到目前为止，工作区由以下功能组成：

  • note hoisting - you can "zoom" into a workspace subtree to focus only on the relevant notes

  • easy entering of workspace:

  • visual identification of workspace in tabs:

  • 笔记提升（note hoisting） - 你可以"放大"到工作区子树，只关注相关笔记

  • 轻松进入工作区：

  • 标签页中工作区的视觉标识：

Configuration / 配置

title: Similar Notes(相似笔记)
full:
The Similar Notes feature tries to identify notes that relate to the current note by looking at the content of the notes, their relationships, as well as the date they were created. 相似笔记（Similar Notes）功能尝试通过查看笔记的内容、它们的关系以及创建日期来识别与当前笔记相关的笔记。

To access the list of similar notes: 要访问相似笔记列表：

  • On the New Layout, go to the Connections tab in the Right Sidebar and look for the corresponding section.
  • On the old layout, press the Similar Notes tab in the Ribbon.
  • 在新布局（New Layout）上，进入右侧边栏（Right Sidebar）中的连接标签页（Connections tab）并查找相应部分。
  • 在旧布局上，按下功能区（Ribbon）中的 相似笔记（Similar Notes） 标签页。

Interaction / 交互

  • Hover over a note to see a short preview of the note.
  • Click over a note to open it in the current view.
  • Ctrl + click a note to open it in a separate tab.
  • 悬停在笔记上以查看笔记的简短预览。
  • 点击笔记在当前视图中打开它。
  • Ctrl + 点击笔记在单独的标签页中打开它。

title: Search in note(在笔记中搜索)
full:
Local search allows you to search within the currently displayed note. 本地搜索（local search）允许你在当前显示的笔记内进行搜索。

Alternatives / 备选方式

  • Pressing Ctrl+F while in a browser while not focused in a Text or a Code note will trigger the browser's native search. This will also find text that is part of Trilium's UI.
  • Pressing Ctrl+F in a Text note will reveal CKEditor's search functionality.
  • 在浏览器中当焦点不在文本（Text）或代码（Code）笔记中时按 Ctrl+F 将触发浏览器的原生搜索。这也会找到属于 Trilium UI 一部分的文本。
  • 在文本笔记中按 Ctrl+F 将显示CKEditor的搜索功能。

Accessing the search / 访问搜索

  • On desktop, pressCtrl + F
  • From the Note buttons, look for the context menu and select Search in note.
  • 在桌面上，按 Ctrl + F
  • 从笔记按钮（Note buttons）中，查找上下文菜单并选择 在笔记中搜索（Search in note）。

Interaction / 交互

  • Finding / 查找：
    • Fill in the Find in text… with the text to search for.
    • The search will be executed automatically in the background.
    • Use up and down arrows of the text box to navigate between results.
    • 在 在文本中查找…（Find in text…） 中填写要搜索的文本。
    • 搜索将在后台自动执行。
    • 使用文本框的上、下箭头在结果之间导航。
  • Replacing / 替换：
    • Fill in the Find in text… field with the text to replace.
    • Fill in the Replace with… field the text to replace it with.
    • Press Replace to replace only the current result.
    • Press Replace all to replace all of them at once.
    • 在 在文本中查找（Find in text）… 字段中填写要替换的文本。
    • 在 替换为…（Replace with…） 字段中填写用于替换的文本。
    • 按 替换（Replace） 只替换当前结果。
    • 按 全部替换（Replace all） 一次性替换所有结果。
  • Options / 选项：
    • Case sensitive – the search will distinguish upper case characters from lower case (e.g. searching for Hello will not match hello).
    • Match words - the search will find only exact word matches (e.g. searching for Java will not match JavaScript).
    • 区分大小写（Case sensitive） – 搜索将区分大写和小写字符（例如搜索 Hello 不会匹配 hello）。
    • 全词匹配（Match words） - 搜索将只找到完全匹配的单词（例如搜索 Java 不会匹配 JavaScript）。

title: Icon Packs(图标包)
full:
By default, Trilium comes with a set of icons called Boxicons v2. Since v0.102.0, custom icon packs allow a wider selection of icons for notes. 默认情况下，Trilium 自带一组名为 Boxicons v2 的图标。自 v0.102.0 起，自定义图标包为笔记提供了更广泛的图标选择。

Icon packs are specific to Trilium, so they must either be created from scratch (see below) or imported from a ZIP file from a third-party developer. 图标包是 Trilium 特有的，因此它们必须从头创建（见下文）或从第三方开发者的 ZIP 文件导入。

Sample icon packs / 示例图标包

The Trilium team maintains a few icon packs that are not shipped with Trilium. These icon packs can be found on the official website on the Resources page. Trilium 团队维护着一些未随 Trilium 一起提供的图标包。这些图标包可以在官方网站的资源页面（Resources page）上找到。

Importing an existing icon pack / 导入现有的图标包

Icon packs are third-party content 图标包是第三方内容

Apart from the sample icon packs, the Trilium maintainers are not responsible for keeping icon packs up to date. If you have an issue with a specific icon pack, then the issue must be reported to the third-party developer responsible for it, not the Trilium team. 除了示例图标包之外，Trilium 维护者不负责保持图标包的更新。如果您对某个特定图标包有问题，则必须向负责该图标包的第三方开发者报告，而不是向 Trilium 团队报告。

To import an icon pack: 要导入图标包：

  1. Ideally, create a dedicated spot in your note tree where to place the icon packs. 理想情况下，在您的笔记树中创建一个专门的位置来放置图标包。
  2. Right click the note where to put it and select Import into note. 右键单击要放入的位置的笔记，然后选择 导入到笔记（Import into note）。
  3. Uncheck Safe import. 取消勾选 安全导入（Safe import）。
  4. Select Import. 选择 导入（Import）。
  5. Refresh the application. 刷新应用程序。

Since Safe import is disabled, make sure you trust the source as it could contain dangerous third-party scripts. One good way to check if the icon pack is safe is to manually extract the .zip and inspect the file contents. Icon packs should only contain a font file and a JSON file. Other files (especially scripts) are to be considered harmful. 警告：由于 安全导入（Safe import） 被禁用，请确保您信任来源，因为它可能包含危险的第三方脚本。检查图标包是否安全的一个好方法是手动解压 .zip 并检查文件内容。图标包应该只包含一个字体文件和一个 JSON 文件。其他文件（尤其是脚本）应被视为有害。

Creating an icon pack / 创建图标包

Creating an icon pack requires some scripting knowledge outside Trilium in order to generate the list of icons. For information, see Creating an icon pack. 创建图标包需要一些 Trilium 之外的脚本知识来生成图标列表。有关信息，请参阅创建图标包（Creating an icon pack）。

Using an icon from an icon pack / 使用图标包中的图标

After refreshing the application, the icon pack should be enabled by default. To test this, simply select an existing note or create a new one and try to change the note icon. 在刷新应用程序之后，图标包应该默认被启用。要测试这一点，只需选择一个现有笔记或创建一个新笔记，然后尝试更改笔记图标。

There should be a Filter button to the right of the search bar in the icon list. Clicking it allows filtering by icon pack and the newly imported icon pack should be displayed there. 在图标列表的搜索栏右侧应该有一个 筛选（Filter） 按钮。点击它可以按图标包筛选，新导入的图标包应该显示在那里。

If the icon pack is missing from that list, then most likely there's something wrong with it. 注意：如果图标包不在该列表中，那么很可能它有问题。

  • Try checking the Backend (server) logs for clues and make sure that the icon pack has the #iconPack labelwith a value assigned to it (a prefix). 尝试检查后端（服务器）日志（Backend (server) logs）寻找线索，并确保图标包具有已赋值的 #iconPack 标签（label）（一个前缀）。
  • Icon packs that are protected are ignored. 受保护（protected）的图标包会被忽略。

Integration with the share and export functionality / 与共享和导出功能的集成

Custom icon packs are also supported by the Sharing feature, where they will be shown in the note tree. However, in order for an icon pack to be visible to the share function, the icon pack note must also be shared. 共享（Sharing）功能也支持自定义图标包，它们将显示在笔记树中。然而，为了使图标包对共享功能可见，图标包笔记也必须被共享。

If you are using a custom share theme, make sure it supports the iconPackCss, otherwise icons will not show up. Check the original share template source code for reference. 如果您使用自定义共享主题，请确保它支持 iconPackCss，否则图标将不会显示。请参考原始共享模板源代码。

Custom icon packs will also be preserved when Exporting static HTML for web publishing. In this case, there's no requirement to make the icon pack shared. 当导出用于网页发布的静态 HTML时，自定义图标包也会被保留。在这种情况下，不需要共享图标包。

What happens if I remove an icon pack / 如果我移除图标包会发生什么

If an icon pack is removed or disabled (by removing or altering its #iconPacklabel), all the notes that use this icon pack will show in the Note Tree with no icon. This won't cause any issues apart from looking strange. 如果图标包被移除或禁用（通过移除或更改其 #iconPack 标签），所有使用该图标包的笔记在笔记树（Note Tree）中将显示为无图标。除了看起来奇怪之外，这不会引起任何问题。

The solution is to replace the icons with some else, try using Search which supports bulk actions, to identify the notes with the now deleted icon pack (by looking for the prefix) and changing or removing their iconClass. 解决方案是替换这些图标。可以尝试使用支持批量操作的搜索（Search），通过查找前缀来识别使用已删除图标包的笔记，并更改或移除它们的 iconClass。

title: Zen mode(专注模式)
full:
Screenshot of Zen Mode activated on a Windows 11 system with native title bar off and background effects on. 在 Windows 11 系统上激活禅定模式的截图，原生标题栏已关闭且背景效果已开启。

When Zen Mode is activated (pictured on the side), most of the user interface of Trilium is hidden away in order to be able to focus on the content, whether it's for reading or writing. 当禅定模式被激活时（如旁边所示），Trilium 的大部分用户界面都会被隐藏，以便专注于内容，无论是阅读还是写作。

Screenshot of the Zen Mode option in the global menu. 全局菜单中禅定模式选项的截图。

Activating & deactivating / 激活与停用

The Zen Mode can be activated by accessing the global menu and selecting the “Zen Mode” option: 禅定模式可以通过访问全局菜单并选择 “禅定模式（Zen Mode）” 选项来激活：

Aside from the global menu, it's also possible to activate this mode by using a keyboard shortcut (which is F9 since TriliumNext 0.92.5 and Alt+Z for older versions). Look for toggleZenMode in the shortcut configuration. 除了全局菜单，还可以通过键盘快捷键来激活此模式（自 TriliumNext 0.92.5 起为 F9，旧版本为 Alt+Z）。在快捷键配置中查找 toggleZenMode。

Once Zen Mode is activated, all the UI elements of the application will be hidden away, including the global menu. In that case, the Zen Mode can be deactivated either by pressing the icon in the top-right corner of the window or by pressing the keyboard combination again. 一旦禅定模式被激活，应用程序的所有 UI 元素都会被隐藏，包括全局菜单。在这种情况下，可以通过按下窗口右上角的 图标或再次按下键组合来停用禅定模式。

Do note that, by design, activating or deactivating the Zen Mode applies only to the current window. Restarting the application will also disable the Zen Mode. 请注意，按照设计，激活或停用禅定模式只适用于当前窗口。重启应用程序也会禁用禅定模式。

Moving the window around / 移动窗口

If “Native title bar” is activated, then the operating system's default title bar can be used to drag the window around. If deactivated, the window can still be moved by dragging the mouse across the top part of the window where the note titles are. 如果激活了 “原生标题栏（Native title bar）”，则可以使用操作系统的默认标题栏来拖动窗口。如果停用，仍然可以通过在窗口顶部显示笔记标题的区域拖动鼠标来移动窗口。

Screenshot of two notes side-by-side while Zen Mode is active, on Windows 11 with background effects off. 在 Windows 11 上、背景效果关闭时，禅定模式激活状态下两个笔记并排显示的截图。

Split windows and tabs / 分屏窗口与标签页

Tabs are completely hidden, however it's still possible to use keyboard shortcuts such as firstTab (Ctrl+1 by default), secondTab (Ctrl+2 by default). There are also some newer shortcuts such as activateNextTab (Ctrl+Tab) or activatePreviousTab (Ctrl+Shift+Tab) that allow easy navigation, however make sure that they are configured properly in the settings. 标签页被完全隐藏，但仍然可以使用诸如 firstTab（默认为 Ctrl+1）、secondTab（默认为 Ctrl+2）之类的键盘快捷键。还有一些较新的快捷键，例如 activateNextTab（Ctrl+Tab）或 activatePreviousTab（Ctrl+Shift+Tab），可以方便导航，但请确保它们在设置中配置正确。

For the split view of notes, there are no keyboard shortcuts at the time of writing, but it's still possible to have them in Zen Mode by creating the split while the Zen Mode is off and then reactivating it afterwards. 对于笔记的分屏视图，在撰写本文时还没有键盘快捷键，但仍然可以在禅定模式中使用它们：在禅定模式关闭时创建分屏，然后稍后重新激活禅定模式。

title: Anchors(锚点)
full:
This feature used to be called Bookmarks (as it is the official name in the editor we are using), but in order not to collide with the concept of Bookmarks, we have renamed it to Anchors. 注意：此功能过去被称为_书签（Bookmarks）（因为它是我们正在使用的编辑器中的官方名称），但为了避免与书签（Bookmarks）的概念冲突，我们已将其重命名为_锚点（Anchors）。

Anchors allows creating links to a certain part of a note, such as referencing a particular heading or section within a note. 锚点（Anchors）允许创建指向笔记特定部分的链接，例如引用笔记中的特定标题或部分。

This feature was introduced in TriliumNext v0.94.0 and augmented in v0.103.0 to support linking across notes. 此功能在 TriliumNext v0.94.0 中引入，并在 v0.103.0 中增强以支持跨笔记链接。

Interaction

交互

  • To create an anchor:
    • Place the cursor at the desired position where to place the anchor.
    • Look for the button in the Formatting toolbar, and then press the button.
    • Alternatively, use Slash Commands and look for anchor.
  • To place a link to an anchor:
    • Place the cursor at the desired position of the link.
    • From the link pane, select the Anchors section and select the desired anchor.
  • 要创建锚点：
    • 将光标放置在要放置锚点的所需位置。
    • 在格式化工具栏（Formatting toolbar）中寻找 按钮，然后按下 按钮。
    • 或者，使用斜杠命令（Slash Commands）并寻找_anchor_。
  • 要放置指向锚点的链接：
    • 将光标放置在链接的所需位置。
    • 从链接（link）面板中，选择_锚点（Anchors）_部分并选择所需的锚点。

Linking across notes

跨笔记链接

Trilium v0.103.0 introduces cross-note Anchors, which make it possible to create Internal (reference) links which point to a specific anchor in that document. Trilium v0.103.0 引入了跨笔记锚点，这使得创建指向该文档中特定锚点的内部（引用）链接（Internal (reference) links）成为可能。

Compatibility with documents from previous versions

与先前版本文档的兼容性

For notes created prior to Trilium v0.103.0, you might notice that the Anchors might not be identified. This limitation is intentional in order not to have to re-process all the notes, looking for anchors. 对于在 Trilium v0.103.0 之前创建的笔记，你可能会注意到锚点可能无法被识别。此限制是故意的，以避免必须重新处理所有笔记来查找锚点。

To fix this, simply go to that note and make any change (e.g. inserting a space), this will trigger the recalculation of the links. 要修复此问题，只需转到该笔记并进行任何更改（例如插入一个空格），这将触发链接的重新计算。

Linking to anchors through the Add link dialog

通过_添加链接（Add link）_对话框链接到锚点

  1. Create an anchor in the target note using the same process as described above.
  2. In another note, press Ctrl+L to insert an internal link. Select the target note containing Anchors.
  3. If the target note contains Anchors, a section will appear underneath the note selector with the list of Anchors.
  4. Add the link normally.
  5. 使用上述相同过程在目标笔记中创建锚点。
  6. 在另一个笔记中，按 Ctrl+L 插入内部链接。选择包含锚点的目标笔记。
  7. 如果目标笔记包含锚点，笔记选择器下方将出现一个部分，其中包含锚点列表。
  8. 正常添加链接。

Clicking on a reference link pointing to an anchor will automatically scroll to the desired section. 点击指向锚点的引用链接将自动滚动到所需部分。

Linking to anchors through the bookmark toolbar

通过书签工具栏链接到锚点

  1. Create an anchor in the target note using the same process as described above.
  2. Click on the anchor to reveal the anchor's floating toolbar.
  3. Click on the Copy anchor reference link button.
  4. Go to the note where to insert the link and press Ctrl+V.
  5. 使用上述相同过程在目标笔记中创建锚点。
  6. 点击锚点以显示锚点的浮动工具栏。
  7. 点击_复制锚点引用链接（Copy anchor reference link）_按钮。
  8. 转到要插入链接的笔记并按 Ctrl+V。

Use this method only to insert Internal (reference) links between two documents. To link to an anchor on the same note, use the Insert link dialog (Ctrl+K) and select the Anchors item instead. 注意：仅使用此方法在两个文档之间插入内部（引用）链接（Internal (reference) links）。要链接到同一笔记上的锚点，请改用_插入链接（Insert link）_对话框（Ctrl+K）并选择_锚点（Anchors）_项。

title: Block quotes & admonitions(块引用与提示框)
full:
Block quotes

块引用

As the name suggests, block quotes can be useful to cite one or more paragraphs. 顾名思义，块引用可用于引用一个或多个段落。

To create a block quote, press from the Formatting toolbar. It's also possible to type >, followed by a space to create one (but only if the cursor is at the beginning of a line). 要创建块引用，请从格式化工具栏（Formatting toolbar）按 。也可以输入 > 后跟一个空格来创建一个（但仅当光标位于行首时）。

Inside the quote block, other block items can be inserted such as tables, images, or even other block quotes or admonitions. 在引用块内部，可以插入其他块项目，例如表格、图像，甚至其他块引用或提示框。

Admonitions

提示框

Admonitions are a way to highlight information to the reader. Other names for it include call-outs and info/warning/alert boxes. 提示框（Admonitions）是向读者突出显示信息的一种方式。它的其他名称包括_标注（call-outs）和_信息/警告/警报框（info/warning/alert boxes）。

（图片：提示框示例）

From a functional point of view, admonitions act very similarly to a block quote, just with different styling. This includes the ability to insert other elements in it such as headings, tables, images, etc. 从功能的角度来看，提示框的作用与块引用非常相似，只是样式不同。这包括在其中插入其他元素的能力，例如标题、表格、图像等。

Inserting a new admonition

插入新的提示框

In the Formatting toolbar: 在格式化工具栏（Formatting toolbar）中：

（图片：插入提示框）

It's possible to insert an admonition simply by typing: 可以通过输入以下内容简单插入提示框：

  • !!! note
  • !!! tip
  • !!! important
  • !!! caution
  • !!! warning
  • !!! note
  • !!! tip
  • !!! important
  • !!! caution
  • !!! warning

In addition to that, it's also possible to type !!! followed by any text, case in which a default admonition type will appear (note) with the entered text inside it. 除此之外，也可以输入 !!! 后跟任意文本，此时将出现默认提示框类型（note），其中包含输入的文本。

Interaction

交互

By design, admonitions act very similarly to block quotes. 按照设计，提示框的作用与块引用非常相似。

  • Selecting a text and pressing the admonition button will turn that text into an admonition.
  • If selecting multiple admonitions, pressing the admonition button will automatically merge them into one.
  • 选择文本并按下提示框按钮会将该文本转换为提示框。
  • 如果选择了多个提示框，按下提示框按钮会自动将它们合并为一个。

Inside an admonition: 在提示框内部：

  • Pressing Backspace while the admonition is empty will remove it.
  • Pressing Enter will start a new paragraph. Pressing it twice will exit out of the admonition.
  • Headings and other block content including tables can be inserted inside the admonition.
  • 当提示框为空时按 Backspace 将移除它。
  • 按 Enter 将开始一个新段落。按两次将退出提示框。
  • 标题和包括表格在内的其他块内容可以插入提示框内部。

Types of admonitions

提示框的类型

There are currently five types of admonitions: Note, Tip, Important, Caution, Warning. 目前有五种类型的提示框：Note（注意）、Tip（提示）、Important（重要）、Caution（小心）、Warning（警告）。

These types were inspired by GitHub's support for this feature and there are currently no plans for adjusting it or allowing the user to customize them. 这些类型受到 GitHub 对此功能支持的启发，目前没有调整它或允许用户自定义它们的计划。

Markdown support

Markdown 支持

See Supported syntax. 参见支持的语法（Supported syntax）。

title: Content language & Right-to-left support(内容语言与从右到左支持)
full:
（图片：内容语言与从右到左支持示例）

The content language determines: 内容语言（content language）决定：

  • The spell-checking of the note, when in a browser. The desktop installation has a dedicated spellchecking section.
  • 笔记的拼写检查（在浏览器中时）。桌面安装版有专门的拼写检查设置区。
  • Whether the text is displayed from right-to-left, for languages such as Arabic, Hebrew, etc.
  • 文本是否从右到左显示，适用于阿拉伯语、希伯来语等语言。
  • How typed quotes are automatically replaced (e.g. English uses “text”, whereas some languages use «text»).
  • 输入的引号如何被自动替换（例如英语使用 “text”，而某些语言使用 «text»）。
  • Which languages are offered by the In-editor AI assistant for translation.
  • 编辑器内 AI 助手（In-editor AI assistant）提供哪些语言用于翻译。

Setting the language of a single note

设置单个笔记的语言

To set the language of the content of a Text note: 要为文本（Text）笔记的内容设置语言：

  • On the new layout, there is a language selector in the Status bar.
  • 在新布局中，状态栏（Status bar）中有一个语言选择器。
  • On the old layout, go to the Ribbon → Basic Properties and look for the Language field.
  • 在旧布局中，前往功能区（Ribbon） → 基本属性（Basic Properties） 并寻找_语言（Language）_字段。

Adjusting the list of languages

调整语言列表

By default there will be no language configured, they can be configured by going to Options → Language & Region or by selecting the Configure languages item when setting the language. 默认情况下不会配置任何语言，可以通过前往选项（Options） → 语言与区域（Language & Region）进行配置，或在设置语言时选择_配置语言（Configure languages）_项。

Default content language

默认内容语言

Notes that do not have a language of their own follow Options → Language & Region → Default content language. It is set to English initially, and can be set to any content language, or to Based on the application's language. 没有自己语言的笔记遵循选项（Options） → 语言与区域（Language & Region） → 默认内容语言（Default content language）。它最初设置为英语，可以设置为任何内容语言，或设置为_基于应用程序的语言（Based on the application's language）_。

If a note has a language set, it always takes precedence over the default. 如果笔记设置了语言，它始终优先于默认设置。

title: Cut to subnote(剪切到子笔记)
full:
（图片：将选区剪切到子笔记的演示 GIF）

When editing a document that becomes too large, you can split it into sub-notes: 当编辑的文档变得过大时，你可以将其拆分为子笔记：

  1. Select the desired text and cut it to the clipboard.
  2. 选中所需文本并将其剪切到剪贴板。
  3. Create a new sub-note and name it.
  4. 新建一个子笔记并命名。
  5. Paste the content from the clipboard into the sub-note.
  6. 将剪贴板中的内容粘贴到子笔记中。

Trilium can automate this process. Select some text within the note, and in the selection toolbar, click the scissors icon for the "cut & pasted selection to sub-note" action. The heading is automatically detected and the new sub-note is named accordingly. You can also assign a keyboard shortcut for this action. This functionality is available through the block toolbar icon. Trilium 可以自动化这一过程。在笔记中选中一些文本，然后在选区工具栏中点击“剪切并粘贴所选内容到子笔记”操作的剪刀图标。标题会被自动检测，新的子笔记也随之命名。你还可以为此操作分配一个键盘快捷键。此功能可通过块工具栏图标使用。

title: Code blocks(代码块)
full:
（图片：代码块示例）

The code blocks feature allows entering pieces of code in text notes. 代码块功能允许在文本笔记中输入代码片段。

Note that this feature is meant for generally small snippets of code. For larger files such as an entire log, see the Code note type instead. 请注意，此功能适用于通常较小的代码片段。对于更大的文件（例如完整日志），请改用代码（Code）笔记类型。

Inserting a code block

插入代码块

  • Via the Formatting toolbar, look for the button.
  • 通过格式化工具栏（Formatting toolbar），寻找 按钮。
    • Pressing directly on the icon will insert a code block with the language that was selected most recently. If this is the first time a code block is inserted, the language will be “Auto-detected” by default.
    • 直接点击图标将插入使用最近所选语言的代码块。如果这是第一次插入代码块，语言将默认为“自动检测（Auto-detected）”。
    • Pressing the arrow next to the icon, which will show a popup with the available languages.
    • 点击图标旁的箭头，将显示一个包含可用语言的下拉弹窗。
  • Type ` `` ` (as in Markdown).
  • 输入 ` `` `（如同在 Markdown 中一样）。
    • Note that it's not possible to specify the language, as it will default to the last selected language.
    • 请注意，无法指定语言，因为它将默认为最近选择的语言。

Exiting out of the code block

退出代码块

  • To exit out of a code block and enter a normal paragraph, move the cursor at the end of the code block and press Enter twice.
  • 要退出代码块并进入普通段落，请将光标移到代码块末尾并按两次 Enter。
  • Similarly, to insert a paragraph above the note block, move the cursor at the beginning of the code block and press Enter twice.
  • 类似地，要在代码块上方插入段落，请将光标移到代码块开头并按两次 Enter。

If you've pasted a code block with a more complex HTML structure, exiting out of the code block by pressing Enter multiple times might not work. In that case the best approach is to delete the code block entirely and use Ctrl+Shift+V (paste as plain text). 注意：如果你粘贴了一个具有更复杂 HTML 结构的代码块，通过多次按 Enter 退出代码块可能无效。在这种情况下，最好的做法是彻底删除该代码块并使用 Ctrl+Shift+V（以纯文本粘贴）。

Syntax highlighting & color schemes

语法高亮与配色方案
