Since TriliumNext v0.90.12, Trilium will try to offer syntax highlighting to the code block. Note that the syntax highlighting mechanism is slightly different than the one in Code notes as different technologies are involved. 自 TriliumNext v0.90.12 起，Trilium 会尝试为代码块提供语法高亮。请注意，语法高亮机制与代码（Code）笔记中的略有不同，因为涉及的技术不同。

Interaction: 交互：

  • When the language is set to Auto-detected (by default), Trilium will try to identify the programming language (or similar) that corresponds to the given snippet of text and highlight it. If this is problematic, consider changing the language of the code block manually.
  • 当语言设置为_自动检测（Auto-detected）_（默认）时，Trilium 会尝试识别与给定文本片段对应的编程语言（或类似语言）并对其高亮。如果这有问题，请考虑手动更改代码块的语言。
  • When the language is set to Plain text, there will be no syntax highlighting.
  • 当语言设置为_纯文本（Plain text）_时，将不会有语法高亮。

Note that when editing a text note, syntax highlighting is automatically disabled if the code block is too big (somewhere around 500 lines). This value is currently not configurable. For Read-Only Notes, this limitation is not applied. 请注意，在编辑文本笔记时，如果代码块过大（大约 500 行左右），语法高亮会被自动禁用。此值目前不可配置。对于只读笔记（Read-Only Notes），此限制不适用。

In order to configure this new feature, a section has been added in Options → Appearance to control the syntax highlighting. There the color scheme can be chosen, from a builtin selection of themes from Highlight.js. 为了配置这项新功能，在 选项（Options）→ 外观（Appearance）中添加了一个部分来控制语法高亮。在那里可以选择配色方案，从 Highlight.js 的内置主题中进行选择。

  • It is possible to disable the syntax highlighting for all the notes by selecting “No syntax highlighting” in the “Color scheme” option.
  • 可以通过在“配色方案（Color scheme）”选项中选择“无语法高亮（No syntax highlighting）”来为所有笔记禁用语法高亮。
  • Word wrapping is disabled by default, but can be configured from the same section.
  • 自动换行默认禁用，但可以在同一部分进行配置。
  • The tab width can also be adjusted from Options.
  • 制表符宽度也可以从选项（Options）中调整。

Context regarding syntax highlighting 关于语法高亮的背景说明

In order to achieve the syntax highlight, the Highlight.js library is being used. Do note that support for syntax highlighting in code blocks is not a supported feature of the text editor we are using (CKEditor), but rather a hack which makes use of the highlights API (used for highlighting search results for example). Nevertheless, we haven't noticed any major issues during the development of the feature, but feel free to report any issues you might have. 为了实现语法高亮，使用了 Highlight.js 库。请注意，代码块中的语法高亮并不是我们所用文本编辑器（CKEditor）的受支持功能，而是一种利用 highlights API（例如用于高亮搜索结果）的技巧。尽管如此，在功能开发过程中我们没有发现任何重大问题，但如果你遇到任何问题，欢迎反馈。

Most of the work to achieve the syntax highlight itself was already done by antonioiejada in https://github.com/antonioiejada/Trilium-SyntaxHighlightWidget. On our side we added customization but also additional functionality. 实现语法高亮本身的大部分工作已由 antonioiejada 在 https://github.com/antonioiejada/Trilium-SyntaxHighlightWidget 中完成。在我们这边，我们添加了自定义设置以及额外的功能。

Migrating from existing syntax highlight plugins

从现有语法高亮插件迁移

If you are already using a syntax highlighting plugin such as the Trilium-SyntaxHighlightWidget we are basing off of, it is important to disable that plugin before upgrading in order for it not to conflict with our implementation. 如果你已经在使用我们基于的Trilium-SyntaxHighlightWidget 等语法高亮插件，那么在升级前禁用该插件非常重要，以免与我们实现产生冲突。

Should you encounter any issues after the migration, try running Trilium in safe mode. 如果在迁移后遇到任何问题，请尝试以安全模式运行 Trilium。

Changing the language of a code block

更改代码块的语言

Simply click anywhere inside the code block and press again the code block button in the Formatting toolbar:
只需点击代码块内任意位置，然后再次点击格式化工具栏（Formatting toolbar）中的代码块按钮： （图片：更改代码块语言）

Adjusting the list of languages

调整语言列表

The code blocks feature shares the list of languages with the Code note type. 代码块功能与代码（Code）笔记类型共享语言列表。

The supported languages can be adjusted by going to Options, then Code Notes and looking for the Available MIME types in the dropdown section. Simply check any of the items to add them to the list, or uncheck them to remove them from the list. 支持的语言（Options）可以调整——前往 选项（Options），然后找到_代码笔记（Code Notes）_，并在_下拉（dropdown）部分寻找_可用 MIME 类型（Available MIME types）。只需勾选任意项目即可将其添加到列表，或取消勾选以将其从列表中移除。

Note that the list of languages is not immediately refreshed, you'd have to manually refresh the application. 请注意，语言列表不会立即刷新，你需要手动刷新应用程序。

title: Footnotes(脚注)
full:
（图片：脚注示例）

Footnotes are a good place to insert references to a paragraph or details that are displayed at the bottom of the note. 脚注是插入段落引用或详细信息的好地方，这些内容会显示在笔记底部。

Interaction

交互

  • To insert a new footnote, press (or press the right arrow and select New footnote).
  • 要插入新脚注，请按 （或按右侧箭头并选择_新脚注（New footnote）_）。
  • To insert a reference to an existing footnote, press the right arrow and select Insert footnote, followed by the number of the footnote to insert.
  • 要插入对现有脚注的引用，请按右侧箭头并选择_插入脚注（Insert footnote）_，然后输入要插入的脚注编号。
  • Hovering over a reference (e.g. [1]) will display the content of the footnote in a tooltip for easy reference.
  • 悬停在引用上（例如 [1]）将在工具提示中显示脚注内容，方便参考。
  • Clicking on a reference in the text (e.g. [1]) will navigate to the corresponding footnote.
  • 点击文本中的引用（例如 [1]）将导航到对应的脚注。
  • Similarly, clicking on the ^ button of a footnote will navigate to the corresponding reference in the text.
  • 类似地，点击脚注的 ^ 按钮将导航到文本中对应的引用。

title: Format Painter(格式刷)
full:
（图片：格式刷示例）

The Format Painter is a feature in text notes that allows users to copy the formatting of text (such as bold, italic, Strikethrough, etc.) and apply it to other parts of the document. It helps maintain consistent formatting and accelerates the creation of rich content. 格式刷（Format Painter）是文本笔记中的一项功能，允许用户复制文本的格式（如粗体、斜体、删除线 等）并将其应用到文档的其他部分。它有助于保持格式一致，并加快富内容的创作。

Usage Instructions

使用说明

Click the text that you want to copy the formatting from and use the paint formatting toolbar button ( ) to copy the style. Then select the target text with your mouse to apply the formatting. 点击你想要复制格式的文本，然后使用“油漆格式”工具栏按钮（）复制该样式。随后用鼠标选中目标文本以应用该格式。

  • To copy the formatting: Place the cursor inside text with some formatting and click the paint formatting toolbar button. The mouse cursor changes to indicate the painter is armed.
  • 复制格式：将光标置于带有某种格式的文本中，点击“油漆格式”工具栏按钮。鼠标光标会变为画笔状，表示格式刷已就绪。
  • To paint with the copied formatting: Select the target text with your mouse. The formatting is applied when you release the button, and the painter disarms — the cursor returns to normal.
  • 使用复制的格式进行涂抹：用鼠标选中目标文本。松开按钮时格式即被应用，格式刷随即解除——光标恢复正常。
  • To cancel without painting: Click the toolbar button again or press Escape.
  • 不进行涂抹而取消：再次点击工具栏按钮，或按 Escape。

Limitations

限制

  1. Painting with block-level formatting (like headings or image styles) is not supported yet. This is because, in CKEditor, they are considered a part of the content rather than text formatting.
  2. 目前尚不支持带块级格式（如标题或图片样式）的涂抹。这是因为在 CKEditor 中，它们被视为内容的一部分而非文本格式。
  3. The painter applies to a selection, not to a word: clicking a single word does not format it. A click only places the caret, so text you type there takes the copied formatting.
  4. 格式刷作用于选区，而非单个单词：单击单个单词不会对其进行格式化。单击只会放置光标，因此你在该处输入的文本会采用复制的格式。
  5. The painter is one-shot; each paint requires copying the formatting again.
  6. 格式刷是一次性的；每次涂抹都需要重新复制格式。

title: Formatting toolbar(格式工具栏)
full:
Trilium allows two different editing experiences for text notes, based on your preference. Trilium 允许根据你的偏好，为文本笔记提供两种不同的编辑体验。

The type of formatting toolbar can be changed by going to Options(选项) and then looking for the 文本笔记 section. In it, look for the Formatting toolbar category. 格式化工具栏的类型可以通过前往Options(选项)，然后找到 文本笔记部分来更改。在其中，寻找_格式化工具栏（Formatting toolbar）_类别。

Floating

浮动

The floating bar is a more minimalist option, in which the formatting is hidden behind two different popups. 浮动工具栏是一种更简约的选项，其中格式化功能隐藏在两个不同的弹出窗口后面。

Block-level popup

块级弹出窗口

The first popup is the block-level popup. This will appear to the left of the current paragraph you are currently editing, as a sequence of dots:
第一个弹出窗口是块级弹出窗口。它会以一系列圆点的形式出现在你当前正在编辑的段落左侧： （图片：块级弹出窗口）

Clicking this popup will reveal the formatting options that are specific to the entire paragraph, such as setting a heading, lists, tables, etc. 点击此弹出窗口将显示针对整个段落的格式化选项，例如设置标题、列表、表格等。

（图片：块级弹出选项）

Inline popup

行内弹出窗口

The inline popup appears automatically when selecting a text: 行内弹出窗口会在选中文本时自动出现：

（图片：行内弹出窗口）

All the options here apply only to the selected portion of text, such as changing the font size, or making the text bold. 这里的所有选项仅应用于所选文本部分，例如更改字号或将文本加粗。

Fixed

固定

The fixed formatting offers a more traditional editing paradigm, usually useful if a lot of formatting is needed. 固定格式化提供更传统的编辑范式，通常在需要大量格式化时很有用。

All the options are combined into a single toolbar that will appear as part of the Ribbon. 所有选项都合并到一个工具栏中，该工具栏将作为功能区（Ribbon）的一部分出现。

（图片：固定工具栏）

By default, if the toolbar does not fit on the screen, the rest of the options will be grouped into a single option at the end. It is possible to display items on multiple lines by checking the corresponding option in the Formatting toolbar section. 默认情况下，如果工具栏无法在屏幕上放下，其余选项将被分组为末尾的单个选项。可以通过勾选_格式化工具栏（Formatting toolbar）_部分中的相应选项，在多个行上显示项目。

title: General formatting(常规格式)
full:
Headings

标题

（图片：标题示例）

Trilium provides headings to define sections within text. Headings are numbered from 2 to 6. Trilium 提供标题用于在文本中定义章节。标题编号从 2 到 6。

The reason why Heading 1 is missing from the list is that it is being reserved for the title of note. 标题 1 之所以不在列表中，是因为它被保留给笔记的标题。

To turn a heading back into a normal text, select Paragraph from the list. 要将标题恢复为普通文本，请从列表中选择_段落（Paragraph）_。

Apart from using the UI, it is also possible to quickly insert headings using the Markdown-like shortcuts: 除了使用界面外，还可以使用类似 Markdown 的快捷键快速插入标题：

  • ## for Heading 2
  • ### for Heading 3
  • #### for Heading 4
  • ##### for Heading 5
  • ###### for Heading 6
  • ## 对应标题 2
  • ### 对应标题 3
  • #### 对应标题 4
  • ##### 对应标题 5
  • ###### 对应标题 6

Font size

字号

（图片：字号选择器）

One way to highlight a portion of text is to increase the size of the font. 突出显示一部分文本的一种方法是增大字号。

To do so, select some text and choose an option from the Font size selector (as pictured to the right). 要做到这一点，请选中一些文本，并从_字号（Font size）_选择器中选择一个选项（如右图所示）。

Unlike other text editors such as Microsoft Word, the font size is relative (i.e. “Tiny”, “Small” instead of a number like 12). 与其他文本编辑器（如 Microsoft Word）不同，字号是相对的（即“极小（Tiny）”、“小（Small）”，而不是 12 这样的数字）。

Avoid using this feature just to simply make all text bigger. In that case it's generally better to adjust the font size for all notes in Options or by zooming. 避免仅仅为了把所有文本变大而使用此功能。在这种情况下，通常最好在选项（Options）中调整所有笔记的字号，或通过缩放来实现。

Bold, italic, underline, strike-through

粗体、斜体、下划线、删除线

（图片：粗体/斜体/下划线/删除线按钮）

Text can be formatted as Bold, Italic, Underline or Strike-through via the dedicated buttons in the formatting toolbar. 文本可以通过格式化工具栏中的专用按钮格式化为粗体（Bold）、斜体（Italic）、下划线（Underline）或删除线（Strike-through）。

This formatting can be easily removed using the Remove formatting item. 可以使用_移除格式（Remove formatting）_项轻松移除该格式。

The following keyboard shortcuts can be used here: 以下键盘快捷键可以在此使用：

  • Ctrl+B for bold
  • Ctrl+I for italic
  • Ctrl+U for underline
  • Ctrl+B 对应粗体
  • Ctrl+I 对应斜体
  • Ctrl+U 对应下划线

Alternatively, Markdown-like formatting can be used: 或者，可以使用类似 Markdown 的格式化：

  • Bold: Type **text** or __text__
  • Italic: Type *text* or _text_
  • Strikethrough: Type ~~text~~
  • 粗体：输入 **text** 或 __text__
  • 斜体：输入 *text* 或 _text_
  • 删除线：输入 ~~text~~

Superscript, subscript

上标、下标

This allows writing superscript or subscript text. 这允许书写上标或下标文本。

This is mostly useful for units of measure (e.g. cm3 for cubic centimeters) and chemical notations (e.g. NaHCO3) 这主要用于度量单位（例如立方厘米的 cm3）和化学符号（例如 NaHCO3）。

For mathematical formulas, prefer the Math Equations feature instead. 对于数学公式，请优先使用数学公式（Math Equations）功能。

Font color and background color

字体颜色和背景颜色

（图片：颜色选择器）

Selected text can be colored with one of the predefined colors from a palette or any color can be selected using the color picker. 选中的文本可以使用调色板中的预定义颜色之一着色，也可以使用颜色选择器选择任意颜色。

Once there is at least one color defined in the document, it will appear in the list for easy reuse. 一旦文档中定义了至少一种颜色，它就会出现在列表中，便于重复使用。

When selecting a foreground or a background color, consider the contrast if switching between a dark theme or a light theme. 在选择前景色或背景色时，如果在深色主题和浅色主题之间切换，请考虑对比度。

To remove either the background or foreground color of a text, select the corresponding formatting button and press Remove color or use the Remove formatting toolbar item. 要移除文本的背景色或前景色，请选择相应的格式化按钮并按下_移除颜色（Remove color）_，或使用_移除格式（Remove formatting）_工具栏项。

Remove formatting

移除格式

The Remove formatting button is a quick way to eliminate the general formatting styling of a particular text. 移除格式（Remove formatting） 按钮是消除特定文本常规格式化样式的快捷方式。

Simply select the text and press the button to remove the formatting (bold, italic, colors, sizes, etc.). If the text does not have any removable formatting, the button will appear disabled. 只需选中文本并按该按钮即可移除格式（粗体、斜体、颜色、大小等）。如果文本没有任何可移除的格式，该按钮将显示为禁用状态。

Note that heading styles are not taken into consideration, these must be manually changed back to a paragraph according to the Headings section. 请注意，标题样式不在考虑范围内，必须按照_标题（Headings）_部分手动将其改回段落。

When pasting content that comes with undesired formatting, an alternative to pasting and then removing formatting is pasting as plain text via Ctrl+Shift+V. 当粘贴带有不需要格式的内容时，粘贴后再移除格式的替代方案是通过 Ctrl+Shift+V 以纯文本粘贴。

Format painter

格式刷

The Format Painter allows users to copy the formatting of text (such as bold, italic, Strikethrough, etc.) and apply it to other parts of the document. It helps maintain consistent formatting and accelerates the creation of rich content. 格式刷（Format Painter）允许用户复制文本的格式（如粗体、斜体、删除线等）并将其应用到文档的其他部分。它有助于保持格式一致，并加快富内容的创作。

Support for Markdown

对 Markdown 的支持

When exported to Markdown, most of the general formatting is maintained such as headings, bold, italic, underline, etc. 当导出为Markdown时，大部分常规格式（如标题、粗体、斜体、下划线等）都会被保留。

title: Image references(图片引用)
full:
（图片：图像引用示例）

Image references are an easy way to embed the preview of another note type into a Text note. 图像引用是一种将其他笔记类型的预览嵌入到文本（Text）笔记中的简单方法。

Supported note types

支持的笔记类型

  • Canvas
  • Mermaid Diagrams
  • Mind Map
  • 画布（Canvas）
  • Mermaid 图表（Mermaid Diagrams）
  • 思维导图（Mind Map）

Steps

步骤

  1. Go to one of the supported notes (listed above) and look for the button in the Floating buttons area.
  2. 前往上述受支持的笔记之一，并在浮动按钮（Floating buttons）区域中寻找 按钮。
  3. Go to a Text note and use the Paste function to insert the reference to that note.
  4. 前往文本（Text）笔记，并使用粘贴功能插入对该笔记的引用。

Interaction

交互

  • Double-clicking an image reference from a text note will automatically open the target note.
  • 从文本笔记中双击图像引用将自动打开目标笔记。
  • Clicking an image reference while Ctrl is pressed will open the target note in a new tab.
  • 按住 Ctrl 键点击图像引用将在新标签页中打开目标笔记。
  • Modifying the target note should also update the image reference. If that doesn't happen, consider Refreshing the application.
  • 修改目标笔记也应更新图像引用。如果没有发生，请考虑刷新应用程序（Refreshing the application）。

title: Include Note(包含笔记)
full:
Text notes can "include" another note as a read-only widget or an interactive widget, depending on the type of note. 文本笔记可以“包含（include）”另一个笔记，作为只读组件或交互式组件，具体取决于笔记类型。

This can be useful for e.g. including a dynamically generated chart (from scripts & "render HTML" note) or other more advanced use cases. 这对于例如包含动态生成的图表（来自脚本和“渲染 HTML”笔记）或其他更高级的用例很有用。

Including a note

包含一个笔记

In the Formatting toolbar, look for the button. There is also a keyboard shortcut defined for it but it is not allocated by default. 在格式化工具栏（Formatting toolbar）中，寻找 按钮。它也有一个已定义的键盘快捷键，但默认未分配。

Included notes in the share functionality

分享功能中的包含笔记

If a shared note contains one or more included notes, they will be displayed in the content of the note as if they were part of the note itself. 如果共享笔记包含一个或多个包含笔记，它们将显示在笔记内容中，就像它们是笔记本身的一部分一样。

For this to work, the included notes must also be shared, otherwise they will not be shown. However, the included notes can still be hidden from the note tree via #shareHiddenFromTree. 要实现这一点，包含笔记也必须被共享，否则它们将不会显示。不过，包含笔记仍然可以通过 #shareHiddenFromTree 从笔记树中隐藏。

Interactive notes

交互式笔记

Since v0.104.0, included notes might become interactive depending on their note type: 自 v0.104.0 起，包含笔记可能会根据其笔记类型变为交互式：

  • Collections (e.g. Geo Map) will render fully interactive, including creating new notes.
  • 集合（Collections）（例如 地理地图（Geo Map））将完全交互式渲染，包括创建新笔记。
  • Saved Search will also display the results.
  • 已保存搜索（Saved Search）也将显示结果。
  • Web View provides an interactive preview of the website.
  • 网页视图（Web View）提供网站的交互式预览。

title: Insert buttons(插入按钮)
full:
Press the button in the Formatting toolbar to reveal special insertable items and blocks such as symbols, Math expressions and separators. 点击格式化工具栏（Formatting toolbar）中的 按钮，以显示特殊的可插入项目和块，例如符号、数学表达式和分隔符。

Bookmarks

书签

See the dedicated Anchors section. 参见专门的锚点（Anchors）章节。

Emoji

（图片：Emoji 选择器）

This feature allows inserting Unicode emoji characters. Simply select a category and a desired emoji to insert it. 此功能允许插入 Unicode emoji 字符。只需选择一个类别和一个所需的 emoji 即可插入。

Emojis can also be searched by their English name and the skin tone can be selected via a combo box to the right. Emoji 也可以通过其英文名称搜索，肤色可以通过右侧的组合框选择。

There is also the possibility of inserting emojis directly by typing :followed by a name of an emoji, triggering the display of a list of emojis. Simply use the arrow keys to select one and press Enter to insert it. 还可以通过输入 : 后跟 emoji 名称直接插入 emoji，从而触发 emoji 列表的显示。只需使用方向键选择一个并按 Enter 插入即可。

（图片：输入冒号触发 emoji 列表）

Symbols

符号

（图片：符号选择器）

Pressing the button will reveal a popup window displaying a list of characters that are generally more difficult to insert directly from the keyboard, such as a subset of emojis, quotation characters, etc. 点击 按钮将显示一个弹出窗口，列出通常更难直接从键盘输入的字符，例如 emoji 子集、引号字符等。

Interaction: 交互：

  • Click on a character to insert it at the current cursor position.
  • 点击一个字符将其插入到当前光标位置。
  • The window can be dragged around by the top bar where the title is, to avoid it getting in the way of the text.
  • 可以通过标题所在的顶部栏拖动该窗口，以避免遮挡文本。
  • Click on the Category selector to filter the characters.
  • 点击_类别（Category）_选择器以过滤字符。

Math equations

数学公式

See the dedicated Math Equations page. 参见专门的数学公式（Math Equations）页面。

Mermaid diagram

Mermaid 图表

Press the button to create an inline Mermaid diagram. 点击 按钮创建行内 Mermaid 图表。

This feature is quite similar to the Mermaid Diagrams note types and is meant as an alternative to it for simple diagrams. For more complex diagrams, use the Include Note feature for a dedicated Mermaid note. 此功能与Mermaid 图表（Mermaid Diagrams）笔记类型非常相似，旨在作为简单图表的替代方案。对于更复杂的图表，请使用包含笔记（Include Note）功能来创建专用的 Mermaid 笔记。

（图片：行内 Mermaid 图表示例）

Horizontal rule

水平分隔线

This feature will display a horizontal line, generally useful to separate different sections of the text. To do so, press the button in the Formatting toolbar. 此功能将显示一条水平线，通常用于分隔文本的不同部分。要做到这一点，请点击格式化工具栏（Formatting toolbar）中的 按钮。

（图片：水平分隔线）

Alternatively, it's possible to insert a horizontal ruler by typing ---. 或者，可以通过输入 --- 插入水平分隔线。

Page break

分页符

（图片：分页符按钮）

Page breaks provide a way to force the next paragraph or block (table, image, etc.) to be displayed onto the next page when printing (either to a real printer to when exporting to PDF). 分页符提供了一种方式，在打印时（无论是打印到真实打印机还是导出为 PDF）强制下一段落或块（表格、图像等）显示在下一页上。

Page breaks are marked in the editor with the words Page break, but they will not actually be shown when printed. 分页符在编辑器中以_分页符（Page break）_字样标记，但在打印时实际上不会显示。

  • To insert a page break, press the in the formatting toolbar.
  • 要插入分页符，请点击格式化工具栏中的 。
  • To insert many page breaks at once, insert a page break first, click on it and press Ctrl+C. Then use Ctrl+V, to paste as many times as needed.
  • 要一次性插入多个分页符，请先插入一个分页符，点击它并按 Ctrl+C。然后使用 Ctrl+V 按需粘贴多次。

title: Link Previews(链接预览)
full:
Link previews turn a pasted URL into a rich, metadata-aware widget that can be displayed in three visual modes: 链接预览（Link previews）将粘贴的 URL 转换为一个丰富的、感知元数据的组件，可以以三种视觉模式显示：

Display modes

显示模式

A link preview can be displayed in one of three modes: 链接预览可以以下三种模式之一显示：

  • Inline — a link showing the site's favicon and page title (quite similar to Internal (reference) links). Use this when you want the link to flow with the surrounding paragraph.
  • 行内（Inline）——显示网站图标和页面标题的链接（与内部（引用）链接（Internal (reference) links）非常相似）。当你希望链接与周围段落融为一体时使用此模式。
  • Card — a block-level preview with thumbnail, title, description, and site name. Use this when the link is the focus of a paragraph.
  • 卡片（Card）——带缩略图、标题、描述和站点名称的块级预览。当链接是段落焦点时使用此模式。
  • Embed — a block-level interactive embed.
    • Currently supported for YouTube videos, which render interactively (via an iframe).
    • To prevent unwanted remote requests, the video is shown only after clicking on it first.
  • 嵌入（Embed）——块级交互式嵌入。
    • 目前支持 YouTube 视频，它们会以交互方式渲染（通过 iframe）。
    • 为防止不必要的远程请求，视频仅在首次点击后才显示。

Inserting a link preview

插入链接预览

There are two ways to create one: 有两种创建方式：

1. By pasting a URL

1. 通过粘贴 URL

A link preview is automatically created: 链接预览会自动创建：

  • By pasting the URL and pressing Space. This will create an inline link preview.
  • 通过粘贴 URL 并按 Space。这将创建一个_行内（inline）_链接预览。
  • When at the start of a new paragraph, pressing Enter will create a card or an embed for YouTube URLs.
  • 当位于新段落开头时，按 Enter 将为 YouTube URL 创建一个_卡片（card）或_嵌入（embed）。

To undo an automatic link preview, press Ctrl+Z immediately afterwards which keeps it as a plain link instead. Alternatively, once a link preview was created, click on the link and select Plain link from the link preview toolbar. 要撤销自动链接预览，请立即按 Ctrl+Z，这会将其保留为普通链接。或者，链接预览创建后，点击链接并从链接预览工具栏中选择_纯链接（Plain link）_。

This automatic conversion can be disabled by going to Options → Text Notes and unchecking Autogenerate link previews from the Features section. 可以通过前往选项（Options） → 文本笔记（Text Notes） 并取消勾选_功能（Features）_部分中的_自动生成链接预览（Autogenerate link previews）_来禁用此自动转换。

If the link is not accessible to the Trilium server (or the network request fails for any other reason), it will not be converted to a link preview. 如果链接对 Trilium 服务器不可访问（或网络请求因任何其他原因失败），它将不会被转换为链接预览。

A URL is only auto-converted when the pasted text is the URL. Links with a display name (e.g. Trilium Notes website) are left as plain links. 注意：只有当粘贴的文本_就是_ URL 时，URL 才会被自动转换。带显示名称的链接（例如 Trilium Notes website）会保持为纯链接。

2. By using the "Link preview" toolbar button

2. 使用“链接预览”工具栏按钮

Click Link preview in the formatting toolbar to open the Link preview popup. Paste the URL and choose the type of preview. 点击格式化工具栏中的**链接预览（Link preview）**以打开_链接预览（Link preview）_弹窗。粘贴 URL 并选择预览类型。

Altering an existing link preview

修改现有的链接预览

Click on an inserted link preview to select it, and a small toolbar will appear with the following options: 点击已插入的链接预览以选中它，将出现一个包含以下选项的小工具栏：

  • The normal link operations (opening in a new tab, copying the link, unlinking).
  • 常规链接操作（在新标签页中打开、复制链接、取消链接）。
  • A button to edit the title of the link preview. This is especially useful if the title is hidden behind a login screen.
  • 一个编辑链接预览标题的按钮。如果标题隐藏在登录界面后面，这一点尤其有用。
  • A way to switch between the link preview modes (Inline, Card or Embed) as well as to convert it to a normal link instead.
    • The Embed option is only enabled when the URL points to a supported service (YouTube today).
  • 一种在链接预览模式（行内、卡片或嵌入）之间切换的方式，以及将其转换为普通链接的方式。
    • 嵌入选项仅在 URL 指向受支持的服务（目前为 YouTube）时才启用。

Where the preview data comes from

预览数据的来源

When you insert a link preview, Trilium fetches metadata once and stores it inside the note's HTML: 当你插入链接预览时，Trilium 会获取一次元数据并将其存储在笔记的 HTML 中：

  • YouTube URLs — title, channel name, and thumbnail are fetched via YouTube's public oEmbed endpoint.
  • YouTube URL——标题、频道名称和缩略图通过 YouTube 的公开 oEmbed 端点获取。
  • All other URLs — Trilium fetches the page and reads OpenGraph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image, og:site_name), falling back to the page's <title> and <meta name="description">. The site's favicon is downloaded and inlined.
  • 所有其他 URL——Trilium 获取页面并读取 OpenGraph 标签（og:title、og:description、og:image、og:site_name），回退到页面的 <title> 和 <meta name="description">。网站图标会被下载并内联。

Because the data is stored in the note itself, link previews continue to render correctly when you reopen the note, share/publish it, or export to HTML — without any further network requests. 由于数据存储在笔记本身中，当你重新打开笔记、分享/发布它或导出为 HTML 时，链接预览会继续正确渲染——无需任何进一步的网络请求。

The metadata is captured at insertion time and is not automatically refreshed. If the linked page later changes its title or thumbnail, you'll need to re-insert the link to pick up the new values. To refresh a link, simply create it again. 元数据在插入时被捕获，不会自动刷新。如果链接页面之后更改了标题或缩略图，你需要重新插入链接以获取新值。要刷新链接，只需重新创建它即可。

When accessing a Server Installation, the data is fetched from the remote URL by the server and not the client. 在访问服务器安装（Server Installation）时，数据由服务器从远程 URL 获取，而不是由客户端获取。

Known limitations

已知限制

  • The Embed display mode currently only supports YouTube. Other video and media platforms fall back to a Card preview.
  • 嵌入显示模式目前仅支持 YouTube。其他视频和媒体平台会回退到卡片预览。
  • Pages that block automated fetches may produce a minimal preview (hostname only).
  • 阻止自动抓取的页面可能会生成最小化预览（仅主机名）。
  • Link previews require the Trilium server to reach the target URL, so they won't generate previews for pages on networks the server can't see.
  • 链接预览要求 Trilium 服务器能够访问目标 URL，因此对于服务器无法访问的网络上的页面，不会生成预览。

title: External links(外部链接)
full:
An external link is a standard web link targeting for example a website. For example, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_China_Sea is an external link to a Wikipedia page. 外部链接是标准的网页链接，例如指向某个网站。例如，https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_China_Sea 是指向维基百科页面的外部链接。

To create a link without a custom text: 创建不带自定义文本的链接：

  • Press in the Formatting toolbar:
    • A popup will appear, type or paste the URL in the box.
    • Press Enter or the check mark icon to confirm.
  • 点击格式化工具栏（Formatting toolbar）中的 ：
    • 将出现一个弹窗，在框中输入或粘贴 URL。
    • 按 Enter 或对勾图标确认。
  • Alternatively, press Ctrl+K to trigger the aforementioned popup.
  • 或者，按 Ctrl+K 触发上述弹窗。
  • A simpler way is to paste the raw link and press space to turn it automatically into a link.
  • 更简单的方法是粘贴原始链接并按空格键自动将其转换为链接。

To create a link with a custom text: 创建带自定义文本的链接：

  • First, type and select the text which will be turned into a link.
  • 首先，输入并选中将要转换为链接的文本。
  • Follow the previous steps to open the link interface (via the formatting toolbar, or Ctrl+K).
  • 按照前面的步骤打开链接界面（通过格式化工具栏，或 Ctrl+K）。
  • Alternatively, simply paste (Ctrl+V) over the selected text to turn it into a link.
  • 或者，只需在选中文本上粘贴（Ctrl+V）即可将其转换为链接。

Once a link is inserted: 链接插入后：

  • The text inside the link can be changed if needed but the link itself will remain.
  • 链接内的文本可以在需要时更改，但链接本身将保持不变。
  • To modify the link, click on the link to display the popup and press the Edit link button.
  • 要修改链接，请点击链接以显示弹窗，并按 编辑链接（Edit link） 按钮。
  • To remove a link, click on it and press the Unlink button.
  • 要移除链接，请点击它并按 取消链接（Unlink） 按钮。

You can follow external link by either double clicking (will open new tab/window) it or right clicking on them and choosing "Open in new tab". 你可以通过双击（将打开新标签页/窗口）或右键点击并选择“在新标签页中打开”来打开外部链接。

title: Internal (reference) links(内部（引用）链接)
full:
Internal links are links to other notes within Trilium. 内部链接是指向 Trilium 内其他笔记的链接。

You can open an internal link by clicking it. You can also see a read-only preview of an internal link's contents by hovering over it. 你可以通过点击打开内部链接。你也可以通过悬停在内部链接上查看其内容的只读预览。

Inserting internal links

插入内部链接

Internal links can be created at the current position in a text note by: 可以通过以下方式在文本笔记的当前位置创建内部链接：

  1. Pressing Ctrl + L or the button underneath the menu in the Formatting toolbar.
  2. 按 Ctrl + L，或点击格式化工具栏（Formatting toolbar）中 菜单下方的 按钮。
  3. Searching for the title of the desired note to link. It's also possible to create new notes from this dialog by typing a non-existing note title and selecting Create and link child note.
  4. 搜索要链接的所需笔记的标题。也可以在此对话框中通过输入不存在的笔记标题并选择_创建并链接子笔记（Create and link child note）_来创建新笔记。

There are two link types which you can select when creating the link to the note: 创建指向笔记的链接时，你可以选择两种链接类型：

  1. Link title mirrors the note's current title
    1. This is sometimes also called "reference link".
    2. The title of this link cannot be changed. Instead, it will always show the current title of the linked note.
    3. The icon of the linked note will also be displayed.
  2. 链接标题镜像笔记的当前标题
    1. 这有时也被称为“引用链接（reference link）”。
    2. 此链接的标题无法更改。相反，它将始终显示被链接笔记的当前标题。
    3. 被链接笔记的图标也会被显示。
  3. Link title can be changed arbitrarily
    1. This will create a traditional hyperlink, where the text of the link can be different from the note title.
  4. 链接标题可以任意更改
    1. 这将创建传统的超链接，其中链接的文本可以与笔记标题不同。

In-place linking

就地链接

You can also insert internal links "inline" by using the @@ symbol: 你也可以通过使用 @@ 符号“就地（inline）”插入内部链接：

  1. Type @@ in a text note, which will open the note search menu.
  2. 在文本笔记中输入 @@，这将打开笔记搜索菜单。
  3. Search for the desired note's title by typing a few characters. Use Up and Down to select the correct note, and press Enter or Tab to create the link. It's also possible to create new notes with this method by typing a non-existing note title and selecting Create and link child note.
  4. 通过输入几个字符搜索所需笔记的标题。使用 Up 和 Down 选择正确的笔记，并按 Enter 或 Tab 创建链接。也可以通过此方法输入不存在的笔记标题并选择_创建并链接子笔记（Create and link child note）_来创建新笔记。

Pasting internal links

粘贴内部链接

You can also insert internal links by copying a note from the note tree. 你也可以通过从笔记树复制笔记来插入内部链接。

  1. In the Note Tree, select a note and press Ctrl + C.
  2. 在笔记树（Note Tree）中，选择一个笔记并按 Ctrl + C。
  3. In a text note, paste the link by pressing Ctrl + V.
  4. 在文本笔记中，按 Ctrl + V 粘贴链接。

title: Lists(列表)
full:
There are three types of lists supported by text notes: 文本笔记支持三种类型的列表：

  • Bulleted lists (also known as unordered lists).
  • Numbered lists (or ordered lists).
  • To-do lists
  • 项目符号列表（Bulleted lists，也称为无序列表）。
  • 编号列表（Numbered lists，或称有序列表）。
  • 待办列表（To-do lists）

For bulleted and numbered lists, it's possible to configure an alternative marker such as squares or Roman numbering by pressing the icon. For numbered lists, it's also possible to specify the number to start at or whether to count in reverse order. 对于项目符号列表和编号列表，可以通过点击 图标配置替代标记，例如方块或罗马数字编号。对于编号列表，还可以指定起始编号或是否倒序计数。

Keyboard interaction

键盘交互

  • To create a new list:
    • Bulleted list: Start a line with * or -followed by a space;
    • Numbered list: Start a line with 1. or 1)followed by a space;
    • To-do list: Start a line with - [ ] for an unchecked item or [x] for a checked item.
  • To create a new item in the list, press Enter.
  • To create a blank line within a list item, press Shift+Enter.
  • To exit out of the list, press Enter twice.
  • To merge two lists, simply delete the gap between them.
  • To create nested lists, simply use the button (see Indentation in Other features) or the Tab key. To decrease the nesting level for the current element, press Shift+Tab.
  • 创建新列表：
    • 项目符号列表：以 * 或 - 开头后跟一个空格；
    • 编号列表：以 1. 或 1) 开头后跟一个空格；
    • 待办列表：以 - [ ] 开头表示未勾选项，或以 [x] 开头表示已勾选项。
  • 在列表中创建新项目：按 Enter。
  • 在列表项内创建空白行：按 Shift+Enter。
  • 退出列表：按两次 Enter。
  • 合并两个列表：只需删除它们之间的间隔。
  • 创建嵌套列表：只需使用 按钮（参见其他功能（Other features）中的_缩进（Indentation）_）或 Tab 键。要减少当前元素的嵌套层级，按 Shift+Tab。

Headings, code blocks within lists

列表中的标题、代码块

It is possible to add content-level blocks such as headings, code blocks, tables within lists, as follows: 可以按如下方式在列表中添加内容级块，例如标题、代码块、表格：

The same principle applies to all three list types (bullet, numbered and to-do). 同样的原理适用于所有三种列表类型（项目符号、编号和待办）。

To-do lists

待办列表

See To-do Lists. 参见待办列表（To-do Lists）。

Collapsible lists

可折叠列表

Starting with Trilium v0.104.0, it is possible to collapse nested list items. This applies to bullet lists, numbered lists as well as to-do lists. 从 Trilium v0.104.0 开始，可以折叠嵌套的列表项。这适用于项目符号列表、编号列表以及待办列表。

To collapse or expand a list item that has nested sub-items: 要折叠或展开带有嵌套子项的列表项：

  • Using the mouse, move the cursor over the list item and an arrow will appear to its left. Clicking it will toggle between collapsed and expanded.
  • 使用鼠标，将光标移到列表项上，其左侧会出现一个箭头。点击它将在折叠和展开之间切换。
  • For bullet lists and numbered lists, it's also possible to click directly on the marker (e.g. the bullet or the number) instead of on the arrow to collapse or expand it. This won't work for to-do lists since this would toggle the to-do instead.
  • 对于项目符号列表和编号列表，也可以直接点击标记（例如项目符号或数字）而不是箭头来折叠或展开它。这对待办列表无效，因为这会切换待办状态。
  • Press Ctrl+Alt+Enter which will toggle the collapse/expand state for the item at the cursor position.
  • 按 Ctrl+Alt+Enter，这将切换光标位置处项目的折叠/展开状态。

Of note: 另请注意：

  • Collapsed items always show the arrow to indicate its state.
  • 折叠的项目总是显示箭头以指示其状态。
  • The collapsed state is saved at note level and synced across instances, which means that it will restore after a refresh or reopening of the application.
  • 折叠状态保存在笔记级别并在各实例间同步，这意味着它在刷新或重新打开应用程序后会恢复。
  • The collapsed state is also persisted in Import & Export, but only for the HTML format. Markdown exports will not preserve the collapse state.
  • 折叠状态也会在导入与导出（Import & Export）中持久化，但仅适用于 HTML 格式。Markdown 导出不会保留折叠状态。
  • Collapsible bullets only exist in the context of editable text notes. Read-only lists will always be fully expanded.
  • 可折叠项目符号仅存在于可编辑文本笔记的上下文中。只读列表将始终完全展开。
  • The list items will auto-expand on edit to avoid typing in a hidden area.
  • 列表项在编辑时会自动展开，以避免在隐藏区域中输入。

title: Math Equations(数学公式)
full:
（图片：数学公式示例）

Within text notes, it's possible to enter mathematical equations using the button from the Formatting toolbar (generally found under the Insert buttons). 在文本笔记中，可以使用格式化工具栏（Formatting toolbar）中的 按钮（通常位于插入按钮（Insert buttons）下）输入数学公式。

The mathematical expression must be written in the TeX format. There is no visual editor for the math equations, only a preview. 数学表达式必须使用 TeX 格式书写。数学公式没有可视化编辑器，只有预览。

Enabling Display mode will render the equation slightly bigger (especially if using big operators such as summation, or fractions) and center it. Display mode equations will act as blocks (i.e. like paragraphs, or tables) and can be inserted for example in lists. Non-display equations can be part of the text. 启用_显示模式（Display mode）_将使公式渲染得稍大（尤其是在使用求和等大型运算符或分数时）并居中显示。显示模式公式将作为块（即类似于段落或表格），例如可以插入到列表中。非显示公式可以成为文本的一部分。

Keyboard shortcuts

键盘快捷键

If inserting equations frequently, using the Ctrl+M keyboard shortcut can be more comfortable. Alternatively, type $$ or \[to trigger the popup directly. 如果频繁插入公式，使用 Ctrl+M 键盘快捷键会更舒适。或者，输入 $$ 或 \[ 直接触发弹窗。

There is currently no quick way to turn an already typed-out equation, such as surrounding it with $ or pressing Ctrl+M. 目前没有快速方法将已经输入的公式转换（例如用 $ 包围它或按 Ctrl+M）。

Supported math features

支持的数学功能

Technically we are using the KaTeX library which allows for a subset of the TeX format. To see the full list of supported features, consult the Supported Functionsand the Support Table from the official documentation. 从技术上讲，我们使用 KaTeX 库，它支持 TeX 格式的一个子集。要查看受支持功能的完整列表，请查阅官方文档中的受支持函数（Supported Functions）和支持表（Support Table）。

Markdown support

Markdown 支持

Math equations will be preserved when exporting to or importing from Markdown, surrounded by $ characters for inline math expressions, and $$ for display mode. 导出到或从 Markdown 导入时，数学公式将被保留，行内数学表达式用 $ 字符包围，显示模式用 $$ 包围。

If you notice any issue with the Markdown import/export for equations, feel free to report it while providing the equation that causes issues. 如果你发现公式的 Markdown 导入/导出有任何问题，请随时报告，并提供导致问题的公式。

Formatting the equation

格式化公式

It is possible to customize the font size and foreground color for both inline and display-mode equations, just like any other text. For inline equations, the background color/highlight can also be adjusted. 可以像任何其他文本一样，为行内和显示模式公式自定义字体大小和前景色。对于行内公式，背景色/高亮也可以调整。

title: Other features(其他功能)
full:
Indentation

缩进

（图片：缩进示例）

Paragraphs can be indented to the right using the button from the Formatting toolbar. 段落可以使用格式化工具栏（Formatting toolbar）中的按钮向右缩进。

  • Press to increase the indentation of the current paragraph by one. Can be pressed multiple times if needed.
  • 按 将当前段落的缩进增加一级。如有需要可以多次按下。
  • Press to decrease the indentation of a current paragraph. The button will be disabled if it is already at the minimum indentation level.
  • 按 减少当前段落的缩进。如果已经处于最小缩进级别，该按钮将被禁用。
  • For convenience, keyboard shortcuts are also available. Press Tab to indent or Shift+Tab to decrease the indentation. These shortcuts work even if the cursor is not at the beginning of a paragraph or a list.
  • 为方便起见，还提供了键盘快捷键。按 Tab 缩进，或按 Shift+Tab 减少缩进。即使光标不在段落或列表的开头，这些快捷键也有效。
  • Apart from paragraphs, the indent button is also enabled in Lists, where it can be used to create nested lists.
  • 除段落外，缩进按钮在列表（Lists）中也已启用，可用于创建嵌套列表。

Markdown import

Markdown 导入

If the clipboard contains Markdown text, it can be easily imported into text notes. Simply copy a Markdown-formatted text and press the to insert its visual representation. 如果剪贴板包含 Markdown 文本，可以轻松导入到文本笔记中。只需复制一段 Markdown 格式的文本，并按 插入其可视化表示。

Note that this only works with raw Markdown (e.g. # Heading 1 to generate a heading) and not the visual representation of the Markdown (e.g. as in the preview pane of an application). In that case, simply use the paste function which already accepts HTML-formatted content. 请注意，这仅适用于原始 Markdown（例如用 # Heading 1 生成标题），而不适用于 Markdown 的可视化表示（例如应用程序预览面板中的样式）。在这种情况下，只需使用已经接受 HTML 格式内容的粘贴功能。

This is mostly useful for snippets of text, for entire Markdown documents use the dedicated Markdown import/export function. 这主要用于文本片段，对于完整的 Markdown 文档，请使用专门的Markdown导入/导出功能。

If accessing Trilium with a web browser, the Markdown import action will ask for the content to be inserted into a dedicated screen since it does not have access to the clipboard. 如果使用 Web 浏览器访问 Trilium，Markdown 导入操作会要求将内容插入到专门的屏幕中，因为它无法访问剪贴板。

Cut to subnote

剪切到子笔记

The button will create a child note with the selected text. For more information, see Cut to subnote. 按钮将使用选中的文本创建一个子笔记。更多信息请参见剪切到子笔记（Cut to subnote）。

Find and replace

查找和替换

（图片：查找和替换）

The button will open the editor's dedicated search and replace functionality. 按钮将打开编辑器的专用查找和替换功能。

Alternatively, the Ctrl+F combination can be pressed to show the dialog. 或者，可以按 Ctrl+F 组合键显示该对话框。

title: Slash Commands(斜杠命令)
full:
（图片：斜杠命令列表）

Slash commands is a feature of Text notes which allows easily accessing commonly used commands simply by using the keyboard, without having to remember dedicated Keyboard Shortcuts. 斜杠命令（Slash commands）是文本（Text）笔记的一项功能，只需使用键盘即可轻松访问常用命令，而无需记住专门的键盘快捷键（Keyboard Shortcuts）。

Interaction

交互

  • As the name suggests, to trigger the slash commands simply press the / key to trigger it. Note that this can be anywhere in a paragraph as long as it's not part of the word, if it doesn't show up simply press a space and press the / key again.
  • 顾名思义，要触发斜杠命令只需按下 / 键。请注意，这可以在段落中的任何位置，只要它不属于某个单词的一部分即可；如果它没有出现，只需按一个空格并再次按 / 键。
  • Use ← and ↓ keys to navigate between options.
  • 使用 ← 和 ↓ 键在选项之间导航。
  • By default, the full list of commands is displayed.
  • 默认情况下，会显示完整的命令列表。
  • To search by title or description, simply start typing for an action.
  • 要按标题或描述搜索，只需开始输入一个操作。
  • To trigger an action, press the Enter key.
  • 要触发操作，请按 Enter 键。

Integration with other features

与其他功能的集成

Apart from the common set of commands, some features are specially integrated with the slash commands: 除了常见的命令集之外，一些功能与斜杠命令进行了特殊集成：

  • For admonitions, each admonition type (e.g. note, tip) will be individually displayed.
  • 对于提示框（admonitions），每种提示框类型（例如 note、tip）都会被单独显示。
  • Every Text Snippets will also appear individually, making it easy to insert them.
  • 每个文本片段（Text Snippets）也会单独出现，方便插入它们。
  • In-editor AI assistant: dedicated Ask AI item as well as all the predefined and custom quick actions.
  • 编辑器内 AI 助手（In-editor AI assistant）：专用的_询问 AI（Ask AI）_项以及所有预定义和自定义快速操作（custom quick actions）。

title: Tables(表格)
full:
Tables are a powerful feature for Text notes, since editing them is generally easy. 表格对文本（Text）笔记来说是一项强大的功能，因为编辑它们通常很容易。

（图片：创建表格）

To create a table, simply press the table button and select with the mouse the desired amount of columns and rows, as indicated in the adjacent figure. 要创建表格，只需按下表格按钮并用鼠标选择所需的列数和行数，如旁边的图所示。

Formatting toolbar

格式化工具栏

When a table is selected, a special formatting toolbar will appear: 当选中表格时，会出现一个特殊的格式化工具栏：

（图片：表格格式化工具栏）

Navigating a table

在表格中导航

  • Using the mouse:
    • Click on a cell to focus it.
    • Click the button at the top or the bottom of a table to insert an empty paragraph near it.
    • Click the button at the top-left of the table to select it entirely (for easy copy-pasting or cutting) or drag and drop it to relocate the table.
  • Using the keyboard:
    • Use the arrow keys on the keyboard to easily navigate between cells.
    • It's also possible to use Tab to go to the next cell and Shift+Tab to go to the previous cell.
    • Unlike arrow keys, pressing Tab at the end of the table (last row, last column) will create a new row automatically.
    • To select multiple cells, hold Shift while using the arrow keys.
  • 使用鼠标：
    • 点击单元格使其聚焦。
    • 点击表格顶部或底部的 按钮在其附近插入一个空段落。
    • 点击表格左上角的 按钮将其完全选中（便于复制粘贴或剪切），或拖放它来重新定位表格。
  • 使用键盘：
    • 使用键盘上的方向键轻松在单元格之间导航。
    • 也可以使用 Tab 转到下一个单元格，使用 Shift+Tab 转到上一个单元格。
    • 与方向键不同，在表格末尾（最后一行、最后一列）按 Tab 会自动创建新行。
    • 要选择多个单元格，请在使用方向键时按住 Shift。

Resizing cells

调整单元格大小

  • Columns can be resized by hovering the mouse over the border of two adjacent cells and dragging it.
  • 列可以通过将鼠标悬停在两个相邻单元格的边框上并拖动来调整大小。
  • By default, the row height is not adjustable using the mouse, but it can be configured from the cell settings (see below).
  • 默认情况下，行高无法使用鼠标调整，但可以从单元格设置中进行配置（见下文）。
  • To adjust exactly the width (in pixels or percentages) of a cell, select the button.
  • 要精确调整单元格的宽度（以像素或百分比），请选择 按钮。

Inserting new rows and new columns

插入新行和新列

  • To insert a new column, click on a desired location, then press the button from the formatting toolbar and select Insert column left or right.
  • 要插入新列，请点击所需位置，然后按下格式化工具栏中的 按钮并选择_在左侧或右侧插入列（Insert column left or right）_。
  • To insert a new row, click on a desired location, then press the button and select Insert row above or below.
    • A quicker alternative to creating a new row while at the end of the table is to press the Tab key.
  • 要插入新行，请点击所需位置，然后按下 按钮并选择_在上方或下方插入行（Insert row above/below）_。
    • 在表格末尾创建新行的更快替代方法是按 Tab 键。

Merging cells

合并单元格

To merge two or more cells together, simply select them via drag & drop and press the button from the formatting toolbar. 要合并两个或多个单元格，只需通过拖放选中它们，然后按下格式化工具栏中的 按钮。

More options are available by pressing the arrow next to it: 通过按下其旁边的箭头可以获得更多选项：

  • Click on a single cell and select Merge cell up/down/right/left to merge with an adjacent cell.
  • 点击单个单元格并选择向上/向下/向右/向左合并单元格，以与相邻单元格合并。
  • Select Split cell vertically or horizontally, to split a cell into multiple cells (can also be used to undo a merge).
  • 选择_垂直拆分单元格（Split cell vertically）或_水平拆分（horizontally），将一个单元格拆分为多个单元格（也可用于撤销合并）。

Table properties

表格属性

（图片：表格属性）

The table properties can be accessed via the button and allows for the following adjustments: 表格属性可以通过 按钮访问，并允许进行以下调整：

  • Border (not the border of the cells, but the outer rim of the table), which includes the style (single, double), color and width.
  • 边框（不是单元格的边框，而是表格的外缘），包括样式（单线、双线）、颜色和宽度。
  • The background color, with none set by default.
  • 背景颜色，默认未设置。
  • The width and height of the table in percentage (must end with %) or pixels (must end with px).
  • 表格的宽度和高度，以百分比（必须以 % 结尾）或像素（必须以 px 结尾）表示。
  • The alignment of the table.
    • Left or right-aligned, case in which the text will flow next to it.
    • Centered, case in which text will avoid the table, regardless of the table width.
  • 表格的对齐方式。
    • 左对齐或右对齐，此时文本将在其旁边流动。
    • 居中，此时文本将避开表格，无论表格宽度如何。

The table will immediately update to reflect the changes, but the Save button must be pressed for the changes to persist. 表格会立即更新以反映更改，但必须按下_保存（Save）_按钮才能使更改持久化。

Cell properties

单元格属性

（图片：单元格属性）

Similarly to table properties, the button opens a popup which adjusts the styling of one or more cells (based on the user's selection). 与表格属性类似， 按钮会打开一个弹窗，用于调整一个或多个单元格的样式（基于用户的选择）。

The following options can be adjusted: 可以调整以下选项：

  • The border style, color and width (same as table properties), but applying to the current cell only.
  • 边框样式、颜色和宽度（与表格属性相同），但仅应用于当前单元格。
  • The background color, with none set by default.
  • 背景颜色，默认未设置。
  • The width and height of the cell in percentage (must end with %) or pixels (must end with px).
  • 单元格的宽度和高度，以百分比（必须以 % 结尾）或像素（必须以 px 结尾）表示。
  • The padding (the distance of the text compared to the cell's borders).
  • 内边距（文本相对于单元格边框的距离）。
  • The alignment of the text, both horizontally (left, centered, right, justified) and vertically (top, middle or bottom).
  • 文本的对齐方式，包括水平（左、中、右、两端对齐）和垂直（顶部、中部或底部）。

The cell will immediately update to reflect the changes, but the Save button must be pressed for the changes to persist. 单元格会立即更新以反映更改，但必须按下_保存（Save）_按钮才能使更改持久化。

Caption

标题说明

Press the button to insert a caption or a text description of the table, which is going to be displayed above the table. 按下 按钮插入表格的标题说明或文本描述，它将显示在表格上方。

Table borders

表格边框

By default, tables will come with a predefined grey border. 默认情况下，表格会带有预定义的灰色边框。

To adjust the borders, follow these steps: 要调整边框，请按照以下步骤操作：

  1. Select the table.
  2. In the floating panel, select the Table properties option ( ).
    1. Look for the Border section at the top of the newly opened panel.
    2. This will control the outer borders of the table.
    3. Select a style for the border. Generally Single is the desirable option.
    4. Select a color for the border.
    5. Select a width for the border, expressed in pixels.
  3. Select all the cells of the table and then press the Cell properties option ( ).
    1. This will control the inner borders of the table, at cell level.
    2. Note that it's possible to change the borders individually by selecting one or more cells, case in which it will only change the borders that intersect these cells.
    3. Repeat the same steps as from step (2).
  4. 选择表格。
  5. 在浮动面板中，选择_表格属性（Table properties）_选项（ ）。
    1. 在新打开的面板顶部寻找_边框（Border）_部分。
    2. 这将控制表格的外边框。
    3. 为边框选择一种样式。通常_单线（Single）_是理想选项。
    4. 为边框选择一种颜色。
    5. 为边框选择一种宽度，以像素表示。
  6. 选择表格的所有单元格，然后按下_单元格属性（Cell properties）_选项（ ）。
    1. 这将在单元格级别控制表格的内边框。
    2. 请注意，可以通过选择一个或多个单元格来单独更改边框，此时只会更改与这些单元格相交的边框。
    3. 重复步骤（2）中的相同步骤。

Tables with invisible borders

带隐形边框的表格

Tables can be set to have invisible borders in order to allow for basic layouts (columns, grids) of text or images without the distraction of their border: 表格可以设置为拥有隐形边框，以便在不被边框干扰的情况下对文本或图像进行基本布局（列、网格）：

  1. First insert a table with the desired number of columns and rows.
  2. Select the entire table.
  3. In Table properties, set:
    1. Style to Single
    2. Color to transparent
    3. Width to 1px.
  4. In Cell Properties, set the same as on the previous step.
  5. 首先插入一个具有所需列数和行数的表格。
  6. 选择整个表格。
  7. 在_表格属性（Table properties）_中，设置：
    1. _样式（Style）为_单线（Single）
    2. _颜色（Color）_为 transparent
    3. 宽度为 1px。
  8. 在单元格属性（Cell Properties）中，设置与上一步相同。

Table indentation

表格缩进

Since v0.104.1, tables can be indented as a block (the whole table moves, rather than just the content of a cell). 自 v0.104.1 起，表格可以作为块进行缩进（整个表格移动，而不仅仅是单元格的内容）。

  1. Click the button to select the entire table. Otherwise, the indentation applies only to the current cell's content.
  2. Press Tab to increase the indent, or Shift+Tab to decrease it. Alternatively, use the indentation buttons in the formatting toolbar.
  3. 点击 按钮选择整个表格。否则，缩进仅应用于当前单元格的内容。
  4. 按 Tab 增加缩进，或按 Shift+Tab 减少缩进。或者，使用格式化工具栏中的缩进按钮。

Markdown does not support indented tables, so the indentation is lost when converting to Markdown. Markdown 不支持缩进表格，因此转换为 Markdown 时会丢失缩进。

Markdown import/export

Markdown 导入/导出

Simple tables are exported in GitHub-flavored Markdown format (e.g. a series of | items). If the table is found to be more complex (it contains HTML elements, has custom sizes or images), the table is converted to an HTML one instead. 简单表格会以 GitHub 风格的 Markdown 格式导出（例如一系列 | 项）。如果表格较为复杂（包含 HTML 元素、自定义大小或图像），则表格会被转换为 HTML 表格。

Generally formatting loss should be minimal when exported to Markdown due to the fallback to HTML formatting. 通常导出到 Markdown 时格式损失应该很小，因为有回退到 HTML 格式的机制。

title: To-do Lists(待办清单)
full:
Extended task states

扩展任务状态

（图片：扩展任务状态）

In Trilium, to-do items aren't limited to a simple "done" or "not done." Tasks can also be marked as in progress ("doing"), under consideration ("maybe"), or cancelled ("won't do"), thus giving a more accurate picture of where things actually stand. 在 Trilium 中，待办事项不限于简单的“已完成”或“未完成”。任务还可以被标记为_进行中（in progress）（“doing”）、考虑中（under consideration）（“maybe”）或_已取消（cancelled）（“won't do”），从而更准确地反映事情的实际情况。

Right-click the checkbox and select the desired state. Alternatively, press Ctrl+Shift+Enter to cycle through the task states. Tapping or left-clicking the checkbox will always toggle between "None" and "Done". 右键点击复选框并选择所需状态。或者，按 Ctrl+Shift+Enter 在任务状态之间循环。点击或左键单击复选框将始终在“None”和“Done”之间切换。

Task states are fully preserved when converting between Text and Markdown notes, in both directions. 在文本（Text）和Markdown笔记之间双向转换时，任务状态会被完全保留。

Customizing the extended task states

自定义扩展任务状态

Task states are customizable: you can reorder them, create new ones with different colors and symbols, or delete the ones you don't need. See Customizing to-do task states for more details. 任务状态是可自定义的：你可以重新排序它们，创建带有不同颜色和符号的新状态，或删除不需要的状态。更多详情请参见自定义待办任务状态（Customizing to-do task states）。

Keyboard shortcuts

键盘快捷键

When at the beginning on an empty paragraph, type the following to insert a to-do list: 当位于空段落的开头时，输入以下内容以插入待办列表：

  • [ ] for an unchecked item
  • [x] for a checked item
  • [ ] 表示未勾选项
  • [x] 表示已勾选项

Extended task states are supported as well, using its corresponding Markdown symbol. These are the defaults but they can be changed if needed (see Customizing to-do task states): 扩展任务状态也受支持，使用其对应的_Markdown 符号_。以下是默认值，但如有需要可以更改（参见自定义待办任务状态（Customizing to-do task states））：

  • [/] for “Doing”.
  • [?] for “Maybe”.
  • [-] for “Cancelled”.
  • [/] 对应“进行中（Doing）”。
  • [?] 对应“可能（Maybe）”。
  • [-] 对应“已取消（Cancelled）”。

To reorder the item under the cursor, press Alt+Up or Alt+Down. To reorder multiple items, select them first. 要重新排序光标下的项目，请按 Alt+Up 或 Alt+Down。要重新排序多个项目，请先选中它们。

See also

另请参阅

  • To-do lists are meant for small task lists. For more complicated, day-to-day task tracking consider using a Kanban Board collection instead.
  • 待办列表适用于小型任务列表。对于更复杂的日常任务跟踪，请考虑使用看板（Kanban Board）集合。

title: Code(代码)
full:
Trilium supports creating "code" notes, i.e. notes which contain some sort of formal code - be it programming language (C++, JavaScript), structured data (JSON, XML) or other types of codes (CSS etc.). Trilium 支持创建“代码（code）”笔记，即包含某种形式化代码的笔记——无论是编程语言（C++、JavaScript）、结构化数据（JSON、XML）还是其他类型的代码（CSS 等）。

This can be useful for a few things: 这可以用于一些事情：

  • computer programmers can store code snippets as notes with syntax highlighting
  • JavaScript code notes can be executed inside Trilium for some extra functionality
    • we call such JavaScript code notes "scripts" - see Scripting
  • JSON, XML etc. can be used as storage for structured data (typically used in conjunction with scripting)
  • 计算机程序员可以将代码片段作为带有语法高亮的笔记存储
  • JavaScript 代码笔记可以在 Trilium 内部执行以获得一些额外功能
    • 我们称此类 JavaScript 代码笔记为“脚本（scripts）”——参见脚本（Scripting）
  • JSON、XML 等可以用作结构化数据的存储（通常与脚本结合使用）

For shorter snippets of code that can be embedded in Text notes, see Code blocks. 对于可以嵌入文本（Text）笔记中的较短代码片段，参见代码块（Code blocks）。

（图片：代码笔记示例）

Adjusting the language of a code note

调整代码笔记的语言

In the Ribbon, look for the Note type selector and click it to reveal the possible note types. Inside of it there will be a section called Code, select any one of the languages. 在功能区（Ribbon）中，寻找_笔记类型（Note type）_选择器并点击它以显示可能的笔记类型。在其中会有一个名为_代码（Code）_的部分，选择任意一种语言。

（图片：选择代码语言）

Adjusting the list of languages

调整语言列表

Trilium supports syntax highlighting for many languages, but by default displays only some of them. The supported languages can be adjusted by going to Options, then Code Notes and looking for the Available MIME types in the dropdown section. Simply check any of the items to add them to the list, or un-check them to remove them from the list. Trilium 支持许多语言的语法高亮，但默认只显示其中一部分。可以通过前往选项（Options），然后_代码笔记（Code Notes）_并在_下拉菜单中可用的 MIME 类型（Available MIME types in the dropdown）_部分来调整支持的语言。只需勾选任何项目以将其添加到列表，或取消勾选以将其从列表中移除。

Note that the list of languages is not immediately refreshed, you'd have to manually refresh the application. 请注意，语言列表不会立即刷新，你必须手动刷新应用程序。

The list of languages is also shared with the Code blocks feature of Text notes. 语言列表也与文本（Text）笔记的代码块（Code blocks）功能共享。

Word wrap

自动换行

Long lines can be displayed on multiple lines: 长行可以显示在多行上：

  • Globally for all code notes, from Options → Code Notes.
  • For a particular note, by going to the menu in Note buttons and selecting Word wrap and selecting the appropriate option:
    • Auto, to respect the global word wrap for code notes.
    • On or Off, to change the state of the word wrap for this note regardless of the global option.
  • 全局适用于所有代码笔记，从选项（Options） → 代码笔记（Code Notes）。
  • 对于特定笔记，通过进入笔记按钮（Note buttons）中的菜单并选择_自动换行（Word wrap）_并选择合适的选项：
    • 自动（Auto），尊重代码笔记的全局自动换行设置。
    • _开（On）或_关（Off），无论全局选项如何，更改此笔记的自动换行状态。

Word wrapping can also be adjusted at note level through the #wrapLines label, which can also be inherited. 注意：自动换行也可以通过 #wrapLines 标签（label）在笔记级别调整，并且可以继承。

Adjusting options using the status bar

使用状态栏调整选项

This feature is only available for the New Layout. For the old layout, the tab width can be adjusted at note level using the #tabWidth attribute, but re-indentation is not available. 注意：此功能仅适用于新布局（New Layout）。对于旧布局，制表符宽度可以在笔记级别使用 #tabWidth 属性调整，但重新缩进不可用。

The status bar at the bottom of the editor shows the current indentation settings and language. Clicking on the indentation indicator opens a menu with three sections: 编辑器底部的状态栏显示当前的缩进设置和语言。点击缩进指示器会打开一个包含三个部分的菜单：

  1. Indent Using — switch between Spaces and Tabs (#indentWithTabs). If a per-note override is active, a "Reset to default" option appears.
  2. Display Width — choose from preset widths (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8). Changes are saved as a per-note #tabWidth label.
  3. Re-indent Content To — convert existing indentation to a different style. For example, re-indent a file from 4 spaces to 2 spaces, or from spaces to tabs. This rewrites the leading whitespace on every line while preserving alignment remainders.
  4. 缩进方式（Indent Using） — 在空格和制表符（#indentWithTabs）之间切换。如果激活了按笔记覆盖，会出现“重置为默认（Reset to default）”选项。
  5. 显示宽度（Display Width） — 从预设宽度（1、2、3、4、6、8）中选择。更改会保存为按笔记的 #tabWidth 标签。
  6. 将内容重新缩进为（Re-indent Content To） — 将现有缩进转换为不同的样式。例如，将文件从 4 个空格重新缩进为 2 个空格，或从空格转为制表符。这会重写每一行的前导空白，同时保留对齐余数。

Clicking the language indicator lets you change the note's MIME type. 点击语言指示器可以让你更改笔记的 MIME 类型。

Re-indentation

重新缩进

When you re-indent content, the editor: 当你重新缩进内容时，编辑器会：

  • Measures the visual column width of each line's leading whitespace using the current style
  • Calculates indent levels and any alignment remainder
  • Rebuilds the leading whitespace in the target style
  • Preserves non-leading whitespace, blank lines, and content without indentation
  • 使用当前样式测量每一行前导空白的视觉列宽
  • 计算缩进级别和任何对齐余数
  • 以目标样式重建前导空白
  • 保留非前导空白、空行和没有缩进的内容

Color schemes

配色方案

Since Trilium 0.94.0 the colors of code notes can be customized by going Options → Code Notes and looking for the Appearance section. 自 Trilium 0.94.0 起，代码笔记的颜色可以通过前往选项（Options） → 代码笔记（Code Notes）并在_外观（Appearance）_部分进行自定义。

Why are there only a few themes whereas the code block themes for text notes have a lot?
The reason is that Code notes use a different technology than the one used in Text notes, and as such there is a more limited selection of themes. If you find a CodeMirror 6 (not 5) theme that you would like to use, let us know and we might consider adding it to the set of default themes. There is no possibility of adding new themes (at least for now), since the themes are defined in JavaScript and not at CSS level. 注意：为什么只有少数主题，而文本笔记的代码块主题有很多？ 原因是代码笔记使用的技术与文本笔记中使用的技术不同，因此主题选择更有限。如果你找到想要使用的 CodeMirror 6（而非 5）主题，请告诉我们，我们可能会考虑将其添加到默认主题集中。目前（至少现在）没有添加新主题的可能性，因为这些主题是用 JavaScript 定义的，而不是在 CSS 层面。

title: Saved Search(保存的搜索)
full:
Trilium allows you to save common searches as notes within the note tree. The search results will appear as sub-notes under these "saved search" notes. Here is an example of how it works: Trilium 允许你将常用搜索保存为笔记树中的笔记。搜索结果将作为子笔记出现在这些“已保存搜索”笔记下。下面是一个示例：

（图片：已保存搜索的工作方式演示）

Location

位置

By default, saved searches are stored in the day note. However, you can designate a different note to store saved searches by marking it with the #searchHomelabel. Additionally, for workspaces, you can use the #workspaceSearchHome label to specify a storage location for saved searches within that workspace. 默认情况下，已保存搜索存储在日记笔记（day note）中。不过，你可以通过为笔记标记 #searchHome 标签来指定不同的笔记存储已保存搜索。此外，对于工作区（workspaces），你可以使用 #workspaceSearchHome 标签来指定该工作区内已保存搜索的存储位置。

title: Relation Map(关系图谱)
full:
Relation map is a type of note which visualizes notes and their relations. 关系图（Relation map）是一种将笔记及其关系（relations）可视化的笔记类型。

Interaction

交互

  • To create a new note and add it to the board, press the plus button in the Floating buttons.
    • Afterwards, click anywhere on the map to place it there.
    • The note will be placed as a sub-child of the map.
  • An existing note can also be dragged from the Note Tree. It will be placed at the position it's dragged on.
    • Multiple notes can also be dragged via Multiple selection. The notes will be positioned near the dragged position without overlapping.
    • The dragged note can be a sub-child of the map, or it can be at any arbitrary position.
  • To create a relationship, hold the mouse on the box on the right of a note and then:
    • Drag it over another note to create a relationship pointing from the first note to the second one.
    • Drag over the same note to create a self-referencing relationship (represented as a loop).
    • Once dragged, enter the name of the relationship to create. To cancel, simply dismiss the dialog or press Esc.
  • To open a note, either click on the note (opening it in the current view) or use the right click menu to open in a new tab.
  • To edit the title of a note or to delete it (either from the map, or delete it completely), right click the note.
  • To delete a relationship, right click it and select the corresponding option.
  • 要创建新笔记并将其添加到画板，请按下浮动按钮（Floating buttons）中的加号按钮。
    • 之后，在地图上点击任意位置以将其放置在那里。
    • 该笔记将被放置为地图的子笔记。
  • 也可以从笔记树（Note Tree）中拖入现有笔记。它将被放置在其拖到的位置。
    • 也可以通过多选（Multiple selection）拖入多个笔记。这些笔记将放置在拖动位置附近而不重叠。
    • 拖入的笔记可以是地图的子笔记，也可以位于任意位置。
  • 要创建关系，请按住鼠标停留在笔记右侧的方框上，然后：
    • 将其拖到另一个笔记上，以创建从第一个笔记指向第二个笔记的关系。
    • 拖到同一笔记上，以创建自引用关系（表示为循环）。
    • 拖放后，输入要创建的关系名称。要取消，只需关闭对话框或按 Esc。
  • 要打开笔记，可以点击笔记（在当前视图中打开它），或使用右键菜单在新标签页中打开。
  • 要编辑笔记的标题或删除它（从地图中删除，或完全删除），请右键点击该笔记。
  • 要删除关系，请右键点击它并选择相应的选项。

Development process demo

开发流程演示

This is a basic example how you can create simple diagram using relation maps: 以下是一个如何使用关系图创建简单图表的基本示例：

（图片：开发流程关系图示例）

And this is how you can create it: 这是你如何创建它的过程：

（图片：创建过程演示动画）

We start completely from scratch by first creating new note called "Development process" and changing its type to "Relation map". After that we create new notes one by one and place them by clicking into the map. We also drag relationsbetween notes and name them. That's all! 我们完全从零开始，首先创建一个名为“开发流程（Development process）”的新笔记并将其类型更改为“关系图（Relation map）”。之后我们逐一创建新笔记并通过点击地图放置它们。我们还拖拽关系（relations）连接笔记并为其命名。就是这样！

Items on the map - "Specification", "Development", "Testing" and "Demo" are actually notes which have been created under "Development process" note - you can click on them and write some content. Connections between notes are called "relations". 地图上的项目——“规格（Specification）”、“开发（Development）”、“测试（Testing）”和“演示（Demo）”实际上是在“开发流程（Development process）”笔记下创建的笔记——你可以点击它们并写入一些内容。笔记之间的连接称为“关系（relations）”。

Family demo

家庭示例

This is more complicated demo using some advanced concepts. Resulting diagram is here: 这是一个使用一些高级概念的更复杂的演示。生成的图表如下：

（图片：家庭关系图示例）

This is how you get to it: 这是你实现它的过程：

（图片：创建过程演示动画）

There are several steps here: 这里有几个步骤：

  • we start with empty relation map and two existing notes representing Prince Philip and Queen Elizabeth II. These two notes already have isPartnerOf relationsdefined.
    • There are actually two "inverse" relations (one from Philip to Elizabeth and one from Elizabeth to Philip)
  • we drag both notes to relation map and place to suitable position. Notice how the existing isPartnerOf relations are displayed.
  • now we create new note - we name it "Prince Charles" and place it on the relation map by clicking on the desired position. The note is by default created under the relation map note (visible in the note tree on the left).
  • we create two new relations isChildOf targeting both Philip and Elizabeth
    • now there's something unexpected - we can also see the relation to display another hasChild relation. This is because there's a relation definition which puts isChildOfas an "inverse" relation of hasChildOf (and vice versa) and thus it is created automatically.
  • we create another note for Princess Diana and create isPartnerOf relation from Charles. Again notice how the relation has arrows both ways - this is because isPartnerOf definition specifies its inverse relation as again "isPartnerOf" so the opposite relation is created automatically.
  • as the last step we pan & zoom the map to fit better to window dimensions.
  • 我们从一个空的关系图和两个现有笔记开始，分别代表菲利普亲王（Prince Philip）和伊丽莎白二世女王（Queen Elizabeth II）。这两个笔记已经定义了 isPartnerOf 关系（relations）。
    • 实际上有两个“反向（inverse）”关系（一个从菲利普到伊丽莎白，一个从伊丽莎白到菲利普）
  • 我们将两个笔记都拖到关系图中并放置在合适的位置。注意现有的 isPartnerOf 关系是如何显示的。
  • 现在我们创建新笔记——将其命名为“查尔斯王子（Prince Charles）”，并通过点击所需位置将其放置在关系图上。该笔记默认在关系图笔记下创建（在左侧的笔记树中可见）。
  • 我们创建两个新的 isChildOf 关系，分别指向菲利普和伊丽莎白
    • 现在有了一些意外——我们还可以看到显示另一个 hasChild 关系。这是因为有一个关系定义（relation definition）将 isChildOf 设置为 hasChildOf 的“反向（inverse）”关系（反之亦然），因此它会自动创建。
  • 我们为戴安娜王妃（Princess Diana）创建另一个笔记，并从查尔斯创建 isPartnerOf 关系。再次注意关系如何有两个方向的箭头——这是因为 isPartnerOf 定义将其反向关系再次指定为“isPartnerOf”，因此相反的关系会自动创建。
  • 作为最后一步，我们平移和缩放地图以更好地适应窗口尺寸。

Relation definitions mentioned above come from "Person template" note which is assigned to any child of "My Family Tree" relation note. You can play with the whole thing in the demo notes. 上面提到的关系定义来自“人员模板（Person template）”笔记，该笔记被分配给“我的家谱（My Family Tree）”关系笔记的任何子项。你可以在演示笔记（demo notes）中玩弄整个机制。

Details

详细信息

You can specify which relations should be displayed with comma delimited names of relations in displayRelations label. 你可以通过在 displayRelations 标签中使用逗号分隔的关系名称来指定应显示哪些关系。

Alternatively, you can specify comma delimited list of relation names in hideRelations which will display all relations, except for the ones defined in the label. 或者，你可以通过在 hideRelations 中指定逗号分隔的关系名称列表，它将显示所有关系，除了该标签中定义的那些。

See also

另请参阅

  • Note Map is a similar concept.
  • 笔记图（Note Map）是一个类似的概念。

title: Note Map(笔记图谱)
full:
（图片：笔记图示例）

A Note map is a note type which displays a standalone version of the feature of the same name: Note Map (Link map, Tree map). Consult that page for more information on how the note map works and what it displays. 笔记图（Note map）是一种笔记类型，它显示同名功能的独立版本：笔记图（Note Map）(链接图 Link map、树图 Tree map)。请参阅该页面以了解笔记图如何工作以及它显示什么的更多信息。

Once created, the note map will display the relations between notes. Only the notes that are part of the parent of the note map will be displayed (including their children). 一旦创建，笔记图将显示笔记之间的关系。只会显示作为笔记图父级一部分的笔记（包括它们的子笔记）。

Root note

根笔记

The root note defines the starting point of the graph, from which the relations and the hierarchy are derived from. 根笔记定义了图的起点，关系和层级结构都由此推导而来。

There are three possible root notes: 有三种可能的根笔记：

  • The default root note is the parent note of the note map.
  • To use the currently hoisted note instead, set the mapRootNoteId label to hoisted.
  • To use a specific note instead, set mapRootNoteId to the Note ID of the desired note.
  • 默认根笔记是笔记图的父笔记。
  • 要改为使用当前悬停笔记（hoisted note），请将 mapRootNoteId 标签设置为 hoisted。
  • 要改为使用特定笔记，请将 mapRootNoteId 设置为所需笔记的笔记 ID（Note ID）。

Customization

自定义

The note map can be customized using the following Labels: 笔记图可以使用以下标签（Labels）进行自定义：

| Label | Description |

title: Render Note(渲染笔记)
full:
（图片：渲染笔记示例）

Render Note is a special case of front-end scripting which allows rendering custom content inside a note. This makes it possible to create custom dashboards, or to use a custom note editor. 渲染笔记（Render Note）是前端脚本（front-end scripting）的一种特殊情况，它允许在笔记内渲染自定义内容。这使得创建自定义仪表板或使用自定义笔记编辑器成为可能。

The content can either be a vanilla HTML, or Preact JSX. 内容可以是原生（vanilla）HTML，也可以是 Preact JSX。

Creating a render note

创建渲染笔记

  1. Create a Code note with the:
    1. HTML language for the legacy/vanilla method, with what needs to be displayed (for example <p>Hello world.</p>).
    2. JSX for the Preact-based approach (see below).
  2. Create a Render Note.
  3. Assign the renderNote relation to point at the previously created code note.
  4. 创建一个代码（Code）笔记，其内容为：
    1. 使用 HTML 语言用于旧版/原生方法，包含需要显示的内容（例如 <p>Hello world.</p>）。
    2. 使用 JSX 用于基于 Preact 的方法（见下文）。
  5. 创建一个渲染笔记（Render Note）。
  6. 将 renderNote 关系（relation）分配给指向之前创建的代码笔记。

Legacy scripting using jQuery

使用 jQuery 的旧版脚本

A static HTML is generally not enough for Scripting. The next step is to automatically change parts of the note using JavaScript. 静态 HTML 通常不足以满足脚本（Scripting）的需求。下一步是使用 JavaScript 自动更改笔记的某些部分。

For a simple example, we are going to create a render note that displays the current date in a field. 以一个简单示例为例，我们将创建一个在字段中显示当前日期的渲染笔记。

To do so, first create an HTML code note with the following content: 为此，首先创建一个包含以下内容的 HTML 代码笔记：

<h1>Current date & time</h1>
The current date & time is <span class="date"></span>

Now we need to add the script. Create another Code, but this time of JavaScript (frontend) language. Make sure the newly created note is a direct child of the HTML note created previously; with the following content: 现在我们需要添加脚本。创建另一个代码（Code）笔记，但这次使用 JavaScript（前端）语言。确保新建的笔记是之前创建的 HTML 笔记的直接子笔记；内容如下：

const $dateEl = api.$container.find(".date");
$dateEl.text(new Date());

Now create a render note at any place and set its ~renderNote relation to point to the HTML note. When the render note is accessed it will display: 现在在任意位置创建一个渲染笔记，并将其 ~renderNote 关系设置为指向该 HTML 笔记。当访问该渲染笔记时，它将显示：

Current date & time The current date & time is Sun Apr 06 2025 15:26:29 GMT+0300 (Eastern European Summer Time) 当前日期与时间 当前日期与时间是 Sun Apr 06 2025 15:26:29 GMT+0300（东欧夏令时间）

Dynamic content using Preact & JSX

使用 Preact 和 JSX 的动态内容

As a more modern alternative to jQuery, it's possible to use Preact & JSX to render pages. Since JSX is a superset of JavaScript, there's no need to provide a HTML anymore. 作为 jQuery 的更现代替代方案，可以使用 Preact 和 JSX 来渲染页面。由于 JSX 是 JavaScript 的超集，不再需要提供 HTML。

Here are the steps to creating a simple render note: 以下是创建简单渲染笔记的步骤：

  1. Create a note of type Render Note.

  2. Create a child Code note with JSX as the language.
    As an example, use the following content:

    export default function() {
    return (
        <>
            <p>Hello world.</p>
        </>
    );
}

  3. In the parent render note, define a ~renderNote relation pointing to the newly created child.

  4. Refresh the render note and it should display a "Hello world" message.

  5. 创建一个类型为渲染笔记（Render Note）的笔记。

  6. 创建一个以 JSX 为语言的子代码（Code）笔记。 例如，使用以下内容：

    export default function() {
    return (
        <>
            <p>Hello world.</p>
        </>
    );
}

  7. 在父渲染笔记中，定义一个指向新建子笔记的 ~renderNote 关系。

  8. 刷新渲染笔记，它应该显示“Hello world”消息。

Refreshing the note

刷新笔记

It's possible to refresh the note via: 可以通过以下方式刷新笔记：

  • The corresponding button in Floating buttons.
  • The "Render active note" keyboard shortcut (not assigned by default).
  • 浮动按钮（Floating buttons）中对应的按钮。
  • “渲染活动笔记（Render active note）”键盘快捷键（默认未分配）。

Examples

示例

  • Weight Tracker which is present in the Demo Notes.
  • 体重追踪器（Weight Tracker），它存在于演示笔记（Demo Notes）中。

title: Canvas(画布)
full:
（图片：画布示例）

Available since Trilium v0.52. 自 Trilium v0.52 起可用。

Canvas notes use the Excalidraw library to allow handwritten notes with mouse, pen or touch on an infinite canvas. It also supports basic diagramming, text and graphics input. 画布（Canvas）笔记使用 Excalidraw 库，允许在无限画布上使用鼠标、笔或触控进行手写笔记。它还支持基本的图表绘制、文本和图形输入。

Interaction

交互

  • The note can be toggled read-only from the Floating buttons section.
  • 可以从浮动按钮（Floating buttons）部分将笔记切换为只读（read-only）。

Embedding notes

嵌入笔记

Since v0.104.0, Canvas supports embedding notes in a similar fashion to the Include Note functionality for Text notes. 自 v0.104.0 起，画布支持以与文本（Text）笔记的包含笔记（Include Note）功能类似的方式嵌入笔记。

To embed a note: 要嵌入笔记：

  • From the Note Tree, drag the item onto the canvas.
  • Manually, by choosing More tools → Web Embed and pasting the link to the note (e.g. root/MujWAc9fQ1nj).
  • 从笔记树（Note Tree）中，将项目拖到画布上。
  • 手动操作，通过选择_更多工具（More tools）_ → _网页嵌入（Web Embed）_并粘贴指向笔记的链接（例如 root/MujWAc9fQ1nj）。

Embedding notes in the canvas follows the same rules as Include Note: some notes are rendered as images (e.g. Mind Map), whereas some render fully interactive such as Collections. 在画布中嵌入笔记遵循与包含笔记（Include Note）相同的规则：一些笔记被渲染为图像（例如思维导图（Mind Map）），而一些则完全交互式渲染，例如集合（Collections）。

title: Mind Map(思维导图)
full:
（图片：思维导图示例）

The mindmap allows for easy jotting down of ideas and storing them in a hierarchical fashion. 思维导图（mindmap）允许轻松记下想法并以层级方式存储它们。

Terminology

术语

  • A node is a single idea, represented differently based on depth (filled rounded rectangle for the root note, unfilled rectangles for sub-ideas, lines only for sub-sub-ideas).
  • The root node is the top-most node from which all other nodes derive, displayed as a filled rectangle. There can only be a single root node.
  • **节点（node）**是一个单独的想法，根据深度以不同方式表示（根笔记为填充圆角矩形，子想法为未填充矩形，子-子想法仅为线条）。
  • **根节点（root node）**是层级最高的节点，所有其他节点都由此衍生，显示为填充矩形。只能有一个根节点。

Interaction

交互

  • To create a new node at the same level as the current one, press Enter, enter the desired text and then press Enter once again to confirm.
  • Similarly, to create a sub-node, press Tab, enter the desired text and then press Enter.
  • To create a parent, use Ctrl+Enter instead.
  • To remove a node, press Delete.
  • To move a node up or down, press Page Up or Page Down.
  • To adjust the font size, color of the text or background or to add a link, click on a node and use the floating panel that appears to the right.
  • To select one or more notes, drag and drop across the map.
  • Right click the node to bring a contextual menu with options such as creating new nodes, focusing on a particular notes or creating links between them.
  • Use the buttons at the top-left to change the positioning of the nodes relative to the root node (to the left, to the right, or to both sides).
  • In the Floating buttons area:
    • An image reference can be copied, to paste the mind map in a text note.
    • The diagram can be exported either as SVG (vectorial) or PNG (raster).
    • The note can be toggled read-only.
  • 要在与当前节点相同级别创建新节点，请按 Enter，输入所需文本，然后再次按 Enter 确认。
  • 类似地，要创建子节点，请按 Tab，输入所需文本，然后按 Enter。
  • 要创建父节点，请改用 Ctrl+Enter。
  • 要移除节点，请按 Delete。
  • 要向上或向下移动节点，请按 Page Up 或 Page Down。
  • 要调整字号、文本或背景颜色或添加链接，请点击一个节点并使用右侧出现的浮动面板。
  • 要选择一个或多个笔记，请在地图上拖放。
  • 右键点击节点以显示上下文菜单，其中包含创建新节点、聚焦特定笔记或创建链接等选项。
  • 使用左上角的按钮更改节点相对于根节点的定位（左侧、右侧或两侧）。
  • 在浮动按钮（Floating buttons）区域中：
    • 可以复制图像引用（image reference），以将思维导图粘贴到文本笔记中。
    • 图表可以导出为 SVG（矢量）或 PNG（光栅）。
    • 笔记可以切换为只读（read-only）。

title: PDFs(PDF)
full:
（图片：PDF 查看器）

PDFs file can be uploaded in Trilium, where they will be displayed without the need to download them first. PDF 文件可以上传到 Trilium，它们将被显示而无需先下载。

Since v0.102.0, PDFs will be rendered using Trilium's built-in PDF viewer, which is a customization of Mozilla's PDF.js viewer (also built-in in the Mozilla Firefox browser). Versions prior to that render PDFs using the browser's default PDF viewer. 自 v0.102.0 起，PDF 将使用 Trilium 的内置 PDF 查看器渲染，它是 Mozilla 的 PDF.js 查看器的一个定制版本（也内置在 Mozilla Firefox 浏览器中）。此前的版本使用浏览器的默认 PDF 查看器渲染 PDF。

Features

功能

  • The last page viewed and scroll position is maintained in between restarts or note navigations.
  • Annotations (text, highlights) as well as comments. These are saved automatically.
  • Forms can be filled.
  • Can be printed or downloaded.
  • Can be saved as a template and the content of the PDF will be copied over to the new note. This is especially useful in combination with annotations or filled forms.
  • Integrates with the sidebar in the New Layout, by displaying the list of pages with thumbnails, table of contents and a listing of the annotations.
  • Basic support for signatures (the hand-drawn ones, not proper digital signatures), similar to annotations. Signatures are stored and can be reused across multiple documents (up to 5).
  • 最后查看的页面和滚动位置会在重启或笔记导航之间被保留。
  • 批注（文本、高亮）以及评论。这些会自动保存。
  • 可以填写表单。
  • 可以打印或下载。
  • 可以保存为模板（template），PDF 的内容将被复制到新笔记。这与批注或已填写的表单结合时尤其有用。
  • 与新布局（New Layout）中的侧边栏集成，显示带有缩略图的页面列表、目录和批注列表。
  • 对签名（手绘签名，而非真正的数字签名）的基本支持，与批注类似。签名会被存储并可在多个文档中重用（最多 5 个）。

Storing last position and settings

存储最后位置和设置

For every PDF, Trilium will remember the following information: 对于每个 PDF，Trilium 将记住以下信息：

  • The current page.
  • The scroll position, within the current page.
  • The rotation of the page.
  • 当前页面。
  • 当前页面内的滚动位置。
  • 页面的旋转。

This makes it useful when reading large documents since the position is remembered automatically. This happens in the background, however it's recorded only a few seconds after stopping any scroll actions. 这在阅读大型文档时很有用，因为位置会被自动记住。这发生在后台，但它只会在停止任何滚动操作几秒后记录。

Technically, the information about the scroll position and rotation is stored in the Attachments section, in a dedicated attachment called pdfHistory.json. 提示：从技术上讲，有关滚动位置和旋转的信息存储在附件（Attachments）部分中一个名为 pdfHistory.json 的专用附件中。

Annotations

批注

Since v0.102.0 it's possible to annotate PDFs. To do so, look for the annotation buttons on the right side of the PDF toolbar ( ). 自 v0.102.0 起可以对 PDF 进行批注。为此，请在 PDF 工具栏右侧寻找批注按钮（ ）。

Since v0.103.0: 自 v0.103.0 起：

  • Annotations are disabled if the note is marked as Read-Only Notes.
  • Comments can also be added, which is similar to highlights but also attach a text.
  • The Right Sidebar also displays a list of annotations (highlights, comments), but only in the New Layout.
  • 如果笔记被标记为只读笔记（Read-Only Notes），批注将被禁用。
  • 也可以添加评论，这与高亮类似但还附带文本。
  • 右侧边栏（Right Sidebar）也会显示批注列表（高亮、评论），但仅在新布局（New Layout）中。

Supported annotations

支持的批注

The following annotation methods are supported: 支持以下批注方法：

  • Highlight
    Allows highlighting text with one of the predefined colors.
    • The thickness is also adjustable.
    • It's also possible to highlight the blank space, turning the feature more into a thicker pen.
  • Text
    Allows adding arbitrary text, with a custom color and size.
  • Pen
    Allows free drawing on the document, with variable color, thickness and opacity.
  • Image
    Allows inserting images from outside Trilium directly into the document.
  • 高亮（Highlight） 允许使用预定义颜色之一高亮文本。
    • 粗细也是可调的。
    • 也可以高亮空白区域，将功能变成更像一支粗笔。
  • 文本（Text） 允许添加任意文本，带有自定义颜色和大小。
  • 画笔（Pen） 允许在文档上自由绘制，带有可变的颜色、粗细和不透明度。
  • 图像（Image） 允许将来自 Trilium 外部的图像直接插入文档。

Editing existing annotations

编辑现有批注

Although annotations are stored in the PDF itself, they can be edited. To edit an annotation, press one of the annotation buttons from the previous section to enter edit mode and click on an existing annotation. This will reveal a toolbar with options to customize the annotation (e.g. to change a color), as well as the possibility to remove it. 虽然批注存储在 PDF 本身中，但它们可以被编辑。要编辑批注，请按下上一节中的一个批注按钮进入编辑模式并点击现有批注。这将显示一个工具栏，其中包含自定义批注的选项（例如更改颜色），以及移除它的可能性。

How are annotations stored

批注如何存储

Annotations are stored directly in the PDF. When modifications are made, Trilium will replace the PDF with the new one. 批注直接存储在 PDF 中。当进行修改时，Trilium 会用新 PDF 替换旧 PDF。

Since modifications are automatically saved, there's no need to manually save the document after making modifications to the annotations. 由于修改会自动保存，因此在修改批注后无需手动保存文档。

The benefit of "baked-in annotations" is that they are also accessible if downloading (for external use outside Trilium) or sharing the note. “烘焙式批注（baked-in annotations）”的好处是，即使下载（用于 Trilium 外部使用）或分享笔记，它们也可访问。

The downside is that the entire PDF needs to be sent back to the server, which can slow down performance for larger documents. If you encounter any issues from this system, feel free to report it. 缺点是整个 PDF 需要被发送回服务器，对于较大的文档可能会降低性能。如果你遇到此系统的任何问题，请随时报告它。

Filling out forms

填写表单

Similar to annotations, forms are also supported by Trilium since v0.102.0. If the document has fields that can be filled-in, they will be indicated with a colored background. 与批注类似，Trilium 自 v0.102.0 起也支持表单。如果文档有可填写的字段，它们将以彩色背景标示。

Simply type text in the forms and they will be automatically saved. 只需在表单中输入文本，它们将被自动保存。

Sidebar navigation

侧边栏导航

This feature is only available if New Layout is enabled. If you are using the old layout, these features are still available by looking for a sidebar button in the PDF viewer toolbar. 注意：此功能仅在启用新布局（New Layout）时可用。如果你使用的是旧布局，这些功能仍可通过在 PDF 查看器工具栏中寻找侧边栏按钮来使用。

See the dedicated section on PDFs in Outline tab. 参见大纲标签页（Outline tab）中关于 PDF 的专门部分。

Share functionality

分享功能

PDFs can also be shared using the Sharing feature. This will also use Trilium's customized PDF viewer. PDF 也可以使用分享（Sharing）功能分享。这也会使用 Trilium 定制的 PDF 查看器。

If you are using a reverse proxy on your server with strict access limitations for the share functionality, make sure that the [host].com/pdfjs directory is accessible. Note that this directory is outside the /share route as it's common with the rest of the application. 如果你在服务器上使用带有严格访问限制的反向代理来使用分享功能，请确保 [host].com/pdfjs 目录可访问。请注意，此目录在 /share 路由之外，这与应用程序的其余部分一致。

title: Audio & Video(音频与视频)
full:
（图片：媒体播放器）

Starting with v0.103.0, Trilium has a custom media player for both video and audio files, which offers more features than the built-in player. 从 v0.103.0 开始，Trilium 为视频和音频文件配备了一个自定义媒体播放器，它提供比内置播放器更多的功能。

Versions prior to v0.103.0 also support media, but using the built-in player. v0.103.0 之前的版本也支持媒体，但使用内置播放器。

The file is streamed directly, so when accessing the note from a server it doesn't have to download the entire file to start playing it. 文件被直接流式传输，因此从服务器访问笔记时，不必下载整个文件即可开始播放。

Note on large media files

关于大型媒体文件的说明

Although Trilium offers support for media files, it is generally not meant to be used with very large files. Uploading large media will cause the Database to balloon, as well as any Backup of it. In addition, there might be slowdowns when first uploading the files. Otherwise, a large database should not impact the general performance of Trilium significantly. 虽然 Trilium 提供对媒体文件的支持，但它通常不适用于非常大的文件。上传大型媒体会导致数据库（Database）膨胀，以及它的任何备份（Backup）。此外，首次上传文件时可能会有变慢。除此之外，大型数据库不应显著影响 Trilium 的整体性能。

Supported formats

支持的格式

Trilium uses the built-in media decoding mechanism of the browser (or Electron/Chromium when running on the desktop). Starting with v0.103.0, a message will be displayed instead when a media format is not supported. Trilium 使用浏览器内置的媒体解码机制（在桌面上运行时为 Electron/Chromium）。从 v0.103.0 开始，当媒体格式不受支持时会显示一条消息。

Interactions

交互

To play/pause, simply click anywhere on the media. For video files, the controls at the bottom will hide automatically after playing, simply move the mouse to show them again. 要播放/暂停，只需点击媒体上的任意位置。对于视频文件，底部的控件会在播放后自动隐藏，只需移动鼠标即可再次显示它们。

The bottom bar has the following features: 底部栏具有以下功能：
