  • A track bar to seek across the media. Audio files up to 60 MB will display a waveform seekbar, to give a visual overview of the track's structure: silences, pauses, and louder segments.
  • On the left of the track bar, the current time is indicated.
  • On the right of the track bar, the remaining time is indicated.
  • On the left side there are buttons to:
    • Adjust the playback speed (e.g. 0.5x, 1x).
    • Play mode (applies to all media from the parent note):
      • Play once — play the media until it ends, then stop.
      • Loop — replay the media automatically once it ends.
      • Play next — when the current item ends, continue with the next one in the same parent note until the last item finishes.
    • Rotate the video by 90 degrees (video only).
  • In the center:
    • Previous media — jumps to the previous media: the nearest media note above the current one in the tree (within the same parent note) in the case of media notes, or the previous media attachment.
    • Go back by 10s
    • Play/pause
    • Go forward by 10s
    • Next media — jumps to the next media: the nearest media note below the current one in the tree (within the same parent note) in the case of media notes, or the next media attachment.
  • On the right side:
    • Mute button
    • Volume adjustment
    • Full screen (video only)
    • Zoom to fill, which will crop the video so that it fills the entire window (video only).
    • Picture-in-picture, if the browser supports it (video only).
  • 一个用于在媒体中快进/快退的轨道栏。最多 60 MB 的音频文件将显示波形进度条，以直观地概览轨道的结构：静音、暂停和较响亮的片段。
  • 轨道栏左侧显示当前时间。
  • 轨道栏右侧显示剩余时间。
  • 左侧有按钮用于：
    • 调整播放速度（例如 0.5x、1x）。
    • 播放模式（适用于父笔记中的所有媒体）：
      • 播放一次（Play once）— 播放媒体直到结束，然后停止。
      • 循环（Loop）— 媒体结束后自动重播。
      • 播放下一个（Play next）— 当前项目结束后，在同一个父笔记中继续下一个，直到最后一个项目完成。
    • 将视频旋转 90 度（仅视频）。
  • 中间：
    • 上一个媒体（Previous media）— 跳转到上一个媒体：对于媒体笔记，是树中当前笔记上方最近的一个媒体笔记（在同一父笔记内）；否则是上一个媒体附件。
    • 后退 10 秒
    • 播放/暂停
    • 前进 10 秒
    • 下一个媒体（Next media）— 跳转到下一个媒体：对于媒体笔记，是树中当前笔记下方最近的一个媒体笔记（在同一父笔记内）；否则是下一个媒体附件。
  • 右侧：
    • 静音按钮
    • 音量调整
    • 全屏（仅视频）
    • 缩放填充（Zoom to fill），将裁剪视频使其填满整个窗口（仅视频）。
    • 画中画（Picture-in-picture），如果浏览器支持（仅视频）。

Including media in notes

在笔记中包含媒体

（图片：音频笔记包含，配置为“小（Small）”大小）

Text and Markdown notes can embed an interactive media player directly in the note content. To do so, include the audio or video file: 文本（Text）和Markdown笔记可以直接在笔记内容中嵌入交互式媒体播放器。为此，请包含音频或视频文件：

  • Text notes: in the formatting toolbar, click "Insert" → "Include".
  • Markdown notes: type /include press Enter.
  • **文本笔记：**在格式化工具栏中，点击“插入（Insert）” → “包含（Include）”。
  • **Markdown 笔记：**输入 /include 并按 Enter。

Then select the audio/video file note to be included. 然后选择要包含的音频/视频文件笔记。

Keyboard shortcuts

键盘快捷键

The following keyboard shortcuts are supported by the media player: 媒体播放器支持以下键盘快捷键：

title: Spreadsheets(电子表格)
full:
（图片：电子表格示例）

Spreadsheets are a new type of note introduced in v0.103.0 and are currently considered experimental/beta. As such, expect major changes to occur to this note type. 重要：电子表格（Spreadsheets）是在 v0.103.0 中引入的新笔记类型，目前被视为实验性/测试版。因此，预期此笔记类型会发生重大变化。

Spreadsheets provide a familiar experience to Microsoft Excel or LibreOffice Calc, with support for formulas, data validation and text formatting. 电子表格提供类似于 Microsoft Excel 或 LibreOffice Calc 的熟悉体验，支持公式、数据验证和文本格式化。

Spreadsheets vs. collections

电子表格与集合

There is a slight overlap between spreadsheets and the Table collection. In general the table collection is useful to track meta-information about notes (for example a collection of people and their birthdays), whereas spreadsheets are quite useful for calculations since they support formulas. 电子表格与表格（Table）集合之间存在轻微重叠。一般来说，表格集合适用于跟踪关于笔记的元信息（例如一个人的集合及其生日），而电子表格由于支持公式，非常适用于计算。

Spreadsheets also benefit from a wider range of features such as data validation, formatting and can work on a relatively large dataset. 电子表格还受益于更广泛的功能，例如数据验证、格式化，并且可以在相对较大的数据集上工作。

Data interoperability (import/export)

数据互操作性（导入/导出）

Starting with v0.104.0, Trilium provides a level of data interoperability between the internal format (Univer) and the following formats: 从 v0.104.0 开始，Trilium 在内部格式（Univer）和以下格式之间提供一定级别的数据互操作性：

  • Microsoft Excel (.xlsx)
    • Preserves basic formatting (fonts, sizes, borders, backgrounds).
    • Formulas are preserved, but not that not all Excel functions are supported and vice-versa with Univer.
    • Images (cell-bound or floating), without preserving rotation.
    • Supports multi-sheets natively.
  • Comma-Separated Values (.csv)
    • Since it's a text-based format, any formatting is lost.
    • Formulas are evaluated and turned into their final value instead.
    • Multi-sheet spreadsheets are exported as a single ZIP containing a CSV file per sheet.
  • Microsoft Excel（.xlsx）
    • 保留基本格式（字体、大小、边框、背景）。
    • 公式会被保留，但并非所有 Excel 函数都受支持，反之与 Univer 亦然。
    • 图像（单元格绑定或浮动），不保留旋转。
    • 原生支持多工作表。
  • 逗号分隔值（.csv）
    • 由于它是基于文本的格式，任何格式都会丢失。
    • 公式会被求值并转换为它们的最终值。
    • 多工作表电子表格会导出为单个 ZIP，其中每个工作表包含一个 CSV 文件。

Both import and export are supported, as follows: 导入和导出均受支持，如下所示：

  • To import a file, simply drag it into the Note Tree and it will be converted into a spreadsheet note.
    • To avoid this behavior (e.g. to import a .xlsx file as an actual File), uncheck the corresponding option in the Import dialog.
    • Multiple files can be imported at the same time, including a mix of .csv and .xlsx files. Folder structure can be preserved by using a .zip file.
  • Unlike importing, exporting is on a per-note basis:
    • In the Note buttons, choose the Export to Excel or Export to CSV options for the New Layout.
    • For the old layout, choose the corresponding buttons in the Floating buttons area.
    • If exported as a single file via Import & Export, the resulting file will be a custom .triliumsheet file that preserves the spreadsheet as-is.
      • The export is intentionally a different process than the normal Import & Export functionality because it does conversion to multiple formats with varying degrees of compatibility.
  • 要导入文件，只需将其拖入笔记树（Note Tree），它将被转换为电子表格笔记。
    • 要避免此行为（例如将 .xlsx 文件作为实际的文件（File）导入），请在导入对话框（Import dialog）中取消勾选相应选项。
    • 可以同时导入多个文件，包括 .csv 和 .xlsx 文件的混合。通过使用 .zip 文件可以保留文件夹结构。
  • 与导入不同，导出是按笔记进行的：
    • 在笔记按钮（Note buttons）中，为新布局（New Layout）选择_导出到 Excel（Export to Excel）_或_导出到 CSV（Export to CSV）_选项。
    • 对于旧布局，请在浮动按钮（Floating buttons）区域中选择相应的按钮。
    • 如果通过导入与导出（Import & Export）作为单个文件导出，生成的文件将是一个自定义的 .triliumsheet 文件，按原样保留电子表格。
      • 此导出故意是与常规导入与导出（Import & Export）功能不同的过程，因为它会以不同的兼容度转换为多种格式。

Import & export for both .xlsx and .csv files are supported on a best-effort basis. It does not support advanced features (data validation, scripting, etc.). If you notice a particular issue, it can be reported, however all bug reports must contain a sample file in order to be taken into consideration. 重要：对 .xlsx 和 .csv 文件的导入与导出以尽力而为的方式支持。它不支持高级功能（数据验证、脚本等）。如果你注意到特定问题，可以报告，但所有错误报告必须包含示例文件才会被考虑。

Supported features

支持的功能

The spreadsheet has support for the following features: 电子表格支持以下功能：

  • Since v0.104.0, images that can be either inside a cell or floating above.
    • The images are saved as Attachments for performance reasons.
    • The image upload respects the same compression settings as text Images.
  • Filtering
  • Sorting
  • Data validation
  • Conditional formatting
  • Notes / annotations
  • Find / replace
  • 自 v0.104.0 起，图像可以在单元格内或浮动在上方。
    • 出于性能原因，图像被保存为附件（Attachments）。
    • 图像上传遵循与文本图像（Images）相同的压缩设置。
  • 筛选（Filtering）
  • 排序（Sorting）
  • 数据验证（Data validation）
  • 条件格式化（Conditional formatting）
  • 注释/批注（Notes / annotations）
  • 查找/替换（Find / replace）

We might consider adding other features from Univer at some point. If there is a particular feature that can be added easily, it can be discussed over GitHub Issues. 我们可能会考虑在某个时候添加 Univer 的其他功能。如果有可以轻松添加的特定功能，可以在 GitHub Issues 上讨论。

Share functionality

分享功能

Spreadsheets can be shared, case in which a best-effort HTML rendering of the spreadsheet is done: 电子表格可以分享（shared），此时会进行电子表格的尽力而为 HTML 渲染：

  • Preserves basic formatting.
  • Cells with formulas display the precalculated value instead of the formula.
  • 保留基本格式。
  • 带有公式的单元格显示预计算值而不是公式。

Since v0.104.0: 自 v0.104.0 起：

  • Numbers and dates are properly formatted.
  • Images are shown inside a cell or floating above, including rotation.
  • 数字和日期被正确格式化。
  • 图像显示在单元格内或浮动在上方，包括旋转。

For more advanced use cases, this will most likely not work as intended. Feel free to report issues, but keep in mind that we might not be able to have a complete feature parity with all the features of Univer. 对于更高级的用例，这很可能不会按预期工作。请随时报告问题，但请记住，我们可能无法与 Univer 的所有功能完全保持一致。

Features not supported yet

尚不支持的功能

Regarding Pro features

关于 Pro 功能

Univer spreadsheets also feature a Pro plan which adds quite a lot of functionality such as charts, printing, pivot tables, export, etc. Univer 电子表格还有一个 Pro 计划（Pro plan），它增加了相当多的功能，例如图表、打印、数据透视表、导出等。

As the Pro plan requires a license, Trilium does not support any of the premium features. Theoretically, pro features can be used in trial mode with some limitations, we might explore this direction at some point. 由于 Pro 计划需要许可证，Trilium 不支持任何高级功能。从理论上讲，Pro 功能可以在试用模式下使用并有一些限制，我们可能会在某个时候探索这个方向。

Planned features

计划中的功能

There are a few features that are already planned but are not supported yet: 有一些已经计划但尚未支持的功能：

  • Trilium-specific formulas (e.g. to obtain the title of a note).
  • User-defined formulas
  • Cross-workbook calculation
  • Trilium 专属公式（例如获取笔记的标题）。
  • 用户自定义公式
  • 跨工作簿计算

If you would like us to work on these features, consider supporting us. 如果你希望我们开发这些功能，请考虑支持我们。

Mobile support

移动端支持

Versions prior to v0.104.0 have no dedicated mobile support, which means that the interaction is difficult without a mouse and keyboard. Starting with v0.104.0 we integrate Univer's mobile plugin, which introduces features such as drag to pan which makes the interface more usable on mobile. v0.104.0 之前的版本没有专门的移动端支持，这意味着没有鼠标和键盘时交互很困难。从 v0.104.0 开始，我们集成了 Univer 的移动插件，它引入了诸如拖拽平移等功能，使界面在移动端上更可用。

title: Markdown(Markdown)
full:
Trilium has always supported Markdown through its import feature, however the file was either transformed to a Text note (converted to Trilium's internal HTML format) or saved as a Code note with only syntax highlighting. Trilium 一直通过其导入功能（import feature）支持 Markdown，但文件要么被转换为文本（Text）笔记（转换为 Trilium 的内部 HTML 格式），要么被保存为仅带语法高亮的代码（Code）笔记。

This note type is a split view, meaning that both the source code and a preview of the document are displayed side-by-side. See Note types with split view for more information. 这种笔记类型是分屏视图，意味着源代码和文档预览并排显示。更多信息参见具有分屏视图的笔记类型（Note types with split view）。

Rationale

设计理念

The goal of this note type is to fill a gap: rendering Markdown but not altering its structure or its whitespace which would inevitably change otherwise through import/export. 这种笔记类型的目标是填补一个空白：渲染 Markdown 但不改变其结构或其空白，否则通过导入/导出这些必然会发生变化。

Even if Markdown is now specially treated by having a preview mechanism, Trilium remains at its core a WYSIWYG editor so Markdown will not replace text notes. 即使 Markdown 现在通过预览机制被特殊对待，Trilium 在核心上仍然是一个 WYSIWYG（所见即所得）编辑器，因此 Markdown 不会取代文本笔记。

Feature requests regarding the Markdown implementation will be considered, but if they are outside the realm of Trilium, they will not be implemented. One of the core aspects of the Markdown integration is that it reuses components that are already available through other features of the application. 注意：关于 Markdown 实现的功能请求会被考虑，但如果它们超出 Trilium 的领域，则不会被实现。Markdown 集成的核心方面之一是它复用了通过应用程序其他功能已经可用的组件。

Features

功能

Source view pane

源代码视图面板

  • Syntax highlighting for the Markdown syntax.
  • Nested syntax highlighting for code inside code blocks.
  • When editing larger documents, the preview scrolls along with the source editor.
  • 对 Markdown 语法进行语法高亮。
  • 对代码块内的代码进行嵌套语法高亮。
  • 当编辑较大的文档时，预览会与源代码编辑器一起滚动。

Preview pane

预览面板

The following features are supported by Trilium's Markdown format and will show up in the preview pane: 以下功能受 Trilium 的 Markdown 格式支持，并会显示在预览面板中：

  • All standard and GitHub-flavored syntax (basic formatting, tables, blockquotes).

  • Basic HTML is also supported (e.g. collapsible blocks using <details> and <summary>).

  • Code blocks with syntax highlighting.

    • The language must be specified for syntax highlighting to be applied (e.g. ```js).
    • Code blocks will respect the text wrapping from the Text section in Options.

  • Block quotes & admonitions

  • Math Equations (both inline and block)

  • Mermaid Diagrams using ```mermaid

  • Include Note (no built-in Markdown syntax, but HTML syntax works just fine):

    <section class="include-note" data-note-id="vJDjQm0VK8Na" data-box-size="expandable">
     
</section>
    • These can also be quickly created via the /include command or via a dedicated keyboard shortcut (not assigned by default).

  • Internal (reference) links via its HTML syntax, or through a Wikilinks-like format (only Note ID):

    [[Hg8TS5ZOxti6]]

  • To-do lists with extended task states:

    - [ ] None
- [/] Doing
- [X] Done
- [?] Maybe
- [-] Cancelled

    Task states are customizable: you can reorder them, create new ones with different colors and symbols, or delete the ones you don't need. See Customizing to-do task states for more details.

    Note that to-do items with task states other than "None" and "Done" are Trilium-specific and may not work well with other Markdown software.

  • Footnotes are also supported via the corresponding Markdown syntax:

    This is [^1], while this is [^2].

[^1]: the first footnote
[^2]: the second footnote
    • These can also be quickly created using the /footnote command.

  • Page breaks for Printing & Exporting as PDF:

    <div class="page-break"></div>

  • Highlights (background color) are supported both via the == Markdown syntax, as well as the canonical HTML representation in Trilium:

    ==highlighted==
<span style="background-color:hsl(0,0%,100%);">Highlighted</span>

  • 所有标准和 GitHub 风格的语法（基本格式化、表格、块引用）。

  • 基本 HTML 也受支持（例如使用 <details> 和 <summary> 的可折叠块）。

  • 带语法高亮的代码块。

    • 必须指定语言才能应用语法高亮（例如 ```js）。
    • 代码块将遵循选项（Options）中文本（Text）部分的文本换行设置。

  • 块引用与提示框（Block quotes & admonitions）

  • 数学公式（Math Equations）（行内和块级）

  • 使用 ```mermaid 的Mermaid 图表（Mermaid Diagrams）

  • 包含笔记（Include Note）（没有内置的 Markdown 语法，但 HTML 语法也很好用）：

    <section class="include-note" data-note-id="vJDjQm0VK8Na" data-box-size="expandable">
     
</section>
    • 也可以通过 /include 命令或专用键盘快捷键（默认未分配）快速创建。

  • 通过其 HTML 语法或类似_维基链接（Wikilinks）_的格式（仅笔记 ID（Note ID））的内部（引用）链接（Internal (reference) links）：

    [[Hg8TS5ZOxti6]]

  • 带有扩展任务状态的待办列表：

    - [ ] None
- [/] Doing
- [X] Done
- [?] Maybe
- [-] Cancelled

    任务状态是可自定义的：你可以重新排序它们，创建带有不同颜色和符号的新状态，或删除不需要的状态。更多详情请参见自定义待办任务状态（Customizing to-do task states）。

    请注意，带有除“None”和“Done”之外任务状态的待办项是 Trilium 特有的，可能无法与其他 Markdown 软件很好地配合。

  • 也通过相应的 Markdown 语法支持脚注（Footnotes）：

    This is [^1], while this is [^2].

[^1]: the first footnote
[^2]: the second footnote
    • 也可以使用 /footnote 命令快速创建。

  • 用于打印与导出为 PDF（Printing & Exporting as PDF）的分页符：

    <div class="page-break"></div>

  • 高亮（背景颜色）既通过 == Markdown 语法支持，也通过 Trilium 中的规范 HTML 表示支持：

    ==highlighted==
<span style="background-color:hsl(0,0%,100%);">Highlighted</span>

Links

链接

Multiple types of links are supported: 支持多种类型的链接：

  • Web URLs can be written with the standard Markdown syntax:

    [Wikipedia](https://www.wikipedia.org)

  • Reference link to other notes with dynamic title, either by manually entering the note ID or via the Add link dialog:

    [[B9oMG6rFvvfq]]

  • Reference link to other notes with a custom text:

    [This is a link](#root/LhtnZxtVsUMp)

  • 可以使用标准 Markdown 语法编写网页 URL：

    [Wikipedia](https://www.wikipedia.org)

  • 使用动态标题到其他笔记的引用链接（Reference link），可以通过手动输入笔记 ID 或通过_添加链接（Add link）_对话框：

    [[B9oMG6rFvvfq]]

  • 使用自定义文本到其他笔记的引用链接（Reference link）：

    [This is a link](#root/LhtnZxtVsUMp)

To create a link, either: 要创建链接，可以：

  • Type it manually using the syntax described above.
  • Use the Add link dialog by pressing Ctrl+L or typing the /link command.
  • 使用上述语法手动输入。
  • 通过按 Ctrl+L 或输入 /link 命令使用_添加链接（Add link）_对话框。

Link Previews are also rendered, but there is no mechanism to insert them automatically as of now, they have to be copied from a Text note instead. 链接预览（Link Previews）也会被渲染，但目前没有自动插入它们的机制，它们必须从文本（Text）笔记中复制。

Keyboard shortcuts

键盘快捷键

The Markdown notes share some of the keyboard shortcuts from Text notes: Markdown 笔记共享来自文本（Text）笔记的一些键盘快捷键：

  • Cut to note (Crtl+X) which cuts the selection into a new child note.
  • Add link (Crtl+L) which shows the dialog to create external or reference links.
  • Insert date/time (Alt+T) which respects the same formatting as text notes.
  • Include note (not assigned by default), which triggers the same dialog to insert notes as the one for text notes.
  • 剪切到笔记（Cut to note）（Crtl+X）将选择内容剪切到一个新的子笔记。
  • 添加链接（Add link）（Crtl+L）显示创建外部或引用链接的对话框。
  • 插入日期/时间（Insert date/time）（Alt+T）遵循与文本笔记相同的格式。
  • 包含笔记（Include note）（默认未分配）触发与文本笔记相同的插入笔记对话框。

In addition, the following formatting keyboard shortcuts are available: 此外，以下格式化键盘快捷键可用：

  • Ctrl+B to toggle bold.
  • Ctrl+I to toggle italic.
  • Ctrl+M to wrap the current selection in an inline math ($).
  • Ctrl+Shift+X to toggle strikethrough.
  • Ctrl+B 切换粗体。
  • Ctrl+I 切换_斜体_。
  • Ctrl+M 将当前选择包装在行内数学公式（$）中。
  • Ctrl+Shift+X 切换删除线。

Images & attachments

图像与附件

Images can be inserted into the document in four different methods: 图像可以通过四种不同的方法插入到文档中：

  • Drag & drop directly into the editor area.
  • Pasting an image from clipboard.
  • Pasting a reference to another attachment (e.g. Copy reference to clipboard button).
  • Use the /image slash command.
  • 直接拖放到编辑器区域。
  • 从剪贴板粘贴图像。
  • 粘贴对另一个附件（attachment）的引用（例如_复制引用到剪贴板（Copy reference to clipboard）_按钮）。
  • 使用 /image 斜杠命令。

An image reference to an attachment looks like this: 指向附件的图像引用如下所示：

![Name.jpeg](api/attachments/z50RceuHXe9J/image/image)

Auto-completion

自动补全

Slash commands

斜杠命令

Just like Text notes, Markdown notes support a selection of slash commands: 与文本（Text）笔记一样，Markdown 笔记支持一系列斜杠命令：

  • Inserting the current date & time (/date).
  • Including another note (/include).
  • Uploading and inserting an image (/image).
  • Inserting a note link (/link).
  • Inserting a math equation block (/math).
  • Inserting a footnote (/footnote).
  • Inserting a Mermaid diagram (/mermaid), with one variant per sample template (e.g. /mermaid:flowchart).
  • Inserting a collapsible block (/collapsible).
  • Inserting a page break for printing (/page-break).
  • Inserting a table (/table).
  • Creating admonitions (e.g. /tip, /note, /important, /caution, /warning).
  • Inserting task items (/todo:<state>, e.g. /todo:done), one per configured task state.
  • Inserting code snippets (/snippet:<name>) from your Markdown/plain-text snippet notes.
  • 插入当前日期和时间（/date）。
  • 包含（Including）另一个笔记（/include）。
  • 上传并插入图像（/image）。
  • 插入笔记链接（/link）。
  • 插入数学公式块（/math）。
  • 插入脚注（footnote）（/footnote）。
  • 插入Mermaid图表（/mermaid），每个示例模板有一个变体（例如 /mermaid:flowchart）。
  • 插入可折叠块（/collapsible）。
  • 插入用于打印的分页符（/page-break）。
  • 插入表格（/table）。
  • 创建提示框（例如 /tip、/note、/important、/caution、/warning）。
  • 插入任务项（/todo:<state>，例如 /todo:done），每个已配置的任务状态对应一个。
  • 从你的 Markdown/纯文本片段笔记中插入代码片段（/snippet:<name>）。

Note that slash commands only work outside of code blocks and inline code. 请注意，斜杠命令只在代码块和行内代码之外起作用。

Code block language auto-completion

代码块语言自动补全

Starting with v0.104.0, typing ``` to insert a code block will automatically open a list of suggested language types which have syntax highlighting. 从 v0.104.0 开始，输入 ``` 插入代码块将自动打开一个具有语法高亮的建议语言类型列表。

The list of languages matches the one for Code notes set in Options, it's not the full list of languages supported by Trilium. 语言列表与选项（Options）中设置的代码（Code）笔记语言列表一致，它不是 Trilium 支持的完整语言列表。

Other features

其他功能

  • The Table of contents will be displayed in the Right Sidebar based on the Markdown-level headings.
    • This feature is available only on the New Layout.
  • 目录（Table of contents）将根据 Markdown 级别的标题显示在右侧边栏（Right Sidebar）中。
    • 此功能仅在新布局（New Layout）上可用。

Shared notes

分享笔记

When a Markdown note is shared publicly, it will be rendered with extended formatting just like Text notes. 当 Markdown 笔记被公开分享（shared publicly）时，它将像文本（Text）笔记一样以扩展格式渲染。

Most of the features described previously should be supported. If you face any issues, feel free to report it alongside a sample Markdown file. 之前描述的大多数功能应该受支持。如果你遇到任何问题，请随时连同示例 Markdown 文件一起报告它。

Creating Markdown notes

创建 Markdown 笔记

There are two ways to create a Markdown note: 有两种创建 Markdown 笔记的方法：

  1. Create a new note (e.g. in the Note Tree) and select the type Markdown, just like all the other note types.
  2. Create a note of type Code and select as the language either Markdown or GitHub-Flavored Markdown. This maintains compatibility with your existing notes prior to the introduction of this feature.
  3. 创建一个新笔记（例如在笔记树（Note Tree）中）并选择类型_Markdown_，就像所有其他笔记类型一样。
  4. 创建一个类型为代码（Code）的笔记，并选择语言为_Markdown_或_GitHub-Flavored Markdown_。这会保持与在此功能引入之前你现有笔记的兼容性。

There is no distinction between the new Markdown note type and code notes of type Markdown; internally both are represented as Code notes with one of the following MIME types: 注意：新的 Markdown 笔记类型与 Markdown 类型的代码笔记之间没有区别；在内部，两者都被表示为具有以下 MIME 类型之一的代码（Code）笔记：

  • text/markdown
  • text/x-markdown
  • text/x-gfm (GitHub Flavored Markdown)
  • text/markdown
  • text/x-markdown
  • text/x-gfm（GitHub 风格 Markdown）

Import/export

导入/导出

Import

导入

By default, when importing a single Markdown file it automatically gets converted to a Text note. To avoid that and have it imported as a Markdown note instead: 默认情况下，导入单个 Markdown 文件时，它会自动被转换为文本（Text）笔记。要避免这种情况并将其作为 Markdown 笔记导入：

  • Right click the Note Tree and select Import into note.
  • Select the file normally.
  • Uncheck Import HTML, Markdown and TXT as text notes if it's unclear from the metadata.
  • 右键点击笔记树（Note Tree）并选择_导入到笔记（Import into note）_。
  • 正常选择文件。
  • 如果从元数据中不清楚，请取消勾选_将 HTML、Markdown 和 TXT 作为文本笔记导入（Import HTML, Markdown and TXT as text notes）_。

When importing a Trilium ZIP, it will preserve the Markdown type without converting to text notes thanks to the meta-information in it. 当导入 Trilium ZIP 时，它会保留 Markdown 类型而不转换为文本笔记，这要归功于其中的元信息。

Exporting

导出

When exporting Markdown files, the extension is preserved and the content remains the same as in the source view (with some small exceptions such as handling of attachments). 导出 Markdown 文件时，扩展名会被保留，内容与源代码视图中的保持一致（除了一些小的例外，例如附件的处理）。

When exporting Markdown files as ZIP, choosing HTML or Markdown as the export format makes no difference as that only affects Text notes. 当将 Markdown 文件导出为 ZIP 时，选择 HTML 或 Markdown 作为导出格式没有区别，因为这只会影响文本（Text）笔记。

If the Markdown note contains attachments, a ZIP export will rewrite the links to attachments so that they are replaced with a relative path to the attachment. On import, the links are re-written back. 如果 Markdown 笔记包含附件，ZIP 导出将重写指向附件的链接，使它们被替换为指向附件的相对路径。在导入时，链接会被重新写回。

Conversion between text notes and Markdown notes

文本笔记与 Markdown 笔记之间的转换

Text notes can be converted into Markdown notes and vice versa. See Converting between note types. 文本（Text）笔记可以转换为 Markdown 笔记，反之亦然。参见在笔记类型之间转换（Converting between note types）。

Sync-scrolling & block highlight

同步滚动与块高亮

When scrolling through the editing pane, the preview pane will attempt to synchronize its position to make it easier to see the preview. 当滚动编辑面板时，预览面板将尝试同步其位置，以便更容易看到预览。

In addition, the block in the preview matching the position of the cursor in the source view will appear slightly highlighted. 此外，预览中与源代码视图中光标位置匹配的块会轻微高亮显示。

The sync is currently one-way only, scrolling the preview will not synchronize the position of the editor. 同步目前只是单向的，滚动预览不会同步编辑器的位置。

This feature cannot be disabled as of now; if the scrolling feels distracting, consider temporarily switching to the editor mode and then switching to preview mode when ready. 此功能目前无法禁用；如果滚动感觉分散注意力，请考虑暂时切换到编辑器模式，然后在准备好时切换到预览模式。

This feature of synchronizing the scroll is based on blocks but it's provided on a best-effort basis since our underlying Markdown library doesn't support this feature natively, so we had to implement our own algorithm. Feel free to report issues, but always provide a sample Markdown file to be able to reproduce it. 注意：这种同步滚动的功能基于块，但以尽力而为的方式提供，因为我们底层的 Markdown 库不原生支持此功能，所以我们必须实现自己的算法。请随时报告问题，但始终提供示例 Markdown 文件以便能够复现。

title: Calendar(日历)
full:
（图片：日历视图示例）

The Calendar view will display each child note in a calendar that has a start date and optionally an end date, as an event. 日历（Calendar）视图将把每个子笔记显示为日历中的一个事件，该事件具有开始日期，可选地具有结束日期。

The Calendar view has multiple display modes: 日历视图有多种显示模式：

  • Month view, where the entire month is displayed and all-day events can be inserted. Both time-specific events and all-day events are listed.
  • Week view, where all the 7 days of the week (or 5 if the weekends are hidden) are displayed in columns. This mode allows entering and displaying time-specific events, not just all-day events.
  • Day view, which views only a single day. Especially useful for heavy agendas or mobile views.
  • List view, which displays all the events of a given month in sequence.
  • Year view, which displays the entire year for quick reference.
  • 月视图（Month view），显示整个月份，可以插入全天事件。时间特定事件和全天事件都会被列出。
  • 周视图（Week view），以列显示一周的 7 天（如果隐藏周末则为 5 天）。此模式允许输入和显示时间特定事件，而不仅仅是全天事件。
  • 日视图（Day view），只查看单一天。特别适用于密集的日程或移动端视图。
  • 列表视图（List view），按顺序显示给定月份的所有事件。
  • 年视图（Year view），显示整年以供快速参考。

Unlike other Collection view types, the Calendar view also allows some kind of interaction, such as moving events around as well as creating new ones. 与其他集合视图类型不同，日历视图也允许某种交互，例如移动事件以及创建新事件。

Creating a calendar

创建日历

Right click on an existing note in the Note Tree and select Insert child note and look for Calendar. 在笔记树（Note Tree）中右键单击现有笔记，选择_插入子笔记（Insert child note）并查找_日历（Calendar）。

Creating a new event/note

创建新事件/笔记

To create a new event: 要创建新事件：

  • First, click the desired day (month & year views) or the desired timeslot (day view).
  • Alternatively, drag across multiple days (or time slots) to set both the start and end date.
  • 首先，点击所需的天（月视图和年视图）或所需的时间段（日视图）。
  • 或者，跨多个天（或时间段）拖拽以同时设置开始和结束日期。

In either cases, a small popup will show with a prompt for a title and the date & time of the event that will be created. 无论哪种情况，都会显示一个小弹出窗口，提示输入标题以及将要创建的事件的日期和时间。

At this point, the event hasn't been created yet to protect against accidental clicks. Add a title optionally and press the Create button. If no title is provided, the event will follow the Default Note Title rules. 此时，事件尚未创建，以防止意外点击。可选地添加标题并按_创建（Create）_按钮。如果未提供标题，事件将遵循默认笔记标题（Default Note Title）规则。

After creating the event, it will show up on the calendar. To edit the content of the event (including recurrence), click on it to bring it into the popup view. 创建事件后，它将显示在日历上。要编辑事件的内容（包括重复），请点击它以将其带入弹出窗口视图。

Creating new notes from the calendar will respect the ~child:template relation if set on the Collection note. 注意：从日历创建新笔记时，如果集合笔记上设置了 ~child:template 关系，将遵循该关系。

Interacting with events

与事件交互

  • Hovering the mouse over an event will display information about the note.
  • Left clicking the event will open a dedicated popup to quickly configure the event or edit its note content.
  • Right click will offer more options including opening the note in a new split or window.
  • Drag and drop an event on the calendar to move it to another day.
  • The length of an event can be changed by placing the mouse to the right edge of the event and dragging the mouse around.
  • 将鼠标悬停在事件上会显示有关该笔记的信息。
    （图片：悬停事件）
  • 左键单击事件将打开一个专门的弹出窗口，用于快速配置事件或编辑其笔记内容。
  • 右键单击将提供更多选项，包括在新分屏或窗口中打开笔记。
  • 在日历上拖放事件以将其移动到另一天。
  • 可以通过将鼠标放在事件的右边缘并拖动鼠标来更改事件的长度。

Popup view

弹出窗口视图

When an event is clicked, a popup will show near the event which contains the following information: 当点击事件时，事件附近将显示一个弹出窗口，其中包含以下信息：

  • The title and icon of the event, both editable.
  • Buttons to interact with the event:
    • Open the event in the same pane, new tab, etc.
    • Color picker to change the color of the event.
    • Button to remove the event from the calendar, which can optionally delete its corresponding note.
  • Calendar-specific features:
    • A toggle for all-day events.
    • A start/end date & time selector.
    • A full recurrence editor, to have the same event show up weekly, monthly, etc.
  • The Promoted Attributes of the marker, if any.
  • The note's content which can be edited directly from the panel.
  • 事件的标题和图标，均可编辑。
  • 与事件交互的按钮：
    • 在同一窗格、新标签页等中打开事件。
    • 用于更改事件颜色的颜色选择器。
    • 从日历中移除事件的按钮，可以选择删除其对应的笔记。
  • 日历特定的功能：
    • 全天事件的切换开关。
    • 开始/结束日期和时间选择器。
    • 完整的重复编辑器，使同一事件每周、每月等显示。
  • 标记的提升属性（Promoted Attributes）（如果有）。
  • 可以直接从面板编辑的笔记内容。

To dismiss the popup: 要关闭弹出窗口：

  • Press the X button at the top-right of the popup.
  • In the calendar, press anywhere outside the popup.
  • Or simply press the Esc key.
  • 按弹出窗口右上角的 X 按钮。
  • 在日历中，按弹出窗口外部的任意位置。
  • 或者直接按 Esc 键。

It is possible to switch between events by clicking on them even when the popup view is already open. 即使在弹出窗口视图已经打开的情况下，也可以通过点击事件在事件之间切换。

Events can have Internal (reference) links between them and clicking on such a link will automatically navigate the calendar to the right date and the popup view to the new note. 事件之间可以有内部（引用）链接（Internal (reference) links），点击此类链接将自动将日历导航到正确的日期，并将弹出窗口视图导航到新笔记。

Interaction on mobile

移动端交互

When Trilium is on mobile, the interaction with the calendar is slightly different: 当 Trilium 在移动端时，与日历的交互略有不同：

  • Clicking on an event displays the popup view, which allows editing the event.
  • Long-pressing an event triggers the contextual menu, including the option to open in Quick edit.
  • To insert a new event, touch and hold the empty space. When successful, the empty space will become colored to indicate the selection.
    • Before releasing, drag across multiple spaces to create multi-day events.
    • When released, a prompt will appear to enter the note title.
  • To move an existing event, touch and hold the event until the empty space near it will become colored.
    • At this point the event can be dragged across other days on the calendar.
    • Or the event can be resized by tapping on the small circle to the right end of the event.
    • To exit out of editing mode, simply tap the empty space anywhere on the calendar.
  • 点击事件会显示弹出窗口视图，允许编辑事件。
  • 长按事件会触发上下文菜单，包括在快速编辑（Quick edit）中打开的选项。
  • 要插入新事件，请触摸并按住空白区域。成功后，空白区域将变色以指示选择。
    • 在释放之前，跨多个区域拖动以创建多天事件。
    • 释放后，将出现一个提示以输入笔记标题。
  • 要移动现有事件，请触摸并按住事件，直到它附近的空白区域变色。
    • 此时事件可以在日历上的其他天之间拖动。
    • 或者可以通过点击事件右端的小圆来调整事件大小。
    • 要退出编辑模式，只需点击日历上任意位置的空白区域。

Configuring the calendar view

配置日历视图

In the Collections tab in the Ribbon, it's possible to adjust the following: 在功能区（Ribbon）的_集合（Collections）_选项卡中，可以调整以下内容：

  • Hide weekends from the week view.
  • Display week numbers on the calendar.
  • Set the slot duration (the length of each time row in day/week view).
  • Set the slot label interval (how often time labels appear on the axis in day/week view).
  • 从周视图中隐藏周末。
  • 在日历上显示周数。
  • 设置时间段时长（日/周视图中每个时间行的长度）。
  • 设置时间段标签间隔（日/周视图中时间标签在轴上出现的频率）。

Configuring the calendar using attributes

使用属性配置日历

The following attributes can be added to the Collection type: 以下属性可以添加到集合类型：

Name / 名称 Description / 描述
#calendar:hideWeekends When present (regardless of value), it will hide Saturdays and Sundays from the calendar.
当存在时（无论值如何），将从日历中隐藏周六和周日。
#calendar:weekNumbers When present (regardless of value), it will show the number of the week on the calendar.
当存在时（无论值如何），将在日历上显示周的编号。
#calendar:initialDate Change the date the calendar opens on. When not present, the calendar opens on the current date.
更改日历打开的日期。当不存在时，日历在当前日期打开。
#calendar:view

Which view to display in the calendar:

  • timeGridDay for the day view;
  • timeGridWeek for the week view;
  • dayGridMonth for the month view;
  • multiMonthYear for the year view;
  • listMonth for the list view.

Any other value will be dismissed and the default view (month) will be used instead.

The value of this label is automatically updated when changing the view using the UI buttons.


在日历中显示哪个视图：

  • timeGridDay 用于日视图；
  • timeGridWeek 用于周视图；
  • dayGridMonth 用于月视图；
  • multiMonthYear 用于年视图；
  • listMonth 用于列表视图。

任何其他值将被忽略，并使用默认视图（月）代替。

使用 UI 按钮更改视图时，此标签的值会自动更新。
#calendar:slotDuration Sets how long each timeslot is on the calendar. Defaults to 00:15:00 (15 minutes). Must have the format "HH:MM:SS". For example, to create timeslots for every 10 minutes, you would set #calendar:slotDuration="00:10:00".
设置日历上每个时间段多长。默认为 00:15:00（15 分钟）。必须具有 “HH:MM:SS” 格式。例如，要为每 10 分钟创建时间段，你将设置 #calendar:slotDuration="00:10:00"。
#calendar:slotLabelInterval Sets how often the timeslots on the calendar should be labeled. Defaults to 01:00:00 (1 hour). Must have the format "HH:MM:SS". For example, to label timeslots every 30 minutes, you would set #calendar:slotLabelInterval="00:30:00".
设置日历上的时间段应多久标记一次。默认为 01:00:00（1 小时）。必须具有 “HH:MM:SS” 格式。例如，要每 30 分钟标记时间段，你将设置 #calendar:slotLabelInterval="00:30:00"。
~child:template Defines the template for newly created notes in the calendar (via dragging or clicking).
定义日历中新创建的笔记（通过拖动或点击）的模板。

In addition, the first day of the week can be either Sunday or Monday and can be adjusted from the application settings. 此外，一周的第一天可以是周日或周一，并且可以从应用程序设置中调整。

Configuring the calendar events using attributes

使用属性配置日历事件

For each note of the calendar, the following attributes can be used: 对于日历中的每个笔记，可以使用以下属性：

How the calendar works

日历如何工作

（图片：日历工作原理）

The calendar displays all the child notes of the Collection that have a #startDate. An #endDate can optionally be added. 日历显示集合中所有具有 #startDate 的子笔记。可以选择添加 #endDate。

The start date & end date can easily be edited from the calendar collection itself by clicking on the event. To edit the date while in the event note itself, the following attributes can be added to the Collection note: 开始日期和结束日期可以通过点击事件轻松地从日历集合本身编辑。要在事件笔记本身中编辑日期，可以将以下属性添加到集合笔记：

#viewType=calendar #label:startDate(inheritable)="promoted,alias=Start Date,single,date"
#label:endDate(inheritable)="promoted,alias=End Date,single,date"
#hidePromotedAttributes

This will result in: 这将导致：

（图片：提升日期属性的日历）

When not used in a Journal, the calendar is recursive. That is, it will look for events not just in its child notes but also in the children of these child notes. 当不在日志（Journal）中使用时，日历是递归的。也就是说，它不仅在子笔记中查找事件，还会在这些子笔记的子级中查找。

Recurrence

重复

The built in calendar view also supports repeating tasks (e.g. every week, every month as well as more complex recurrence rules). 内置的日历视图也支持重复任务（例如每周、每月以及更复杂的重复规则）。

Starting with v0.105.0, recurrence can be directly edited from the calendar by clicking on an event and then selecting the Repeats option. 从 v0.105.0 开始，可以通过点击事件然后选择_重复（Repeats）_选项，直接从日历编辑重复。

Custom recurrence using a subset of RRULE

使用 RRULE 子集的自定义重复

If the existing recurrence editor from the event popup is not sufficient, more complex rules can be manually set via the #recurrence label. 如果事件弹出窗口中的现有重复编辑器不够用，可以通过 #recurrence 标签手动设置更复杂的规则。

For example, to make a note repeat on the calendar: 例如，要使笔记在日历上重复：

  • Every Day - #recurrence="FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=1"
  • Every 3 days - #recurrence="FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=3"
  • Every week - #recurrence="FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=1"
  • Every 2 weeks on Monday, Wednesday and Friday - #recurrence="FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=MO,WE,FR"
  • Every 3 months - #recurrence="FREQ=MONTHLY;INTERVAL=3"
  • Every 2 months on the First Sunday - #recurrence="FREQ=MONTHLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=1SU"
  • Every month on the Last Friday - #recurrence="FREQ=MONTHLY;INTERVAL=1;BYDAY=-1FR"
  • 每天 - #recurrence="FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=1"
  • 每 3 天 - #recurrence="FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=3"
  • 每周 - #recurrence="FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=1"
  • 每 2 周的周一、周三和周五 - #recurrence="FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=MO,WE,FR"
  • 每 3 个月 - #recurrence="FREQ=MONTHLY;INTERVAL=3"
  • 每 2 个月的第一个周日 - #recurrence="FREQ=MONTHLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=1SU"
  • 每月最后一个周五 - #recurrence="FREQ=MONTHLY;INTERVAL=1;BYDAY=-1FR"

For other examples of valid RRULE strings see https://icalendar.org/rrule-tool.html 有关有效 RRULE 字符串的其他示例，请参阅 https://icalendar.org/rrule-tool.html

Note that the recurrence string does not include the DTSTART attribute as defined in the iCAL specifications. This is derived directly from the startDateand startTime attributes 请注意，重复字符串不包含 iCAL 规范中定义的 DTSTART 属性。它直接从 startDate 和 startTime 属性派生。

If you want to override the label the calendar uses to fetch the recurrence string, you can use the #calendar:recurrence attribute. For example, you can set #calendar:recurrence=taskRepeats. Then you can set your recurrence string like #taskRepeats="FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=1" 如果你想覆盖日历用于获取重复字符串的标签，可以使用 #calendar:recurrence 属性。例如，你可以设置 #calendar:recurrence=taskRepeats。然后你可以像这样设置你的重复字符串 #taskRepeats="FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=1"。

Also note that the recurrence label can be made promoted as with the start and end dates. 还要注意，重复标签可以像开始和结束日期一样被提升。

If the recurrence string is not valid, a toast will be shown with the note ID and title of the note with the erroneous recurrence message. This note will not be added to the calendar 警告：如果重复字符串无效，将显示一个提示，其中包含带有错误重复消息的笔记的笔记 ID 和标题。此笔记将不会添加到日历中。

Slot Duration & Slot Label Interval

时间段时长和时间段标签间隔

Trilium's calendar view is powered by FullCalendar, which gives you fine-grained control over how the time grid looks and behaves for day and week views. Two labels you can use to configure these views are #calendar:slotDuration and #calendar:slotLabelInterval. Understanding what each one does — and how they interact — lets you tailor the calendar to match your workflow, whether you're scheduling in 15-minute increments or planning out your day in broad hourly blocks. Trilium 的日历视图由 FullCalendar 提供支持，它使你可以对日视图和周视图的时间网格的外观和行为进行细粒度控制。可用于配置这些视图的两个标签是 #calendar:slotDuration 和 #calendar:slotLabelInterval。理解每个标签的作用——以及它们如何相互作用——可以让你定制日历以匹配你的工作流程，无论是按 15 分钟增量安排，还是以宽泛的小时块规划你的一天。

These settings can also be adjusted from the Collections tab in the Ribbon. 这些设置也可以从功能区（Ribbon）的_集合（Collections）_选项卡中调整。

Slot duration

时间段时长

Controls how tall each time slot is on the calendar — essentially the smallest unit of time the grid is divided into. A shorter duration means more rows and finer granularity; a longer one means fewer, chunkier rows. The default is one row every 15 minutes. 控制日历上每个时间段的高度——本质上就是网格被划分的最小时间单位。较短的时长意味着更多行和更精细的粒度；较长的时长意味着更少、更粗的行。默认是每 15 分钟一行。

Examples: 示例：

Label interval

标签间隔

Controls how often a time label appears on the left-hand axis. This is independent of the slot size — you can have very small slots but only label every hour to keep the axis readable. The default is a time label shown every hour. 控制左侧轴上时间标签出现的频率。这与时间段大小无关——你可以有非常小的时间段，但只每小时标记一次以保持轴可读。默认是每小时显示一个时间标签。

Examples: 示例：

Useful combinations

有用的组合

Format

格式

Both values use HH:mm:ss format. Hours can go up to 24 (24:00:00), while minutes and seconds must be between 00 and 59. The minimum meaningful duration is 1 minute (00:01:00). 两个值都使用 HH:mm:ss 格式。小时最多可达 24（24:00:00），而分钟和秒必须在 00 和 59 之间。最小有意义的时长是 1 分钟（00:01:00）。

Use-cases

用例

Using with the Journal / calendar

与日志/日历一起使用

It is possible to integrate the calendar view into the Journal with day notes. In order to do so change the note type of the Journal note (calendar root) to Collection and then select the Calendar View. 可以将日历视图集成到带有日笔记的日志中。要做到这一点，请将日志笔记（日历根）的笔记类型更改为集合（Collection），然后选择日历视图。

While in journal mode, the popup editor will not show dates, recurrence, colors or removal, since day notes aren't editable events. 在日志模式下，弹出窗口编辑器将不显示日期、重复、颜色或移除，因为日笔记不是可编辑的事件。

Based on the #calendarRoot (or #workspaceCalendarRoot) attribute, the calendar will know that it's in a calendar and apply the following: 基于 #calendarRoot（或 #workspaceCalendarRoot）属性，日历将知道它在一个日历中并应用以下内容：

  • The calendar events are now rendered based on their dateNote attribute rather than startDate.
  • Interactive editing such as dragging over an empty era or resizing an event is no longer possible.
  • Clicking on the empty space on a date will automatically open that day's note or create it if it does not exist.
  • Direct children of a day note will be displayed on the calendar despite not having a dateNote attribute. Children of the child notes will not be displayed.
  • 日历事件现在基于它们的 dateNote 属性而非 startDate 渲染。
  • 诸如在空白区域拖动或调整事件大小之类的交互式编辑不再可能。
  • 点击某个日期的空白区域将自动打开当天的笔记，如果不存在则创建它。
  • 日笔记的直接子级将显示在日历上，即使没有 dateNote 属性。子笔记的子级将不会显示。

（图片：与日志集成的日历）

Using a different attribute as event title

使用不同的属性作为事件标题

By default, events are displayed on the calendar by their note title. However, it is possible to configure a different attribute to be displayed instead. （图片：属性标题示例）默认情况下，事件以其笔记标题显示在日历上。然而，可以配置显示不同的属性。

To do so, assign #calendar:title to the child note (not the calendar/Collection note), with the value being namewhere name can be any label (make not to add the # prefix). The attribute can also come through inheritance such as a template attribute. If the note does not have the requested label, the title of the note will be used instead. 要做到这一点，将 #calendar:title 分配给子笔记（不是日历/集合笔记），值为 name，其中 name 可以是任何标签（注意不要添加 # 前缀）。该属性也可以通过继承（如模板属性）获得。如果笔记没有请求的标签，将使用笔记的标题代替。

#startDate=2025-02-11 #endDate=2025-02-13 #name="My vacation" #calendar:title="name"

Using a relation attribute as event title

使用关系属性作为事件标题

Similarly to using an attribute, use #calendar:title and set it to name where name is the name of the relation to use. （图片：关系标题示例）与使用属性类似，使用 #calendar:title 并将其设置为 name，其中 name 是要使用的关系的名称。

Moreover, if there are more relations of the same name, they will be displayed as multiple events coming from the same note. 此外，如果存在更多同名关系，它们将显示为来自同一笔记的多个事件。

#startDate=2025-02-14 #endDate=2025-02-15 ~for=@John Smith ~for=@Jane Doe #calendar:title="for"

Note that it's even possible to have a #calendar:title on the target note (e.g. "John Smith") which will try to render an attribute of it. Note that it's not possible to use a relation here as well for safety reasons (an accidental recursion of attributes could cause the application to loop infinitely). （图片：目标笔记标题）请注意，甚至可以在目标笔记（例如 “John Smith”）上设置 #calendar:title，它将尝试渲染该笔记的一个属性。注意，出于安全原因，这里也不能使用关系（属性的意外递归可能导致应用程序无限循环）。

#calendar:title="shortName" #shortName="John S."

title: Table(表格)
full:
（图片：表格视图示例）

The table view displays information in a grid, where the rows are individual notes and the columns are Promoted Attributes. In addition, values are editable. 表格视图以网格形式显示信息，其中行是单独的笔记，列是提升属性（Promoted Attributes）。此外，这些值是可编辑的。

How it works

工作原理

The tabular structure is represented as such: 表格结构表示如下：

  • Each child note is a row in the table.
  • If child rows also have children, they will be displayed under an expander (nested notes).
  • Each column is a promoted attribute that is defined on the Collection note.
    • Actually, both promoted and unpromoted attributes are supported, but it's a requirement to use a label/relation definition.
    • The promoted attributes are usually defined as inheritable in order to show up in the child notes, but it's not a requirement.
  • If there are multiple attribute definitions with the same name, only one will be displayed.
  • If an attribute definition has multiple values, they will all be grouped under a single column, with chips indicating individual values.
  • 每个子笔记是表格中的一行。
  • 如果子行也有子级，它们将显示在展开器下（嵌套笔记）。
  • 每个列是一个定义在集合笔记上的提升属性（promoted attribute）。
    • 实际上，提升和未提升的属性都受支持，但需要使用标签/关系定义。
    • 提升属性通常定义为可继承，以便在子笔记中显示，但这并非必须。
  • 如果有多个具有相同 name 的属性定义，只显示一个。
  • 如果一个属性定义有多个值，它们将全部归入单个列下，用标签（chips）表示各个值。

There are also a few predefined columns: 还有一些预定义的列：

  • The current item number, identified by the # symbol.
    • This simply counts the note and is affected by sorting.
  • Note ID, representing the unique ID used internally by Trilium
  • The title of the note.
  • 当前项目编号，由 # 符号标识。
    • 这只是对笔记进行计数，并受排序影响。
  • 笔记 ID（Note ID），表示 Trilium 内部使用的唯一 ID
  • 笔记的标题。

Interaction

交互

Creating a new table

创建新的表格

Right click on an existing note in the Note Tree and select Insert child note and look for Table. 在笔记树（Note Tree）中右键单击现有笔记，选择_插入子笔记（Insert child note）并查找_表格（Table）。

Adding columns

添加列

Each column is a promoted or unpromoted attribute that is defined on the Collection note. 每个列是定义在集合笔记上的一个提升或未提升属性（promoted or unpromoted attribute）。

To create a new column, either: 要创建新列，可以：

  • Press Add new column at the bottom of the table.
  • Right click on an existing column and select Add column to the left/right.
  • Right click on the empty space of the column header and select Label or Relation in the New column section.
  • 按表格底部的_添加新列（Add new column）_。
  • 右键单击现有列并选择向左/向右添加列（Add column to the left/right）。
  • 右键单击列标题的空白区域，在_新列（New column）_部分中选择_标签（Label）或_关系（Relation）。

Adding new rows

添加新行

Each row is actually a note that is a child of the Collection note. 每一行实际上是一个作为集合笔记子级的笔记。

To create a new note, either: 要创建新笔记，可以：

  • Press Add new row at the bottom of the table.
  • Right click on an existing row and select Insert row above, Insert child note or Insert row below.
  • 按表格底部的_添加新行（Add new row）_。
  • 右键单击现有行并选择_在上方插入行（Insert row above）_、_插入子笔记（Insert child note）或_在下方插入行（Insert row below）。

By default it will try to edit the title of the newly created note. 默认情况下，它会尝试编辑新建笔记的标题。

Alternatively, the note can be created from the Note Tree or scripting. 另外，可以从笔记树（Note Tree）或脚本（scripting）创建笔记。

Context menu

上下文菜单

There are multiple menus: 有多个菜单：

  • Right clicking on a column, allows:
    • Sorting by the selected column and resetting the sort.
    • Hiding the selected column or adjusting the visibility of every column.
    • Adding new columns to the left or the right of the column.
    • Editing the current column.
    • Deleting the current column.
  • Right clicking on the space to the right of the columns, allows:
    • Adjusting the visibility of every column.
    • Adding new columns.
  • Right clicking on a row, allows:
    • Opening the corresponding note of the row in a new tab, split, window or quick editing it.
    • Inserting a new note above or below the selected row. These options are only enabled if the table is not sorted.
    • Inserting a new child note for the selected row.
    • Deleting the row.
  • 右键单击列，允许：
    • 按所选列排序并重置排序。
    • 隐藏所选列或调整每一列的可见性。
    • 在列的左侧或右侧添加新列。
    • 编辑当前列。
    • 删除当前列。
  • 右键单击列右侧的空间，允许：
    • 调整每一列的可见性。
    • 添加新列。
  • 右键单击行，允许：
    • 在新标签页、分屏、窗口中打开该行对应的笔记，或快速编辑它。
    • 在所选行的上方或下方插入新笔记。这些选项仅在表格未排序时启用。
    • 为所选行插入新的子笔记。
    • 删除该行。

Editing data

编辑数据

Simply click on a cell within a row to change its value. The change will not only reflect in the table, but also as an attribute of the corresponding note. 只需点击行内的单元格即可更改其值。更改不仅会反映在表格中，还会作为相应笔记的属性。

  • The editing will respect the type of the promoted attribute, by presenting a normal text box, a number selector or a date selector for example.
  • It also possible to change the title of a note.
  • Editing relations is also possible
    • Simply click on a relation and it will become editable. Enter the text to look for a note and click on it.
    • To remove a relation, remove the title of the note from the text box and click outside the cell.
  • 编辑将遵循提升属性的类型，例如显示普通文本框、数字选择器或日期选择器。
  • 也可以更改笔记的标题。
  • 编辑关系也是可能的
    • 只需点击关系，它将变为可编辑。输入文本以查找笔记并点击它。
    • 要移除关系，请从文本框中移除笔记的标题并点击单元格外部。

Editing columns

编辑列

It is possible to edit a column by right clicking it and selecting Edit column. This will basically change the label/relation definition at the collection level. 可以通过右键单击列并选择_编辑列（Edit column）_来编辑它。这基本上会在集合级别更改标签/关系定义。

If the Name field of a column is changed, this will trigger a batch operation in which the corresponding label/relation will be renamed in all the children. 如果更改了列的_名称（Name）_字段，这将触发一个批量操作，其中相应的标签/关系将在所有子级中被重命名。

Working with the data

处理数据

Sorting by column

按列排序

By default, the order of the notes matches the order in the Note Tree. However, it is possible to sort the data by the values of a column: 默认情况下，笔记的顺序与笔记树（Note Tree）中的顺序一致。然而，可以按列的值对数据进行排序：

  • To do so, simply click on a column.
  • To switch between ascending or descending sort, simply click again on the same column. The arrow next to the column will indicate the direction of the sort.
  • To disable sorting and fall back to the original order, right click any column on the header and select Clear sorting.
  • 要做到这一点，只需点击一个列。
  • 要在升序或降序排序之间切换，只需再次点击同一列。列旁边的箭头将指示排序的方向。
  • 要禁用排序并回退到原始顺序，请右键单击标题上的任何列并选择_清除排序（Clear sorting）_。

Reordering and hiding columns

重新排序和隐藏列

  • Columns can be reordered by dragging the header of the columns.
  • Columns can be hidden or shown by right clicking on a column and clicking the item corresponding to the column.
  • 可以通过拖拽列的标题来重新排序列。
  • 可以通过右键单击列并点击与列对应的项目来隐藏或显示列。

Reordering rows

重新排序行

Notes can be dragged around to change their order. To do so, move the mouse over the three vertical dots near the number row and drag the mouse to the desired position. 笔记可以被拖拽以更改它们的顺序。要做到这一点，将鼠标移到编号行附近的三个垂直圆点上，并将鼠标拖到所需位置。

This will also change the order of the note in the Note Tree. 这也会更改笔记在笔记树（Note Tree）中的顺序。

Reordering does have some limitations: 重新排序确实有一些限制：

  • If the parent note has #sorted, reordering will be disabled.
  • If using nested tables, then reordering will also be disabled.
  • Currently, it's possible to reorder notes even if column sorting is used, but the result might be inconsistent.
  • 如果父笔记有 #sorted，重新排序将被禁用。
  • 如果使用嵌套表格，重新排序也将被禁用。
  • 目前，即使使用了列排序，也可以重新排序笔记，但结果可能不一致。

Nested trees

嵌套树

If the child notes of the collection also have their own child notes, then they will be displayed in a hierarchy. 如果集合的子笔记也有它们自己的子笔记，那么它们将以层级结构显示。

Next to the title of each element there will be a button to expand or collapse. By default, all items are expanded. 每个元素标题的旁边会有一个展开或折叠的按钮。默认情况下，所有项目都是展开的。

Since nesting is not always desirable, it is possible to limit the nesting to a certain number of levels or even disable it completely. To do so, either: 由于嵌套并不总是可取的，可以将嵌套限制在一定的层级数，甚至完全禁用它。要做到这一点，可以：

  • Go to Collection Properties and look for the Max nesting depth section.
    • To disable nesting, type 0 and press Enter.
    • To limit to a certain depth, type in the desired number (e.g. 2 to only display children and sub-children).
    • To re-enable unlimited nesting, remove the number and press Enter.
  • Manually set maxNestingDepth to the desired value.
  • 转到集合属性（Collection Properties）并查找_最大嵌套深度（Max nesting depth）_部分。
    • 要禁用嵌套，请输入 0 并按 Enter。
    • 要限制到一定深度，请输入所需数字（例如 2 表示仅显示子级和孙级）。
    • 要重新启用无限制嵌套，请移除数字并按 Enter。
  • 手动将 maxNestingDepth 设置为所需的值。

Limitations: 限制：

  • While in this mode, it's not possible to reorder notes.
  • 在此模式下，无法重新排序笔记。

Limitations

限制

  • There is no support to filter the rows by a certain criteria. Consider using the table view in search for that use case.
  • 不支持按特定条件筛选行。对于这种用例，请考虑在搜索中使用表格视图。

Use in search

在搜索中使用

The table view can be used in a Saved Search by adding the #viewType=table attribute. 可以通过添加 #viewType=table 属性，在保存的搜索（Saved Search）中使用表格视图。

Unlike when used in a Collection, saved searches are not limited to the sub-hierarchy of a note and allows for advanced queries thanks to the power of the Search. 与在集合中使用时不同，保存的搜索不受笔记子层级的限制，并借助搜索（Search）的强大功能允许高级查询。

However, there are also some limitations: 然而，也有一些限制：

  • It's not possible to reorder notes.
  • It's not possible to add a new row.
  • 无法重新排序笔记。
  • 无法添加新行。

Columns are supported, by being defined as Promoted Attributes to the Saved Search note. 通过将提升属性（Promoted Attributes）定义为保存的搜索（Saved Search）笔记，列得到支持。

Editing is also supported. 编辑也受支持。

title: Kanban Board(看板)
full:
（图片：看板示例）

The Board view presents sub-notes in columns for a Kanban-like experience. Each column represents a possible value for a status label, which can be adjusted. 看板（Board）视图以列的形式呈现子笔记，提供类似看板的体验。每个列代表状态标签的一个可能值，该值可以调整。

Creating a Kanban board

创建看板

Right click on an existing note in the Note Tree and select Insert child note and look for Kanban Board. 在笔记树（Note Tree）中右键单击现有笔记，选择_插入子笔记（Insert child note）并查找_看板（Kanban Board）。

How it works

工作原理

When first creating a collection of Board type, a few subnotes will be created, each having a #status label set. The board then groups each note by the value of the status attribute. 当首次创建_看板（Board）_类型的集合时，会创建一些子笔记，每个子笔记都设置了 #status 标签。看板随后按状态属性的值对每个笔记进行分组。

Notes are displayed recursively, so even the child notes of the child notes will be displayed. However, unlike the Table, the notes are not displayed in a hierarchy. 笔记是递归显示的，所以甚至子笔记的子笔记也会被显示。然而，与表格（Table）不同，笔记不是以层级结构显示的。

Interaction

交互

Working with columns

处理列

  • Create a new column by pressing Add Column near the last column.
    • Once pressed, a text box will be displayed to set the name of the column. Press Enter to confirm, or Esc to dismiss.
  • To reorder a column, simply hold the mouse over the title and drag it to the desired position.
  • To delete a column, right click on its title and select Delete column.
  • To rename a column, click on the note title.
    • Press Enter to confirm.
    • Upon renaming a column, the corresponding status attribute of all its notes will be changed in bulk.
  • If there are many columns, use the mouse wheel to scroll.
  • 通过按最后一个列附近的_添加列（Add Column）_来创建新列。
    • 按下后，将显示一个文本框以设置列的名称。按 Enter 确认，或按 Esc 取消。
  • 要重新排序列，只需将鼠标悬停在标题上并将其拖到所需位置。
  • 要删除列，请右键单击其标题并选择_删除列（Delete column）_。
  • 要重命名列，请点击笔记标题。
    • 按 Enter 确认。
    • 重命名列后，其所有笔记的相应状态属性将批量更改。
  • 如果列很多，请使用鼠标滚轮滚动。

Working with notes

处理笔记

  • Create a new note in any column by pressing New item
    • Enter the name of the note and press Enter or click away. To dismiss the creation of a new note, simply press Esc or leave the name empty.
    • Once created, the new note will have an attribute (status label by default) set to the name of the column.
  • To open the note, simply click on it.
  • To change the title of the note directly from the board, hover the mouse over its card and press the edit button on the right.
  • To change the state of a note, simply drag a note from one column to the other to change its state.
  • The order of the notes in each column corresponds to their position in the tree.
    • It's possible to reorder notes simply by dragging them to the desired position within the same columns.
    • It's also possible to drag notes across columns, at the desired position.
  • For more options, right click on a note to display a context menu with the following options:
    • Open the note in a new tab/split/window or quick edit.
    • Move the note to any column.
    • Insert a new note above/below the current one.
    • Archive/unarchive the current note.
    • Delete the current note.
  • If there are many notes within the column, move the mouse over the column and use the mouse wheel to scroll.
  • 通过按_新项目（New item）_在任何列中创建新笔记
    • 输入笔记的名称并按 Enter 或点击别处。要取消新笔记的创建，只需按 Esc 或让名称留空。
    • 创建后，新笔记将有一个设置为列名称的属性（默认 status 标签）。
  • 要打开笔记，只需点击它。
  • 要直接从看板更改笔记的标题，请将鼠标悬停在其卡片上并按右侧的编辑按钮。
  • 要更改笔记的状态，只需将笔记从一个列拖到另一个列以更改其状态。
  • 每个列中笔记的顺序对应于它们在树中的位置。
    • 只需将笔记拖到同一列内的所需位置即可重新排序。
    • 也可以在列之间拖拽笔记到所需位置。
  • 要获得更多选项，请右键单击笔记以显示包含以下选项的上下文菜单：
    • 在新标签页/分屏/窗口中打开笔记或快速编辑。
    • 将笔记移动到任何列。
    • 在当前笔记的上方/下方插入新笔记。
    • 归档/取消归档当前笔记。
    • 删除当前笔记。
  • 如果列内笔记很多，请将鼠标移到列上并使用鼠标滚轮滚动。

Working with the note tree

处理笔记树

It's also possible to add items on the board using the Note Tree. 也可以使用笔记树（Note Tree）在看板上添加项目。

  1. Select the desired note in the Note Tree.
  2. Hold the mouse on the note and drag it to the to the desired column.
  3. 在笔记树（Note Tree）中选择所需的笔记。
  4. 按住鼠标并将笔记拖到所需列。

This works for: 这适用于：

  • Notes that are not children of the board, case in which a clone will be created.
  • Notes that are children of the board, but not yet assigned on the board.
  • Notes that are children of the board, case in which they will be moved to the new column.
  • 不是看板子级的笔记，此时将创建一个克隆（clone）。
  • 是看板子级但尚未在看板上分配的笔记。
  • 是看板子级的笔记，此时它们将被移动到新列。

Keyboard interaction

键盘交互

The board view has mild support for keyboard-based navigation: 看板视图对基于键盘的导航有适度的支持：

  • Use Tab and Shift+Tab to navigate between column titles, notes and the “New item” button for each of the columns, in sequential order.
  • To rename a column or a note, press F2 while it is focused.
  • To open a specific note or create a new item, press Enter while it is focused.
  • To dismiss a rename of a note or a column, press Esc.
  • 使用 Tab 和 Shift+Tab 按顺序在列标题、笔记和每个列的 “新项目（New item）” 按钮之间导航。
  • 要重命名列或笔记，请在其获得焦点时按 F2。
  • 要打开特定笔记或创建新项目，请在其获得焦点时按 Enter。
  • 要取消笔记或列的重命名，请按 Esc。

Configuration

配置

Displaying custom attributes

显示自定义属性

（图片：显示自定义属性的看板示例）

Since v0.100.0, note attributes can be displayed on the board to enhance it with custom information such as adding a Due date for your tasks. 从 v0.100.0 起，笔记属性可以显示在看板上，以自定义信息增强它，例如为你的任务添加_截止日期（Due date）_。

This feature works exclusively via attribute definitions (Promoted Attributes). The easiest way to add these is: 此功能仅通过属性定义（提升属性（Promoted Attributes））工作。添加这些属性最简单的方法是：

  1. Go to board note.
  2. In the ribbon select Owned Attributes → plus button → Add new label/relation definition.
  3. Configure the attribute as desired.
  4. Check Inheritable to make it applicable to child notes automatically.
  5. 转到看板笔记。
  6. 在功能区中选择_自有属性（Owned Attributes）_ → 加号按钮 → 添加新的标签/关系定义（Add new label/relation definition）。
  7. 根据需要配置属性。
  8. 勾选_可继承（Inheritable）_以使其自动适用于子笔记。

After creating the attribute, click on a note and fill in the promoted attributes which should then reflect inside the board. 创建属性后，点击一个笔记并填写提升属性，这些属性随后应反映在看板内部。

Of note: 值得注意：

  • Both promoted and non-promoted attribute definitions are supported. The only difference is that non-promoted attributes don't have an “Alias” for assigning a custom name.
  • Both “Single value” and “Multi value” attributes are supported. In case of multi-value, a badge is displayed for every instance of the attribute.
  • All label types are supported, including dates, booleans and URLs.
  • Relation attributes are also supported as well, showing a link with the target note title and icon.
  • Currently, it's not possible to adjust which promoted attributes are displayed, since all promoted attributes will be displayed (except the board:groupBy one). There are plans to improve upon this being able to hide promoted attributes individually.
  • 提升和非提升的属性定义都受支持。唯一的区别是非提升属性没有用于指定自定义名称的 “别名（Alias）”。
  • “单值（Single value）”和“多值（Multi value）”属性都受支持。在多值的情况下，属性的每个实例都会显示一个徽章。
  • 支持所有标签类型，包括日期、布尔值和 URL。
  • 关系属性同样受支持，显示带有目标笔记标题和图标的链接。
  • 目前，无法调整显示哪些提升属性，因为所有提升属性都会被显示（除了 board:groupBy 那个）。有计划改进这一点，使其能够单独隐藏提升属性。

Grouping by another label

按另一个标签分组

By default, the label used to group the notes is #status. It is possible to use a different label if needed by defining a label named #board:groupBywith the value being the attribute to use (with or without # attribute prefix). 默认情况下，用于对笔记进行分组的标签是 #status。如果需要，可以通过定义一个名为 #board:groupBy 的标签来使用不同的标签，其值是要使用的属性（带或不带 # 属性前缀均可）。

Grouping by relations

按关系分组

（图片：按关系分组的看板示例）

A more advanced use-case is grouping by Relations. 一个更高级的用例是按关系（Relations）分组。

During this mode: 在此模式下：

  • The columns represent the target notes of a relation.
  • When creating a new column, a note is selected instead of a column name.
  • The column icon will match the target note.
  • Moving notes between columns will change its relation.
  • Renaming an existing column will change the target note of all the notes in that column.
  • 列表示关系的_目标笔记（target notes）_。
  • 创建新列时，选择的是笔记而不是列名。
  • 列图标将与目标笔记匹配。
  • 在列之间移动笔记将更改其关系。
  • 重命名现有列将更改该列中所有笔记的目标笔记。

Using relations instead of labels has some benefits: 使用关系而不是标签有一些好处：

  • The status/grouping of the notes is visible outside the Kanban board, for example on the Note Map.
  • Columns can have icons.
  • Renaming columns is less intensive since it simply involves changing the note title of the target note instead of having to do a bulk rename.
  • 笔记的状态/分组在看板之外可见，例如在笔记地图（Note Map）上。
  • 列可以有图标。
  • 重命名列的负担较小，因为它只涉及更改目标笔记的笔记标题，而不必进行批量重命名。

To do so: 要做到这一点：

  1. First, create a Kanban board from scratch and not a template:

  2. Assign #viewType=board #hidePromotedAttributes to emulate the default template.

  3. Set #board:groupBy to the name of a relation to group by, including the ~ prefix (e.g. ~status).

  4. Optionally, use Promoted Attributes for easy status change within the note:

    #relation:status(inheritable)="promoted,alias=Status,single"

  5. 首先，从零开始创建一个看板，而不是使用模板：

  6. 分配 #viewType=board #hidePromotedAttributes 以模拟默认模板。

  7. 将 #board:groupBy 设置为要按其分组的关系名称，包括 ~ 前缀（例如 ~status）。

  8. 可选地，使用提升属性（Promoted Attributes）以便在笔记内轻松更改状态：

    #relation:status(inheritable)="promoted,alias=Status,single"

title: Geo Map(地理地图)
full:
（图片：地理地图示例）

This note type displays the children notes on a geographical map, based on an attribute. It is also possible to add new notes at a specific location using the built-in interface. 此笔记类型基于一个属性，将子笔记显示在地理地图上。也可以使用内置界面在特定位置添加新笔记。

Features

功能

  • Add markers on the map, which can be customized with icons, colors and text.
  • Display tracks on the map using .gpx files.
  • 3D view of the map, which displays buildings when using a vector map.
  • 在地图上添加标记，可以使用图标、颜色和文本进行自定义。
  • 使用 .gpx 文件在地图上显示轨迹。
  • 地图的 3D 视图，在使用矢量地图时显示建筑物。

System requirements

系统要求

Starting with v0.105.0, the geomap uses MapLibre GL which requires WebGL v1 support. In general, most devices will support it because browsers/Electron can render it in software if needed. 从 v0.105.0 开始，地理地图使用 MapLibre GL，它需要 WebGL v1 支持。一般来说，大多数设备都会支持它，因为浏览器/Electron 可以在需要时以软件方式渲染它。

If the map could not be drawn because WebGL could not be initialized, an error message will appear instead of the map (This map can't be drawn because WebGL isn't available…). 如果由于无法初始化 WebGL 而无法绘制地图，将显示错误消息而不是地图（无法绘制此地图，因为 WebGL 不可用……）。

Interaction

交互

  • At the bottom-center there is a central toolbar which provides editing features: adding new markers on the map and importing GPX tracks.
  • At the bottom-right there are the viewport items:
    • Zoom in/out
      • On mobile these are hidden, use pinch to zoom instead.
      • On desktop, alternatively use the scroll wheel to adjust the zoom.
    • Full screen button which focuses the entire map onto the screen, while still allowing for edits.
  • 在底部中央有一个中央工具栏，提供编辑功能：在地图上添加新标记和导入 GPX 轨迹。
  • 在右下角有视口项目：
    • 放大/缩小
      • 在移动端这些被隐藏，请改用捏合手势缩放。
      • 在桌面端，也可以使用滚轮调整缩放。
    • 全屏按钮，将整个地图聚焦到屏幕上，同时仍允许编辑。

Creating a new geo map

创建新的地理地图

Right click on an existing note in the Note Tree and select Insert child note → Geo Map. 在Note Tree中右键单击现有笔记，选择_插入子笔记（Insert child note）_ → 地理地图（Geo Map）。

By default the map will be empty and will show the entire world. 默认情况下地图为空，将显示整个世界。

Repositioning the map

重新定位地图

  • Click and drag the map in order to move across the map.
  • Use the mouse wheel, two-finger gesture on a touchpad or the +/- buttons on the bottom-right to adjust the zoom.
  • 点击并拖动地图以在地图上移动。
  • 使用鼠标滚轮、触控板上的双指手势或右下角的 +/- 按钮来调整缩放。

The position on the map and the zoom are saved inside the map note and restored when visiting again the note. 地图上的位置和缩放级别保存在地图笔记内部，并在再次访问该笔记时恢复。

Adding a marker using the map

使用地图添加标记

Adding a new note using the plus button

使用加号按钮添加新笔记

  1. To create a marker, first navigate to the desired point on the map. Then press the Add marker button at the center-bottom of the map.

  2. Once pressed, the map will enter in the insert mode, as illustrated by the notification. Additionally, a preview of the marker will be shown at the cursor position.

    Simply click the point on the map where to place the marker. To cancel, press either the Esc key or press again the Add marker button.

  3. Once clicked, the marker will show up on the map and a popup will show to the right with the title already selected to be changed.

  4. 要创建标记，首先在地图上导航到所需点。然后按地图中下方的_添加标记（Add marker）_按钮。

  5. 按下后，地图将进入插入模式，如通知所示。此外，标记的预览将显示在光标位置。

    只需点击地图上要放置标记的点。要取消，请按 Esc 键或再次按_添加标记（Add marker）_按钮。

  6. 点击后，标记将显示在地图上，右侧将显示一个弹出窗口，标题已被选中待更改。

Adding a new note using the contextual menu

使用上下文菜单添加新笔记

  1. Right click anywhere on the map, where to place the newly created marker (and corresponding note).
  2. Select Add a marker at this location.
  3. Once clicked on a position on the map, the marker will show up on the map and a popup will show to the right with the title already selected to be changed.
  4. 在地图上的任意位置右键单击，以放置新创建的标记（以及相应的笔记）。
  5. 选择_在此位置添加标记（Add a marker at this location）_。
  6. 点击地图上的一个位置后，标记将显示在地图上，右侧将显示一个弹出窗口，标题已被选中待更改。

Adding an existing note from the note tree

从笔记树添加现有笔记

  1. Select the desired note in the Note Tree.
  2. Hold the mouse on the note and drag it to the map to the desired location.
  3. The map should be updated with the new marker.
  4. 在Note Tree中选择所需的笔记。
  5. 按住鼠标并将笔记拖到地图上的所需位置。
  6. 地图应更新为新的标记。

This works for: 这适用于：

  • Notes that are not part of the geo map, case in which a clone will be created.
  • Notes that are a child of the geo map but not yet positioned on the map.
  • Notes that are a child of the geo map and also positioned, case in which the marker will be relocated to the new position.
  • 不是地理地图一部分的笔记，此时将创建一个克隆（clone）。
  • 是地理地图的子级但尚未在地图上定位的笔记。
  • 是地理地图的子级且已定位的笔记，此时标记将被重新定位到新位置。

Dragging existing notes only works if the map is in editing mode. See the Read-only section for more information. 注意：仅当地图处于编辑模式时，拖拽现有笔记才有效。有关更多信息，请参阅_只读（Read-only）_部分。

How the location of the markers is stored

标记的位置如何存储

The location of a marker is stored in the #geolocation attribute of the child notes: 标记的位置存储在子笔记的 #geolocation 属性中：

This value can be added manually if needed. The value of the attribute is made up of the latitude and longitude separated by a comma. 如果需要，可以手动添加此值。该属性的值由用逗号分隔的纬度和经度组成。

Repositioning markers

重新定位标记

Once a marker is set, it can be repositioned using one of the two ways: 一旦设置了标记，可以通过以下两种方式之一重新定位：

  • By right clicking the marker and selecting Move to another location.
  • By clicking the marker to open the popup and selecting the Move to another location button underneath the title bar.
  • 右键单击标记并选择_移动到另一个位置（Move to another location）_。
  • 点击标记以打开弹出窗口，并选择标题栏下方的_移动到另一个位置（Move to another location）_按钮。

After clicking the button to move the marker, click at the desired position on the map to replace it. To cancel the operation, press Esc. 点击移动标记的按钮后，在地图上点击所需位置以替换它。要取消操作，请按 Esc。

If the map is locked for editing (see below), the map needs to be unlocked before moving the marker. 注意：如果地图被锁定无法编辑（见下文），需要在移动标记之前解锁地图。

Interaction with the markers

与标记的交互

  • Hovering over a marker will display a Note Tooltip with the content of the note it belongs to.
    • Clicking on the note title in the tooltip will navigate to the note in the current view.
  • Right-clicking the marker will open a contextual menu (as described below).
  • Clicking a marker will focus on the marker and display a dedicated popup with the details. This works regardless of whether the map is editable or not.
  • 悬停在标记上将显示一个Note Tooltip，其中包含该标记所属笔记的内容。
    • 点击工具提示中的笔记标题将在当前视图中导航到该笔记。
  • 右键单击标记将打开上下文菜单（如下所述）。
  • 点击标记将聚焦于该标记并显示一个专门的弹出窗口，其中包含详细信息。无论地图是否可编辑，这都有效。

Popup view

弹出窗口视图

When a marker or a track is clicked, a popup will open to the right which contains the following information: 当点击标记或轨迹时，右侧将打开一个弹出窗口，其中包含以下信息：

  • The title and icon of the marker, both editable.
  • An indicator for the coordinates; clicking it will copy the coordinates to clipboard.
  • A button to maximize the popup.
  • Buttons to interact with the marker:
    • Open the marker in the same pane, new tab, etc.
    • A button to open the location in a dedicated application (e.g. Google Maps on mobile).
    • Color picker to change the color of the marker.
    • Button to remove the marker from the map, which can optionally delete its corresponding note. Removing a marker without deleting the note will only remove its #geolocation attribute (case in which the coordinates have to be manually added back in in order to get the note to show on the map again).
  • The Promoted Attributes of the marker, if any.
  • The note's content which can be edited directly from the panel.
  • 标记的标题和图标，均可编辑。
  • 坐标指示器；点击它将坐标复制到剪贴板。
  • 最大化弹出窗口的按钮。
  • 与标记交互的按钮：
    • 在同一窗格、新标签页等中打开标记。
    • 在专用应用程序（例如移动端的 Google 地图）中打开位置的按钮。
    • 用于更改标记颜色的颜色选择器。
    • 从地图上移除标记的按钮，可以选择删除其对应的笔记。不移除笔记而移除标记只会移除其 #geolocation 属性（这种情况下，必须手动重新添加坐标才能使笔记再次显示在地图上）。
  • 标记的Promoted Attributes（如果有）。
  • 可以直接从面板编辑的笔记内容。

To dismiss the popup: 要关闭弹出窗口：

  • Press the X button at the top-right of the popup.
  • In the map, press anywhere outside the popup.
  • Or simply press the Esc key.
  • 按弹出窗口右上角的 X 按钮。
  • 在地图中，按弹出窗口外部的任意位置。
  • 或者直接按 Esc 键。

When a marker is clicked, the map will automatically adjust the viewport so that the marker is still visible with the popup open. The currently selected marker is shown slightly bigger. 当点击标记时，地图将自动调整视口，以便在弹出窗口打开时标记仍然可见。当前选中的标记显示得稍大一些。

It is possible to switch between markers by clicking on them even when the popup view is already open. 即使在弹出窗口视图已经打开的情况下，也可以通过点击标记在标记之间切换。

Markers can have Internal (reference) links between them and clicking on such a link will automatically adjust the viewport and the popup view to the new note. 标记之间可以有Internal (reference) links，点击此类链接将自动将视口和弹出窗口视图调整到新笔记。

Contextual menu

上下文菜单

It's possible to press the right mouse button to display a contextual menu. 可以按鼠标右键显示上下文菜单。

  1. If right-clicking an empty section of the map (not on a marker), it allows to:
    1. Display the latitude and longitude. Clicking this option will copy them to the clipboard.
    2. Open the location using an external application (if the operating system supports it).
    3. Adding a new marker at that location.
  2. If right-clicking on a marker, it allows to:
    1. Display the latitude and longitude. Clicking this option will copy them to the clipboard.
    2. Open the location using an external application (if the operating system supports it).
    3. Open the note in a new tab, split or window.
    4. Button to remove the marker from the map, which can optionally delete its corresponding note. Removing a marker without deleting the note will only remove its #geolocation attribute (case in which the coordinates have to be manually added back in in order to get the note to show on the map again).
  3. 如果右键单击地图的空白区域（不在标记上），允许：
    1. 显示纬度和经度。点击此选项将它们复制到剪贴板。
    2. 使用外部应用程序打开位置（如果操作系统支持）。
    3. 在该位置添加新标记。
  4. 如果右键单击标记，允许：
    1. 显示纬度和经度。点击此选项将它们复制到剪贴板。
    2. 使用外部应用程序打开位置（如果操作系统支持）。
    3. 在新标签页、分屏或窗口中打开笔记。
    4. 从地图上移除标记的按钮，可以选择删除其对应的笔记。不移除笔记而移除标记只会移除其 #geolocation 属性（这种情况下，必须手动重新添加坐标才能使笔记再次显示在地图上）。

Icon and color of the markers

标记的图标和颜色

（图片：标记颜色示例）

The markers will have the same icon as the note. 标记将具有与笔记相同的图标。

It's possible to add a custom color to a marker by assigning them a #colorattribute such as #color=green. 可以通过为标记分配 #color 属性（例如 #color=green）来为其添加自定义颜色。

Adding the coordinates manually

手动添加坐标

In a nutshell, create a child note and set the #geolocation attribute to the coordinates. 简而言之，创建一个子笔记并将 #geolocation 属性设置为坐标。

The value of the attribute is made up of the latitude and longitude separated by a comma. 该属性的值由用逗号分隔的纬度和经度组成。

Adding from Google Maps

从 Google 地图添加

  1. In Google Maps, on the web:
    1. Look for a desired location, right click on it and a context menu will show up.
    2. Simply click on the first item displaying the coordinates and they will be copied to clipboard.
  2. In Trilium, create a child note under the map.
  3. Then paste the value inside the text box into the #geolocation attribute of a child note of the map (don't forget to surround the value with a "character).
  4. 在 Google 地图的网页版中：
    1. 查找所需位置，右键单击它，将显示上下文菜单。
    2. 只需点击显示坐标的第一项，它们将被复制到剪贴板。
  5. 在 Trilium 中，在地图下创建一个子笔记。
  6. 然后将文本框中的值粘贴到地图子笔记的 #geolocation 属性中（别忘了用 " 字符包围该值）。

Adding from OpenStreetMap

从 OpenStreetMap 添加

Similarly to the Google Maps approach: 与 Google 地图的方法类似：

  1. Go to any location on openstreetmap.org and right click to bring up the context menu. Select the Show address item.
  2. The address will be visible in the top-left of the screen, in the place of the search bar. Select the coordinates and copy them into the clipboard.
  3. Simply paste the value inside the text box into the #geolocation attribute of a child note of the map and then it should be displayed on the map.
  4. 转到 openstreetmap.org 上的任意位置并右键单击以调出上下文菜单。选择_显示地址（Show address）_项目。
  5. 地址将显示在屏幕左上角搜索栏的位置。选择坐标并将它们复制到剪贴板。
  6. 只需将文本框中的值粘贴到地图子笔记的 #geolocation 属性中，然后它就应该显示在地图上。

Adding GPS tracks (.gpx)

添加 GPS 轨迹（.gpx）

（图片：GPS 轨迹示例）

Trilium can display GPS tracks on the geo map, in the form of .gpx files. Trilium 可以以 .gpx 文件的形式在地理地图上显示 GPS 轨迹。

To add a track, either: 要添加轨迹，可以：

  1. Drag & drop a .gpx file inside the geo map in the note tree.
    1. In order for the file to be recognized as a GPS track, it needs to show up as application/gpx+xml in the File type field.
  2. Press the Add a GPS track from a GPX file which will directly prompt for a GPX file and import it as a subnote of the collection.
  3. 在笔记树中拖放一个 .gpx 文件到地理地图内。
    1. 为了使文件被识别为 GPS 轨迹，它需要在_文件类型（File type）_字段中显示为 application/gpx+xml。
  4. 按_从 GPX 文件添加 GPS 轨迹（Add a GPS track from a GPX file）_，它将直接提示选择 GPX 文件并将其作为集合的子笔记导入。

When going back to the map, the track should now be visible. 回到地图时，轨迹现在应该可见。

The starting point of the track will be displayed as a marker, with the name of the note underneath. The start marker will also respect the icon and the color of the note. The end marker is displayed with a distinct icon. 轨迹的起点将显示为标记，笔记名称在其下方。起点标记也会遵循笔记的图标和 color。终点标记以不同的图标显示。

If the track file contains multiple tracks, they will all be displayed as well as markers. Trilium will also split a single track that happens to have non-continuous points. 如果轨迹文件包含多个轨迹，它们都将作为标记显示。Trilium 也会拆分碰巧具有不连续点的单个轨迹。

If the GPX contains waypoints, they will also be displayed, including their names. 如果 GPX 包含航点，它们也将被显示，包括它们的名称。

When the track is clicked, the entire route is brought into view, as well as the right popup will indicate details about the track such as distance, duration and the elevation map. This information is also displayed when clicking the .gpx note itself. 当点击轨迹时，整个路线将进入视野，右侧弹出窗口将显示轨迹的详细信息，例如距离、持续时间和高程图。点击 .gpx 笔记本身时也会显示此信息。

When clicking on the markers of a track (whether it's the start or stop built-in markers, or custom markers that are part of the track), only that marker is brought into view, as opposed to the entire route. 当点击轨迹的标记时（无论是开始或停止的内置标记，还是作为轨迹一部分的自定义标记），只有该标记进入视野，而不是整个路线。

Read-only mode

只读模式

When a map is read-only all editing features will be disabled such as: 当地图为只读（read-only）时，所有编辑功能都将被禁用，例如：

  • The add button at the bottom of the map.
  • Repositioning markers.
  • Editing from the contextual menu (removing locations or adding new items).
  • 地图底部的添加按钮。
  • 重新定位标记。
  • 从上下文菜单编辑（移除位置或添加新项目）。

To set a map as read-only, go to Note buttons → Editable → Read-only (on the new layout, or in Basic Properties on the Ribbon for the old layout). 要将地图设置为只读，请转到Note buttons → 可编辑（Editable） → 只读（Read-only）（在新布局中，或在旧布局的Ribbon的基本属性中）。

Configuration

配置

Map Style

地图样式

The styling of the map can be adjusted in the Collection Properties or manually via the #map:style attribute. 地图的样式可以在Collection Properties中调整，或通过 #map:style 属性手动调整。

The geo map comes with two different types of styles: 地理地图带有两种不同类型的样式：

  • Raster styles
    • For these styles the map is represented as a grid of images at different zoom levels. This is the traditional way OpenStreetMap used to work.
    • Zoom is slightly restricted.
    • Currently, the only raster theme is the original OpenStreetMap style.
  • Vector styles
    • Vector styles are not represented as images, but as geometrical shapes. This makes the rendering much smoother, especially when zooming and looking at the building edges, for example.
    • The map can be zoomed in much further.
    • These come in various styles that are both light (Colorful, Graybeard, Neutrino) and dark (Eclipse, Shadow).
    • The vector styles come from VersaTiles, a free and open-source project providing map tiles based on OpenStreetMap.
    • The VersaTiles layers also provide 3D building information (see below).
  • 栅格（Raster）样式
    • 对于这些样式，地图表示为不同缩放级别下的图像网格。这是 OpenStreetMap 过去工作的传统方式。
    • 缩放略有受限。
    • 目前，唯一的栅格主题是原始的 OpenStreetMap 样式。
  • 矢量（Vector）样式
    • 矢量样式不以图像表示，而是以几何形状表示。这使得渲染更加平滑，尤其是在缩放和查看建筑边缘时。
    • 地图可以放大得更远。
    • 这些样式既有浅色（Colorful、Graybeard、Neutrino）也有深色（Eclipse、Shadow）。
    • 矢量样式来自 VersaTiles，这是一个基于 OpenStreetMap 提供地图瓦片的免费开源项目。
    • VersaTiles 图层还提供 3D 建筑信息（见下文）。

The default theme is VersaTiles Colorful (vector). 默认主题是 VersaTiles Colorful（矢量）。

3D view with buildings

带建筑物的 3D 视图

（图片：3D 建筑视图示例）

Trilium v0.105.0 introduces a 3D view, courtesy of MapLibre GL. To enter 3D mode, simply press the corresponding button at the bottom-right of the map or press Ctrl and drag across the map. Trilium v0.105.0 引入了 3D 视图，由 MapLibre GL 提供。要进入 3D 模式，只需按地图右下角的相应按钮，或按住 Ctrl 并在地图上拖动。

The buildings will only appear from zoom 14 onwards to avoid lag. 建筑物只会在缩放级别 14 及以上出现，以避免卡顿。

To get 3D buildings, make sure you are using the VersaTiles styles which provide the building information via the versatiles-shortbread source. 注意：要获得 3D 建筑物，请确保你使用的是 VersaTiles 样式，它通过 versatiles-shortbread 源提供建筑信息。

Custom map style / tiles

自定义地图样式 / 瓦片

Starting with v0.102.0 it is possible to use custom tile sets, but only in raster format. 从 v0.102.0 开始，可以使用自定义瓦片集，但仅限于栅格格式。

To do so, manually set the #map:style labelto the URL of the tile set. For example, to use Esri.NatGeoWorldMap, set the value to https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/NatGeo_World_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}. 为此，请手动将 #map:style 标签（label）设置为瓦片集的 URL。例如，要使用 Esri.NatGeoWorldMap，请将值设置为 https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/NatGeo_World_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}。

Additionally: 此外：

  • Hi-DPI tiles are supported via the {r} placeholder.
  • To mark the custom style as dark (which affects the styling of the UI), apply the map:darkStyle label. This attribute also overrides built-in themes.
  • 通过 {r} 占位符支持高 DPI 瓦片。
  • 要将自定义样式标记为深色（这会影响 UI 的样式），请应用 map:darkStyle 标签。此属性也会覆盖内置主题。

For a list of tile sets, see the Leaflet Providers preview page. Select a desired tile set and just copy the URL from the Plain JavaScript example. 注意：有关瓦片集的列表，请参阅 Leaflet Providers 预览页面。选择所需的瓦片集，只需从_纯 JavaScript（Plain JavaScript）_示例中复制 URL 即可。

Custom vector map support is planned, but not yet implemented. 自定义矢量地图支持已在计划中，但尚未实现。

Other options

其他选项

The following options can be configured either via the Collection Properties, by clicking on the settings (Gear icon). Alternatively, each of these options also have a corresponding label that can be set manually. 以下选项可以通过Collection Properties配置，方法是点击设置（齿轮图标）。另外，这些选项中的每一个也有一个可以手动设置的相应标签（label）。

  • Scale, which illustrates the scale of the map in either kilometers or miles in the bottom-left of the map.
    • The unit is determined by the Formatting locale option in Language & Region.
  • The name of the markers is displayed by default underneath the pin on the map. Since v0.102.0, it is possible to hide these labels which increases the performance and decreases clutter when there are many markers on the map.
  • v0.105.0 also introduces a feature called Group nearby markers which will cluster multiple markers together at low zoom.
    • The clusters display the number of items they contain. The color also changes based on the count.
    • Clicking on a cluster will automatically zoom in so that the individual markers that make up the cluster are now visible.
  • 比例尺（Scale），它在地图的左下角以公里或英里显示地图的比例尺。
    • 单位由_语言与区域（Language & Region）_中的_格式区域（Formatting locale）_选项决定。
  • 标记的名称默认显示在地图图钉下方。从 v0.102.0 开始，可以隐藏这些标签，这在地图上有许多标记时可以提高性能并减少杂乱。
  • v0.105.0 还引入了一个名为_分组附近标记（Group nearby markers）_的功能，它将在低缩放级别将多个标记聚集在一起。
