    • 聚簇显示它们包含的项目数量。颜色也会根据数量变化。
    • 点击聚簇将自动放大，以便构成聚簇的各个标记现在可见。

title: Presentation(演示文稿)
full:
（图片：演示文稿示例）

The Presentation view allows the creation of slideshows directly from within Trilium. 演示文稿（Presentation）视图允许直接在 Trilium 内创建幻灯片放映。

Creating a new presentation

创建新的演示文稿

Right click on an existing note in the Note Tree and select Insert child note and look for Presentation. 在笔记树（Note Tree）中右键单击现有笔记，选择_插入子笔记（Insert child note）并查找_演示文稿（Presentation）。

How it works

工作原理

  • Each slide is a child note of the collection.
  • The order of the child notes determines the order of the slides.
  • Unlike traditional presentation software, slides can be laid out both horizontally and vertically (see below for more information).
  • Direct children will be laid out horizontally and the children of those will be laid out vertically. Children deeper than two levels of nesting are ignored.
  • 每个幻灯片是集合的一个子笔记。
  • 子笔记的顺序决定幻灯片的顺序。
  • 与传统的演示软件不同，幻灯片可以横向和纵向布局（详见下文）。
  • 直接子级将横向布局，而它们的子级将纵向布局。嵌套超过两层的子级将被忽略。

Interaction and navigation

交互与导航

In the floating buttons section (top-right): 在浮动按钮部分（右上角）：

  • Edit button to go to the corresponding note of the current slide.
  • Press Overview button (or the O key) to show a birds-eye view of the slides. Press the button again to disable it.
  • Press the “Start presentation” button to show the presentation in full-screen.
  • 编辑按钮，用于转到当前幻灯片对应的笔记。
  • 按概览（Overview）按钮（或 O 键）以显示幻灯片的鸟瞰视图。再次按该按钮将其禁用。
  • 按 “开始演示（Start presentation）” 按钮以全屏显示演示文稿。

The following keyboard shortcuts are supported: 支持以下键盘快捷键：

  • Press ← and → (or H and L) to go to the slide on the left or on the right (horizontal).
  • Press ↑ and ↓ (or K and J) to go to the upward or downward slide (vertical).
  • Press Space and Shift + Space or to go to the next/previous slide in order.
  • And a few more, press ? to display a popup with all the supported keyboard combinations.
  • 按 ← 和 →（或 H 和 L）转到左侧或右侧的幻灯片（横向）。
  • 按 ↑ 和 ↓（或 K 和 J）转到上方或下方的幻灯片（纵向）。
  • 按 Space 和 Shift + Space 或按顺序转到下一张/上一张幻灯片。
  • 还有更多，按 ? 可显示包含所有受支持键盘组合的弹出窗口。

Vertical slides and nesting

纵向幻灯片与嵌套

Unlike traditional presentation software such as Microsoft PowerPoint, the slides in Trilium can be laid out horizontally or vertically in order to create depth or better organize the slides by topic. 与 Microsoft PowerPoint 等传统演示软件不同，Trilium 中的幻灯片可以横向或纵向布局，以创造深度或按主题更好地组织幻灯片。

This horizontal/vertical organization affects transitions (especially on the “slide” transition), however it is most noticeable in navigation. 这种横向/纵向的组织方式会影响过渡效果（尤其是在 “slide” 过渡上），但它在导航中最为明显。

  • Pressing ← and → will navigate through slides horizontally, thus skipping vertical notes under the current slide. This is useful to skip entire chapters/related slides.
  • Pressing ↑ and ↓ will navigate through the vertical slides at the current level.
  • Pressing Space and Shift + Space will go to the next/previous slide in order, regardless of the direction. This is generally the key combination to use when presenting.
  • The arrows on the bottom-right of the slide will also reflect this navigation scheme.
  • 按 ← 和 → 将在幻灯片中横向导航，从而跳过当前幻灯片下方的纵向笔记。这对于跳过整章/相关幻灯片很有用。
  • 按 ↑ 和 ↓ 将在当前级别的纵向幻灯片中导航。
  • 按 Space 和 Shift + Space 将按顺序转到下一张/上一张幻灯片，无论方向如何。这通常是演示时使用的按键组合。
  • 幻灯片右下角的箭头也会反映这种导航方案。
（图片：幻灯片结构示例）

All direct children of the collection will be laid out horizontally. If a direct child also has children, those children will be placed as vertical slides. 集合的所有直接子级将横向布局。如果直接子级也有子级，这些子级将作为纵向幻灯片放置。

In the following example, the note structure is as follows: 在下面的示例中，笔记结构如下：

  • Presentation collection
    • Trilium Notes (demo page)
    • “Introduction” slide
      • “The challenge of personal knowledge management”
      • “Note-taking structures”
    • “Demo & Feature highlights” slide
      • “Really fast installation process”
      • Video slide
  • 演示文稿集合
    • Trilium Notes（演示页面）
    • “介绍（Introduction）” 幻灯片
      • “个人知识管理的挑战”
      • “笔记记录结构”
    • “演示与功能亮点（Demo & Feature highlights）” 幻灯片
      • “真正快速的安装过程”
      • 视频幻灯片

Customization

自定义

At collection level, it's possible to adjust: 在集合级别，可以调整：

  • The theme of the entire presentation to one of the predefined themes by going to the Collection Properties and looking for the Theme option.
  • It's currently not possible to create custom themes, although it is planned.
  • Note that it is not possible to alter the CSS via Custom app-wide CSS because the slides are rendered isolated (in a shadow DOM).
  • 通过转到集合属性（Collection Properties）并查找_主题（Theme）_选项，将整个演示文稿的主题设置为预定义主题之一。
  • 目前无法创建自定义主题，尽管有计划这样做。
  • 请注意，无法通过自定义全局 CSS（Custom app-wide CSS）更改 CSS，因为幻灯片是隔离渲染的（在影子 DOM 中）。

At slide level: 在幻灯片级别：

  • It's possible to adjust the background color of a slide by using the predefined promoted attributefor the color or manually setting #slide:backgroundto a hex color.
  • More complex backgrounds can be achieved via gradients. There's no UI for it; it has to be set via #slide:background to a CSS gradient definition such as: linear-gradient(to bottom, #283b95, #17b2c3).
  • 可以通过使用颜色的预定义提升属性（predefined promoted attribute）或手动将 #slide:background 设置为十六进制颜色来调整幻灯片的背景颜色。
  • 更复杂的背景可以通过渐变实现。没有对应的 UI；必须通过 #slide:background 将其设置为 CSS 渐变定义，例如：linear-gradient(to bottom, #283b95, #17b2c3)。

Tips and tricks

提示与技巧

  • Text notes generally respect the formatting (bold, italic, foreground and background colors) and font size. Code blocks and tables also work.
  • Try using more than just text notes, the presentation uses the same mechanism as shared notes and Note List so it should be able to display Mermaid Diagrams, Canvas and Mind Map in full-screen (without the interactivity).

    • Consider using a transparent background for Canvas, if the slides have a custom background (go to the hamburger menu in the Canvas, press the button select a custom color and write transparent).

    • For Mermaid Diagrams, some of them have a predefined background which can be changed via the frontmatter. For example, for XY-charts:

      ---
config:
    themeVariables:
        xyChart:
            backgroundColor: transparent
---
  • 文本笔记通常遵循格式（粗体、斜体、前景色和背景色）和字体大小。代码块和表格也有效。
  • 尝试使用不仅仅是文本笔记的内容，演示文稿使用与共享笔记（shared notes）和笔记列表（Note List）相同的机制，因此它应该能够在全屏下显示Mermaid 图表（Mermaid Diagrams）、画布（Canvas）和思维导图（Mind Map）（没有交互性）。

    • 如果幻灯片有自定义背景，请考虑为画布（Canvas）使用透明背景（进入画布中的汉堡菜单，按下按钮选择自定义颜色并写入 transparent）。

    • 对于Mermaid 图表（Mermaid Diagrams），其中一些有预定义的背景，可以通过 frontmatter 更改。例如，对于 XY 图表：

      ---
config:
    themeVariables:
        xyChart:
            backgroundColor: transparent
---

Under the hood

底层机制

The Presentation view uses Reveal.js to handle the navigation and layout of the slides. 演示文稿视图使用 Reveal.js 来处理幻灯片的导航和布局。

title: Grid View(网格视图)
full:
（图片：网格视图示例）

This view presents the child notes in a grid format, allowing for a more visual navigation experience. 此视图以网格格式呈现子笔记，提供更具视觉化的导航体验。

Each tile contains: 每个磁贴包含：

  • The title of a note.
  • A snippet of the content.
  • For empty notes, the sub-children are also displayed, allowing for quick navigation.
  • 笔记的标题。
  • 内容片段。
  • 对于空笔记，也会显示其子级笔记，以便快速导航。

Depending on the type of note: 根据笔记的类型：

  • For Text notes, the text can be slightly scrollable via the mouse wheel to reveal more context.
  • For Code notes, syntax highlighting is applied.
  • For File notes, a preview is made available for audio, video and PDF notes.
  • If the note does not have a content, a list of its child notes will be displayed instead.
  • 对于文本（Text）笔记，文本可以通过鼠标滚轮略微滚动以显示更多上下文。
  • 对于代码（Code）笔记，会应用语法高亮。
  • 对于文件（File）笔记，音频、视频和 PDF 笔记会提供预览。
  • 如果笔记没有内容，则改为显示其子笔记列表。

The grid view is also used by default in the Note List of every note, making it easy to navigate to children notes. 网格视图也是每个笔记的笔记列表（Note List）中的默认方式，使得导航到子笔记变得容易。

Creating a new table

创建新的表格

Right click on an existing note in the Note Tree and select Insert child note and look for Grid View. 在笔记树（Note Tree）中右键单击现有笔记，选择_插入子笔记（Insert child note）并查找_网格视图（Grid View）。

Configuration

配置

Unlike most other view types, the grid view is not actually configurable. 与大多数其他视图类型不同，网格视图实际上不可配置。

title: List View(列表视图)
full:
（图片：列表视图示例）

List view is similar to Grid View, but in the list view mode, each note is displayed in a single row with only the title and the icon of the note being visible by the default. By pressing the expand button it's possible to view the content of the note, as well as the children of the note (recursively). 列表视图与网格视图（Grid View）类似，但在列表视图模式下，每个笔记显示为单行，默认只显示笔记的标题和图标。通过按下展开按钮，可以查看笔记的内容以及笔记的子级（递归）。

In the example above, the "Node.js" note on the left panel contains several child notes. The right panel displays the content of these child notes as a single continuous document. 在上面的示例中，左侧面板的 “Node.js” 笔记包含多个子笔记。右侧面板将这些子笔记的内容显示为单个连续文档。

Creating a new table

创建新的表格

Right click on an existing note in the Note Tree and select Insert child note and look for List View. 在笔记树（Note Tree）中右键单击现有笔记，选择_插入子笔记（Insert child note）并查找_列表视图（List View）。

Interaction

交互

  • Each note can be expanded or collapsed by clicking on the arrow to the left of the title.
  • In the Ribbon, in the Collection tab there are options to expand and to collapse all notes easily.
  • 每个笔记都可以通过点击标题左侧的箭头来展开或折叠。
  • 在功能区（Ribbon）的_集合（Collection）_选项卡中，有轻松展开和折叠所有笔记的选项。

Printing and exporting to PDF

打印和导出为 PDF

Since v0.100.0, list collections can be printed or exported to PDF. 从 v0.100.0 起，列表集合可以打印或导出为 PDF。

A printed list collection will print all the notes in the collection, in the right order and preserving the full hierarchy. 打印的列表集合将按正确顺序打印集合中的所有笔记，并保留完整的层级结构。

If exported to PDF within the desktop application, there is additional functionality: 如果在桌面应用程序中导出为 PDF，还有额外的功能：

  • The table of contents of the PDF will reflect the structure of the notes.
  • Reference and inline links to other notes within the same hierarchy will be functional (will jump to the corresponding page). If a link refers to a note that is not in the printed hierarchy, it will be unlinked.
  • PDF 的目录将反映笔记的结构。
  • 指向同一层级内其他笔记的引用和行内链接将是可用的（将跳转到相应页面）。如果链接指向不在打印层级中的笔记，它将被取消链接。

Expanding and collapsing multiple notes at once

同时展开和折叠多个笔记

Apart from individually expanding or collapsing notes, it's also possible to expand or collapse them all at once. To do so, go to the Collection Properties and look for the corresponding button. 除了单独展开或折叠笔记之外，还可以一次性全部展开或折叠。为此，请转到集合属性（Collection Properties）并查找相应的按钮。

By default, the Expand button will only expand the direct children (first level) of the collection. Starting with v0.100.0, it's possible to expand multiple levels of notes using the arrow button next to the button. 默认情况下，_展开（Expand）_按钮只会展开集合的直接子级（第一级）。从 v0.100.0 开始，可以使用按钮旁边的箭头按钮展开多级笔记。

Manually expanded notes will reset if the application/tab is closed and then the collection is visited again. Automatically expanded notes, using the ribbon configuration will persist. 手动展开的笔记在应用程序/标签页关闭后再次访问集合时会重置。使用功能区配置自动展开的笔记将会保留。

By design, the UI provides only a handful of levels of depth for expanding notes (direct children, 2-5, all levels). It's also possible to specify any desired depth by manually setting the corresponding label. For example: #expanded=100 to expand up to 100 levels of depth. 提示：按照设计，UI 只提供少数几个深度级别用于展开笔记（直接子级、2-5 级、所有级别）。也可以通过手动设置相应的标签（corresponding label）来指定任意所需的深度。例如：#expanded=100 表示展开最多 100 级的深度。

From a performance standpoint, the List collection is efficient since it does not load child notes unless the notes are actually expanded. Expanding the list for a significantly large hierarchy can cause slow-downs. 注意：从性能角度来看，列表集合是高效的，因为它只有在笔记实际展开时才加载子笔记。对于非常大的层级结构展开列表可能会导致变慢。

title: Collection Properties(集合属性)
full:
（图片：集合属性工具栏示例）

The Collection Properties is a toolbar that is displayed at the top of every collection note. _集合属性（Collection Properties）_是一个工具栏，显示在每个集合笔记（collection note）的顶部。

For versions prior to v0.102.0, this feature was only available for the New Layout. Starting with this version, the collection properties are enabled for the Old layout as well, and Ribbon no longer contains a dedicated tab for collection properties. 对于 v0.102.0 之前的版本，此功能仅对新布局（New Layout）可用。从该版本开始，集合属性也对旧布局启用，并且功能区（Ribbon）不再包含专门的集合属性选项卡。

The collection properties has: 集合属性包含：

  • A quick selector for the view type (e.g. grid, calendar, board).
  • A settings button with:
    • Settings for the current view, for example hiding the weekends in a calendar.
    • Generic settings for the collection, such as hiding the child notes or showing archived notes.
  • Specific interactions for the current view, for example month selector and view switcher for the calendar.
  • 视图类型的快速选择器（例如网格、日历、看板）。
  • 一个设置按钮，包含：
    • 当前视图的设置，例如在日历中隐藏周末。
    • 集合的通用设置，例如隐藏子笔记（hiding the child notes）或显示归档笔记（archived notes）。
  • 当前视图的特定交互，例如日历的月份选择器和视图切换器。

title: Dashboard(仪表盘)
full:
（图片：仪表盘示例）

The dashboard is currently considered beta. This means that it might face some changes in behavior until it is stabilized. 注意：仪表盘目前被视为测试版（beta）。这意味着在它稳定之前，其行为可能会发生一些变化。

The dashboard is a collection introduced in Trilium v0.104.0. It is similar to the Grid View collection, but with some key differences: 仪表盘是在 Trilium v0.104.0 中引入的一种集合。它与网格视图（Grid View）集合类似，但有一些关键区别：

  • The grid layout is not fixed, allowing for tiles of varying widths and heights. The grid has 12 columns and an unlimited number of rows.
  • Each widget represents a child note of the collection and can be reordered or resized.
  • The grid will distribute the columns evenly to fill the entire screen.
    • If the available space is too low (e.g. in a split or in mobile), the columns are collapsed so that all widgets are displayed one under the other.
    • While the columns are collapsed, the widgets cannot be reordered or resized.
  • Unlike the Grid View, the widgets are not clickable which allows them to be interactive.
  • 网格布局不是固定的，允许磁贴具有不同的宽度和高度。网格有 12 列和无限数量的行。
  • 每个小组件代表集合的一个子笔记，可以重新排序或调整大小。
  • 网格会均匀分布列以填满整个屏幕。
    • 如果可用空间过低（例如在分屏或移动端），列会被折叠，使所有小组件一个接一个地显示。
    • 在列折叠时，小组件不能重新排序或调整大小。
  • 与网格视图（Grid View）不同，小组件不可点击，这使它们可以交互。

Types of widgets

小组件的类型

The dashboard uses the same rendering mechanism as the Grid View or the Note List, which means every note can be rendered, such as: 仪表盘使用与网格视图（Grid View）或笔记列表（Note List）相同的渲染机制，这意味着每个笔记都可以被渲染，例如：

  • Static content, via Text or Code.
  • Images via File, Mermaid Diagrams, Mind Map.
  • Interactive widgets via Render Note.
  • Web pages can be displayed via Web View and refreshed via the context menu.
  • Collections render interactively inside the dashboard
  • 静态内容，通过文本（Text）或代码（Code）。
  • 图像，通过文件（File）、Mermaid 图表（Mermaid Diagrams）、思维导图（Mind Map）。
  • 交互式小组件，通过渲染笔记（Render Note）。
  • 网页可以通过网页视图（Web View）显示，并通过上下文菜单刷新。
  • 集合（Collections）在仪表盘内交互式渲染

Interactive widgets through the use of Render Note is the highlighted use case of the dashboard. Using the AI chat, these widgets can be easily created as the AI is instructed in how to write them. 提示：通过使用渲染笔记（Render Note）实现的交互式小组件是仪表盘的重点用例。使用AI 聊天，可以轻松创建这些小组件，因为 AI 会被指导如何编写它们。

Adding new widgets

添加新小组件

There are two ways to add widgets to a dashboard: 有两种方式可以向仪表盘添加小组件：

  • Create a child note of any type, the dashboard will automatically pick it up and add it onto the grid.
  • From the Note Tree, drag an existing note onto the dashboard and it will be placed there. This will clone the note into the collection.
  • 创建任何类型的子笔记，仪表盘会自动拾取它并将其添加到网格上。
  • 从笔记树（Note Tree）中，将现有笔记拖到仪表盘上，它将被放置在那里。这将把笔记克隆（clone）到集合中。

title: Anonymized Database(匿名化数据库)
full:
（图片：匿名化数据库选项）

In certain scenarios, understanding the structure of a database is crucial for troubleshooting issues. However, sharing your actual database file with personal notes is not advisable. To address this, Trilium offers a feature to anonymize the database. This feature can be accessed via Menu -> Options -> Advanced tab. 在某些情况下，理解数据库的结构对于排查问题至关重要。然而，分享你带有个人笔记的实际数据库（database）文件是不可取的。为了解决这个问题，Trilium 提供了匿名化数据库的功能。此功能可以通过 菜单（Menu）-> 选项（Options）-> 高级（Advanced）选项卡访问。

This feature creates a copy of your database with all sensitive data removed. Specifically, it strips out note titles, contents, revisions, history, and some non-system attributes while retaining the overall structure and metadata, such as modification dates. After anonymization, the database undergoes a vacuuming process to ensure no sensitive data remnants remain in the file. The anonymized database is saved in the anonymized directory within the Data directory, making it safe to share with bug reports. 此功能会创建你数据库的副本并移除所有敏感数据。具体来说，它会剥离笔记标题、内容、修订、历史记录以及一些非系统属性，同时保留整体结构和元数据（例如修改日期）。匿名化之后，数据库会经历一个真空（vacuuming）过程以确保文件中不残留敏感数据。匿名化数据库保存在数据目录（Data directory）内的 anonymized 目录中，可以安全地随错误报告分享。

This will create a copy of your document and remove all sensitive data (currently note titles, contents, revisions, history and some of the options, and non-system attributes) while leaving all structure and metadata (e.g. date of last change). After this is done, the database is VACUUMEd to make sure there's no stale sensitive data in the document file. The resulting file is stored in anonymized directory (placed in the Data directory). You can safely attach it to a bug report. 这将创建你文档的副本并移除所有敏感数据（目前包括笔记标题、内容、修订、历史记录和一些选项，以及非系统属性），同时保留所有结构和元数据（例如最后更改日期）。完成后，数据库会经过VACUUM处理以确保文档文件中没有过时的敏感数据。结果文件存储在 anonymized 目录中（位于数据目录（Data directory）中）。你可以安全地将其附加到错误报告中。

Command Line Anonymization

命令行匿名化

If your database is corrupted to the point where Trilium cannot start, the anonymization process can still be executed via the command line: 如果你的数据库（database）损坏到 Trilium 无法启动的程度，仍然可以通过命令行执行匿名化过程：

node src/anonymize.js

Run this command from the directory containing Trilium's source files, typically found in the resources/app directory for desktop builds. 从包含 Trilium 源文件的目录运行此命令，对于桌面构建，通常位于 resources/app 目录中。

title: Frontend logs(前端日志)
full:
To provide frontend logs, we need to open the Developer Console. Often the easiest way is to press Ctrl-Shift-I which should work in most browsers (and desktop app). Make sure that the error producing action happened right before you copy&paste the errors, the console is cleared on app restart. 要提供前端日志，我们需要打开开发者控制台（Developer Console）。通常最简单的方法是按 Ctrl-Shift-I，这在大多数浏览器（和桌面应用）中应该有效。确保产生错误的行为恰好发生在你复制粘贴错误之前，因为控制台在应用重启时会被清空。

If that doesn't work, then: 如果那不起作用，那么：

  • in Trilium desktop app, go to top-left menu button -> Advanced -> Open Dev Tools
  • In Firefox/Chrome right-click anywhere in the page and click Inspect:
  • 在 Trilium 桌面应用中，转到左上角菜单按钮 -> 高级（Advanced） -> 打开开发者工具（Open Dev Tools）
  • 在 Firefox/Chrome 中，右键单击页面任意位置并点击 检查（Inspect）：

（图片：Firefox 上下文菜单）

Once you have Dev Tools open, click on "Console" tab: 打开开发者工具后，点击 “控制台（Console）” 选项卡：

（图片：控制台日志）

Copy-paste (or screenshots) the logs. It's better to provide not just errors, but the whole log, which might provide context while analyzing the bug. 复制粘贴（或截图）日志。最好不仅提供错误，还要提供整个日志，这可能在分析错误时提供上下文。

title: Creating a custom theme(创建自定义主题)
full:
Step 1. Find a place to place the themes

第 1 步：为主题找一个放置位置

Organization is an important aspect of managing a knowledge base. When developing a new theme or importing an existing one it's a good idea to keep them into one place. 组织化管理是管理知识库的一个重要方面。在开发新主题或导入现有主题时，最好将它们放在一个地方。

As such, the first step is to create a new note to gather all the themes. 因此，第一步是创建一个新笔记来汇集所有主题。

（图片：主题文件夹）

Step 2. Create the theme

第 2 步：创建主题

Step 3. Define the theme's CSS

第 3 步：定义主题的 CSS

As a very simple example we will change the background color of the launcher pane to a shade of blue. 作为一个非常简单的示例，我们将把启动器面板的背景颜色改为蓝色调。

To alter the different variables of the theme: 要更改主题的不同变量：

:root {
	--launcher-pane-background-color: #0d6efd;
}

Step 4. Activating the theme

第 4 步：激活主题

Refresh the application (Ctrl+Shift+R is a good way to do so) and go to settings. You should see the newly created theme: 刷新应用程序（Ctrl+Shift+R 是一个好方法）并转到设置。你应该会看到新创建的主题：

（图片：设置中的主题）

Afterwards the application will refresh itself with the new theme: 之后，应用程序将用新主题自行刷新：

（图片：应用新主题）

Do note that the theme will be based off of the legacy theme. To override that and base the theme on the new TriliumNext theme, see: Theme base (legacy vs. next) 请注意，主题将基于旧版（legacy）主题。要覆盖这一点并使主题基于新的 TriliumNext 主题，请参阅：主题基础（旧版 vs. 新版）

Step 5. Making changes

第 5 步：进行更改

Simply go back to the note and change according to needs. To apply the changes to the current window, press Ctrl+Shift+R to refresh. 只需回到笔记并根据需要进行更改。要将更改应用到当前窗口，请按 Ctrl+Shift+R 刷新。

It's a good idea to keep two windows, one for editing and the other one for previewing the changes. 保持两个窗口是一个好主意，一个用于编辑，另一个用于预览更改。

title: Customize the Next theme(自定义 Next 主题)
full:
By default, any custom theme will be based on the legacy light theme. To use the TriliumNext theme instead, add the #appThemeBase=next attribute onto the existing theme. The appTheme attribute must also be present. 默认情况下，任何自定义主题都基于旧版浅色主题。要改用 TriliumNext 主题，请在现有主题上添加 #appThemeBase=next 属性。appTheme 属性也必须存在。

（图片：设置 Next 主题基础）

The appThemeBase label can be set to one of the following values: appThemeBase 标签可以设置为以下值之一：

  • next, for the TriliumNext (auto light or dark mode).
  • next-light, for the always light mode of the TriliumNext.
  • next-dark, for the always dark mode of the TriliumNext.
  • Any other value is ignored and will use the legacy white theme instead.
  • next，用于 TriliumNext（自动浅色或深色模式）。
  • next-light，用于 TriliumNext 的始终浅色模式。
  • next-dark，用于 TriliumNext 的始终深色模式。
  • 任何其他值将被忽略，并将使用旧版白色主题代替。

Overrides

覆盖

Do note that the TriliumNext theme has a few more overrides than the legacy theme. Due to that, it is recommended to use #trilium-app with a next theme instead of the :root of a legacy theme. 请注意，TriliumNext 主题比旧版主题有更多的覆盖项。因此，建议在 next 主题中使用 #trilium-app 而不是旧版主题的 :root。

#trilium-app {
	--launcher-pane-background-color: #0d6efd;
}

title: Custom app-wide CSS(自定义全局 CSS)
full:
It is possible to provide a CSS file to be used regardless of the theme set by the user. 可以提供一份不受用户设置的主题影响、始终生效的 CSS 文件。

Seeing the changes

查看更改

Adding a new app CSS note or modifying an existing one does not immediately apply changes. To see the changes, press Ctrl+Shift+R to refresh the page first. 添加新的_应用 CSS 笔记（app CSS note）_或修改现有的笔记不会立即应用更改。要查看更改，请先按 Ctrl+Shift+R 刷新页面。

Sample use cases

示例用例

Customizing the printing stylesheet

自定义打印样式表

Since v0.99.2, it's no longer possible to use #appCss to customize the printing CSS, since the printing is now done in an isolated environment.

However, it's still possible to customize the CSS via ~printCss; see Printing & Exporting as PDF for more information. 提示：自 v0.99.2 起，不再可能使用 #appCss 来自定义打印 CSS，因为打印现在在隔离环境中完成。

然而，仍然可以通过 ~printCss 自定义 CSS；有关更多信息，请参阅打印与导出为 PDF（Printing & Exporting as PDF）。

Per-workspace styles

按工作区设置样式

When using Workspaces, it can be helpful to create a visual distinction between notes in different workspaces. 使用工作区（Workspaces）时，在不同工作区的笔记之间创建视觉区分会很有帮助。

To do so: 要做到这一点：

  1. In the note with #workspace, add an inheritable attribute #cssClass(inheritable) with a value that uniquely identifies the workspace (say my-workspace).
  2. Anywhere in the note structure, create a CSS note with #appCss.
  3. 在带有 #workspace 的笔记中，添加一个可继承的属性 #cssClass(inheritable)，其值唯一标识该工作区（比如 my-workspace）。
  4. 在笔记结构中的任何位置，创建一个带有 #appCss 的 CSS 笔记。

Change the color of the icons in the Note Tree

更改笔记树（Note Tree）中图标的颜色

.fancytree-node.my-workspace.fancytree-custom-icon {
    color: #ff0000;
}

Change the color of the note title and the icon

更改笔记标题和图标的颜色

To change the color of the note title and the icon (above the content): 要更改笔记标题和图标的颜色（在内容上方）：

.note-split.my-workspace .note-icon-widget button.note-icon,
.note-split.my-workspace .note-title-widget input.note-title {
    color: #ff0000;
}

Add a watermark to the note content

为笔记内容添加水印

（图片：水印示例）
  1. Insert an image in any note and take the URL of the image.
  2. Use the following CSS, adjusting the background-image and widthand height to the desired values.
  3. 在任意笔记中插入一张图像并获取图像的 URL。
  4. 使用以下 CSS，将 background-image 以及 width 和 height 调整为所需的值。
.note-split.my-workspace .scrolling-container:after {
    position: fixed;
    content: "";
    background-image: url("/api/attachments/Rvm3zJNITQI1/image/logo.png");
    background-size: contain;
    background-position: center;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    width: 237px;
    height: 44px;
    bottom: 1em;
    right: 1em;
    opacity: 0.5;
    z-index: 0;
}

Limitations

限制

Some parts of the application can't be styled directly via custom CSS because they are rendered in an isolated mode (shadow DOM), more specifically: 应用程序的某些部分无法直接通过自定义 CSS 设置样式，因为它们在隔离模式（影子 DOM）中渲染，具体来说：

  • The slides in a Presentation.
  • 演示文稿（Presentation）中的幻灯片。

title: Promoted Attributes(提升属性)
full:
（图片：提升属性示例）

Promoted attributes are attributes which are displayed prominently in the UI which allow them to be easily viewed and edited. 提升属性（Promoted attributes）是属性（attributes）中在 UI 中突出显示、便于查看和编辑的部分。

One way of seeing promoted attributes is as a kind of form with several fields. Each field is just regular attribute, the only difference is that they appear on the note itself. 理解提升属性的一种方式是将其视为带有多个字段的表单。每个字段只是一个普通的属性，唯一的区别是它们直接显示在笔记上。

Attributes can be pretty useful since they allow for querying and script automation etc. but they are also inconveniently hidden. This allows you to select few of the important ones and push them to the front of the user. 属性非常有用，因为它们允许查询和脚本自动化等，但它们也被不方便地隐藏着。提升属性让你选择少数重要的属性并将它们推到用户面前。

Attribute definition

属性定义

（图片：属性定义）

In order to have promoted attributes, there needs to be a way to define them. 为了拥有提升属性，需要有一种方法来定义它们。

Technically, attributes are only name-value pairs where both name and value are strings. 从技术上讲，属性只是名称-值对，其中名称和值都是字符串。

The Attribute definition specifies how should this value be interpreted: _属性定义（Attribute definition）_指定了该值应如何被解释：

  • Is it just string, or is it a date?
  • Should we allow multiple values or note?
  • Should we promote the attribute or not?
  • 它只是字符串，还是日期？
  • 我们应该允许多个值还是一个？
  • 我们应该_提升（promote）_该属性还是不提升？

Types of attributes

属性的类型

Attribute definitions have a dedicated type field which will change how the value will be edited in the promoted attributes section. 属性定义有一个专门的类型字段，它将改变在提升属性部分中编辑值的方式。

The following types are supported: 支持以下类型：

  • Text, the default option which allows any type of text to be edited, similar to normal labels that don't have a type associated.
  • Multi-line text, similar to a normal text field, but rendered in a bigger text box that also supports writing on multiple lines.
  • Number, will display as a number input field with up/down arrows.
    • Optionally a precision which sets how many decimals the value steps by and is displayed with.
  • Boolean, which renders as a checkbox for a true/false value.
  • Select, which provides a list of user-defined options when editing.
    • The list is not fixed, meaning that new options can be easily added from the promoted attribute.
    • Renaming an option does not change the existing values since the value is stored as text. Consider a bulk rename.
    • The items do not have a custom color or icon. This is intentional as selects are meant to be light-weight. For a more customizable option, consider using Relations instead which use notes as items and those notes can be colored and also carry an icon.
  • Date, which provides a date picker.
  • Date & Time, which provides a date & time picker.
  • Time, which provides a time picker.
  • URL, which provides a button to open the web address in a new window.
  • Email, which provides a button to quickly send an email to that address using your operating system's default app.
  • Phone, which provides a button to quickly call that number using your operating system's default app.
  • Color, which provides a color picker and a way to remove the value.
  • Relation, which points to another note and uses Relations instead of Labels.
  • 文本（Text），默认选项，允许编辑任何类型的文本，类似于没有关联类型的普通标签。
  • 多行文本（Multi-line text），类似于普通文本字段，但在更大的文本框中渲染，也支持在多行上书写。
  • 数字（Number），将显示为带有上/下箭头的数字输入字段。
    • 可选地，一个_精度（precision）_设置值以多少位小数为步进并显示。
  • 布尔（Boolean），渲染为真/假值的复选框。
  • 选择（Select），编辑时提供用户自定义选项的列表。
    • 列表不是固定的，意味着可以从提升属性轻松添加新选项。
    • 重命名选项不会改变现有值，因为值以文本形式存储。考虑使用批量重命名（bulk rename）。
    • 项目没有自定义颜色或图标。这是有意为之，因为选择被设计为轻量级。对于更可定制的选项，考虑使用关系（Relations）代替，它使用笔记作为项目，这些笔记可以被着色并携带图标。
  • 日期（Date），提供日期选择器。
  • 日期和时间（Date & Time），提供日期和时间选择器。
  • 时间（Time），提供时间选择器。
  • URL，提供在新窗口中打开网页地址的按钮。
  • 电子邮件（Email），提供使用操作系统默认应用快速向该地址发送电子邮件的按钮。
  • 电话（Phone），提供使用操作系统默认应用快速拨打该号码的按钮。
  • 颜色（Color），提供颜色选择器和移除值的方法。
  • 关系（Relation），指向另一个笔记，并使用关系（Relations）而不是标签（Labels）。

For label-based attributes, these types are not enforced by the attribute system, meaning that changing the type afterwards does not guarantee that the values in it correspond to the type (e.g. turning a text into a number). 注意：对于基于标签的属性，属性系统不会强制执行这些类型，意味着之后更改类型并不能保证其中的值与类型对应（例如将文本变为数字）。

Creating a new promoted attribute definition

创建新的提升属性定义

To create a new promoted attribute: 要创建新的提升属性：

  1. Go to a note.
  2. Go to Owned Attributes in the Ribbon.
  3. Press the + button.
  4. Select either Add new label definition or Add new relation definition.
  5. Select the name which will be name of the label or relation that will be created when the promoted attribute is edited.
  6. Ensure Promoted is checked in order to display it at the top of notes.
  7. Optionally, choose an Alias which will be displayed next to the promoted attribute instead of the attribute name. Generally it's best to choose a "user-friendly" name since it can contain spaces and other characters which are not supported as attribute names.
  8. Check Inheritable to apply it to this note and all its descendants. To keep it only for the current note, un-check it.
  9. Press "Save & Close" to apply the changes.
  10. 转到某个笔记。
  11. 在功能区（Ribbon）中转到_自有属性（Owned Attributes）_。
  12. 按下 + 按钮。
  13. 选择_添加新标签定义（Add new label definition）或_添加新关系定义（Add new relation definition）。
  14. 选择名称，该名称将是编辑提升属性时创建的标签或关系的名称。
  15. 确保勾选_提升（Promoted）_以便在笔记顶部显示。
  16. 可选地，选择一个_别名（Alias）_，它将显示在提升属性旁边而不是属性名称。通常最好选择一个 “用户友好（user-friendly）” 的名称，因为它可以包含属性名称不支持的空格和其他字符。
  17. 勾选_可继承（Inheritable）_以将其应用于此笔记及其所有后代。要仅保留给当前笔记，请取消勾选。
  18. 按 “保存并关闭（Save & Close）” 以应用更改。

How attribute definitions actually work

属性定义实际如何工作

When a new promoted attribute definition is created, it creates a corresponding label prefixed with either label: or relation:, depending on the definition type: 当创建新的提升属性定义时，它会创建一个带有 label: 或 relation: 前缀的相应标签，具体取决于定义类型：

#label:myColor(inheritable)="promoted,alias=Color,multi,color"

The only purpose of the attribute definition is to set up a template. If the attribute was marked as promoted, then it's also displayed to the user for easy editing. 属性定义的唯一目的是建立一个模板。如果属性被标记为提升，那么它也会显示给用户以便于编辑。

So there's one attribute for value and one for definition. But notice how an definition attribute can be made Inheritable, meaning that it's also applied to all descendant notes. In this case, the definition used for the whole sub-tree while "value" attributes are for each note individually. 所以有一个用于值的属性和一个用于定义的属性。但注意定义属性可以设置为可继承（Inheritable），意味着它也应用于所有后代笔记。在这种情况下，定义用于整个子树，而 “值” 属性则用于每个笔记个体。

Using system attributes

使用系统属性

It's possible to create promoted attributes out of system attributes, to be able to easily alter them. 可以基于系统属性创建提升属性，以便轻松更改它们。

Here are a few practical examples: 这里有一些实际示例：

  • Collections already make use of this practice, for example:
    • Calendars add "Start Date", "End Date", "Start Time" and "End Time" as promoted attributes. These map to system attributes such as startDate which are then interpreted by the calendar view.
    • Presentation adds a "Background" promoted attribute for each of the slides to easily be able to customize.
  • The Trilium documentation (which is edited in Trilium) uses a promoted attribute to be able to easily edit the #shareAlias (see Sharing) in order to form clean URLs.
  • If you always edit a particular system attribute such as #color, simply create a promoted attribute for it to make it easier.
  • 集合（Collections）已经使用了这种做法，例如：
    • 日历添加 “开始日期（Start Date）”、“结束日期（End Date）”、“开始时间（Start Time）” 和 “结束时间（End Time）” 作为提升属性。这些映射到诸如 startDate 的系统属性，然后由日历视图解释。
    • 演示文稿（Presentation）为每个幻灯片添加一个 “背景（Background）” 提升属性以便轻松自定义。
  • Trilium 文档（在 Trilium 中编辑）使用提升属性来轻松编辑 #shareAlias（参见分享（Sharing））以形成干净的 URL。
  • 如果你总是编辑某个特定的系统属性（例如 #color），只需为它创建一个提升属性使其更容易。

Inverse relation

反向关系

Some relations always occur in pairs - my favorite example is on the family. If you have a note representing husband and note representing wife, then there might be a relation between those two of isPartnerOf. This is bidirectional relationship - meaning that if a relation is pointing from husband to wife then there should be always another relation pointing from wife to husband. 某些关系总是成对出现——我最喜欢的例子是家庭关系。如果你有一个代表丈夫的笔记和一个代表妻子的笔记，那么这两者之间可能存在一个 isPartnerOf 关系。这是一种双向关系——意味着如果一个关系从丈夫指向妻子，那么应该总是有另一个关系从妻子指向丈夫。

Another example is with parent-child relationship. Again these always occur in pairs, but in this case it's not exact same relation - the one going from parent to child might be called isParentOf and the other one going from child to parent might be called isChildOf. 另一个例子是父子关系。这些也总是成对出现，但在这种情况下它们不是完全相同的关系——从父到子的可能称为 isParentOf，从子到父的可能称为 isChildOf。

Relation definition allows you to specify such "inverse relation" - for the relation you just define you specify which is the inverse relation. Note that in the second example we should have two relation definitions - one for isParentOf which defines isChildOf as inverse relation and then second relation definition for isChildOf which defines isParentOf as inverse relation. 关系定义允许你指定这样的 “反向关系（inverse relation）” —— 为你刚刚定义的关系指定哪个是反向关系。注意在第二个示例中我们应该有两个关系定义——一个用于 isParentOf，将 isChildOf 定义为反向关系，然后第二个关系定义用于 isChildOf，将 isParentOf 定义为反向关系。

What this does internally is that whenever we save a relation which has defined inverse relation, we check that this inverse relation exists on the relation target note. Similarly, when we delete relation, we also delete inverse relation on the target note. 这在内部的作用是，每当我们保存一个定义了反向关系的关系时，我们会检查该反向关系存在于关系目标笔记上。类似地，当我们删除关系时，我们也会删除目标笔记上的反向关系。

See also

另请参阅

  • The Table collection makes heavy use of promoted attributes to define the columns of the table, since they already carry the type information. When made inheritable, it's also easy to change those fields when the child notes are opened.
  • 表格（Table）集合大量使用提升属性来定义表格的列，因为它们已经携带了类型信息。当设置为可继承时，在打开子笔记时也很容易更改这些字段。

title: Templates(模板)
full:
A template in Trilium serves as a predefined structure for other notes, referred to as instance notes. Assigning a template to a note brings three main effects: Trilium 中的模板作为其他笔记（称为实例笔记）的预定义结构。将模板分配给笔记会带来三个主要效果：

  1. Attribute Inheritance: All attributes from the template note are inherited by the instance notes. Even attributes with #isInheritable=false are inherited by the instance notes, although only inheritable attributes are further inherited by the children of the instance notes.
  2. Content Duplication: The content of the template note is copied to the instance note, provided the instance note is empty at the time of template assignment.
  3. Child Note Duplication: All child notes of the template are deep-duplicated to the instance note.
  4. 属性继承（Attribute Inheritance）：模板笔记中的所有属性都被实例笔记继承（inherited）。即使带有 #isInheritable=false 的属性也会被实例笔记继承，尽管只有可继承的属性会被实例笔记的子笔记进一步继承。
  5. 内容复制（Content Duplication）：模板笔记的内容被复制到实例笔记，前提是实例笔记在模板分配时为空。
  6. 子笔记复制（Child Note Duplication）：模板的所有子笔记被深度复制到实例笔记。

Example

示例

A typical example would be a "Book" template note, which might include: 一个典型的示例是 “书（Book）” 模板笔记，它可能包含：

  • Promoted Attributes: Such as publication year, author, etc. (see promoted attributes).
  • Outline: An outline for a book review, including sections like themes, conclusion, etc.
  • Child Notes: Additional notes for highlights, summary, etc.
  • 提升属性（Promoted Attributes）：例如出版年份、作者等（参见提升属性（promoted attributes））。
  • 大纲（Outline）：书评的大纲，包括主题、结论等部分。
  • 子笔记（Child Notes）：用于高亮、摘要等的额外笔记。

（图片：模板示例）

Instance Note

实例笔记

An instance note is a note related to a template note. This relationship means the instance note's content is initialized from the template, and all attributes from the template are inherited. 实例笔记是与模板笔记相关的笔记。这种关系意味着实例笔记的内容从模板初始化，并且模板的所有属性都被继承。

To create an instance note through the UI: 要通过 UI 创建实例笔记：

（图片：显示子笔记模板）

For the template to appear in the menu, the template note must have the #templatelabel. Do not confuse this with the ~template relation, which links the instance note to the template note. If you use workspaces, you can also mark templates with #workspaceTemplate to display them only in the workspace. 要使模板出现在菜单中，模板笔记必须具有 #template 标签。不要将其与 ~template 关系混淆，后者将实例笔记链接到模板笔记。如果你使用工作区（workspaces），你还可以使用 #workspaceTemplate 标记模板，使其仅在工作区中显示。

Templates can also be added or changed after note creation by creating a ~template relation pointing to the desired template note. 模板也可以在笔记创建后通过创建指向所需模板笔记的 ~template 关系来添加或更改。

To specify a template for child notes, you can use a ~child:template relation pointing to the appropriate template note. There is no limit to the depth of the hierarchy — you can use ~child:child:template, ~child:child:child:template, and so on. 要为子笔记指定模板，你可以使用指向适当模板笔记的 ~child:template 关系。层级的深度没有限制——你可以使用 ~child:child:template、~child:child:child:template 等。

Changing the template hierarchy after the parent note is created will not retroactively apply to newly created child notes.
For example, if you initially use ~child:template and later switch to ~child:child:template, it will not automatically apply the new template to the grandchild notes. Only the structure present at the time of note creation is considered. 重要：在父笔记创建后更改模板层级不会追溯应用于新创建的子笔记。
例如，如果你最初使用 ~child:template，后来切换到 ~child:child:template，它不会自动将新模板应用于孙笔记。只有在创建笔记时存在的结构会被考虑。

Regarding note types

关于笔记类型

By default, newly created notes are Text(文本) notes. If a parent note defines a child:template pointing to a template of a different type (e.g. a Code note), the behavior depends on how the new note is created: 默认情况下，新创建的笔记是Text(文本)笔记。如果父笔记定义了一个指向不同类型模板（例如代码笔记）的 child:template，行为取决于新笔记的创建方式：

  • If no note type is explicitly chosen (e.g. the + button in the Note Tree(笔记树)), the template is applied and the new note takes the type and content of the template.
  • If a note type is explicitly selected (e.g. Note Tree(笔记树) → Insert note after / Insert child note):
    • If the selected type matches the template's type, the template is applied.
    • If the selected type differs, the template is disregarded entirely — the new note is an empty note of the selected type.
  • 如果没有显式选择笔记类型（例如Note Tree(笔记树)中的 + 按钮），则应用模板，新笔记采用模板的类型和内容。
  • 如果显式选择了笔记类型（例如Note Tree(笔记树)→ 在后面插入笔记（Insert note after） / 插入子笔记（Insert child note））：
    • 如果所选类型与模板的类型匹配，则应用模板。
    • 如果所选类型不同，则完全忽略模板——新笔记是所选类型的空笔记。

Selecting a specific template from the creation menu always takes precedence over child:template. 从创建菜单中选择特定模板总是优先于 child:template。

Additional Notes

补充说明

From a visual perspective, templates can define #iconClass and #cssClassattributes, allowing all instance notes (e.g., books) to display a specific icon and CSS style. 从视觉角度看，模板可以定义 #iconClass 和 #cssClass 属性，允许所有实例笔记（例如，书籍）显示特定的图标和 CSS 样式。

Explore the concept further in the Demo Notes(演示笔记), including examples like the Relation Map(关系图谱), Task Manager(任务管理器), and Day Notes(日记). 在Demo Notes(演示笔记)中进一步探索这个概念，包括诸如Relation Map(关系图谱)、Task Manager(任务管理器)和Day Notes(日记)等示例。

Additionally, see Default Note Title(默认笔记标题) for creating title templates. Note templates and title templates can be combined by creating a #titleTemplate for a template note. 此外，请参阅Default Note Title(默认笔记标题)以了解创建标题模板。笔记模板和标题模板可以通过为模板笔记创建 #titleTemplate 来组合。

title: Text Snippets(文本片段)
full:
（图片：文本片段按钮）

Text Snippets are closely related to Templates, but instead of defining the content of an entire note, text snippets are pieces of formatted text that can easily be inserted in a text note. 文本片段与模板（Templates）密切相关，但与定义整个笔记的内容不同，文本片段是可以轻松插入到文本笔记中的格式化文本片段。

Creating a text snippet

创建文本片段

In the Note Tree: 在笔记树（Note Tree）中：

  1. Right click a note where to place the text snippet.
  2. Select Insert child note.
  3. Select Text snippet.
  4. 右键单击要放置文本片段的笔记。
  5. 选择_插入子笔记（Insert child note）_。
  6. 选择_文本片段（Text snippet）_。

Afterwards, simply type in the content of the note the desired text. The text can be formatted in the same manner as a normal text note. 之后，只需在笔记内容中输入所需文本。该文本可以像普通文本笔记一样进行格式化。

The title of the note will become the title of the template. Optionally, a description can be added in the Promoted Attributes section. 笔记的标题将成为模板的标题。可选地，可以在提升属性（Promoted Attributes）部分添加描述。

Inserting a snippet

插入片段

Once a snippet is created, there are two options to insert it: 一旦创建了片段，有两种插入选项：

  1. From the Formatting toolbar, by looking for the button.
  2. Using Slash Commands:
    1. To look for a specific template, start typing the name of the template (its title).
    2. To look for all the templates, type template.
  3. 从格式化工具栏（Formatting toolbar）中，寻找 按钮。
  4. 使用斜杠命令（Slash Commands）：
    1. 要查找特定模板，开始输入模板的名称（其标题）。
    2. 要查找所有模板，输入 template。

A newly created snippet doesn't appear? Generally it takes up to a few seconds to refresh the list of templates once you make a change.

If this doesn't happen, reload the application and report the issue to us. 提示：新创建的片段没有出现？通常在你做出更改后，最多需要几秒钟来刷新模板列表。

如果这没有发生，请重新加载应用程序（reload the application）并向我们报告问题（report the issue）。

Limitations

限制

  • Whenever a snippet is created, deleted or its title/description are modified, all the open text notes will need to be refreshed. This causes a slight flash for usually under a second, but it can cause some discomfort.
  • Unlike Templates, the snippets cannot be limited to a particular workspace.
  • 每当创建、删除片段或其标题/描述被修改时，所有打开的文本笔记都需要刷新。这通常会导致不到一秒的轻微闪烁，但可能会引起一些不适。
  • 与模板（Templates）不同，片段不能限制在特定的工作区（workspace）中。

title: Note Map (Link map, Tree map)(笔记图谱（链接图谱、树形图谱）)
full:
Note map is a visualization of connections between notes. This provides an insight into a structure ("web") of notes. 笔记地图（Note map）是笔记之间连接的可视化。这提供了对笔记结构（“网络”）的洞察。

There are two types of note map: 有两种类型的笔记地图：

  • Link Map, which shows relations between notes.
  • Note Map, which shows the hierarchical tree structure.
  • 链接地图（Link Map），显示笔记之间的关系。
  • 笔记地图（Note Map），显示层级树结构。

Accessing the note map

访问笔记地图

The note map comes into multiple flavors: 笔记地图有多种形式：

  • To access the note map for the current note:
    • On the New Layout, the note map is available in the Connections tab in the Right Sidebar.
    • On the old layout, the note map is a tab in the Ribbon.
  • To display a full-screen note map, there is a dedicated note type with the same name.
  • To view the global note map (of all the notes in the knowledge base), there is a dedicated Note map button in the Launch Bar.
  • 要访问当前笔记的笔记地图：
    • 在新布局（New Layout）中，笔记地图可在右侧边栏（Right Sidebar）的连接（Connections）选项卡中找到。
    • 在旧布局中，笔记地图是功能区（Ribbon）中的一个选项卡。
  • 要显示全屏笔记地图，有一个同名的专用笔记类型（dedicated note type）。
  • 要查看全局笔记地图（知识库中所有笔记的），在启动栏（Launch Bar）中有一个专用的_笔记地图（Note map）_按钮。

Terminology and structure

术语和结构

  • Each note is represented as a node in the graph, with the title displayed underneath.
    • When the map is zoomed out, the title can still be viewed by hovering over the node.
    • The icon and color of the note are respected.
  • The root node is the reference point for which the relations and hierarchical structure are displayed.
    • When accessing the note map through the Ribbon or the Right Sidebar (new layout), the root node is the current note.
    • When using a dedicated Note Map note, the root note can be either the parent note, the currently hoisted note or a specific note. See the note type documentation for more information.
  • 每个笔记在图中表示为一个_节点（node）_，标题显示在下方。
    • 当地图缩小后，仍可通过悬停在节点上来查看标题。
    • 笔记的图标和颜色（icon and color）会被尊重。
  • 根节点是显示关系和层级结构的参考点。
    • 当通过功能区（Ribbon）或右侧边栏（Right Sidebar）（新布局）访问笔记地图时，根节点是当前笔记。
    • 当使用专用的笔记地图（Note Map）笔记时，根笔记可以是父笔记、当前提升（hoisted）的笔记或特定笔记。有关更多信息，请参阅笔记类型文档。

Interaction

交互

  • Nodes can be dragged around, but they will return to their original position once released.
    • To have the notes remain in the same position as they were dragged, press the Fix nodes button. The position of the notes is not saved, so it will return to normal once you navigate to another note or restart the application.
  • When hovering over a node, the adjacent relations and nodes are highlighted.
  • The distance between nodes can be adjusted via the slider in the bottom-left. Similarly, this value is not saved.
  • Archived Notes are generally ignored by the note map in order to reduce clutter. There is one exception: if the root note is also archived, then all archived notes are displayed too.
  • 节点可以四处拖动，但一旦释放它们将返回原始位置。
    • 要使笔记保持在拖动时的位置，请按_固定节点（Fix nodes）_按钮。笔记的位置不会被保存，因此一旦你导航到另一个笔记或重启应用程序，它就会恢复正常。
  • 当悬停在节点上时，相邻的关系和节点会被高亮。
  • 节点之间的距离可以通过左下角的滑块调整。同样，此值不会被保存。
  • 已归档笔记（Archived Notes）通常被笔记地图忽略以减少杂乱。有一个例外：如果根笔记也被归档，那么所有已归档的笔记也会显示。

Link Map

链接地图

（图片：链接地图）

The link map is a visualization of links and Relations incoming to and outgoing from a particular note. 链接地图是进入和离开特定笔记的链接和关系（Relations）的可视化。

The map indicates the following types of relations: 该地图指示以下类型的关系：

  • Internal (reference) links between notes.
  • Relations
  • 笔记之间的内部（引用）链接（Internal (reference) links）。
  • 关系（Relations）

The link map will also show unlinked notes that are part of the hierarchy as a cloud of unconnected dots. On the New Layout, the sidebar deliberately omits this in order to save some space, but they will be revealed once the map is maximized. 链接地图还会将层级中未链接的笔记显示为一团未连接的点。在新布局（New Layout）中，侧边栏为了节省空间特意省略了这一点，但一旦地图最大化，它们就会被显示。

Tree Map

树地图

Shows hierarchical map of notes: 显示笔记的层级地图：

（图片：树地图）

See also

另请参阅

  • Apart from the note map feature which can be accessed from any note, it is also possible to create a dedicated note which will display the relations in full screen. See Note Map for more information.
  • Relation Map is a similar concept, with some differences:
    • note map is automatically generated while relation map must be created manually
    • relation map is a type of note while a link map is just virtual visualization
  • 除了可从任何笔记访问的笔记地图功能外，还可以创建一个专用笔记，以全屏显示关系。有关更多信息，请参阅笔记地图（Note Map）。
  • 关系图（Relation Map）是一个类似的概念，但有一些不同：
    • 笔记地图是自动生成的，而关系图必须手动创建
    • 关系图是一种笔记类型，而链接地图只是虚拟可视化

title: Serving directly the content of a note(直接提供笔记内容)
imgs: 1_Serving directly the content of a note_image.png
full:
When accessing a shared note, Trilium will render it as a web page. Sometimes it's desirable to serve the content directly so that it can be used in a script or downloaded by the user. 当访问共享笔记时，Trilium 会将其渲染为网页。有时希望直接提供内容，以便在脚本中使用或由用户下载。

By adding an attribute to the note

通过向笔记添加属性

Simply add the #shareRaw attribute and the note will always be rendered raw when 只需添加 #shareRaw 属性，该笔记在以下情况将始终以_原始（raw）_格式渲染

title: Day Notes(日记)
full:
A common pattern in note-taking is that a lot of notes will be centered around a certain date - e.g. you have some tasks which needs to be done on a certain date, you have meeting minutes from a certain date, you have your thoughts etc. and it all revolves around a date on which they occurred. For this reason, it makes sense to create a certain "day workspace" which will centralize all those notes relevant for a certain date. 在笔记记录中一个常见的模式是，许多笔记会围绕某个特定日期——例如，你有一些需要在某天完成的任务，你有某天的会议记录，你有你的想法等等，它们都围绕发生它们的日期展开。因此，创建一个“日工作区（day workspace）”来集中某个特定日期的所有相关笔记是有意义的。

For this, Trilium provides a concept of "day note". Trilium semi-automatically generates a single note for each day. Under this note you can save all those relevant notes. 为此，Trilium 提供了一个“日笔记（day note）”的概念。Trilium 半自动地为每天生成一个单独的笔记。在这个笔记下你可以保存所有那些相关笔记。

Select an existing day note, and the menu bar contains a calendar widget. Select any day to create a note for that day. 选择一个现有的日笔记，菜单栏包含一个日历小部件。选择任意一天来为那一天创建笔记。

（图片：日笔记）

This pattern works well also because of Cloning Notes functionality - note can appear in multiple places in the note tree, so besides appearing under day note, it can also be categorized into other notes. 这种模式之所以运行良好，也是因为克隆笔记（Cloning Notes）功能——笔记可以出现在笔记树的多个位置，因此除了出现在日笔记下，它还可以被归类到其他笔记中。

Demo

演示

（图片：日笔记演示）

You can see the structure of day notes appearing under "Journal" note - there's a note for the whole year 2025, under it, you have "03 - March" which then contains "09 - Monday". This is our "day note" which contains some text in its content and also has some child notes (some of them are from Task manager). 你可以看到出现在 “日志（Journal）” 笔记下的日笔记结构——有一个覆盖整个 2025 年的笔记，在其下有 “03 - March（三月）”，其中又包含 “09 - Monday（周一）”。这就是我们的 “日笔记”，它内容中有一些文本，也有一些子笔记（其中一些来自任务管理器（Task manager））。

You can also notice how this day note has promoted attribute "weight" where you can track your daily weight. This data is then used in Weight tracker. 你还可以注意到这个日笔记有一个提升属性（promoted attribute） “weight（体重）”，你可以在其中追踪你的每日体重。这些数据随后被用于体重追踪器（Weight tracker）。

Week Note and Quarter Note

周笔记和季度笔记

Week and quarter notes are disabled by default, since it might be too much for some people. To enable them, you need to set #enableWeekNote and #enableQuarterNoteattributes on the root calendar note, which is identified by the #calendarRoot label. Week note is affected by the first week of year option. Be careful when you already have some week notes created, it will not automatically change the existing week notes and might lead to some duplicates. 周笔记和季度笔记默认是禁用的，因为对某些人来说可能太多。要启用它们，你需要在根日历笔记上设置 #enableWeekNote 和 #enableQuarterNote 属性，该根日历笔记由 #calendarRoot 标签标识。周笔记受一年中第一周选项的影响。当你已经创建了一些周笔记时要小心，它不会自动更改现有的周笔记，并且可能导致一些重复。

Templates

模板

Trilium provides template functionality, and it could be used together with day notes. Trilium 提供模板（template）功能，它可以与日笔记一起使用。

You can define one of the following relations on the root of the journal (identified by #calendarRoot label): 你可以在日志的根上定义以下关系之一（由 #calendarRoot 标签标识）：

  • yearTemplate / 年模板（yearTemplate）
  • quarterTemplate (if #enableQuarterNote is set) / 季度模板（quarterTemplate）（如果设置了 #enableQuarterNote）
  • monthTemplate / 月模板（monthTemplate）
  • weekTemplate (if #enableWeekNote is set) / 周模板（weekTemplate）（如果设置了 #enableWeekNote）
  • dateTemplate / 日期模板（dateTemplate）

All of these are relations. When Trilium creates a new note for year or month or date, it will take a look at the root and attach a corresponding ~templaterelation to the newly created role. Using this, you can e.g. create your daily template with e.g. checkboxes for daily routine etc. 所有这些都是关系。当 Trilium 为年、月或日期创建新笔记时，它会查看根并为新创建的角色附加相应的 ~template 关系。利用这一点，你可以例如创建你的每日模板，比如带有日常例程的复选框等。

Migrate from old template usage

从旧模板用法迁移

If you have been using Journal prior to version v0.93.0, the previous template pattern likely used was ~child:template=.
To transition to the new system: 如果你在 v0.93.0 版本之前一直在使用日志（Journal），以前使用的模板模式很可能是 ~child:template=。 要过渡到新系统：

  1. Set up the new template pattern in the Calendar root note.
  2. Use Bulk Actions to remove child:template and child:child:templatefrom all notes under the Journal (calendar root).
  3. Ensure that all old template patterns are fully removed to prevent conflicts with the new setup.
  4. 在日历根笔记中设置新的模板模式。
  5. 使用批量操作（Bulk Actions）从日志（日历根）下的所有笔记中移除 child:template 和 child:child:template。
  6. 确保所有旧模板模式被完全移除，以防止与新设置冲突。

Naming pattern

命名模式

You can customize the title of generated journal notes by defining a #datePattern, #weekPattern, #monthPattern, #quarterPattern and #yearPatternattribute on a root calendar note (identified by #calendarRootlabel). The naming pattern replacements follow a level-up compatibility - each level can use replacements from itself and all levels above it. For example, #monthPattern can use month, quarter and year replacements, while #weekPattern can use week, month, quarter and year replacements. But it is not possible to use week replacements in #monthPattern. 你可以通过在根日历笔记（由 #calendarRoot 标签标识）上定义 #datePattern、#weekPattern、#monthPattern、#quarterPattern 和 #yearPattern 属性来自定义生成的日志笔记标题。命名模式替换遵循逐级向上兼容——每一级可以使用来自其自身及其以上所有级别的替换。例如，#monthPattern 可以使用月份、季度和年份替换，而 #weekPattern 可以使用周、月、季度和年替换。但在 #monthPattern 中不可能使用周替换。

Date pattern

日期模式

It's possible to customize the title of generated date notes by defining a #datePattern attribute on a root calendar note (identified by #calendarRoot label). Following are possible values: 可以通过在根日历笔记（由 #calendarRoot 标签标识）上定义 #datePattern 属性来自定义生成的日期笔记标题。以下是可能的值：

  • {isoDate} results in an ISO 8061 formatted date (e.g. "2025-03-09" for March 9, 2025)
  • {dateNumber} results in a number like 9for the 9th day of the month, 11 for the 11th day of the month
  • {dateNumberPadded} results in a number like 09 for the 9th day of the month, 11for the 11th day of the month
  • {ordinal} is replaced with the ordinal date (e.g. 1st, 2nd, 3rd) etc.
  • {weekDay} results in the full day name (e.g. Monday)
  • {weekDay3} is replaced with the first 3 letters of the day, e.g. Mon, Tue, etc.
  • {weekDay2} is replaced with the first 2 letters of the day, e.g. Mo, Tu, etc.
  • {isoDate} 产生 ISO 8061 格式的日期（例如 2025 年 3 月 9 日为 "2025-03-09"）
  • {dateNumber} 产生一个数字，如该月第 9 天为 9，第 11 天为 11
  • {dateNumberPadded} 产生一个数字，如该月第 9 天为 09，第 11 天为 11
  • {ordinal} 被替换为序数日期（例如 1st、2nd、3rd）等
  • {weekDay} 产生完整的星期名称（例如 Monday）
  • {weekDay3} 被替换为星期的前 3 个字母，例如 Mon、Tue 等
  • {weekDay2} 被替换为星期的前 2 个字母，例如 Mo、Tu 等

The default is {dateNumberPadded} - {weekDay} 默认值为 {dateNumberPadded} - {weekDay}

Week pattern

周模式

It is also possible to customize the title of generated week notes through the #weekPattern attribute on the root calendar note. The options are: 也可以通过根日历笔记上的 #weekPattern 属性自定义生成的周笔记标题。选项是：

  • {weekNumber} results in a number like 9for the 9th week of the year, 11 for the 11th week of the year
  • {weekNumberPadded} results in a number like 09 for the 9th week of the year, 11for the 11th week of the year
  • {shortWeek} results in a short week string like W9 for the 9th week of the year, W11 for the 11th week of the year
  • {shortWeek3} results in a short week string like W09 for the 9th week of the year, W11 for the 11th week of the year
  • {weekNumber} 产生一个数字，如一年中第 9 周为 9，第 11 周为 11
  • {weekNumberPadded} 产生一个数字，如一年中第 9 周为 09，第 11 周为 11
  • {shortWeek} 产生一个简短的周字符串，如一年中第 9 周为 W9，第 11 周为 W11
  • {shortWeek3} 产生一个简短的周字符串，如一年中第 9 周为 W09，第 11 周为 W11

The default is Week {weekNumber} 默认值为 Week {weekNumber}

Month pattern

月模式

It is also possible to customize the title of generated month notes through the #monthPattern attribute on the root calendar note. The options are: 也可以通过根日历笔记上的 #monthPattern 属性自定义生成的月笔记标题。选项是：

  • {isoMonth} results in an ISO 8061 formatted month (e.g. "2025-03" for March 2025)
  • {monthNumber} results in a number like 9for September, and 11 for November
  • {monthNumberPadded} results in a number like 09 for September, and 11 for November
  • {month} results in the full month name (e.g. September or October)
  • {shortMonth3} is replaced with the first 3 letters of the month, e.g. Jan, Feb, etc.
  • {shortMonth4} is replaced with the first 4 letters of the month, e.g. Sept, Octo, etc.
  • {isoMonth} 产生 ISO 8061 格式的月份（例如 2025 年 3 月为 "2025-03"）
  • {monthNumber} 产生一个数字，如 9 月为 9，11 月为 11
  • {monthNumberPadded} 产生一个数字，如 9 月为 09，11 月为 11
  • {month} 产生完整的月份名称（例如 September 或 October）
  • {shortMonth3} 被替换为月份的前 3 个字母，例如 Jan、Feb 等
  • {shortMonth4} 被替换为月份的前 4 个字母，例如 Sept、Octo 等

The default is {monthNumberPadded} - {month} 默认值为 {monthNumberPadded} - {month}

Quarter pattern

季度模式

It is also possible to customize the title of generated quarter notes through the #quarterPattern attribute on the root calendar note. The options are: 也可以通过根日历笔记上的 #quarterPattern 属性自定义生成的季度笔记标题。选项是：

  • {quarterNumber} results in a number like 1for the 1st quarter of the year
  • {shortQuarter} results in a short quarter string like Q1 for the 1st quarter of the year
  • {quarterNumber} 产生一个数字，如一年中第 1 季度为 1
  • {shortQuarter} 产生一个简短的季度字符串，如一年中第 1 季度为 Q1

The default is Quarter {quarterNumber} 默认值为 Quarter {quarterNumber}

Year pattern

年模式

It is also possible to customize the title of generated year notes through the #yearPattern attribute on the root calendar note. The options are: 也可以通过根日历笔记上的 #yearPattern 属性自定义生成的年笔记标题。选项是：

  • {year} results in the full year (e.g. 2025)
  • {year} 产生完整的年份（例如 2025）

The default is {year} 默认值为 {year}

Implementation

实现

Trilium has some special support for day notes in the form of backend Script API - see e.g. getDayNote() function. Trilium 以后端脚本 API（backend Script API）的形式对日笔记有一些特殊支持——例如参见 getDayNote() 函数。

Day (and year, month) notes are created with a label - e.g. #dateNote="2025-03-09" this can then be used by other scripts to add new notes to day note etc. 日（以及年、月）笔记创建时带有一个标签——例如 #dateNote="2025-03-09"，这随后可以被其他脚本用来向日笔记添加新笔记等。

title: Weight Tracker(体重记录)
full:
（图片：体重追踪器）

The Weight Tracker is a Script API showcase presented in the demo notes. 体重追踪器（Weight Tracker） 是在演示笔记（demo notes）中展示的脚本 API（Script API）案例。

By adding weight as a promoted attribute in the template from which day notes are created, you can aggregate the data and plot weight change over time. 通过在用于创建日笔记（day notes）的模板（template）中将 weight 添加为提升属性（promoted attribute），你可以聚合数据并绘制体重随时间的变化。

Implementation

实现

The Weight Tracker note in the screenshot above is of the type Render Note. That type of note doesn't have any useful content itself. Instead it is a placeholder where a script can render its output. 上面截图中的 体重追踪器（Weight Tracker） 笔记是 渲染笔记（Render Note） 类型。这种类型的笔记本身没有任何有用的内容。相反，它是一个占位符，脚本（script）可以在其中渲染其输出。

Scripts for Render Notes are defined in a relation called ~renderNote. In this example, it's the Weight Tracker's child Implementation. The Implementation consists of two code notes that contain some HTML and JavaScript respectively, which load all the notes with a weightattribute and display their values in a chart. 渲染笔记（Render Notes） 的脚本在名为 ~renderNote 的关系（relation）中定义。在这个例子中，它是 体重追踪器（Weight Tracker） 的子笔记 实现（Implementation）。实现由两个代码笔记（code notes）组成，分别包含一些 HTML 和 JavaScript，它们加载所有带有 weight 属性的笔记并在图表中显示它们的值。

To actually render the chart, we're using a third party library called chart.jswhich is imported as an attachment, since it's not built into Trilium. 为了实际渲染图表，我们使用一个名为 chart.js 的第三方库，它作为附件导入，因为它不是 Trilium 内置的。

Code

代码

Here's the content of the script which is placed in a code note of type JS Frontend: 以下是放置在类型为 JS Frontend（JS 前端） 的代码笔记（code note）中的脚本内容：

async function getChartData() {
    const days = await api.runOnBackend(async () => {
        const notes = api.getNotesWithLabel('weight');
        const days = [];

        for (const note of notes) {
            const date = note.getLabelValue('dateNote');
            const weight = parseFloat(note.getLabelValue('weight'));

            if (date && weight) {
                days.push({ date, weight });
            }
        }

        days.sort((a, b) => a.date > b.date ? 1 : -1);

        return days;
    });

    const datasets = [
        {
            label: "Weight (kg)",
            backgroundColor: 'red',
            borderColor: 'red',
            data: days.map(day => day.weight),
            fill: false,
            spanGaps: true,
            datalabels: {
                display: false
            }
        }
    ];

    return {
        datasets: datasets,
        labels: days.map(day => day.date)
    };
}

const ctx = $("#canvas")[0].getContext("2d");

new chartjs.Chart(ctx, {
    type: 'line',
    data: await getChartData()
});

How to remove the Weight Tracker button from the top bar

如何从顶栏移除体重追踪器按钮

In the link map of the Weight Tracker, there is a note called Button. Open it and delete or comment out its contents. The Weight Tracker button will disappear after you restart Trilium. 在 体重追踪器（Weight Tracker） 的链接地图中，有一个名为 Button（按钮） 的笔记。打开它并删除或注释掉其内容。体重追踪器（Weight Tracker） 按钮将在你重启 Trilium 后消失。

title: Task Manager(任务管理器)
full:
Task Manager is a promoted attributes and scriptsshowcase presented in the demo notes. 任务管理器（Task Manager）是在演示笔记（demo notes）中展示的提升属性（promoted attributes）和脚本（scripts）案例。

Demo

演示

（图片：任务管理器）

Task Manager manages outstanding (TODO) tasks and finished tasks (non-empty doneDate attribute). Outstanding tasks are further categorized by location and arbinary tags - whenever you change tag attribute in the task note, this task is then automatically moved to appropriate location. 任务管理器（Task Manager）管理未完成（TODO）任务和已完成任务（非空的 doneDate 属性）。未完成的任务进一步按地点和任意标签分类——每当你在任务笔记中更改标签属性，该任务就会被自动移动到适当的位置。

Task Manager also integrates with day notes - notes are cloned into day note to both todoDate note and doneDate note (with prefix of either "TODO" or "DONE"). 任务管理器（Task Manager）还与日笔记（day notes）集成——笔记被克隆（cloned）到日笔记中，同时进入 todoDate 笔记和 doneDate 笔记（带有 “TODO” 或 “DONE” 的前缀（prefix））。

Implementation

实现

New tasks are created in the TODO note which has ~child:template relation(see attribute inheritanc) pointing to the task template. 新任务在 TODO 笔记中创建，该笔记具有指向任务模板的 ~child:template 关系（relation）（参见属性继承（attribute inheritanc））。

Attributes

属性

Task template defines several promoted attributes - todoDate, doneDate, tags, location. Importantly it also defines ~runOnAttributeChanged relation - event handler which is run on attribute change. This script handles when e.g. we fill out the doneDate attribute - meaning the task is done and should be moved to "Done" note and removed from TODO, locations and tags. 任务模板定义了几个提升属性（promoted attributes）——todoDate、doneDate、tags、location。重要的是它还定义了 ~runOnAttributeChanged 关系——在属性更改时运行的事件（event）处理器。这个脚本（script）处理例如当我们填写 doneDate 属性时——意味着任务已完成，应该被移动到 “Done（已完成）” 笔记并从 TODO、locations 和 tags 中移除。

New task button

新建任务按钮

There's also "button" note which contains simple script which adds a button to create new note (task) in the TODO note. 还有一个 “button（按钮）” 笔记，包含一个简单的脚本，它添加一个按钮以在 TODO 笔记中创建新笔记（任务）。

api.addButtonToToolbar({
    title: 'New task',
    icon: 'check',
    shortcut: 'alt+n',
    action: async () => {
        // creating notes is backend (server) responsibility so we need to pass
        // the control there
        const taskNoteId = await api.runOnBackend(async () => {
            const todoRootNote = await api.getNoteWithLabel('taskTodoRoot');
            const {note} = await api.createNote(todoRootNote.noteId, 'new task', '');

            return note.noteId;
        });

        // we got an ID of newly created note and we want to immediately display it
        await api.activateNewNote(taskNoteId);
    }
});

（注释译文：创建笔记是后端（服务器）的责任，所以我们需要把控制权传递过去） （注释译文：我们得到了新创建笔记的 ID，并且我们希望立即显示它）

CSS

CSS

In the demo screenshot above you may notice that TODO tasks are in red color and DONE tasks are green. 在上面的演示截图中你可能会注意到 TODO 任务是红色，而 DONE 任务是绿色。

This is done by having this CSS code note which defines extra CSS classes: 这是通过拥有这个定义额外 CSS 类的 CSS 代码笔记（code note）来实现的：

span.fancytree-node.todo .fancytree-title {
    color: red !important;
}

span.fancytree-node.done .fancytree-title {
    color: green !important;
}

This code note has #appCss labelwhich is recognized by Trilium on startup and loaded as CSS into the application. 这个代码笔记（code note）有 #appCss 标签（label），它被 Trilium 在启动时识别并作为 CSS 加载到应用程序中。

Second part of this functionality is based in event handler described above which assigns #cssClass label to the task to either "done" or "todo" based on the task status. 此功能的第二部分基于上面描述的事件处理器，它根据任务状态为任务分配 #cssClass 标签为 “done” 或 “todo”。

title: SQL Console(SQL 控制台)
full:
Starting with v0.104.0, backend scripts are disabled by default to reduce the attack surface. See Security for more information. 重要：从 v0.104.0 开始，后端脚本默认被禁用以减少攻击面。有关更多信息，请参阅安全（Security）。

The SQL Console is Trilium's built-in database editor. SQL 控制台（SQL Console）是 Trilium 的内置数据库编辑器。

It can be accessed by going to the Global menu → Advanced → Open SQL Console. 可以通过前往全局菜单（Global menu） → 高级（Advanced） → 打开 SQL 控制台（Open SQL Console）来访问它。

（图片：SQL 控制台）

Interaction

交互

  • Hovering the mouse over one of the tables listed at the top of the document will show the columns and their data types.
  • Only one SQL statement can be run at once.
  • To run the statement, press the Execute icon.
  • For queries that return a result, the data will displayed in a table.
  • For statements (e.g. INSERT, UPDATE), the number of affected rows is displayed.
  • 将鼠标悬停在文档顶部列出的其中一个表上，将显示列及其数据类型。
  • 一次只能运行一条 SQL 语句。
  • 要运行该语句，请按_执行（Execute）_图标。
  • 对于返回结果的查询，数据将显示在表格中。
  • 对于语句（例如 INSERT、UPDATE），显示受影响的行数。
（图片：SQL 控制台结果）

Interacting with the table

与表格交互

After executing a query, a table with the results will be displayed: 执行查询后，将显示包含结果的表格：

  • Clicking on a column allows sorting ascending or descending.
  • Underneath each column there is an input field which allows filtering by text.
  • Press Ctrl+C to copy the current cell to clipboard.
  • Multiple cells can be selected by dragging or by holding Shift + arrow keys
  • Results are paginated for performance reasons. The controls at the bottom of the table can be used to navigate through pages.
  • 点击列允许按升序或降序排序。
  • 每列下方有一个输入字段，允许按文本过滤。
  • 按 Ctrl+C 将当前单元格复制到剪贴板。
  • 可以通过拖动或按住 Shift + 方向键选择多个单元格。
  • 出于性能原因，结果被分页。表格底部的控件可用于浏览页面。

Saved SQL console

保存的 SQL 控制台

SQL queries or commands can be saved into a dedicated note. SQL 查询或命令可以保存到专用笔记中。

To do so, simply write the query and press the button. Once saved, the note will appear in Day Notes by default. It is possible to change the default location of saved queries by assigning a #sqlConsoleHome label. 要做到这一点，只需编写查询并按 按钮。（图片：保存按钮）保存后，笔记将默认出现在日笔记（Day Notes）中。可以通过分配 #sqlConsoleHome 标签（label）来更改已保存查询的默认位置。

The note can be locked for editing by pressing the Lock button in the note actions section near the title bar (on the New Layout, or in the Floating buttons area if using the old layout). When editing is locked, the SQL statement is hidden from view. 可以通过按标题栏附近笔记操作部分中的_锁定（Lock）_按钮来锁定笔记以进行编辑（在新布局（New Layout）上，或者如果使用旧布局则在浮动按钮（Floating buttons）区域）。当编辑被锁定时，SQL 语句从视图中隐藏。

title: Bulk Actions(批量操作)
full:
（图片：批量操作）

The Bulk Actions dialog makes it easy to apply changes to multiple notes at once, ranging from simple actions such as adding or removing a label to being executing custom scripts. _批量操作（Bulk Actions）_对话框使一次性将更改应用于多个笔记变得容易，范围从诸如添加或删除标签之类的简单操作到执行自定义脚本。

Interaction

交互

  • The first step is to select the notes in the Note Tree. It's possible to apply bulk actions to:
    • A single note (and potentially its child notes) simply by clicking on it (with a left click or a right click).
    • Multiple notes. See Multiple selection on how to do so.
  • Right click in the Note Tree and select Advanced → Apply bulk actions.
  • By default, only the selected notes will be affected. To also include all the descendants of the notes, check Include descendants of the selected notes. The number of affected notes at the top of the dialog will update to reflect the change.
  • Click on which action to apply from the Available actions section. A detailed description of each is available in the next section.
    • For each action selected, the Chosen actions section will update to reveal the entry. Each action will have its own configuration.
    • To remove an action, simply press the X button to the right of it.
    • It is possible to apply multiple actions of the same type, such as adding multiple types.
  • When all the actions are defined, press Execute bulk actions to trigger all of them at once.
  • For convenience, the last bulk action configuration is saved for further use and will be restored when entering the dialog again.
  • 第一步是在笔记树（Note Tree）中选择笔记。可以将批量操作应用于：
    • 单个笔记（以及可能的其子笔记），只需单击它（左键单击或右键单击）。
    • 多个笔记。参见多选（Multiple selection）了解如何操作。
  • 在笔记树（Note Tree）中右键单击并选择_高级（Advanced）_ → 应用批量操作（Apply bulk actions）。
  • 默认情况下，只有选中的笔记会受影响。要同时包含笔记的所有后代，请勾选_包括所选笔记的后代（Include descendants of the selected notes）_。对话框顶部的受影响笔记数将更新以反映更改。
  • 从_可用操作（Available actions）_部分点击要应用的操作。下一节中提供了每个操作的详细描述。
    • 对于每个选中的操作，_已选操作（Chosen actions）_部分将更新以显示该条目。每个操作都有自己的配置。
    • 要移除操作，只需按其右侧的 X 按钮。
    • 可以应用多个相同类型的操作，例如添加多个类型。
  • 当所有操作都定义好后，按_执行批量操作（Execute bulk actions）_一次性触发所有操作。
  • 为方便起见，最后的批量操作配置会被保存以供进一步使用，并在再次进入对话框时恢复。

Actions

操作

Labels

标签

These actions operate the Labels of a note: 这些操作处理笔记的标签（Labels）：

  • Add label / 添加标签
    • For each note, if it doesn't already have a label of the given name, it will create it. Keep the New value field empty to create a label without a value, or complete it to assign a value.
    • If a note already has this label, its value will be updated.
    • 对于每个笔记，如果它还没有给定名称的标签（label），它将被创建。保持_新值（New value）_字段为空以创建没有值的标签，或填写它来分配一个值。
    • 如果笔记已经有此标签，其值将被更新。
  • Update label value / 更新标签值
    • For each note, if it has a label of the given name, it will change its value to the specified one. Leave New value field empty to create a label without a value.
    • Notes without the label will not be affected.
    • 对于每个笔记，如果它有给定名称的标签（label），它将把其值更改为指定的值。将_新值（New value）_字段留空以创建没有值的标签。
    • 没有该标签的笔记将不受影响。
  • Rename label / 重命名标签
    • For each note, if it has a label of the given name, it will be renamed/replaced with a label of the new name. The value of the label (if present) will be kept intact.
    • Notes without the label will not be affected.
    • 对于每个笔记，如果它有给定名称的标签（label），它将被重命名/替换为新名称的标签。标签的值（如果存在）将保持不变。
    • 没有该标签的笔记将不受影响。
  • Delete label / 删除标签
    • For each note, if it has a label of a given name, it will be deleted (regardless of whether it has a value or not).
    • Notes without the label will not be affected.
    • 对于每个笔记，如果它有给定名称的标签，它将被删除（无论它是否有值）。
    • 没有该标签的笔记将不受影响。

Relations

关系

These actions operate the Relations of a note: 这些操作处理笔记的关系（Relations）：

  • Add relation / 添加关系
    • For each note, it will create a relation pointing to the given note.
    • Notes without this relation will not be affected.
    • 对于每个笔记，它将创建一个指向给定笔记的关系。
    • 没有此关系的笔记将不受影响。
  • Update relation target / 更新关系目标
    • For each note, it will modify a relation to point to the newly given note.
    • Notes without this relation will not be affected.
    • 对于每个笔记，它将修改一个关系以指向新给定的笔记。
    • 没有此关系的笔记将不受影响。
  • Rename relation / 重命名关系
    • For each note, if it has a relation of the given name, it will be renamed/replaced with a relation of the new name. The target note of the relation will be kept intact.
    • Notes without this relation will not be affected.
    • 对于每个笔记，如果它有给定名称的关系，它将被重命名/替换为新名称的关系。关系的目标笔记将保持不变。
    • 没有此关系的笔记将不受影响。
  • Delete relation / 删除关系
    • For each note, if it has a relation of the given name, it will be deleted.
    • Notes without this relation will not be affected.
    • 对于每个笔记，如果它有给定名称的关系，它将被删除。
    • 没有此关系的笔记将不受影响。

Notes

笔记

  • Rename note / 重命名笔记
    • For each note, it will change the title of the note to the given one.
    • As a more advanced use case, the note can be a "template string" which allows for dynamic values with access to the note information via FNote, for example:
      • NEW: ${note.title} will prefix all notes with NEW: .
      • ${note.dateCreatedObj.format('MM-DD:')}: ${note.title} will prefix the note titles with each note's creation date (in month-day format).
    • 对于每个笔记，它将把笔记标题更改为给定的标题。
    • 作为更高级的用例，笔记可以是一个 “模板字符串（template string）”，允许通过 FNote 访问笔记信息以使用动态值，例如：
      • NEW: ${note.title} 将给所有笔记加上 NEW: 前缀。
      • ${note.dateCreatedObj.format('MM-DD:')}: ${note.title} 将给笔记标题加上每个笔记的创建日期（以月-日格式）前缀。
  • Move note / 移动笔记
    • For each note, it will be moved to the specified parent note.
    • As an alternative for less complex situations, the notes can be moved directly from within the Note Tree via cut → paste or via the contextual menu.
    • 对于每个笔记，它将被移动到指定的父笔记。
    • 作为较简单情况的替代方案，笔记可以通过剪切 → 粘贴或通过上下文菜单直接从笔记树（Note Tree）内移动。
  • Convert note / 转换笔记
    • This allows a note to be converted from one type to another:
      • Text Notes → Markdown Notes — each Text note is converted to a Markdown note. Since Markdown does not support all the formatting capabilities of Text Notes, some formatting may be lost and some unsupported elements may even be dropped.
      • Markdown Notes → Text Notes — each Markdown note is converted to a Text Note.
    • For each converted note, a revision is saved automatically, allowing you to restore the original or recover any missing elements from it.
    • 这允许将笔记从一种类型转换为另一种类型：
      • 文本笔记（Text Notes）→ Markdown 笔记（Markdown Notes）——每个文本（Text）笔记都被转换为Markdown笔记。由于 Markdown 不支持文本笔记的所有格式功能，一些格式可能会丢失，一些不支持的元素甚至可能被丢弃。
      • Markdown 笔记（Markdown Notes）→ 文本笔记（Text Notes）——每个Markdown笔记都被转换为文本（Text）笔记。
    • 对于每个转换后的笔记，会自动保存一个修订版本，允许你从中恢复原始版本或找回任何缺失的元素。
  • Save revision / 保存修订
    • Automatically creates a revision of each note. Optionally, a name can be assigned to this revision. See Note Revisions.
    • 自动创建每个笔记的修订版本。可选地，可以为该修订版本分配一个名称。参见笔记修订（Note Revisions）。
  • Delete note / 删除笔记
    • For each note, it will be deleted.
    • As an alternative for less complex situations, the notes can be removed directly from within the Note Tree by selecting them and pressing Delete.
    • 对于每个笔记，它将被删除。
    • 作为较简单情况的替代方案，可以通过在笔记树（Note Tree）中选择它们并按 Delete 直接移除笔记。
  • Delete note revisions / 删除笔记修订
    • This will delete all the Note Revisions of the notes.
    • 这将删除笔记的所有笔记修订（Note Revisions）。

Others

其他

  • Execute script / 执行脚本
    • For more complex scenarios, it is possible to type in a JavaScript expression in order to apply the necessary changes.
    • Examples:

      • To apply a suffix (- suffix in this example), to the note title:

        note.title = note.title + " - suffix";

      • To alter attributes of a note based on another attribute, such as setting the #shareAlias label to the title of the note:

        note.setLabel("shareAlias", note.title)
    • 对于更复杂的场景，可以输入 JavaScript 表达式以应用必要的更改。
    • 示例：

      • 要给笔记标题添加后缀（在此示例中为 - suffix）：

        note.title = note.title + " - suffix";

      • 要根据另一个属性更改笔记的属性，例如将 #shareAlias 标签设置为笔记的标题：

        note.setLabel("shareAlias", note.title)

title: Note source(笔记来源)
full:
Understanding the source code of the different notes

理解不同笔记的源代码

Internally, the structure of the content of each note is different based on the Note Types. 在内部，每个笔记内容的结构根据笔记类型（Note Types）而不同。

For example: 例如：

  • Text notes are represented internally as HTML, using the CKEditor representation. Note that due to the custom plugins, some HTML elements are specific to Trilium only, for example the admonitions.
  • Code notes are plain text and are represented internally as-is.
  • Geo Map notes contain only minimal information (viewport, zoom) as a JSON.
  • Canvases notes are represented as JSON, with Trilium's own information alongside with Excalidraw's internal JSON representation format.
  • Mind Map notes are represented as JSON, with the internal format of MindElixir.
  • 文本（Text）笔记在内部表示为 HTML，使用 CKEditor 表示。请注意，由于自定义插件，一些 HTML 元素是 Trilium 特有的，例如提醒（admonitions）。
  • 代码（Code）笔记是纯文本，在内部按原样表示。
  • 地理地图（Geo Map）笔记仅以 JSON 形式包含最少信息（视口、缩放）。
  • 画布（Canvases）笔记表示为 JSON，包含 Trilium 自身的信息以及 Excalidraw 的内部 JSON 表示格式。
  • 思维导图（Mind Map）笔记表示为 JSON，使用 MindElixir 的内部格式。

Note that some information is also stored as Attachments. For example Canvases notes use the attachments feature to store the custom libraries, and alongside with Mind Map and other similar note types it stores an SVG representation of the content for use in other features such as including in other notes, shared notes, etc. 请注意，一些信息也存储为附件（Attachments）。例如画布（Canvases）笔记使用附件功能存储自定义库，并且与思维导图（Mind Map）及其他类似笔记类型一起，它存储内容的 SVG 表示，用于诸如包含在其他笔记、共享笔记等其它功能中。

Here's part of the HTML representation of this note, as it's stored in the database (but prettified). 以下是此笔记的 HTML 表示的一部分，即存储在数据库中的样子（但经过美化）。

<h2>
	Understanding the source code of the different notes
</h2>
<p>
	Internally, the structure of the content of each note is different based on the 
	<a class="reference-link" href="#root/Q0A1Gg3pgIOP">
		Note Types
	</a>
	.
</p>

Viewing the source code

查看源代码

It is possible to view the source code of a note by pressing the contextual menu in Note buttons and selecting Note source. 可以通过按 Note buttons（笔记按钮）中的上下文菜单并选择_笔记源代码（Note source）_来查看笔记的源代码。

（图片：笔记源代码）

The source code will be displayed in a new tab. 源代码将显示在一个新选项卡中。

For some note types, such as text notes and JSON notes, the source code is also formatted in order to be more easily readable. 对于某些笔记类型，例如文本笔记和 JSON 笔记，源代码也会被格式化以便更容易阅读。

Modifying the source code

修改源代码

It is possible to modify the source code of a note directly, however not via the Note source functionality. 可以直接修改笔记的源代码，但不能通过_笔记源代码（Note source）_功能。

To do so: 要做到这一点：

  1. Change the note type from the real note type (e.g. Canvas, Geo Type) to Code (plain text) or the corresponding format such as JSON or HTML.
  2. Confirm the warning about changing the note type.
  3. The source code will appear, make the necessary modifications.
  4. Change the note type back to the real note type.
  5. 将笔记类型从真实笔记类型（例如 画布（Canvas）、地理类型（Geo Type））更改为代码（Code）（纯文本）或相应的格式，如 JSON 或 HTML。
  6. 确认关于更改笔记类型的警告。
  7. 源代码将出现，进行必要的修改。
  8. 将笔记类型改回真实笔记类型。

Depending on the changes made, there is a risk that the note will not render properly. It's best to save a revision before making any big changes.

If the note does not render properly, modify the source code again or revert to a prior revision. Since the error handling for unexpected changes might not always be perfect, it be required to refresh the application. 警告：根据所做的更改，存在笔记无法正确渲染的风险。在进行任何重大更改之前，最好保存一个修订版本。

如果笔记无法正确渲染，请再次修改源代码或恢复到之前的修订版本。由于对意外更改的错误处理可能并不总是完美的，可能需要刷新应用程序。

title: Hidden Notes(隐藏笔记)
full:
（图片：隐藏笔记）

For easy extensibility, a lot of features in Trilium make use of actual notes to store information as opposed to having them stored in a separate location in the database. This allows some functions such as Attributes, Relations or even Search and Links to be able to operate on them. 为了易于扩展，Trilium 中的许多功能使用实际笔记来存储信息，而不是将它们存储在数据库中的单独位置。这允许一些功能（例如属性（Attributes）、关系（Relations），甚至搜索（Search）和链接（Links））能够对它们进行操作。

As the name suggests, these notes are hidden to the user by default to prevent cluttering the note tree and to prevent them from being accidentally deleted. 顾名思义，这些笔记默认对用户隐藏，以防止笔记树杂乱，并防止它们被意外删除。

The hidden notes are stored in the user's Database just like normal notes, but they have a unique Note ID which allows them to be distinguished from the normal ones. 隐藏笔记像普通笔记一样存储在用户的数据库（Database）中，但它们有唯一的笔记 ID（Note ID），这使得它们可以与普通笔记区分开来。

Accessing the hidden note tree

访问隐藏笔记树

From the Global menu, select Advanced → Show Hidden Subtree. 从全局菜单（Global menu）中，选择_高级（Advanced）_ → 显示隐藏子树（Show Hidden Subtree）。

Contents of the hidden note tree

隐藏笔记树的内容

Here is a brief summary of all the notes within the hidden tree: 以下是隐藏树中所有笔记的简要总结：

Note / 笔记 Description / 描述
Note Map
笔记地图

This note is actually opened when the Note Map feature that is accessed from the Launch Bar.

It is possible to create any child notes in it without any additional meaning. For example, it can be used to store a list of note maps which can be linked to from other notes or bookmarked.


当从 启动栏（Launch Bar） 访问 笔记地图（Note Map） 功能时，实际打开的就是此笔记。
可以在其中创建任何子笔记而不带有任何额外含义。例如，它可以用来存储笔记地图列表，这些地图可以从其他笔记链接或被收藏（bookmarked）。
SQL Console History
SQL 控制台历史

When SQL queries or commands are executed in the SQL Console, they are stored here, grouped by month. Only the query is stored and not the results.

This section can be accessed without going to the hidden tree by simply going to the Global menu and selecting Advanced → Open SQL Console History.

Notes can be added as children of this tree, but it's generally not recommended to do so to not interfere with the normal history process.


当在 SQL 控制台（SQL Console） 中执行 SQL 查询或命令时，它们会被存储在这里，按月份分组。只存储查询而不存储结果。
无需进入隐藏树即可访问此部分，只需前往 全局菜单（Global menu） 并选择 高级（Advanced）→ 打开 SQL 控制台历史（Open SQL Console History）。
可以在此树下添加笔记作为子节点，但通常不建议这样做，以免干扰正常的历史记录过程。
Search History
搜索历史

Whenever a search is executed from the full Search, the query will be stored here, grouped by month. Only the search parameters are stored and not the results themselves.
